ti: Mai Kivelä: Hallituksen lakiesitys lyhytvuokrauksen ongelmiin puuttumiseksi jäi täysin hampaattomaksi
s: Left Alliance MP Mai Kivelä submitted a dissenting opinion in the Environment Committee against the government's proposal on short-term rental regulation, arguing it weakens current law by cementing a 90-day rental right and provides no tools for municipalities to address problems.

q.o: Hallituksen esitys jätti alun alkaenkin toivomisen varaa, mutta valiokuntakäsittelyssä se lässähti totaalisesti
q.t: The government's proposal left much to be desired from the start, but in committee processing it completely fell flat

q.o: Käytännössä lakiesitys nyt heikentää nykytilaa sementoimalla lakiin oikeuden lyhytvuokrata asuntoa joka tapauksessa 90 päivän ajan
q.t: In practice, the legislative proposal now weakens the current situation by cementing into law the right to short-term rent an apartment for 90 days in any case

q.o: Hallituksen esityksessä painottuvat asunnon vuokraajien oikeudet ja omaisuudensuoja. Pysyvät asukkaat sekä lyhytvuokrauksen kanssa täysin pulassa olevat kunnat ohitetaan
q.t: The government's proposal emphasizes the rights of apartment renters and property protection. Permanent residents and municipalities completely struggling with short-term rentals are bypassed

q.o: Tarvitsemme lakiesityksen, joka on oikeustilaa aidosti selkeyttävä, asukkaiden oikeuksia vahvistava ja jolla pystytään tiukemmin puuttumaan lyhytvuokrauksen haittoihin
q.t: We need a legislative proposal that genuinely clarifies the legal situation, strengthens residents' rights, and can more strictly address the harms of short-term rentals

ti: Honkasalo vaatii Helsingin tekoälyn käytölle selkeitä pelisääntöjä valtuustoaloitteella
s: Left Alliance city councillor and MP Veronika Honkasalo submitted a council initiative on 4 November 2026 demanding that the City of Helsinki investigate how artificial intelligence is used across municipal services and establish clear, democratically processed principles for AI use, including safeguards for data protection, equality, transparency, and citizens' rights to human decision-making.

q.o: Meidän on tiedettävä, mitä tekoälyllä kaupungin palveluissa tehdään ja millaisia vaikutuksia sillä on ihmisten arkeen. Erityisesti lasten, nuorten ja haavoittuvassa asemassa olevien asiakkaiden kohdalla tarvitaan selkeitä rajoja. Periaatteellista päätöstä tekoälyn hyödyntämisestä ei pidä jättää yksin virkamiesjohdon käsiin, vaan myös luottamushenkilöiden ja kaupunkilaisten on voitava osallistua yhteisten pelisääntöjen määrittelyyn
q.t: We must know what is being done with AI in the city's services and what effects it has on people's everyday lives. Especially in the case of children, young people and clients in vulnerable positions, clear boundaries are needed. The principled decision on the use of AI should not be left solely to the civil service management, but elected officials and residents must also be able to participate in defining common rules

q.o: Tekoäly voi olla hyödyllinen työkalu, mutta vastuun päätöksistä on säilyttävä ihmisellä. Kaupunkilaisilla on oltava oikeus tietää, milloin heidän asioidensa käsittelyssä käytetään tekoälyä
q.t: AI can be a useful tool, but responsibility for decisions must remain with humans. Residents must have the right to know when AI is used in processing their matters

ti: Pia Lohikoski: Vasemmistoliitto ei kannata tasokokeita perusopetukseen
s: Left Alliance MP Pia Lohikoski opposes the Audit Committee's proposal for mandatory national standardized tests in basic education, citing unanimous opposition from the Education Committee and over 650 education researchers.

q.o: Teimme asiasta sivistysvaliokunnassa yksimielisen lausunnon, jossa kansallisia kokeita ei kannateta. Nyt myös yli 650 kasvatuksen ja koulutuksen tutkijaa on allekirjoittanut tasokokeita vastustavan vetoomuksen
q.t: We made a unanimous statement in the Education Committee in which national tests are not supported. Now also over 650 education and training researchers have signed a petition opposing standardized tests

q.o: Merkittävä riski kansallisissa tasokokeissa on myös, että niiden perusteella aletaan laittaa kouluja paremmuusjärjestykseen, ja segregaatio vain kasvaa.
q.t: A significant risk in national standardized tests is also that schools will start to be ranked based on them, and segregation will only increase.

q.o: Opetus saattaa kaventua, kun kansallisten kokeiden vuoksi keskitytään helposti mitattaviin asioihin. Tässä maailmassa meillä ei todellakaan ole varaa tinkiä laaja-alaisesta opetuksesta ja yleissivistyksestä.
q.t: Teaching may narrow when, due to national tests, focus is easily placed on things that are easy to measure. In this world we really cannot afford to compromise on broad-based education and general education.

ti: Merja Kyllönen ja Katri Kulmuni: AdBlue-ongelman ratkaisu eteni EU-parlamentissa
s: Left Alliance MEP Merja Kyllönen and Centre Party MEP Katri Kulmuni secured European Parliament committee support for provisions addressing freezing problems in diesel vehicle AdBlue emission-control systems in cold northern conditions, as part of the Automotive Omnibus regulatory package.

q.o: Suomessa pakkanen kuuluu tavalliseen talveen. Kuljetusyrittäjän tai autoilijan ei pitäisi joutua maksamaan siitä, etteivät ajoneuvon järjestelmät kestä niitä oloja, joissa niitä käytetään. Olemme vaatineet tähän korjausta, ja nyt työ tuottaa tulosta
q.t: In Finland, freezing temperatures are part of a normal winter. A transport entrepreneur or motorist should not have to pay for the fact that vehicle systems cannot withstand the conditions in which they are used. We have demanded a correction to this, and now the work is producing results

q.o: Pohjoisen ongelman saaminen mukaan laajaan eurooppalaiseen lakipakettiin ei ole ollut itsestään selvää. Suomalainen sisu on tullut tarpeeseen, mutta ennen kaikkea tulos on syntynyt yhteistyöstä yli puoluerajojen ja alan toimijoilta saadusta tuesta
q.t: Getting the northern problem included in a broad European legislative package has not been self-evident. Finnish determination has been needed, but above all the result has come from cooperation across party lines and support from industry actors

q.o: Päästövähennystavoitteista pidetään kiinni, mutta keinojen on toimittava myös pohjoisen pakkasissa. Sääntelyn pitää mahdollistaa ratkaisut, joilla päästöt vähenevät ja kalusto toimii luotettavasti ympäri vuoden
q.t: Emission reduction targets are being maintained, but the means must also work in northern freezing conditions. Regulation must enable solutions where emissions decrease and equipment operates reliably year-round

q.o: Nyt Suomen hallituksen, ministerien ja virkamiesten on huolehdittava siitä, että pohjoisen olosuhteet saavat tuen myös neuvostossa. Olemme saaneet parlamentissa tärkeän askeleen eteenpäin. Seuraavaksi on varmistettava, että tämä työ johtaa suomalaisten ihmisten ja yritysten arjessa toimivaan ratkaisuun
q.t: Now the Finnish government, ministers and officials must ensure that northern conditions receive support also in the Council. We have achieved an important step forward in Parliament. Next it must be ensured that this work leads to a solution that works in the everyday lives of Finnish people and businesses

ti: Timo Furuholm: Keinoja köyhyyskriisin ratkaisemiseksi kyllä löytyisi
s: Left Alliance MP Timo Furuholm delivered a group speech in parliament during debate on an opposition interpellation concerning the cost of living, criticizing the right-wing government for worsening poverty and proposing measures including restoring social security protections, child supplements to unemployment benefits, full index increases to benefits, restarting social housing production, and establishing a national crisis mechanism to support low-income people.

q.o: Ministeri Purra lupasi, että pienituloisilta leikkaaminen ei perussuomalaisille käy. Sen jälkeen pienituloisilta on leikattu jokaisessa budjetissa. Ei tullut euron bensaa. Ei tullut 100 000 uutta työpaikkaa. Ei lopetettu velaksi elämistä. Sen sijaan saatiin työttömyys- ja köyhyyskriisi.
q.t: Minister Purra promised that cutting from low-income people would not be acceptable to the Finns Party. After that, low-income people have been cut in every budget. There was no one-euro gasoline. There were no 100,000 new jobs. Living on debt was not stopped. Instead, we got an unemployment and poverty crisis.

q.o: Vasemmistoliitto palauttaisi suojaosat sosiaaliturvaan, lapsikorotuksen työttömyysturvaan ja toteuttaisi indeksikorotukset etuuksiin täysimääräisesti. Myös alas ajettu sosiaalinen asuntotuotanto pitäisi potkaista jälleen käyntiin, jotta ihmisillä olisi tulevaisuudessakin kohtuuhintaisia koteja.
q.t: The Left Alliance would restore protected portions to social security, child supplements to unemployment benefits, and implement index increases to benefits in full. The run-down social housing production should also be kicked back into action so that people would have affordable homes in the future as well.

q.o: Me vasemmistoliitossa emme vaadi mahdottomia. Me vaadimme politiikkaa, jolla pidetään kaikki ihmiset mukana. Politiikkaa, joka palvelee tavallisia suomalaisia, ei vain miljonäärejä. Politiikan tehtävä on turvata ihmisarvoinen elämä kaikille – ei vain harvoille.
q.t: We in the Left Alliance do not demand the impossible. We demand politics that keeps all people included. Politics that serves ordinary Finns, not just millionaires. The task of politics is to secure a dignified life for everyone – not just for the few.

ti: Islam: da Monfalcone FdI rilancia sfida a velo integrale e separatismo
s: Brothers of Italy announces a legislative proposal requiring transparency on mosque financing, banning full-face veils, increasing penalties for arranged marriages, and prohibiting virginity certificates, while criticizing left-wing parties for allegedly allying with Islamism.

q.o: L'integrazione richiede il rispetto delle nostre regole, mentre in diversi Paesi europei fino al 64% dei musulmani ritiene che la sharia venga prima delle leggi dello Stato
q.t: Integration requires respect for our rules, while in various European countries up to 64% of Muslims believe that sharia comes before state laws

q.o: Chi sceglie di vivere nella nostra nazione è tenuto ad accettarne fino in fondo le regole e i principi costituzionali, sottoscrivendo le intese previste dall'articolo 8 della Costituzione e garantendo piena trasparenza su chi finanzia le moschee
q.t: Those who choose to live in our nation are required to fully accept its rules and constitutional principles, subscribing to the agreements provided by Article 8 of the Constitution and guaranteeing full transparency on who finances mosques

q.o: Con la nostra proposta di legge contrastiamo le sacche di separatismo religioso e le 'no-go zone' in cui vige la Sharia, introducendo l'obbligo di trasparenza sui finanziamenti esteri alle moschee con la chiusura dei centri non a norma, l'aumento delle pene per i matrimoni combinati e il reato che vieta i certificati di verginità
q.t: With our legislative proposal we combat pockets of religious separatism and 'no-go zones' where Sharia prevails, introducing the obligation of transparency on foreign financing to mosques with the closure of non-compliant centers, increased penalties for arranged marriages and the crime that prohibits virginity certificates

q.o: Se in alcuni Paesi islamici alle donne è vietato uscire scoperte, in Italia non sarà consentito circolare a volto coperto, né tollereremo più scene come quelle che si vedono anche a Monfalcone, con le donne costrette a camminare dietro agli uomini
q.t: If in some Islamic countries women are forbidden to go out uncovered, in Italy it will not be permitted to circulate with a covered face, nor will we tolerate scenes like those seen also in Monfalcone, with women forced to walk behind men

ti: Diritti: tutela disabilità entra con più forza in costituzione
s: Brothers of Italy senators announced the Senate's unanimous first-reading approval of the Guidi bill amending Article 38 of the Italian Constitution to replace the term 'minorati' with 'persone con disabilità' and guarantee rights to autonomy and participation for people with disabilities.

q.o: Con il ddl Guidi, approvato oggi in prima lettura al Senato con voto unanime, compiamo un passo importante verso il riconoscimento dei diritti delle persone con disabilità nella nostra Costituzione.
q.t: With the Guidi bill, approved today in first reading in the Senate with a unanimous vote, we take an important step toward the recognition of the rights of people with disabilities in our Constitution.

q.o: Superiamo il termine 'minorati', ormai anacronistico e connotato negativamente, per riconoscere il diritto all'autonomia e alla partecipazione effettiva alla vita politica, economica e sociale del Paese.
q.t: We move beyond the term 'minorati', now anachronistic and negatively connoted, to recognize the right to autonomy and effective participation in the political, economic and social life of the country.

q.o: Con questa riforma superiamo un'espressione ormai anacronistica come 'minorati', sostituendola con 'persone con disabilità', e introduciamo un principio fondamentale: la Repubblica garantisce il diritto all'autonomia e all'effettiva partecipazione all'organizzazione politica, economica e sociale, rimuovendo gli ostacoli che ne impediscono l'esercizio.
q.t: With this reform we move beyond an expression now anachronistic like 'minorati', replacing it with 'people with disabilities', and we introduce a fundamental principle: the Republic guarantees the right to autonomy and effective participation in political, economic and social organization, removing obstacles that prevent its exercise.

ti: 4 novembre: omaggio a chi serve e difende Italia ogni giorno
s: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni issued a statement on November 4th honoring Italy's Armed Forces and commemorating fallen soldiers, including four military personnel recently killed in Bosnia.

q.o: Il 4 novembre è il giorno in cui l'Italia rende onore alla sua storia, alla sua Unità e a tutti coloro che hanno scelto di servire la Patria, anche a costo della propria vita.
q.t: November 4th is the day when Italy honors its history, its Unity and all those who have chosen to serve the Homeland, even at the cost of their own lives.

q.o: In questi giorni, il dolore per la perdita dei nostri quattro militari in Bosnia ci ha ricordato, ancora una volta, quanto possa essere alto il prezzo di questa scelta.
q.t: In these days, the pain for the loss of our four military personnel in Bosnia has reminded us, once again, how high the price of this choice can be.

q.o: A tutte le donne e gli uomini delle Forze Armate, che ogni giorno servono l'Italia con dedizione e coraggio, va la nostra gratitudine. Onore ai nostri caduti. Viva le Forze Armate. Viva l'Italia.
q.t: To all the women and men of the Armed Forces, who serve Italy every day with dedication and courage, goes our gratitude. Honor to our fallen. Long live the Armed Forces. Long live Italy.

ti: Consumi: al via carta Dedicata a Te, aiuti per un milione di famiglie
s: Minister Francesco Lollobrigida announced the launch on November 4 of the "Carta Dedicata a Te" program, allocating over 1 billion euros to support one million vulnerable Italian families while supporting domestic agri-food sectors.

q.o: Con l'avvio oggi 4 novembre della Carta Dedicata a Te manteniamo un impegno preciso nei confronti delle famiglie italiane, destinando oltre 1 miliardo di euro ai nuclei più fragili.
q.t: With the launch today, November 4, of the Carta Dedicata a Te, we maintain a precise commitment to Italian families, allocating over 1 billion euros to the most fragile households.

q.o: La nostra è una scelta di visione: no all'assistenzialismo passivo, sì a un sostegno concreto e dignitoso che protegge il potere d'acquisto degli italiani e, al contempo, difende l'eccellenza delle nostre filiere agroalimentari, della pesca e dell'agricoltura di qualità.
q.t: Ours is a choice of vision: no to passive welfare, yes to concrete and dignified support that protects the purchasing power of Italians and, at the same time, defends the excellence of our agri-food supply chains, fishing and quality agriculture.

ti: Agricoltura: oltre un miliardo per rafforzare filiere italiane
s: The Italian Senate unanimously approved the ColtivaItalia bill, allocating over 1.1 billion euros to support Italian agriculture through business support, research, generational renewal, and Made in Italy protection.

q.o: Con l'approvazione definitiva del ddl ColtivaItalia, diventa legge un importante provvedimento a sostegno dei nostri agricoltori. Oltre un miliardo di euro di investimenti per sostenere chi ogni giorno, con sacrificio, passione e dedizione, lavora la nostra terra, custodisce le nostre tradizioni e contribuisce alla crescita dell'economia nazionale.
q.t: With the final approval of the ColtivaItalia bill, an important measure in support of our farmers becomes law. Over one billion euros of investments to support those who every day, with sacrifice, passion and dedication, work our land, preserve our traditions and contribute to the growth of the national economy.

q.o: Oggi il Senato della Repubblica ha approvato senza nessun voto contrario il Coltivaitalia, una proposta che avevo presentato nel 2025: oltre 1 miliardo e 100 milioni di euro per interventi destinati a rafforzare il mondo agricolo italiano, renderlo più forte in termini strutturali, intervenire sulle criticità e aiutare l'Italia a essere garantita nelle sue produzioni di alta qualità e poterle mettere a disposizione dei suoi cittadini e del mondo.
q.t: Today the Senate of the Republic approved without any vote against ColtivaItalia, a proposal I presented in 2025: over 1 billion and 100 million euros for interventions aimed at strengthening the Italian agricultural world, making it structurally stronger, addressing critical issues and helping Italy to be guaranteed in its high-quality productions and to make them available to its citizens and the world.

ti: Sud: ‘Locomotiva d’Italia’, un tour per illustrare successi governo
s: Brothers of Italy launches a multi-city tour across southern Italy called 'Sud - Locomotiva d'Italia' to illustrate the Meloni government's achievements for the Mezzogiorno, including the Zes Unica special economic zone and employment measures.

q.o: Questo Governo considera tra le sue priorità il Sud. E sono tante le misure, a partire dalla Zes Unica, che ne dimostrano l'impegno. I risultati, a differenza di quanto asserisce la sinistra, sono i fatti: pil in aumento, occupazione record, soprattutto al Sud e soprattutto tra giovani e donne.
q.t: This Government considers the South among its priorities. And there are many measures, starting with the Zes Unica, that demonstrate the commitment. The results, unlike what the left asserts, are the facts: GDP increasing, record employment, especially in the South and especially among young people and women.

q.o: Con Fratelli d'Italia, non più assistenzialismo ma lavoro: il Mezzogiorno è diventato la locomotiva della Nazione per crescita e occupazione. E adesso grazie alla manovra del governo Meloni raddoppiamo i fondi per la Zes unica e proroghiamo gli sgravi al 100% per chi assume.
q.t: With Brothers of Italy, no more welfare dependency but work: the Mezzogiorno has become the locomotive of the Nation for growth and employment. And now thanks to the Meloni government's budget we are doubling the funds for the Zes Unica and extending 100% tax breaks for those who hire.

q.o: Il Mezzogiorno non è soltanto un territorio da rilanciare, ma un'infrastruttura strategica per l'intera nazione. Con 'Sud-Locomotiva d'Italia' vogliamo raccontare quanto è stato fatto e le ulteriori prospettive di sviluppo, a partire dalla prossima manovra economica.
q.t: The Mezzogiorno is not only a territory to relaunch, but a strategic infrastructure for the entire nation. With 'Sud-Locomotiva d'Italia' we want to tell what has been done and the further development prospects, starting with the next economic budget.

ti: Covid: governo Conte rifiutò monoclonali gratuiti. Speranza ha mentito
s: Brothers of Italy parliamentarians accused the former Conte II government and ex-Health Minister Speranza of wrongly refusing a free donation of 10,000 monoclonal antibody doses from Eli Lilly during the pandemic while investing 15 million euros in a competing Tuscan foundation project that never produced doses.

q.o: Ricevere 10 mila dosi di monoclonali da parte di Eli Lilly durante la pandemia rappresentava 'un'opportunità straordinariamente interessante' per curare i pazienti affetti da Covid. Opportunità che tuttavia il governo Conte II ha inspiegabilmente e colpevolmente rifiutato.
q.t: Receiving 10 thousand doses of monoclonals from Eli Lilly during the pandemic represented 'an extraordinarily interesting opportunity' to treat patients affected by Covid. An opportunity that however the Conte II government inexplicably and culpably refused.

q.o: Il progetto, finanziato con soldi pubblici, non ha mai realmente visto produzione di una sola dose di anticorpo monoclonale, si è rivelato soltanto un vergognoso spreco di denaro pubblico, soprattutto considerando che l'Italia avrebbe potuto salvare molte vite senza spendere un euro grazie ai monoclonali della Eli Lilly
q.t: The project, financed with public money, never actually saw production of a single dose of monoclonal antibody, it proved to be only a shameful waste of public money, especially considering that Italy could have saved many lives without spending a euro thanks to Eli Lilly's monoclonals

ti: Cybersicurezza: guerra ibrida è realtà, investire in difesa
s: Brothers of Italy parliamentarians called for increased investment in cybersecurity and defense following cyberattacks on European infrastructure including Italian supermarkets, describing hybrid warfare as a current reality and praising the Meloni government's response through the National Cybersecurity Agency.

q.o: Gli attacchi informatici che in queste ore stanno colpendo infrastrutture e attività produttive in diversi Paesi europei, Italia compresa, dimostrano quanto la sicurezza cibernetica sia ormai parte integrante della nostra sicurezza nazionale. La guerra ibrida non è uno scenario futuro: è una realtà con cui dobbiamo confrontarci già oggi.
q.t: The cyberattacks that are currently hitting infrastructure and productive activities in several European countries, including Italy, demonstrate how much cybersecurity is now an integral part of our national security. Hybrid warfare is not a future scenario: it is a reality we must confront today.

q.o: Per questo è fondamentale continuare a investire nella difesa, nella sicurezza e nella resilienza cibernetica del nostro Paese. Proteggere le infrastrutture strategiche, le imprese, i servizi essenziali e il sistema finanziario significa proteggere concretamente la libertà e la sicurezza degli italiani.
q.t: For this reason it is essential to continue investing in defense, security and cyber resilience of our country. Protecting strategic infrastructure, businesses, essential services and the financial system means concretely protecting the freedom and security of Italians.

q.o: Il governo Meloni sta affrontando la situazione attraverso l'Agenzia per la Cybersicurezza Nazionale e il coordinamento delle strutture di sicurezza, con attività di monitoraggio e indicazioni operative per rafforzare le difese delle aziende coinvolte.
q.t: The Meloni government is addressing the situation through the National Cybersecurity Agency and the coordination of security structures, with monitoring activities and operational guidance to strengthen the defenses of the companies involved.

q.o: La cybersicurezza non può essere considerata un costo accessorio, ma un investimento sulla sicurezza nazionale e sulla quotidianità dei cittadini
q.t: Cybersecurity cannot be considered an accessory cost, but an investment in national security and the daily lives of citizens
