ti: Il PCI al centenario di Akel (Partito Progressista del Popolo Lavoratore) a Cipro
s: The Italian Communist Party participated as a delegation in the centenary celebration of AKEL (Progressive Party of Working People) in Nicosia, Cyprus, on November 6-7, alongside more than thirty communist parties from around the world, and attended an international seminar on the contemporary left.

q.o: Come Partito Comunista Italiano siamo stati onorati nel partecipare come delegazione a tale evento, insieme a più di trenta partiti comunisti provenienti da tutto il mondo, e al seminario internazionale 'La sinistra e il mondo contemporaneo'.
q.t: As the Italian Communist Party we were honored to participate as a delegation in this event, together with more than thirty communist parties from around the world, and in the international seminar 'The Left and the Contemporary World'.

q.o: Come PCI comprendiamo e condividiamo quindi la richiesta che AKEL pone a livello interno ed internazionale di porre fine all'occupazione, e di ritrovare, nel rispetto della convivenza e dei diritti di tutto il suo popolo, l'unità e la propria completa sovranità.
q.t: As PCI we therefore understand and share the request that AKEL makes at the internal and international level to end the occupation, and to regain, respecting the coexistence and rights of all its people, unity and its complete sovereignty.

ti: A 109 anni dalla rivoluzione d’Ottobre
s: The Italian Communist Party issued a statement commemorating the 109th anniversary of the October Revolution, reaffirming its communist identity and calling for continued struggle for socialism against capitalism, imperialism, and inequality.

q.o: Con la Rivoluzione d'Ottobre le parole Socialismo e Comunismo uscirono dal solo campo delle idee per entrare nella concretezza della realizzazione storica.
q.t: With the October Revolution the words Socialism and Communism left the field of ideas alone to enter the concreteness of historical realization.

q.o: Oggi, in un mondo attraversato da guerre, imperialismo, precarietà e ingiustizie, ricordare la Rivoluzione d'Ottobre non significa guardare nostalgicamente al passato. Significa riconoscere che la necessità di trasformare radicalmente la società è ancora tutta davanti a noi.
q.t: Today, in a world crossed by wars, imperialism, precarity and injustices, remembering the October Revolution does not mean looking nostalgically at the past. It means recognizing that the necessity to radically transform society is still entirely before us.

q.o: La storia non è finita. La lotta per il socialismo continua.
q.t: History is not finished. The struggle for socialism continues.

ti: PCI: rapimento e detenzione di Giorgia Lombardi e Lorenzo Diofili; la libertà non si tocca, subito il rilascio!
s: The Ligurian Federation of the Italian Communist Party condemned the detention of Italian volunteers Giorgia Lombardi and Lorenzo Diofili in the West Bank and called on the Italian government to secure their immediate release through diplomatic intervention.

q.o: Come Federazione ligure del Partito Comunista Italiano esprimiamo la più profonda indignazione e la ferma condanna per il rapimento e la detenzione degli spezzini Giorgia Lombardi e Lorenzo Diofili, volontari italiani impegnati in Cisgiordania al fianco della popolazione palestinese e delle comunità contadine, in un'attività di solidarietà e accompagnamento internazionale.
q.t: As the Ligurian Federation of the Italian Communist Party we express the deepest indignation and firm condemnation for the kidnapping and detention of Giorgia Lombardi and Lorenzo Diofili from La Spezia, Italian volunteers engaged in the West Bank alongside the Palestinian population and peasant communities, in an activity of solidarity and international accompaniment.
q.sp: Partito Comunista Italiano - Federazione della Liguria

q.o: Rivolgiamo un appello diretto al Governo italiano, alla Presidenza del Consiglio e al Ministro degli Esteri affinché la Farnesina intervenga immediatamente, utilizzando tutti gli strumenti diplomatici a disposizione per ottenere la liberazione di Giorgia e di Lorenzo assieme alle altre volontarie e agli altri volontari coinvolti, verificare le loro condizioni, garantire la loro incolumità e assicurare il pieno rispetto dei loro diritti.
q.t: We make a direct appeal to the Italian Government, to the Presidency of the Council and to the Foreign Minister so that the Farnesina intervenes immediately, using all available diplomatic instruments to obtain the release of Giorgia and Lorenzo together with the other volunteers involved, verify their conditions, guarantee their safety and ensure full respect for their rights.
q.sp: Partito Comunista Italiano - Federazione della Liguria

q.o: Come comunisti, consideriamo l'internazionalismo non una parola da utilizzare nelle occasioni commemorative, ma un principio politico da praticare ogni giorno.
q.t: As communists, we consider internationalism not a word to be used on commemorative occasions, but a political principle to be practiced every day.
q.sp: Partito Comunista Italiano - Federazione della Liguria

ti: La strategia dello smantellamento
s: The Italian Communist Party criticizes the 2027 Budget Law presented by the Meloni government, arguing it dismantles collective guarantees through selective tax measures, pension restrictions, and insufficient funding for public health and education while shifting responsibility for rights from the state to individual economic capacity.

q.o: Prima di entrare nel merito delle misure principali, voglio dire che, a monte, la filosofia che governa anche questa Manovra di bilancio è stata quella di concentrare le risorse, non moltissime, che avevamo a disposizione sulle stesse priorità alle quali ci siamo dedicati nei quattro anni che sono passati: famiglia, natalità, riduzione delle tasse, tutela del potere d'acquisto, incentivi al lavoro, incentivi alle imprese, salute dei cittadini
q.t: Before going into the details of the main measures, I want to say that, fundamentally, the philosophy governing this Budget Maneuver has been to concentrate the resources, not very many, that we had available on the same priorities to which we have dedicated ourselves in the four years that have passed: family, birth rate, tax reduction, protection of purchasing power, work incentives, business incentives, citizens' health

q.o: Possiamo già affermare che questa manovra non offre risposte adeguate all'emergenza economica e sociale del Paese. Le misure previste non incidono sulle cause dell'impoverimento, non restituiscono potere d'acquisto ai salari e non rafforzano in modo strutturale i servizi pubblici.
q.t: We can already state that this maneuver does not offer adequate responses to the country's economic and social emergency. The planned measures do not address the causes of impoverishment, do not restore purchasing power to wages, and do not structurally strengthen public services.

q.o: Non siamo di fronte soltanto a singole misure da discutere o a benefici da quantificare. Siamo di fronte a un indirizzo politico che dobbiamo contrastare, perché le sue conseguenze non si misurano soltanto nei singoli provvedimenti, ma nel progressivo indebolimento delle condizioni materiali che rendono effettivi i diritti.
q.t: We are not only facing individual measures to discuss or benefits to quantify. We are facing a political direction that we must oppose, because its consequences are not measured only in individual provisions, but in the progressive weakening of the material conditions that make rights effective.

ti: Elezioni di Midterm negli Stati Uniti
s: The Italian Communist Party issued a statement on the 2026 US midterm elections, arguing that while the Democratic victory signals discontent with Trump's policies—especially regarding the Iran conflict and inflation—it does not represent a true alternative, and calling for Europe and Italy to pursue diplomatic solutions and prioritize workers' interests over alignment with US strategy.

q.o: Trump aveva conquistato una parte importante dell'elettorato, soprattutto quello MAGA, promettendo di mettere l'America al primo posto, difendere il potere d'acquisto delle famiglie e tenere gli Stati Uniti lontani da nuove guerre.
q.t: Trump had won an important part of the electorate, especially the MAGA one, promising to put America first, defend families' purchasing power and keep the United States away from new wars.

q.o: Democratici e Repubblicani rappresentano ancora, su molte questioni fondamentali, due facce della stessa medaglia: quella di un sistema politico ed economico dominato dagli interessi del grande capitale, segnato dalle disuguaglianze sociali e dal mantenimento della potenza globale statunitense.
q.t: Democrats and Republicans still represent, on many fundamental issues, two sides of the same coin: that of a political and economic system dominated by the interests of big capital, marked by social inequalities and the maintenance of US global power.

q.o: Non esiste emancipazione senza coscienza di classe, non esiste democrazia compiuta senza giustizia sociale e non può esserci futuro senza pace.
q.t: There is no emancipation without class consciousness, there is no complete democracy without social justice and there can be no future without peace.

ti: Mozione PCI: approvata “Diritto di scelta”
s: The Italian Communist Party's motion on preventive conscientious objection was approved by the Assembly of Municipalities of Circondario Empolese Valdelsa, with the right voting against, following the model of Capaci municipality which allows 17-year-olds to declare conscientious objector status preventively.

q.o: È STATA APPROVATA (LA DESTRA HA VOTATO CONTRO) LA MOZIONE 'DIRITTO DI SCELTA', PRESENTATA DAL GRUPPO PCI DELL'ASSEMBLEA DEI COMUNI CIRCONDARIO EMPOLESE VALDELSA.
q.t: THE MOTION 'RIGHT OF CHOICE' WAS APPROVED (THE RIGHT VOTED AGAINST), PRESENTED BY THE PCI GROUP OF THE ASSEMBLY OF MUNICIPALITIES CIRCONDARIO EMPOLESE VALDELSA.

q.o: Con una delibera di Giunta, il Comune di Capaci, la delibera n°80 del 6 maggio 2026, ha introdotto il principio della obiezione di coscienza preventiva, invitando tutti i diciassettenni (e i loro genitori, trattandosi di minorenni) ad inviare all'ufficio comunale un'Istanza, con cui comunicano di dichiararsi obiettori di coscienza.
q.t: With a council resolution, the Municipality of Capaci, resolution no. 80 of May 6, 2026, introduced the principle of preventive conscientious objection, inviting all seventeen-year-olds (and their parents, being minors) to send to the municipal office a request, with which they communicate their declaration as conscientious objectors.

q.o: O si sposa appieno l'articolo 11 della nostra Costituzione o siamo per il 'Rearm Europe', per l'invio di armi all'Ucraina e favorevoli all'invio di missioni militari italiane all'estero!
q.t: Either one fully embraces Article 11 of our Constitution or we are for 'Rearm Europe', for sending weapons to Ukraine and in favor of sending Italian military missions abroad!

ti: L’oltraggiosa risposta del governo alle manifestazioni degli studenti: nuovi tagli al personale della scuola, altri soldi per le armi
s: The Italian Communist Party condemns the Meloni government's 2027-2028 budget for cutting 7,000 school staff positions and 83.9 million euros from public education while increasing military spending by 14.4 billion euros, calling for mobilization against the cuts and rearmament.

q.o: Il PCI è con i docenti e gli studenti in lotta, per rovesciare la politica voluta dalla grande finanza e dai mercanti e produttori di armi.
q.t: The PCI is with the teachers and students in struggle, to overturn the policy wanted by big finance and the merchants and producers of arms.

q.o: NO al riarmo e NO alla guerra! NO ai tagli e PIÙ investimenti per la scuola pubblica, dove si costruisce il nostro futuro!
q.t: NO to rearmament and NO to war! NO to cuts and MORE investments for public schools, where our future is built!

ti: George Galloway and Yvonne Ridley arrive in Cape Town for Palestine solidarity tour - thestar.co.za
s: George Galloway and Yvonne Ridley arrived in Cape Town for a Palestine solidarity tour.

ti: Dr Ellie Chowns urges PM to publish a roadmap for phasing out fossil fuel company tax breaks at COP31
s: Green Party Parliamentary leader Dr Ellie Chowns wrote to the Prime Minister urging publication of a roadmap to phase out fossil fuel company tax breaks at COP31, strengthen the Oil and Gas Revenue Levy, and push for a global profit tax on oil companies through the UN Tax Convention.

q.o: Less than ten years ago the UK took pride in being a climate leader on the global stage, with overwhelming cross-party consensus on the need for urgent action to reduce emissions and transition away from climate-wrecking fossil fuels. How quickly we have fallen.
q.t: Less than ten years ago the UK took pride in being a climate leader on the global stage, with overwhelming cross-party consensus on the need for urgent action to reduce emissions and transition away from climate-wrecking fossil fuels. How quickly we have fallen.

q.o: Against the political backdrop of the Tories abandoning their commitment to net zero and Reform UK adopting outright climate-denialism, it is unforgiveable that Andy Burnham's Labour is also now taking shocking steps backward when it comes to our climate commitments: approving Jackdaw, refusing to rule out greenlighting Rosebank oilfield, and cutting funding for vital home insultation and clean heating programmes.
q.t: Against the political backdrop of the Tories abandoning their commitment to net zero and Reform UK adopting outright climate-denialism, it is unforgiveable that Andy Burnham's Labour is also now taking shocking steps backward when it comes to our climate commitments: approving Jackdaw, refusing to rule out greenlighting Rosebank oilfield, and cutting funding for vital home insultation and clean heating programmes.

ti: Green Party responds to continuation of power-sharing in Sheffield
s: The Green Party of England and Wales issued a statement after Sheffield City Council's Labour Group reversed its decision to end power-sharing with the Green Group, criticizing Labour leadership's attempted intervention and linking it to Labour's position on Israel.

q.o: In Sheffield, the Green Group have stood firmly by their principles, and are continuing to put residents above political point-scoring. The local Labour Party have also realised that smashing apart their administration at the whims of Labour HQ isn't in residents' interests.
q.t: In Sheffield, the Green Group have stood firmly by their principles, and are continuing to put residents above political point-scoring. The local Labour Party have also realised that smashing apart their administration at the whims of Labour HQ isn't in residents' interests.

q.o: Andy Burnham's authoritarian diktat has angered councillors and residents across the country, including those in his own party. The Labour Party leadership's attempts to force local councillors to tear up agreements they've worked hard to maintain have resulted in their own councillors defying this overreach.
q.t: Andy Burnham's authoritarian diktat has angered councillors and residents across the country, including those in his own party. The Labour Party leadership's attempts to force local councillors to tear up agreements they've worked hard to maintain have resulted in their own councillors defying this overreach.

q.o: The Labour Party leadership's support for Israel seems to have no limit – arming a genocide, locking up pensioners for holding up pieces of paper, and now attempting to disrupt successful local partnerships from delivering for residents.
q.t: The Labour Party leadership's support for Israel seems to have no limit – arming a genocide, locking up pensioners for holding up pieces of paper, and now attempting to disrupt successful local partnerships from delivering for residents.

q.o: would work more constructively together going forward
q.t: would work more constructively together going forward

q.o: what happens in Sheffield will be a matter for both the party chair and the NEC to decide
q.t: what happens in Sheffield will be a matter for both the party chair and the NEC to decide

ti: Green Party writes to the Environment Secretary about ‘advisory’ water councils when public ownership is needed
s: Green Party Deputy Leader Rachel Millward wrote to Environment Secretary Angela Eagle demanding public ownership of failing water companies without compensation, criticizing the government's announcement of eight regional advisory water councils as insufficient bureaucracy.

q.o: I am concerned that you are putting the advice of water industry shareholders and their well-paid lobbyists above the interests of the British people.
q.t: I am concerned that you are putting the advice of water industry shareholders and their well-paid lobbyists above the interests of the British people.

q.o: This bureaucratic proposal only adds to the sense of a tinkering government that talks big but delivers very little. As the Chancellor has said, this is a continuity government.
q.t: This bureaucratic proposal only adds to the sense of a tinkering government that talks big but delivers very little. As the Chancellor has said, this is a continuity government.

q.o: We need failing water companies to be taken into public ownership without further delay.
q.t: We need failing water companies to be taken into public ownership without further delay.

q.o: It is time to take these failing companies into public ownership, without compensation.
q.t: It is time to take these failing companies into public ownership, without compensation.

ti: Green Party Response to Drug-Related Death Figures
s: The Green Party of England and Wales issued a statement criticizing the government for lacking a dedicated drugs minister and called for immediate evidence-based drug policy measures including Overdose Prevention Centres, Heroin Assisted Treatment, increased Naloxone provision, drug checking services, and improved prison harm reduction services in response to 5,519 drug poisoning deaths in 2025.

q.o: Our call to action is to contact your MP now, today, and ask them to act on behalf of people who have little or no voice, to follow the evidence, and make life-saving changes to their policy of inaction and avoidance. Please ask your MP to support the opening of OPCs in their constituencies. Let's hold the government to account and see the number of unnecessary deaths reduce for the first time in over a decade.
q.t: Our call to action is to contact your MP now, today, and ask them to act on behalf of people who have little or no voice, to follow the evidence, and make life-saving changes to their policy of inaction and avoidance. Please ask your MP to support the opening of OPCs in their constituencies. Let's hold the government to account and see the number of unnecessary deaths reduce for the first time in over a decade.

ti: Joint statement from The Green Party and the Local Government Association Green Group
ac: Green Party of England and Wales
s: The Green Party and its Local Government Association Green Group issued a joint statement criticizing national parties for forcing local council leaders to end progressive partnerships with Labour, Independent, and Liberal Democrat councillors, defending their commitment to local power-sharing agreements and democratic decision-making.

q.o: The Green Party, and the Green Group Office, representing Green councillors across the country, have been hugely disappointed in moves designed by national parties to force local council leaders into jeopardising successful progressive partnerships that are delivering benefits for residents.
q.sp: Green Party and Green Group Office

q.o: Partnership is at the heart of Green politics. We believe in working together for the good of people and planet, even when that means working alongside people and parties with whom we disagree on some national and international issues.
q.sp: Green Party and Green Group Office

q.o: The Green Party believes top-down directives to break up and disrupt locally-run services are not in the interests of the residents we represent. We trust local communities, local councillors and local leaders to know what is best for them.

ti: Zack Polanski snubs our fallen heroes and wears a white poppy for Remembrance Sunday - London Business News
s: Zack Polanski wore a white poppy for Remembrance Sunday, which the source characterizes as snubbing fallen heroes.

ti: Zack Polanski takes swipe at Labour's 'shocking record of backsliding' on climate issues - GB News
s: Zack Polanski of the Green Party of England and Wales criticized Labour's record on climate issues, describing it as backsliding.

ti: Como, presidio in largo Miglio a Como nella giornata dello sciopero contro carovita e prezzi alti - CiaoComo
s: A protest was held in Largo Miglio in Como on the day of a strike against high cost of living and high prices.

ti: Anac: Opposition attacks: “Another embarrassing blunder by the government”; Salvini: “New name tomorrow” - la Repubblica
s: Salvini announced that a new name for Anac would be revealed the following day, amid opposition criticism of the government over the issue.

q.o: Nuovo nome domani
q.t: New name tomorrow

ti: Lega (League): northerners absent from the Federal Council meeting. Salvini: “We can hold a vote from April” - la Repubblica
s: Northern League members were absent from a Federal Council meeting, while Salvini stated that a vote could be held from April onwards.

q.o: We can hold a vote from April
q.t: We can hold a vote from April

ti: Το δεύτερο μέρος του Διεθνούς Συμποσίου του ΑΚΕΛ: Απέναντι στην ακροδεξιά με προοπτική κοινωνικής αλλαγής
s: AKEL concluded its International Symposium on the Left and the Contemporary World on November 7, 2026, featuring sessions on confronting the far-right, European left prospects, and contemporary social transformation experiences with participation from communist and left parties from Portugal, Belgium, USA, Germany, Colombia, Spain, China, Cuba, Austria, and India.

q.o: Αναδείχθηκε η ανάγκη ενίσχυσης των δεσμών με τους εργαζομένους και τα κοινωνικά κινήματα, υπεράσπισης των εργασιακών δικαιωμάτων και των δημόσιων υπηρεσιών, καθώς και συνεργασίας απέναντι στον νεοφιλελευθερισμό, στη στρατιωτικοποίηση και στην ακροδεξιά, με προοπτική μια Ευρώπη ειρήνης και κοινωνικής προόδου.
q.t: The need was highlighted to strengthen ties with workers and social movements, defend labor rights and public services, and cooperate against neoliberalism, militarization and the far-right, with the prospect of a Europe of peace and social progress.

q.o: Τονίστηκε η ανάγκη αντιφασιστικής δράσης και μιας Αριστεράς που απαντά στα κοινωνικά προβλήματα, προβάλλοντας μια πειστική, ελπιδοφόρα εναλλακτική, χωρίς υποχωρήσεις στα ανθρώπινα δικαιώματα.
q.t: The need was emphasized for antifascist action and a Left that responds to social problems, projecting a convincing, hopeful alternative, without concessions on human rights.

ti: Κοινωνίες υπό πίεση, ειρήνη υπό απειλή – Στο επίκεντρο του πρώτου μέρους του Διεθνούς Συμποσίου του ΑΚΕΛ
s: AKEL organized an International Symposium on the Left and the Contemporary World as part of its 100th anniversary celebrations, featuring sessions on neoliberal policies, militarization, and international law with speakers from communist and left parties from Brazil, Chile, Iran, Sri Lanka, and Greece.

q.o: Η υπεράσπιση της ειρήνης συνδέθηκε με την προοπτική μιας επανενωμένης Κύπρου, στη βάση διζωνικής, δικοινοτικής ομοσπονδίας με πολιτική ισότητα όπως αυτή περιγράφεται στα ψηφίσματα του ΟΗΕ.
q.t: The defense of peace was linked to the prospect of a reunified Cyprus, on the basis of a bizonal, bicommunal federation with political equality as described in UN resolutions.

ti: Άρχισαν οι εργασίες του Διεθνούς Συμποσίου του ΑΚΕΛ – Στ. Στεφάνου: «Η Αριστερά οφείλει στο σήμερα να κτίζει το μέλλον που οραματίζεται»
s: AKEL hosted an International Symposium titled 'The Left in the Modern World' with representatives from over 35 left-wing parties and forces worldwide as part of its 100th anniversary celebrations, with General Secretary Stefanos Stefanou emphasizing the need for enhanced international cooperation among left forces.

q.o: Η Αριστερά οφείλει στο σήμερα να κτίζει το μέλλον που οραματίζεται
q.t: The Left must build today the future it envisions

ti: Το ΑΚΕΛ αναδεικνύει την κατοχή και τη διαίρεση της Κύπρου στις διεθνείς αντιπροσωπείες που βρίσκονται στο νησί
s: AKEL organized a tour along the Green Line in Nicosia for international delegations attending the International Symposium on the Left and the Modern World, held as part of the 100th anniversary celebrations of KKK-AKEL, to highlight the Turkish occupation and division of Cyprus and strengthen international solidarity for reunification based on a bizonal, bicommunal federation.

q.o: Το ΑΚΕΛ αξιοποιεί κάθε ευκαιρία, κάθε διεθνή επαφή και κάθε διεθνή διοργάνωση για να αναδεικνύει το Κυπριακό και να ενισχύει τη διεθνή αλληλεγγύη στον αγώνα του κυπριακού λαού για απαλλαγή από την τουρκική κατοχή και επανένωση.
q.t: AKEL utilizes every opportunity, every international contact and every international event to highlight the Cyprus issue and strengthen international solidarity in the struggle of the Cypriot people for liberation from Turkish occupation and reunification.

q.o: Η διεθνοποίηση του Κυπριακού αποτελεί σταθερή προτεραιότητα της διεθνούς δράσης του Κόμματος, το οποίο αξιοποιεί το ευρύ δίκτυο σχέσεων και συνεργασιών του με πολιτικές και κοινωνικές δυνάμεις από ολόκληρο τον κόσμο.
q.t: The internationalization of the Cyprus issue is a constant priority of the Party's international action, which utilizes its broad network of relations and collaborations with political and social forces from around the world.

ti: Το ΑΚΕΛ για την επέτειο της Οκτωβριανής Επανάστασης
s: AKEL issued a statement honoring the anniversary of the October Revolution, linking its historical legacy to contemporary struggles for workers' rights and social justice, and announced a commemorative event on 7 November 2026 at the PEO Theatre in Nicosia.

q.o: Το ΑΚΕΛ τιμά την επέτειο της Μεγάλης Οκτωβριανής Σοσιαλιστικής Επανάστασης.
q.t: AKEL honors the anniversary of the Great October Socialist Revolution.

q.o: Για το ΑΚΕΛ, η τιμή στην Οκτωβριανή Επανάσταση συνδέεται με τη συμμετοχή στους σημερινούς αγώνες για δικαιώματα, ειρήνη και κοινωνική δικαιοσύνη.
q.t: For AKEL, honoring the October Revolution is connected with participation in today's struggles for rights, peace and social justice.

q.o: Το ΑΚΕΛ επειδή ακριβώς μελέτησε τη θετική αλλά και την αρνητική εμπειρία της Σοβιετικής Ένωσης απορρίπτει τον μηδενισμό της προσφοράς της, όπως και την προσπάθεια να απαξιωθεί το ίδιο το όραμα του κοινωνικού μετασχηματισμού.
q.t: AKEL, precisely because it has studied both the positive and negative experience of the Soviet Union, rejects the nullification of its contribution, as well as the attempt to devalue the very vision of social transformation.

ti: Ακάμας: Πόσες έρευνες χρειάζονται για να αποδοθούν επιτέλους ευθύνες;
s: AKEL's Head of Sustainable Development and Sustainability Sector, Christina Nicolaou, issued a written statement demanding accountability for environmental violations in the Akamas area following an Audit Service report, calling for all investigations to be submitted, full financial and environmental accounting to be published, and for the government and ministry to be held responsible.

q.o: Τα ευρήματα της Ελεγκτικής Υπηρεσίας (ΕΥ) για τον Ακάμα είναι καταπέλτης. Επιβεβαιώνουν με τον πιο επίσημο τρόπο όσα το ΑΚΕΛ καταγγέλλει από το 2023: παραβιάσεις περιβαλλοντικών όρων, ανεπαρκείς έλεγχοι, σπατάλη δημόσιων πόρων και απουσία ουσιαστικής λογοδοσίας.
q.t: The findings of the Audit Service regarding Akamas are damning. They confirm in the most official way what AKEL has been denouncing since 2023: violations of environmental terms, inadequate controls, waste of public resources and absence of substantial accountability.

q.o: Το ΑΚΕΛ απαιτεί να κατατεθούν όλες οι έρευνες, να δημοσιοποιηθεί πλήρης οικονομικός και περιβαλλοντικός απολογισμός και να δοθούν σαφείς απαντήσεις για τις παραλείψεις και τις αποφάσεις που οδήγησαν στη σημερινή κατάσταση.
q.t: AKEL demands that all investigations be submitted, that a full financial and environmental accounting be published, and that clear answers be given for the omissions and decisions that led to the current situation.

q.o: Η κυβέρνηση και το υπουργείο φέρουν ευθύνη και πρέπει να λογοδοτήσουν.
q.t: The government and the ministry bear responsibility and must be held accountable.

ti: Καθολική, συνεχής και συνεπής η αλληλεγγύη της διεθνούς Αριστεράς προς την Κύπρο
s: AKEL General Secretary Stefanos Stefanou hosted over 30 left-wing parties from around the world for AKEL's 100th anniversary and an international symposium on "The Left in the Modern World," briefing them on the Cyprus issue and receiving expressions of solidarity for a solution based on international law and UN resolutions.

q.o: Έχουμε τη χαρά να φιλοξενούμε στην Κύπρο πάνω από 30 κόμματα της Αριστεράς από ολόκληρο τον κόσμο τα οποία έχουμε προσκαλέσει για να τιμήσουμε μαζί τα 100 χρόνια ζωής του ΑΚΕΛ αλλά και την ίδια ώρα για να συμμετέχουν στο Διεθνές Συμπόσιο που οργανώνουμε με θέμα «Η Αριστερά στο σύγχρονο κόσμο».
q.t: We have the pleasure of hosting in Cyprus over 30 left-wing parties from around the world which we have invited to honor together the 100 years of AKEL's life and at the same time to participate in the International Symposium we are organizing on the theme 'The Left in the Modern World.'

q.o: Πρέπει να πω ότι η αλληλεγγύη και υποστήριξη των κομμάτων της Αριστεράς για την Κύπρο, για τη λύση του Κυπριακού, είναι καθολική, είναι συνεπής και συνεχής.
q.t: I must say that the solidarity and support of the left-wing parties for Cyprus, for the solution of the Cyprus issue, is universal, it is consistent and continuous.

q.o: Διαχρονικά και πάντα η Αριστερά ήταν και συνεχίζει να είναι, στο πλευρό της Κύπρου και του λαού μας.
q.t: Throughout time and always the Left was and continues to be on the side of Cyprus and our people.

ti: Συνάντηση ΑΚΕΛ με αντιπροσωπεία της ΟΕΛΜΕΚ
s: AKEL met with OELMEK teachers' union delegation to discuss the Ministry of Education's proposed new teacher appointment system, jointly identifying serious weaknesses and ambiguities in the proposal currently under public consultation, and agreed to continue dialogue while AKEL advocates for extension of negotiations.

ti: FrP reagerer på nye matavgifter: – Bomskudd
s: Progress Party criticizes the Høie committee's proposal for new taxes on sugar, chocolate and sugary drinks, arguing the state should not control people's diets through taxes.

q.o: Staten skal ikke styre folks kosthold gjennom stadig nye avgifter
q.t: The state should not control people's diets through constantly new taxes

ti: FrP sier krystallklart nei til EU
s: The Progress Party reaffirmed its opposition to Norwegian EU membership and noted that it voted in June to withdraw Norway from ACER.

q.o: La det være så tydelig at selv ikke Rødt kan misforstå: Fremskrittspartiet er imot norsk EU-medlemskap og senest i juni stemte vi for å få Norge ut av ACER.
q.t: Let it be so clear that not even Rødt can misunderstand: The Progress Party is against Norwegian EU membership and most recently in June we voted to get Norway out of ACER.

ti: Klimapolitikk koster enten vi vil eller ikke
s: Progress Party calls for a thorough debate on why Norway should have strict climate policy when most of the world does not have climate policy.

q.o: Så lenge mesteparten av verden ikke har klimapolitikk, bør vi ha en grundig debatt om hvorfor Norge skal ha en streng politikk.
q.t: As long as most of the world does not have climate policy, we should have a thorough debate about why Norway should have a strict policy.

ti: Idrett og aktivitet er feil sted å kutte
s: Progress Party criticizes the Labour Party for appearing to cut funding for sports and activities for persons with disabilities.

q.o: Norge står ovenfor store utfordringer. At personer med nedsatt funksjonsevne ønsker å leve aktive liv, er ikke en av dem. Likevel er det her Arbeiderpartiet ser ut til å ha funnet et problem som ingen andre har sett.
q.t: Norway faces major challenges. That persons with reduced functional ability wish to live active lives is not one of them. Nevertheless, this is where the Labour Party appears to have found a problem that no one else has seen.

ti: – Det er alvorlig
s: Progress Party's Per-Willy Amundsen, leader of the Storting's Control Committee, reacts to new information that contradicts what Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre stated in a parliamentary control hearing about the foreign service.

ti: Sylvi om mellomvalget i USA: – Økonomi var avgjørende
s: Progress Party leader Sylvi Listhaug commented on the US midterm elections, stating that the economy was decisive in the Democratic Party's victory in both the Senate and House of Representatives.

ti: – Stenseng sminker virkeligheten
s: Progress Party MP Bjørn-Kristian Svendsrud criticizes Labour minister Kjersti Stenseng for characterizing 300 new sheltered employment places in the 2027 budget as a major investment when Parliament has mandated 1000 new places annually.

q.o: En ting er å ikke prioritere VTA-plasser. Det er en politisk prioritering man gjerne kan diskutere. Men å selge det inn som en stor satsing stemmer ikke med virkeligheten. Det er å sminke realiteten
q.t: One thing is not to prioritize VTA places. That is a political priority one can certainly discuss. But to sell it as a major investment does not match reality. It is to disguise the reality

ti: Helsereformutvalget peker i FrPs retning
s: Progress Party demands shorter healthcare queues and better patient services after a health reform committee proposed changes the party has long advocated, including abolishing regional health enterprises.

ti: Invester i fred – nei til atomvåpen i oljefondet
s: The Communist Party of Norway's International Committee issued a statement on the Gjedrem committee's proposal regarding nuclear weapons investments in the oil fund.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: PCP Secretary-General Paulo Raimundo is in Cyprus to participate in the centenary celebrations of the Communist Party of Cyprus/AKEL and an international symposium, and will meet with AKEL Secretary-General Stefanos Stefanou in the framework of bilateral relations between the two parties.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: Paula Santos, President of the Parliamentary Group and member of the Political Commission of the Central Committee of the Portuguese Communist Party, presented over 500 budget amendment proposals for the 2027 State Budget focusing on public services including healthcare, education, social security, and transport.

q.o: Neste último dia para a entrega de propostas de alteração ao Orçamento do Estado para 2027, destacamos um conjunto de propostas que visam inverter o caminho de degradação dos serviços públicos como é o caso do Serviço Nacional de Saúde.
q.t: On this last day for submitting amendment proposals to the State Budget for 2027, we highlight a set of proposals that aim to reverse the path of degradation of public services such as the National Health Service.

q.o: A intervenção do PCP nesta fase do processo orçamental foi intensa e diversificada, com a apresentação de mais de 500 propostas, que apontam um rumo alternativo para o País.
q.t: The PCP's intervention in this phase of the budget process was intense and diversified, with the presentation of more than 500 proposals, which point to an alternative direction for the country.

q.o: Propostas que rompem com os critérios aceites por PSD/CDS, IL, Chega e PS, marcados pelo favorecimento do grande capital e pela submissão às imposições da UE
q.t: Proposals that break with the criteria accepted by PSD/CDS, IL, Chega and PS, marked by favoring big capital and submission to EU impositions

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: The Portuguese Communist Party issued a statement on the US midterm elections, characterizing the Republican Party's defeat as a repudiation of Trump's reactionary and warmongering policies, particularly regarding military aggression against Iran, support for Israel's actions in Palestine, and policies against Cuba, while calling for continued solidarity with Palestine and Cuba.

q.o: A clara derrota do Partido Republicano nas eleições intercalares nos EUA, nomeadamente com a perda da maioria no Senado e na Câmara dos Representantes, é expressão do amplo descontentamento e repúdio por parte de diversos sectores da sociedade norte-americana face à política reaccionária e belicista da Administração Trump e às suas nefastas consequências.
q.t: The clear defeat of the Republican Party in the US midterm elections, namely with the loss of the majority in the Senate and House of Representatives, is an expression of the broad discontent and repudiation by various sectors of American society regarding the reactionary and warmongering policy of the Trump Administration and its harmful consequences.

q.o: Repúdio que se estende à sua política belicista, em particular à agressão militar dos EUA e Israel contra o Irão, ao continuado apoio dos EUA ao genocídio levado a cabo por Israel na Palestina, ou à sua ofensiva fascizante e agressiva contra numerosos países da América Latina, nomeadamente contra Cuba.
q.t: Repudiation that extends to its warmongering policy, in particular to the military aggression of the USA and Israel against Iran, to the continued US support for the genocide carried out by Israel in Palestine, or to its fascist and aggressive offensive against numerous Latin American countries, namely against Cuba.

q.o: Só uma forte mobilização e resistência popular de massas nos EUA poderá romper com a actual política e abrir a perspectiva de um outro rumo que dê resposta aos direitos e aspirações do povo norte-americano.
q.t: Only a strong mobilization and mass popular resistance in the USA can break with the current policy and open the prospect of another path that responds to the rights and aspirations of the American people.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: PCP Secretary-General Paulo Raimundo condemned the government's housing policy, criticized the sale of TAP to Lufthansa, denounced a coalition between PSD, PS, Chega, CDS and IL on eviction laws and rent increases, and called for protests on November 14 and 21, 2026.

q.o: É extraordinário que no exacto dia em que o Governo entrega a TAP à Luftansa, com a TAP a ser novamente comprada com o próprio dinheiro da TAP, no dia em que o CDS serviu de moço de recados de PSD, Chega e IL, travando a possibilidade do debate de urgência na AR requerido pelo PCP, é exactamente neste dia que o Governo pela voz do Primeiro-Ministro decide fazer uma comunicação ao País onde reafirma todo um caminho desastroso relativamente à habitação.
q.t: It is extraordinary that on the exact day the Government hands TAP over to Lufthansa, with TAP being bought again with TAP's own money, on the day CDS served as errand boy for PSD, Chega and IL, blocking the possibility of urgent debate in the Assembly requested by PCP, it is exactly on this day that the Government through the voice of the Prime Minister decides to make a communication to the country reaffirming a disastrous path regarding housing.

q.o: Uma opção do Governo de envolvimento dos seus dois maiores parceiros, um PS que viabiliza o Orçamento do Estado, um Chega que garante a lei dos despejos, uma política contra a maioria que quer continuar.
q.t: A Government option involving its two biggest partners, a PS that enables the State Budget, a Chega that guarantees the eviction law, a policy against the majority that wants to continue.

q.o: É preciso derrotar o Governo e é preciso derrotar a política que é do Governo mas que está para lá do Governo.
q.t: It is necessary to defeat the Government and it is necessary to defeat the policy that belongs to the Government but goes beyond the Government.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: Bruno Dias, member of the Portuguese Communist Party Central Committee, issued a statement regarding a declaration by the Prime Minister on November 3, 2026.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: Paula Santos of the Portuguese Communist Party made a declaration in the Assembly of the Republic regarding the rejection of an urgent parliamentary debate on police actions in Lisbon and Porto.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: The Portuguese Communist Party presented budget amendment proposals for the 2027 State Budget, including raising corporate tax to 21%, creating a new 10th IRS bracket at 56% for incomes over 250,000 euros, reducing VAT on essential goods to 6%, and rescuing public-private partnerships in infrastructure.

q.o: Mais de 72% das receitas fiscais são hoje suportadas pelo IVA e pelo IRS, ou seja, é quem trabalha e trabalhou a suportar o grosso dos impostos no nosso país, enquanto os rendimentos do capital veem o seu contributo cada vez mais reduzido
q.t: More than 72% of tax revenues are today supported by VAT and IRS, that is, it is those who work and have worked who bear the bulk of taxes in our country, while capital income sees its contribution increasingly reduced

q.o: Propomos a reposição nos 21% da taxa de IRC (cada ponto percentual custa, pelo menos, 300 M€ segundo o Governo) e a eliminação dos benefícios fiscais previstos no IRC (1886 M€)
q.t: We propose restoring the IRC rate to 21% (each percentage point costs at least 300 million euros according to the Government) and eliminating the tax benefits provided for in IRC (1886 million euros)

q.o: Propomos que se venham a fixar 10 escalões no IRS, consagrando um novo 10º escalão, com uma taxa de 56% para rendimentos superiores a 250 mil euros
q.t: We propose establishing 10 brackets in IRS, creating a new 10th bracket, with a rate of 56% for incomes over 250 thousand euros

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: Paula Santos of the Portuguese Communist Party made a declaration in the Assembly of the Republic regarding a Lisbon Court decision about the right to demonstrate.

ti: Το ΕΛΑΜ τίμησε τον ήρωα Κυριάκο Μάτση
s: ELAM held a commemorative event at Fylakismena Mnimata for EOKA hero Kyriakos Matsis, with wreath-laying by MP Marios Pelekanos and MEP Geadis Geadi, followed by inauguration of a photographic exhibition.

ti: V-top on the government demand: "Impossible to influence" - Metro Mode
s: A Left Party leader stated that the government demand is impossible to influence.

q.o: Omöjligt att påverka
q.t: Impossible to influence

ti: Sodexo Workers Win In Full After 50 Days On Strike
s: People Before Profit MLA Gerry Carroll congratulated Sodexo workers at Erskine House who won full demands including restored hours and back pay after more than 50 days on strike against the multinational company.

q.o: This is a huge victory for the receptionists, cleaners, porters and kitchen workers at Erskine House. Their hours will be restored immediately, they will be back paid for every hour lost and there will be no changes to their job roles. They won everything they fought for.
q.t: This is a huge victory for the receptionists, cleaners, porters and kitchen workers at Erskine House. Their hours will be restored immediately, they will be back paid for every hour lost and there will be no changes to their job roles. They won everything they fought for.

q.o: This sends a clear message to every worker facing cuts to their hours, pay or conditions: you don't have to accept it. When workers organise and take action, they can win.
q.t: This sends a clear message to every worker facing cuts to their hours, pay or conditions: you don't have to accept it. When workers organise and take action, they can win.

ti: Richard Boyd Barrett Slams Government for Refusing Public Sector Workers Cost-of-Living Pay Rises While Upping Weapon Spending
s: Richard Boyd Barrett TD criticised the Irish Government for refusing public sector workers cost-of-living pay rises while increasing military spending to €1.7 billion by 2030, and announced People Before Profit support for a public sector strike and Irish Anti-War Movement demonstration both scheduled for 12 November 2026.

q.o: It is appropriate that workers will be striking for cost-of-living pay increases on the same day that anti-war protestors are mobilising against the hundreds of billions of Euros being spent on weapons of death and destruction. The Irish Government and the EU can find the money for vast increases in military spending but not to protect workers incomes. There is a clear connection between these two things.
q.t: It is appropriate that workers will be striking for cost-of-living pay increases on the same day that anti-war protestors are mobilising against the hundreds of billions of Euros being spent on weapons of death and destruction. The Irish Government and the EU can find the money for vast increases in military spending but not to protect workers incomes. There is a clear connection between these two things.

q.o: The Irish Government has said it will increase spending on weapons and military equipment to €1.7 billion by 2030, a 55% increase on its previous military spending plans. But the same Government won't give workers a pay increase to compensate for inflation. This demonstrates this Government's lethal priorities are fully aligned to the EU's militarisation and war agenda.
q.t: The Irish Government has said it will increase spending on weapons and military equipment to €1.7 billion by 2030, a 55% increase on its previous military spending plans. But the same Government won't give workers a pay increase to compensate for inflation. This demonstrates this Government's lethal priorities are fully aligned to the EU's militarisation and war agenda.

q.o: Public sector workers and anti-war demonstrators will have common cause on the streets on 12th November
q.t: Public sector workers and anti-war demonstrators will have common cause on the streets on 12th November

ti: Richard Boyd Barrett Calls on Taoiseach to Use Shared Ireland Funds to Save Services in Newry’s Daisy Hill Hospital
s: Richard Boyd Barrett raised concerns in the Dáil about the collapse of maternity services at Newry's Daisy Hill Hospital due to consultant shortages and called on the Taoiseach to use Shared Ireland funds to develop an all-Ireland health service to retain services at the hospital.

q.o: I was in Newry on Monday night meeting campaigners who are part of the SOS Daisy Hill campaign. This campaign is opposing relocation of maternity services to Craigavon hospital because of a lack of consultants at Daisy Hill Thousands of people have marched in Newry to keep the services in Daisy Hill.
q.t: I was in Newry on Monday night meeting campaigners who are part of the SOS Daisy Hill campaign. This campaign is opposing relocation of maternity services to Craigavon hospital because of a lack of consultants at Daisy Hill Thousands of people have marched in Newry to keep the services in Daisy Hill.

q.o: The Taoiseach should engage with this very serious issue and use the Shared Island fund in his own department to assist in developing an all-Ireland health service which will keep maternity services and other services in Daisy Hill Hospital in Newry.
q.t: The Taoiseach should engage with this very serious issue and use the Shared Island fund in his own department to assist in developing an all-Ireland health service which will keep maternity services and other services in Daisy Hill Hospital in Newry.

q.o: The local community needs services in Daisy Hill and I will continue to work with campaigners to escalate mobilisation and take action to ensure services in Daisy Hill are retained and protected.
q.t: The local community needs services in Daisy Hill and I will continue to work with campaigners to escalate mobilisation and take action to ensure services in Daisy Hill are retained and protected.

ti: Gerry Carroll says Far-Right the Real Danger to Community Cohesion
s: People Before Profit MLA Gerry Carroll responded to PSNI confirmation of explosive devices linked to extreme right-wing terrorism in the Shankill area, calling the far right the real threat to community cohesion and criticizing focus on Garvaghy Road residents instead.

q.o: This is the largest haul of weaponry linked to the far right ever found here, and it comes after three years of racist riots that have driven families out of their homes and left children afraid to walk to school.
q.t: This is the largest haul of weaponry linked to the far right ever found here, and it comes after three years of racist riots that have driven families out of their homes and left children afraid to walk to school.

q.o: The real threat to our communities comes from the far right. It does not come from residents on the Garvaghy Road, from peaceful protesters, or from the anti-racists who have stood up again and again to defend their neighbours.
q.t: The real threat to our communities comes from the far right. It does not come from residents on the Garvaghy Road, from peaceful protesters, or from the anti-racists who have stood up again and again to defend their neighbours.

q.o: The far right is organising across these islands. Its figures openly praise the disorder here and draw inspiration from it. Their aim is to turn working class people against each other, and to blame migrants for a housing crisis and a broken health service that were caused by decades of austerity and profiteering.
q.t: The far right is organising across these islands. Its figures openly praise the disorder here and draw inspiration from it. Their aim is to turn working class people against each other, and to blame migrants for a housing crisis and a broken health service that were caused by decades of austerity and profiteering.

ti: Conor Reddy Calls for Local Opposition to Finglas Gambling Arcade's Bid to Extend Opening Hours to Midnight
s: People Before Profit Councillor Conor Reddy called on Finglas residents and organisations to oppose a planning application by Leeside Leisure Centre Ltd to extend a gambling arcade's opening hours from 10pm to midnight, arguing it threatens community wellbeing and contradicts efforts to revitalise the village.

q.o: Last year, many of us warned that allowing this gambling arcade to open could be the start of a slippery slope. We've seen it elsewhere in Dublin, where gambling arcades have opened with restricted hours and then sought to extend them once established. Unfortunately, that's exactly what's happening here.

Gambling arcades are predatory businesses. They make their money from people losing theirs, often people who are already struggling with addiction, debt and financial hardship. Extending the opening hours means two more hours of access to high-frequency gambling every night of the week, with all the potential harm that brings.
I'm asking residents, local businesses and community organisations to make planning observations before the deadline of 23 November - I'll be helping anyone who needs assistance with that.

ti: Miriam Boush Co-opted to Carlow County Council as Adrienne Wallace Takes Maternity Leave
s: Miriam Boush is being co-opted to Carlow County Council as a People Before Profit councillor to replace Adrienne Wallace during maternity leave, becoming the first person of colour on the council, with stated priorities including banning new data centres, opposing Triple Lock changes, challenging council rent increases, and improving council transparency.

q.o: I'm delighted that Miriam will be co-opted onto the council during my maternity leave. She has a deep commitment to the people of her home county of Carlow and I know her sense of social justice, her energy and her drive will serve them well.
q.t: I'm delighted that Miriam will be co-opted onto the council during my maternity leave. She has a deep commitment to the people of her home county of Carlow and I know her sense of social justice, her energy and her drive will serve them well.

q.o: I join the council just as the Government is trying to end the Triple Lock so it can send young people abroad to fight in imperialist wars. If they get away with ending the Triple Lock, sending Irish soldiers to Lebanon on the same side as Israel against Hezbollah will just be the start.
q.t: I join the council just as the Government is trying to end the Triple Lock so it can send young people abroad to fight in imperialist wars. If they get away with ending the Triple Lock, sending Irish soldiers to Lebanon on the same side as Israel against Hezbollah will just be the start.

q.o: A key priority during my six month term on the council is to establish a ban on new data centres in Carlow. Data centres consume almost a quarter of our State's electricity, paying just half the electricity rate that households have to pay and driving up electricity prices for everyone else.
q.t: A key priority during my six month term on the council is to establish a ban on new data centres in Carlow. Data centres consume almost a quarter of our State's electricity, paying just half the electricity rate that households have to pay and driving up electricity prices for everyone else.

ti: Danish People's Party wants three more names taken off citizenship bill - The Local Denmark
s: The Danish People's Party is seeking to remove three additional names from a citizenship bill under parliamentary consideration.

ti: Statement on the suspension of Workers’ Party TCD committee members
s: The Workers' Party of Ireland suspended the Workers' Party TCD committee pending disciplinary proceedings after members publicly burned membership cards, accused the party of being a Russian puppet, and supported NATO's role in Ukraine.

q.o: The Workers' Party of Ireland condemns the conduct of members of the Workers' Party TCD committee, including the public burning of branch membership cards, their characterisation of the party as oppressive, their false accusations that it acts as a Russian puppet, and their support for NATO's imperialist role in the war in Ukraine.
For these reasons, the Workers' Party has suspended the Workers' Party TCD committee pending disciplinary proceedings.
Holding office in the branch while publicly repudiating the Party is incompatible with the responsibilities owed to the organisation and its membership.

ti: Trinity's Workers' Party committee suspended after infighting on Russia-Ukraine war - The Journal
s: The Workers' Party suspended its Trinity College committee following internal conflict over positions on the Russia-Ukraine war.

ti: SV vil sette et rødt og grønt stempel på Kommune-Norge
s: Socialist Left Party working group led by Andreas Sjalg Unneland presents policy document "Green and Fair Local Communities" proposing free kindergarten, expanded municipal housing role, and zero-vision for development of valuable nature ahead of 2027 municipal elections.

q.o: Vi skal kunne sette et tydelig SV-stempel på Kommune-Norge. Det skal bety noe for folk at SV sitter med makten. Vi vil ha kommuner som reduserer forskjeller, bygger ut velferden og tar vare på naturen.
q.t: We shall be able to put a clear SV stamp on Municipal Norway. It shall mean something for people that SV holds power. We want municipalities that reduce differences, expand welfare and take care of nature.

q.o: Vi har gratis skole fordi vi mener alle barn skal ha de samme mulighetene, uavhengig av foreldrenes lommebok. Nå er tiden inne for å ta neste steg og gjøre barnehagen gratis.
q.t: We have free school because we believe all children shall have the same opportunities, regardless of their parents' wallet. Now the time has come to take the next step and make kindergarten free.

q.o: Et trygt sted å bo er helt grunnleggende for å kunne leve et godt liv. Likevel har bolig i altfor stor grad blitt noe folk skal tjene penger på, framfor et hjem. Kommunene må igjen bli en aktiv aktør i boligpolitikken.
q.t: A safe place to live is completely fundamental to being able to live a good life. Nevertheless, housing has to too great an extent become something people shall earn money from, rather than a home. Municipalities must again become an active actor in housing policy.

q.o: Vi kan ikke fortsette å bygge ned naturen bit for bit og tro at summen ikke betyr noe. Kommunene trenger både tydeligere nasjonale rammer og bedre verktøy for å ta vare på naturen.
q.t: We cannot continue to develop nature bit by bit and believe that the sum does not matter. Municipalities need both clearer national frameworks and better tools to take care of nature.

ti: SVs alternative budsjett: – En vanlig jobb skal være nok til å leve gode liv
s: The Socialist Left Party presented its alternative budget for 2027, proposing major spending increases on housing construction, welfare, climate measures, and tax cuts for lower incomes, funded partly by higher wealth taxes on fortunes over 100 million kroner.

q.o: Folk får det bedre med vårt budsjett
q.t: People will be better off with our budget

q.o: Vi lever i en tid med voksende ulikhet, en mer urolig verden og en klima- og naturkrise med allerede enorme konsekvenser. De siste årene har hverdagen blitt tøffere for mange av oss. Politikken må vise at det er mulig å gi folk en bedre og tryggere hverdag. Det gjør vi med vårt alternative budsjett.
q.t: We live in a time of growing inequality, a more turbulent world and a climate and nature crisis with already enormous consequences. In recent years, everyday life has become tougher for many of us. Politics must show that it is possible to give people a better and safer everyday life. We do that with our alternative budget.

q.o: I et land med så høy materiell velstand som vi har i Norge, kan vi ikke akseptere at 100 000 barn vokser opp i fattigdom og at 500 barn er bostedsløse i Norge.
q.t: In a country with as high material prosperity as we have in Norway, we cannot accept that 100,000 children grow up in poverty and that 500 children are homeless in Norway.

q.o: Dette er en dramatisk utvikling som rammer alle som bor i en leid bolig. I dag er én av tre leietakere økonomisk utrygge. Nå gjør vi store grep for å lage en ny leiesektor i Norge som vil skape forutsigbarhet og lavere pris for folk
q.t: This is a dramatic development that affects everyone who lives in a rented home. Today, one in three tenants are financially insecure. Now we are taking major steps to create a new rental sector in Norway that will create predictability and lower prices for people

q.o: Det har aldri hastet mer å kutte klimagassutslippene og ta vare på naturen. Derfor er det uforståelig at regjeringen, i en tid der vi trenger det mer enn noen gang, foreslo store kutt i klimatiltak i budsjettforslaget sitt.
q.t: It has never been more urgent to cut greenhouse gas emissions and take care of nature. Therefore, it is incomprehensible that the government, at a time when we need it more than ever, proposed major cuts in climate measures in its budget proposal.

ti: Stimmfreigabe zur Feuerwerksinitiative
s: The Swiss Party of Labour's Central Committee decided to issue a neutral voting recommendation on the fireworks initiative, citing both ecological and safety arguments in favor and concerns about restricting working-class culture and potential police repression against the initiative.

q.o: Gemäss dem Zentralkomitee der Partei der Arbeit der Schweiz (PdAS) gibt es sowohl überzeugende Argumente für als auch gegen die Initiative. Deshalb hat das Zentralkomitee es vorgezogen, die Stimmfreigabe zu beschliessen.
q.t: According to the Central Committee of the Swiss Party of Labour (PdAS), there are convincing arguments both for and against the initiative. Therefore, the Central Committee has decided to issue a neutral voting recommendation.

q.o: Als Partei, die die arbeitende Klasse organisieren will, um für ihre Interessen zu kämpfen, sollten wir die Stadien nicht den anderen überlassen und den Fans nicht durch weitere ungerechtfertigte Verbote zusätzliche Einschränkungen auferlegen.
q.t: As a party that wants to organize the working class to fight for their interests, we should not leave the stadiums to others and should not impose additional restrictions on fans through further unjustified bans.

ti: איחוד עם סמוטריץ'? מפלגת זהות ביקשה להגיע בנפרד להתייעצויות אצל הרצוג - חרדים10
s: The Identity party requested to arrive separately to consultations with President Herzog, indicating potential organizational distance from Smotrich.

ti: D’autres solutions existent pour financer la 13e rente AVS
s: Solidarities calls for a 'no' vote on the November 29 VAT increase to finance the 13th AVS pension, arguing for paritaire financing instead and criticizing both the bourgeois parties and the USS union leadership for abandoning demands for employer contributions.

q.o: L'AVS a la plus grande fortune de son histoire, donc aucune dette. Pour les années à venir, les chiffres permettent d'introduire la 13e rente sans financement supplémentaire
q.t: The AVS has the greatest fortune in its history, therefore no debt. For the coming years, the figures allow the introduction of the 13th pension without additional financing

q.o: l'essentiel c'est qu'il n'y ait pas de hausses des cotisations salariales
q.t: the essential thing is that there be no increases in wage contributions

q.o: Un non le 29 novembre enverrait aussi un signal d'avertissement contre toute proposition d'augmentation de l'âge de la retraite. Les concessions, du type de l'augmentation de la TVA, sont des signes de faiblesse, qui nous affaibliront encore davantage et qui alimenteront encore la détermination du camp patronal.
q.t: A no on November 29 would also send a warning signal against any proposal to increase the retirement age. Concessions, such as the VAT increase, are signs of weakness that will weaken us further and will further fuel the determination of the employer camp.

ti: En guerre contre l’armement
s: Solidarities joined a coalition of over 50 organizations opposing the relaxation of Switzerland's Federal Law on War Material (LFMG) ahead of a November 29 vote, calling for mobilization against arms exports.

q.o: Fin octobre, une nouvelle coalition regroupant plus de 50 organisations a été fondée pour s'opposer à l'assouplissement de la Loi fédérale sur le matériel de guerre (LFMG), soumise au vote le 29 novembre.
q.t: At the end of October, a new coalition bringing together more than 50 organizations was founded to oppose the relaxation of the Federal Law on War Material (LFMG), subject to a vote on November 29.

q.o: Ce ne sont pas les patrons qui partent au combat, mais bien les classes populaires des pays en guerre.
q.t: It is not the bosses who go into combat, but rather the working classes of countries at war.

q.o: Lors de la conférence de presse du collectif Guerre à la guerre, la coalition a appelé à multiplier les actions, les débats, les projections et les mobilisations.
q.t: At the press conference of the War on War collective, the coalition called for multiplying actions, debates, screenings and mobilizations.

ti: Des battles d’aura aux barricades!
s: Solidarities calls for participation in a youth strike on November 20, 2026, positioning it within a global wave of Gen Z-led mobilizations against austerity, ecological crisis, and inequality.

q.o: Le 20 novembre, engageons-nous touxtes ensemble pour la grève de la jeunesse!
q.t: On November 20, let us all commit together to the youth strike!

q.o: Le rôle de notre organisation doit donc être tout aussi clair: soutenir ces mouvements, contribuer à leur développement autonome, participer à la création d'un front large en établissant une stratégie et des orientations programmatiques claires.
q.t: The role of our organization must therefore be equally clear: support these movements, contribute to their autonomous development, participate in the creation of a broad front by establishing a clear strategy and programmatic orientations.

ti: Non à la hausse de la TVA ! Oui à des retraites solidaires!
s: solidaritéS and allied anticapitalist groups call for rejection of a VAT increase to fund the 13th AVS pension, arguing it is antisocial and that alternative financing through social contributions exists, while defending the solidarity-based AVS model.

q.o: solidaritéS, le collectif anticapitaliste Fribourg, DAS-WAS, Alternative Linke à Berne et Zürich appellent à rejeter cette hausse de la TVA et à lutter pour défendre le modèle de l'AVS!
q.t: solidaritéS, the anticapitalist collective Fribourg, DAS-WAS, Alternative Linke in Bern and Zurich call for rejection of this VAT increase and to fight to defend the AVS model!

q.o: Aujourd'hui, l'USS, le PS et les Vert·exs cèdent entièrement à la pression de la droite, en abandonnant tout projet de financement solidaire.
q.t: Today, the USS, the PS and the Greens yield entirely to pressure from the right, abandoning any project for solidarity-based financing.

q.o: Elle a fait 5,632 milliards de bénéfices en 2024 et 4,445 milliards en 2025, soit près de 10 milliards en 2 ans!
q.t: It made 5.632 billion in profits in 2024 and 4.445 billion in 2025, nearly 10 billion in 2 years!

ti: Israel's Eisenkot invites Netanyahu's Likud to join government under his leadership as 28-day deadline... - Moneycontrol.com
s: Gadi Eisenkot invited Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party to join a government under Eisenkot's leadership as a 28-day deadline approaches for government formation.

s: Itamar Ben-Gvir publicly criticized Boaz Balet, head of police investigations, calling him a fraud in connection with an election-related probe.

q.o: Boaz Balet is a fraud
q.t: Boaz Balet is a fraud

ti: Ben Gvir demands new elections, launches sharp criticism - Israel National News
s: Itamar Ben Gvir demands new elections and launches sharp criticism.

s: Polling data indicates New Democracy is losing support in the Peloponnese and Macedonia regions to right-wing parties including Greek Solution.
