s: Article discusses presence of fascist groups including CasaPound Italy on European streets in context of migration and conservative politics.

ti: Gemeinsam mit der GenZ auf die Straße!
s: The Left party announces support for peaceful protests planned for October 31, 2026, organized by Generation Z under the motto "Gen Z regelt" in 32 cities across Germany, opposing social cuts, pension reforms, and the eight-hour workday abolition proposed by the Merz government.

q.o: Die Bezahlbarkeitskrise macht sich in ganz Europa und darüber hinaus bemerkbar. In vielen Ländern demonstrieren Menschen für ein bezahlbares Leben.
q.t: The affordability crisis is making itself felt throughout Europe and beyond. In many countries, people are demonstrating for an affordable life.

q.o: Schon nächste Woche bringt die Bundesregierung mit dem Pflege-Kürzungspaket die nächsten sozialen Grausamkeiten in den Bundestag ein. Rentenklau und Abschaffung des 8-Stunden-Tags sollen folgen.
q.t: Next week the federal government will bring the next social cruelties into the Bundestag with the care cuts package. Pension theft and abolition of the 8-hour day are to follow.

q.o: Nur starke und friedliche Proteste können die Merz-Regierung zum Einlenken bewegen. Deshalb unterstützt Die Linke die friedlichen Proteste.
q.t: Only strong and peaceful protests can move the Merz government to back down. Therefore, The Left supports the peaceful protests.

q.o: Wir stehen solidarisch an der Seite der jungen Menschen!
q.t: We stand in solidarity at the side of young people!

ti: VW rechnet sich arm, um Druck auf die Beschäftigten zu machen
s: Die Linke party chair Luigi Pantisano criticized Volkswagen's reported quarterly loss as an accounting trick to pressure workers before wage negotiations, arguing that VW remains financially strong with 33 billion euros in cash and supporting the IG Metall union's demand for a five percent wage increase.

q.o: VW meldet einen Milliardenverlust. Wer genauer hinsieht, findet vor allem einen Buchungstrick. 6,4 der 7,8 Milliarden Euro Sonderbelastungen sind eine Abschreibung auf Porsche, bei der kein einziger Euro die Kasse verlässt.
q.t: VW reports a billion-euro loss. Anyone who looks more closely finds primarily an accounting trick. 6.4 of the 7.8 billion euros in special charges are a write-down on Porsche, in which not a single euro leaves the cash register.

q.o: Die Beschäftigten bei VW haben eine Lohnerhöhung verdient und keine Rechentricks. Die Forderung der IG Metall nach fünf Prozent ist mehr als gerechtfertigt.
q.t: VW employees deserve a wage increase and not accounting tricks. The IG Metall demand for five percent is more than justified.

ti: Oxfam-Studie: Die Privatjet-Party muss enden
s: Die Linke party chairman Luigi Pantisano calls for a ban on private jets and mega-yachts alongside wealth taxation, responding to an Oxfam study showing private jets produce 16 million tons of CO₂ annually, and criticizes Chancellor Merz for flying private jets to Sylt.

q.o: Die Welt steuert auf 2,8° Erwärmung zu und die Superreichen fliegen im Privatjet zum Einkaufen nach Paris. Superreiche zerstören unsere Lebensgrundlagen und treiben damit immer mehr Menschen ins Elend. Wir können uns diese Superreichen nicht mehr leisten.
q.t: The world is heading towards 2.8° warming and the super-rich fly by private jet to shop in Paris. The super-rich are destroying our livelihoods and driving more and more people into misery. We can no longer afford these super-rich.

q.o: Die Privatjet-Party muss enden, wenn dieses Land und diese Erde für die Menschen lebenswert bleiben soll. Wir brauchen neben einer ordentlichen Besteuerung dieser riesigen Vermögen ein Verbot von Privatjets und Mega-Yachten.
q.t: The private jet party must end if this country and this earth are to remain livable for people. In addition to proper taxation of these huge fortunes, we need a ban on private jets and mega-yachts.

q.o: Darüber könnte Bundeskanzler Merz einmal nachdenken, wenn er im Privatjet nach Sylt fliegt.
q.t: Chancellor Merz could think about that when he flies by private jet to Sylt.

ti: Left-Wing Leader in Berlin Fears Hamas Supporters: "My Husband and I Are Afraid" - CubaHeadlines
s: A Left party leader in Berlin publicly expressed fear of Hamas supporters, stating that both she and her husband are afraid.

q.o: My Husband and I Are Afraid
q.t: My Husband and I Are Afraid

ti: Germany: Elif Eralp Fears Linking Die Linke to Hamas - voz.us
s: Elif Eralp expressed concern about attempts to link Die Linke (The Left party) to Hamas.

ti: Berlin: Die Linke mayoral candidate Eralp under police protection: “I’m afraid of Hamas sympathisers” - la Repubblica
s: Die Linke's mayoral candidate Eralp is under police protection and has expressed fear of Hamas sympathisers during the Berlin election campaign.

q.o: I'm afraid of Hamas sympathisers
q.t: I'm afraid of Hamas sympathisers

ti: VAS Saramo: Joululahjarahojen jako lopetettava ja VTV:n selvitettävä rahojen aiempaa käyttöä
s: Left Alliance MEP Jussi Saramo demands the government stop distributing so-called Christmas gift funds and calls for the National Audit Office to investigate past use of these funds, criticizing allocations to religious fundamentalist organizations and proposing redirected savings to social and health sector organizations.

q.o: Mitä se kertoo hallituksen arvoista, että rahaa tutkitusti tärkeää työtä esimerkiksi vanhusten, vammaisten tai sairaiden kanssa tekeviltä järjestöiltä vain leikataan ja leikataan, mutta hallituspuolueiden lähipiirissä toimiville naispappeutta tai aborttia vastustaville toimijoille kyllä riittää jaettavaa?
q.t: What does it say about the government's values that money is just cut and cut from organizations doing demonstrably important work with, for example, the elderly, disabled or sick, but there is enough to distribute to actors in the government parties' circles who oppose women priests or abortion?

q.o: On kohtuutonta, että sote-järjestöjen jokainen avustuseuro syynätään tarkasti, mutta joululahjarahojen käytön asianmukaisesta valvonnasta ei ole vastaavaa varmuutta
q.t: It is unreasonable that every euro of assistance to social and health organizations is scrutinized carefully, but there is no corresponding certainty about proper supervision of the use of Christmas gift funds

q.o: Meillä ei ole varaa jatkaa veroeurojen jakelemista turhille tai jopa haitallisille toimijoille vailla mitään ehtoja
q.t: We cannot afford to continue distributing tax euros to unnecessary or even harmful actors without any conditions

q.o: Joululahjarahoista luopumalla voisimme kohdentaa säästyneet veroeurot paikkaamaan sote-järjestöjen epäinhimillisiä ja haitallisia leikkauksia.
q.t: By abandoning Christmas gift funds, we could allocate the saved tax euros to patch up the inhumane and harmful cuts to social and health organizations.

ti: Mai Kivelä: Suomen on tutkittava ovatko Israelin armeijassa taistelevat suomalaiset syyllistyneet sotarikoksiin
s: Left Alliance MP Mai Kivelä submitted a written question to the government calling for an official investigation into whether Finnish citizens serving in the Israeli army may have committed war crimes in Gaza.

q.o: Gazan tilanne on katastrofaalinen. Israelin sotatoimet Gazassa ovat täysin ylimitoitettuja ja epäinhimillisiä. Israel suorittaa koko maailman silmien edessä kansanmurhaa. Myös Suomen on omalta osaltaan selvitettävä ovatko sen kansalaiset syyllistyneet Gazassa sotarikoksiin
q.t: The situation in Gaza is catastrophic. Israel's military operations in Gaza are completely disproportionate and inhumane. Israel is committing genocide before the eyes of the entire world. Finland must also for its part investigate whether its citizens have committed war crimes in Gaza

q.o: Israelin sotatoimet Gazassa täyttävät useiden eri YK-elinten ja asiantuntijoiden mukaan kansanmurhan tunnusmerkistön ja sen johtajista on annettu Kansainvälisen rikostuomioistuimen pidätysmääräys. Israel on miehittänyt palestiinalaisalueita vuosikymmeniä ja rakentaa kiihtyvällä tahdilla kansainvälisen oikeuden vastaisia siirtokuntia sekä kohdistaa palestiinalaisiin sortotoimia, jotka täyttävät apartheidin tunnusmerkistön. On selvää, että Suomessa on tutkittava asiaa
q.t: According to several different UN bodies and experts, Israel's military operations in Gaza meet the criteria for genocide and arrest warrants have been issued for its leaders by the International Criminal Court. Israel has occupied Palestinian territories for decades and is building illegal settlements at an accelerating pace in violation of international law and subjects Palestinians to oppressive measures that meet the criteria for apartheid. It is clear that Finland must investigate the matter

ti: Johannes Yrttiaho: VM:n avaus puolustusmenojen leikkaamisesta on kannatettava
s: Left Alliance MP Johannes Yrttiaho endorsed the Finance Ministry's proposal to temporarily reduce defense spending targets during the next government term, arguing that uncontrolled military spending growth threatens welfare services and prolongs recession.

q.o: Tämä on tervetullut realismin pilkahdus ja keskustelunavaus valtionvarainministeriöltä
q.t: This is a welcome glimpse of realism and opening for discussion from the Finance Ministry

q.o: Sotilasmenojen hallitsematon kasvu heikentää julkista taloutta erittäin merkittävästi. Se on keskeinen valtionvelan kasvun syy, ja se on tarkoittanut jo nyt toteutettavia kovia sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden, sosiaaliturvan ja koulutuksen leikkauksia.
q.t: The uncontrolled growth of military spending weakens public finances very significantly. It is a central reason for the growth of state debt, and it has already meant hard cuts being implemented in social and health services, social security and education.

q.o: Pidän selvänä, että sotilasmenoja on leikattava, jotta suomalaisten hyvinvointi voidaan pelastaa. Muussa tapauksessa vaarassa ovat eläkkeet ja nykyinen sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden palvelulupaus
q.t: I consider it clear that military spending must be cut so that the welfare of Finns can be saved. Otherwise pensions and the current service promise of social and health services are at risk

q.o: Kysymys ei enää ole Suomen alueen puolustamisen vaatimista määrärahoista, vaan varautumisesta kansainvälisiin tehtäviin sotilasliitto Naton johtovaltion, eli Yhdysvaltojen etujen mukaisesti
q.t: The question is no longer about the appropriations required to defend Finland's territory, but about preparing for international tasks in accordance with the interests of NATO's leading state, that is, the United States

ti: VAS Andersson: Amazonin algoritmiseen riistoon tulee puuttua uusilla EU-säännöillä
s: Left Alliance MEP Li Andersson visited Amazon warehouse facilities in Germany and Poland with the European Parliament's Employment Committee to investigate working conditions and algorithmic management, calling for new EU regulations on algorithmic management and artificial intelligence use in workplaces.

q.o: Osoittautui käytännössä mahdottomaksi saada kunnolla tietoa työn valvontaan ja tehokkuuden seurantaan käytettävien järjestelmien toiminnasta. Työntekijät eivät tiedä, mitä dataa kerätään ja mihin sitä käytetään. Kiristyvät tehokkuusvaatimukset kuitenkin aiheuttavat vaaratilanteita ja kuormitusta. Riisto muuttuu näkymättömäksi, kun sen suorittaa algoritmi.
q.t: It proved practically impossible to properly obtain information about the functioning of systems used for work monitoring and efficiency tracking. Workers do not know what data is collected and what it is used for. Tightening efficiency requirements, however, cause dangerous situations and strain. Exploitation becomes invisible when it is carried out by an algorithm.

q.o: Amazonin Bezosin ja Teslan Muskin kaltaisille teknologiajättien johtajille on periaatekysymys, että ammattiliittojen kanssa ei neuvotella. Tässä ajattelussa esimerkiksi palkka ja työehdot kuuluvat työnantajan määräysvaltaan. Samalla kuulimme työntekijöiltä siitä, että liittoon kuuluvia tai lakkoon osallistuvia työntekijöitä painostetaan tai jopa irtisanotaan.
q.t: For tech giant leaders like Amazon's Bezos and Tesla's Musk, it is a matter of principle that they do not negotiate with trade unions. In this thinking, for example, wages and working conditions belong to the employer's control. At the same time, we heard from workers that union members or workers participating in strikes are pressured or even dismissed.

ti: Pia Lohikoski: Valtiovarainministeriö ajaisi Suomen yhä syvemmin luokkayhteiskuntaan
s: Left Alliance MP Pia Lohikoski criticized the Ministry of Finance's proposals for public spending cuts, arguing they would push Finland toward a class society by drastically cutting education, research, student grants, and child benefits.

q.o: On järkyttävää, että valtiovarainministeriön mukaan suomalaisesta koulutuksesta ja tutkimuksesta voitaisiin leikata näin rajusti.
q.t: It is shocking that according to the Ministry of Finance, Finnish education and research could be cut so drastically.

q.o: Suomen kaltainen pieni maa pärjää vain panostamalla koulutukseen, osaamiseen ja kaikkien lasten ja nuorten hyvinvointiin ja tasa-arvoon.
q.t: A small country like Finland can only succeed by investing in education, competence, and the well-being and equality of all children and young people.

q.o: Miten voi olla niin puusilmäistä talouspolitiikkaa, että tuijotetaan pelkästään budjettikirjan numeroita ilman mitään ymmärrystä tai tahtoa ymmärtää leikkausten seurauksia?
q.t: How can economic policy be so short-sighted that it only stares at budget numbers without any understanding or will to understand the consequences of the cuts?

ti: Cisgiordania, Ricciardi e Miji (Rifondazione): «Solidarietà ai tre attivisti imperiesi arrestati, vengano liberati subito - Riviera24
s: Communist Refoundation Party representatives Ricciardi and Miji issued a statement expressing solidarity with three activists from Imperia arrested in the West Bank and calling for their immediate release.

q.o: Solidarietà ai tre attivisti imperiesi arrestati, vengano liberati subito
q.t: Solidarity with the three activists from Imperia who were arrested, they must be freed immediately

ti: Comrade Acerbo: “Let’s leave NATO. Zelensky? He’s singing the praises of the Nazis. Rizzo? A rough-and-ready fellow. I’m off to China.” - Il Foglio
s: Communist Refoundation Party member Acerbo calls for Italy to leave NATO, criticizes Zelensky regarding Nazis, comments on Rizzo, and announces travel to China.

q.o: Usciamo dalla NATO
q.t: Let's leave NATO

q.o: Zelensky? Fa l'elogio dei nazisti
q.t: Zelensky? He's singing the praises of the Nazis

q.o: Rizzo? Un tipo alla buona
q.t: Rizzo? A rough-and-ready fellow

q.o: Vado in Cina
q.t: I'm off to China

ti: Magi: “The group? A disgraceful affair. Schlein opted for Rifondazione” - Il Foglio
s: Magi criticized a group formation as disgraceful and stated that Schlein chose Communist Refoundation Party.

q.o: Il gruppo? Una vicenda vergognosa. Schlein ha optato per Rifondazione
q.t: The group? A disgraceful affair. Schlein opted for Rifondazione

ti: Tappio Marokolle ja Yhdysvalloille YK:ssä – Länsi-Saharan itsemääräämisoikeuden sivuuttanut esitys kaatui
s: The Communist Party of Finland issued a statement supporting Western Sahara's right to self-determination and decolonization after the UN Security Council rejected a US resolution that would have supported Morocco's autonomy plan and altered the MINURSO peacekeeping mission's mandate.

q.o: SKP tukee sahrawikansan itsemääräämisoikeutta ja Länsi-Saharan dekolonisaatiota.
q.t: The Communist Party of Finland supports the Sahrawi people's right to self-determination and the decolonization of Western Sahara.

q.o: Suomen kommunistinen puolue tukee Länsi-Saharan sahrawikansan itsemääräämisoikeutta ja oikeudenmukaista YK:n päätösten mukaista ratkaisua, joka lopettaa Marokon miehityksen ja saattaa päätökseen Länsi-Saharan dekolonisaation.
q.t: The Communist Party of Finland supports the Sahrawi people of Western Sahara's right to self-determination and a just solution in accordance with UN decisions that ends Morocco's occupation and completes the decolonization of Western Sahara.

ti: EOP:n ja SKP:n yhteinen kannanotto vaalirauhan puolesta
s: The Communist Party of Finland (SKP) and EOP issued a joint statement calling for respectful electoral campaigning, announcing they will remove personal attacks and hate speech from their platforms while welcoming political criticism as parliamentary elections approach.

q.o: Eduskuntavaalien lähestyessä myös ehdokkaiden esittelyt alkavat näkyä sosiaalisessa mediassa.
q.t: As parliamentary elections approach, candidate presentations are also beginning to appear on social media.
q.sp: EOP hallitus ja SKP poliittinen toimikunta

q.o: Häirintä, vihapuhe ja hiljentämisyritykset eivät edistä demokratiaa.
q.t: Harassment, hate speech and attempts to silence do not promote democracy.
q.sp: EOP hallitus ja SKP poliittinen toimikunta

q.o: Poliittinen kritiikki on tervetullutta, mutta henkilöihin kohdistuvat loukkaukset ja muu asiaton kommentointi poistetaan.
q.t: Political criticism is welcome, but personal insults and other inappropriate comments will be removed.
q.sp: EOP hallitus ja SKP poliittinen toimikunta

ti: Idän ja lännen demokratiamallit täydentävät toisiaan
s: Communist Party of Finland chairperson Tiina Sandberg will speak at a Socialism seminar in Beijing in early November organized by the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, discussing democracy-building and comparing Western liberal and Chinese socialist models.

q.o: Puheenvuoroni käsittelee demokratian rakentamisen vaikeutta
q.t: My speech will address the difficulty of building democracy

q.o: Länsimainen liberaali demokratia lähtee yksilön muodollisesta vapaudesta, mutta vapaus jää helposti tyhjäksi, jos valta omistamisen ja talouden avulla keskitetään vain joidenkin käsiin. Kiinan sosialistinen järjestelmä lähtee vahvemmin yhteisestä toimintakyvystä ja pitkäjänteisestä suunnittelusta
q.t: Western liberal democracy starts from the individual's formal freedom, but freedom easily becomes empty if power through ownership and economy is concentrated in only some hands. China's socialist system starts more strongly from collective capacity to act and long-term planning

q.o: Vuoropuhelu erilaisten mallien välillä on äärimmäisen tärkeää. Tarkoitus ei ole julistaa mitään olemassa olevaa mallia täydelliseksi tai kopioida sitä sellaisenaan, vaan oppia toistemme saavutuksista, ristiriidoista ja kokemuksista.
q.t: Dialogue between different models is extremely important. The purpose is not to declare any existing model perfect or copy it as such, but to learn from each other's achievements, contradictions and experiences.

q.o: Yhteinen maailmamme ei kuulu vain ihmisille, eikä sosialismi voi sivuuttaa muiden tuntevien olentojen elämää.
q.t: Our common world does not belong only to humans, and socialism cannot ignore the lives of other sentient beings.

ti: Esercito: quattro vite spezzate mentre servivano Italia, vicini a loro cari
s: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and Defense Minister Guido Crosetto laid roses at Circo Massimo to honor four Italian soldiers who died in Bosnia, establishing a public memorial site at the Defense Village ahead of November 4th commemorations.

q.o: Simone, Claudio, Franco Adriano, Laura. Quattro vite spezzate mentre servivano l'Italia. Oggi il mio pensiero è per loro e per chi li ama.
q.t: Simone, Claudio, Franco Adriano, Laura. Four lives cut short while serving Italy. Today my thoughts are with them and those who love them.

q.o: Abbiamo voluto che il Villaggio della Difesa, allestito in vista del 4 novembre, diventasse un luogo di raccoglimento aperto a tutti.
q.t: We wanted the Defense Village, set up ahead of November 4th, to become a place of gathering open to everyone.

q.o: Simone, Claudio, Franco Adriano, Laura: non vi dimenticheremo.
q.t: Simone, Claudio, Franco Adriano, Laura: we will not forget you.

ti: Siher: con nuove chat si rivaluti posizione. Solidarietà a Donzelli per minacce
s: Brothers of Italy deputy group leaders Augusta Montaruli and Stefano Maullu called for re-evaluation of Youssef Siher's legal position based on newly emerged chat messages allegedly showing organized violent activity, and expressed solidarity with Giovanni Donzelli over reported threats.

q.o: Dalla lettura delle nuove chat di Youssef Siher emerge chiaramente la presenza di una vera e propria organizzazione che, addirittura, consigliava scorte di cibo e acqua a coloro che erano chiamati a distruggere vetrine e tirare "merda agli sbirri".
q.t: From reading the new chats of Youssef Siher, the presence of a real organization clearly emerges that even advised food and water supplies to those who were called to destroy shop windows and throw 'shit at the cops'.

q.o: Quanto si legge è sufficiente ad approfondire ulteriormente la condotta di Siher e di rivalutare la sua posizione e la gravità dell'accusa. Parole che adombrano l'ipotesi di terrorismo, dinanzi alle quali è giustificato superare qualsiasi scrupolo, perchè difendere l'Italia è prioritario.
q.t: What we read is sufficient to further investigate Siher's conduct and to re-evaluate his position and the seriousness of the accusation. Words that hint at the hypothesis of terrorism, in the face of which it is justified to overcome any scruple, because defending Italy is a priority.

q.o: Il diritto al dissenso non giustifica mai la violenza e l'intimidazione, tutte le forze politiche devono respingere apertamente questi messaggi e isolare chi alimenta l'odio.
q.t: The right to dissent never justifies violence and intimidation, all political forces must openly reject these messages and isolate those who fuel hatred.

ti: Dehors: regole chiare e tempi dimezzati per imprese
s: Brothers of Italy senators praise a Council of Ministers decree reorganizing outdoor seating (dehors) regulations, reducing authorization times to 45 days and limiting cultural heritage oversight to areas directly adjacent to exceptional monuments.

q.o: Con il via libera del Consiglio dei ministri al decreto di riordino sui dehors, il governo Meloni mette finalmente la parola fine alla stagione delle proroghe emergenziali e dell'incertezza normativa, consegnando a bar, ristoranti e pubblici esercizi una disciplina organica, stabile e moderna.
q.t: With the Council of Ministers' approval of the decree reorganizing dehors, the Meloni government finally puts an end to the season of emergency extensions and regulatory uncertainty, delivering to bars, restaurants and public establishments an organic, stable and modern discipline.

q.o: Tra le principali novità previste: la riduzione a 45 giorni dei termini per il rilascio delle autorizzazioni culturali e paesaggistiche, l'applicazione del silenzio-assenso e l'istituzione di un sistema informativo delle aree interessate.
q.t: Among the main innovations provided: the reduction to 45 days of the terms for issuing cultural and landscape authorizations, the application of tacit consent and the establishment of an information system for the areas concerned.

ti: Polizia penitenziaria: piano assunzioni più grande di ultimi 40 anni
s: Undersecretary of Justice Alberto Balboni announced the largest prison police recruitment plan in 40 years, with hiring in January and February expected to bring staffing close to full capacity, and noted the government renewed the collective contract for officers after 10 years.

q.o: Questo governo ha trovato una situazione molto difficile. Dopo oltre 10 anni del blocco del turnover e un ridimensionamento delle scuole di formazione, ci siamo trovati con uno stato del personale difficilissimo da gestire, con un'età media molto elevata.
q.t: This government found a very difficult situation. After over 10 years of turnover freeze and a downsizing of training schools, we found ourselves with a very difficult staffing situation to manage, with a very high average age.

q.o: Per questo abbiamo varato il più grande piano assunzionale degli ultimi 40 anni; ciò nonostante siamo ancora sotto organico. Con il reclutamento di gennaio e febbraio ci avvicineremo finalmente alla saturazione della pianta organica.
q.t: For this reason we launched the largest recruitment plan of the last 40 years; nevertheless we are still understaffed. With the recruitment in January and February we will finally approach full staffing capacity.

q.o: Siamo riusciti a rinnovare dopo 10 anni il contratto collettivo degli agenti, addirittura a luglio abbiamo rinnovato il contratto prima della scadenza, prima volta nella storia della Repubblica.
q.t: We managed to renew the collective contract for officers after 10 years, indeed in July we renewed the contract before its expiration, the first time in the history of the Republic.

ti: Cortei: scarcerazione Siher mortifica lavoro forze dell’ordine
s: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni criticized a Milan judge's decision not to validate the arrest of Youssef Siher, accused of managing a Telegram page that incited protests leading to vandalism in Milan, calling it shameful and a mortification of law enforcement work.

q.o: Lo dirò senza mezzi termini: considero vergognosa la decisione del gip di Milano di non convalidare l'arresto di Youssef Siher, accusato di essere il gestore della pagina Telegram 'Movimento 17 ottobre', cioè la pagina che incitava l'organizzazione di quelle manifestazioni che poi abbiamo visto portare alla devastazione di diversi esercizi commerciali a Milano.
q.t: I will say it without mincing words: I consider shameful the decision of the Milan investigating judge not to validate the arrest of Youssef Siher, accused of being the manager of the Telegram page 'Movimento 17 ottobre', that is the page that incited the organization of those demonstrations that we then saw lead to the devastation of several commercial establishments in Milan.

q.o: Penso che questa sia una mortificazione insopportabile del lavoro delle forze dell'ordine, degli inquirenti, del ministero dell'Interno e, in generale, di tutti coloro che si adoperano per difendere la gente per bene dal rischio di vedere devastate le proprie città e i propri esercizi commerciali.
q.t: I think this is an unbearable mortification of the work of law enforcement, investigators, the Ministry of the Interior and, in general, of all those who work to defend decent people from the risk of seeing their cities and their commercial establishments devastated.

ti: Mafia: arrestato sindaco sinistra che fomentava protesta tir
s: Brothers of Italy Senator Raoul Russo and party members in the Anti-Mafia Commission commented on the arrest of Corigliano Rossano mayor Flavio Stasi on mafia-related charges, criticizing left-wing parties for their silence and noting Stasi had recently led trucker protests against the Meloni government.

q.o: Stamane è stata compiuta una vasta azione contro la 'Ndrangheta che, oltre a portare all'arresto di vari esponenti di famiglie mafiose, ha portato anche all'arresto del sindaco di Corigliano Rossano, Flavio Stasi, cui sono state mosse accuse pesantissime, fra cui reati connessi all'immigrazione. Stasi è stato fino a pochi giorni fa impegnato a fianco delle proteste degli autotrasportatori non lesinando attacchi alla premier Meloni. E oggi è stato arrestato. Da parte della sinistra non si è ancora levata nessuna voce quando, per molto meno, questa voce l'hanno fatta sentire. Questa è la dimostrazione che a sinistra hanno la coda di paglia e, come al solito, applicano due pesi e due misure.
q.t: This morning a vast action was carried out against the 'Ndrangheta which, in addition to leading to the arrest of various members of mafia families, also led to the arrest of the mayor of Corigliano Rossano, Flavio Stasi, who has been charged with very serious accusations, including crimes related to immigration. Until a few days ago Stasi was engaged alongside the truck drivers' protests, not sparing attacks on Premier Meloni. And today he was arrested. From the left not a single voice has yet been raised when, for much less, they made their voice heard. This is proof that the left has a guilty conscience and, as usual, applies double standards.

q.o: Cosa hanno da dire oggi Giuseppe Conte, Elly Schlein, Pasquale Tridico, Anna Laura Orrico e Vittoria Baldino, che hanno sostenuto con entusiasmo Stasi facendone il modello del 'campo largo' in Calabria?
q.t: What do Giuseppe Conte, Elly Schlein, Pasquale Tridico, Anna Laura Orrico and Vittoria Baldino, who enthusiastically supported Stasi making him the model of the 'broad coalition' in Calabria, have to say today?
q.sp: Brothers of Italy Anti-Mafia Commission members

q.o: Come annunciato dal presidente Colosimo, chiederemo subito di acquisire gli atti dell'inchiesta. Intanto attendiamo che Pd, M5S e sinistra rompano il loro imbarazzato silenzio.
q.t: As announced by President Colosimo, we will immediately request to acquire the investigation documents. Meanwhile we await the PD, M5S and the left to break their embarrassed silence.
q.sp: Brothers of Italy Anti-Mafia Commission members

ti: Sanità: riforma professioni sanitarie tutela e valorizza categoria
s: Brothers of Italy deputy Francesco Ciancitto announced Chamber approval of a government delegation on healthcare professions and professional responsibility, a reform aimed at reorganizing the National Health Service through enhanced professional training, administrative simplification, and revised liability rules.

q.o: L'approvazione alla Camera della delega al governo in materia di professioni sanitarie e responsabilità professionale rappresenta un passaggio significativo nel percorso di riorganizzazione e rafforzamento del nostro Servizio sanitario nazionale.
q.t: The Chamber's approval of the delegation to the government on healthcare professions and professional responsibility represents a significant step in the path of reorganization and strengthening of our National Health Service.

q.o: La tutela della salute passa necessariamente dalla valorizzazione di chi se ne prende cura.
q.t: The protection of health necessarily passes through the valorization of those who take care of it.

ti: Giustizia: tutela vittime reato entra in Costituzione
s: Brothers of Italy senators announce a constitutional reform inserting crime victim protection into Article 24 of the Italian Constitution, emphasizing state duty to protect victims of violence, stalking, and families of state servants.

q.o: La tutela delle vittime entra nella Costituzione e segna un passaggio storico per la nostra Nazione.
q.t: The protection of victims enters the Constitution and marks a historic passage for our Nation.

q.o: Per troppo tempo abbiamo definito con grande precisione le garanzie dell'imputato, lasciando invece in secondo piano chi ha subito un reato.
q.t: For too long we have defined with great precision the guarantees of the accused, leaving instead in the background those who have suffered a crime.

q.o: Questa riforma – che inserisce la tutela della vittima all'articolo 24 della Costituzione – è una pietra miliare nella storia civile e giuridica della nostra Nazione.
q.t: This reform – which inserts the protection of the victim into Article 24 of the Constitution – is a milestone in the civil and legal history of our Nation.

q.o: Da oggi la solitudine delle vittime cessa di essere un destino e diventa una responsabilità inderogabile della Repubblica.
q.t: From today the loneliness of victims ceases to be a destiny and becomes a non-negotiable responsibility of the Republic.

ti: Vox (political party) - Wikipedia
s: Vox's six deputies in the European Parliament are members of Patriots for Europe, having previously been in the European Conservatives and Reformists Group.

ti: General election poll: An internal Vox survey prior to Urda places the PSOE ahead of the PP, but keeps the right-wing majority - Demócrata
s: An internal Vox survey conducted before an event in Urda shows the PSOE leading the PP in general election polling, while maintaining a right-wing majority overall.

ti: Sondaxe poll: the PP leads the PSOE by 2.3 points and Vox reaches 19.2% one month before the elections - Demócrata
s: A Sondaxe poll shows Vox reaching 19.2% support one month before elections, with PP leading PSOE by 2.3 points.

ti: 30 ANNI CON IL POPOLO, CONTRO IL POTERE
s: Forza Nuova announces its 5th Congress will be held in Rome on January 23-24, framing 2027 as a struggle between power and the people, with revolutionary rhetoric about sweeping away enemies.

q.o: Il 23 e 24 gennaio si terrà a Roma il 5°Congresso di Forza Nuova
q.t: On January 23 and 24, the 5th Congress of Forza Nuova will be held in Rome

q.o: Il 2027 preannuncia una lotta particolarmente aspra: da una parte il potere barricato nelle aule di una giustizia di parte e corrotta e di un parlamento vile ed incapace, e dall'altra un Popolo che alza la testa quando la sua dignità, la sua identità e libertà vengono calpestate.
q.t: 2027 heralds a particularly harsh struggle: on one side power barricaded in the halls of a partisan and corrupt justice system and a cowardly and incapable parliament, and on the other a People who raise their heads when their dignity, identity and freedom are trampled.

q.o: Alla fine solo uno dei contendenti rimarrà in piedi e la Rivoluzione 'come il vento' spazzerà via il nemico dei popoli.
q.t: In the end only one of the contenders will remain standing and the Revolution 'like the wind' will sweep away the enemy of the peoples.

ti: PCI Umbria, il 31 ottobre a Perugia l’inaugurazione della nuova sede regionale
s: The Italian Communist Party's Umbria regional branch will inaugurate its new regional headquarters in Perugia on October 31, 2026, with national secretary Mauro Alboresi attending, positioning the space as open to citizens, political forces, unions, and social movements for discussion and collective action.

q.o: L'apertura della nuova sede vuole rappresentare qualcosa di più di un semplice momento organizzativo: uno spazio fisico aperto alla discussione, al confronto, alla partecipazione e alla costruzione di iniziative comuni.
q.t: The opening of the new headquarters aims to represent something more than a simple organizational moment: a physical space open to discussion, debate, participation and the construction of common initiatives.

q.o: Il PCI considera l'unità della sinistra una condizione necessaria per costruire un blocco politico e sociale alternativo, capace di mettere in relazione esperienze, movimenti, organizzazioni e soggetti diversi intorno a obiettivi comuni.
q.t: The PCI considers the unity of the left a necessary condition to build an alternative political and social bloc, capable of connecting experiences, movements, organizations and different subjects around common objectives.

ti: Presentazione del libro “La Controriforma permanente.La scuola italiana tra mercato e guerra”, a cura di LucaCangemi
s: The Italian Communist Party announces book presentations in Sassari and Cagliari on 30-31 September discussing the transformation of Italian public schools under market logic and militarization processes, edited by Luca Cangemi.

q.o: É indispensabile ribadire la necessità di difendere una scuola pubblica che non sia subordinata agli interessi economici né alle logiche della guerra, ma che continui a rappresentare uno spazio di libertà, conoscenza critica, inclusione e costruzione della pace.
q.t: It is essential to reaffirm the necessity of defending a public school that is not subordinated to economic interests nor to the logic of war, but that continues to represent a space of freedom, critical knowledge, inclusion and construction of peace.

ti: Lula vince, il Partito Comunista del Brasile si rafforza
s: The Italian Communist Party congratulates the Communist Party of Brazil on Lula's electoral victory and the party's growth from 6 to 11 seats and 3,000 new members, while condemning Flavio Bolsonaro's flight from Brazil and pledging solidarity against US imperialism.

q.o: Il Partito Comunista Italiano si congratula con il Partito Comunista del Brasile (PCdoB) per la splendida vittoria elettorale di Lula e per il rafforzamento del PCdoB, che passa da 6 a 11 seggi nella nuova legislatura e che ha reclutato 3.000 nuove iscritte e iscritti durante la campagna elettorale.
q.t: The Italian Communist Party congratulates the Communist Party of Brazil (PCdoB) for the splendid electoral victory of Lula and for the strengthening of the PCdoB, which goes from 6 to 11 seats in the new legislature and which recruited 3,000 new members during the electoral campaign.

q.o: Insieme combatteremo l'imperialismo USA, che è il principale sponsor dei tentativi che in America Latina, Europa e nelle altre parti del mondo cercano di distruggere le istituzioni democratiche e il diritto internazionale nati dalla sconfitta del nazifascismo nella Seconda Guerra Mondiale.
q.t: Together we will fight US imperialism, which is the main sponsor of the attempts in Latin America, Europe and other parts of the world that seek to destroy the democratic institutions and international law born from the defeat of Nazi-fascism in the Second World War.

ti: Il governo Italiano a fianco degli USA contro il popolo e la rivoluzione Cubana!
s: The Italian Communist Party condemned the Italian government's abstention at the UN General Assembly vote on ending the US embargo against Cuba, participated in solidarity protests on 27 October 2026, and accused the Meloni government of servility to US policy and authoritarian fascist tendencies.

q.o: Il governo italiano, che precedentemente aveva votato per l'abolizione del Bloqueo, questa volta si è astenuto, a seguito delle pressioni esercitate in particolare dal Segretario di Stato Marco Rubio sui Paesi alleati degli USA.
q.t: The Italian government, which had previously voted for the abolition of the Bloqueo, this time abstained, following pressure exerted particularly by Secretary of State Marco Rubio on US allied countries.

q.o: L'astensione dell'Italia si inquadra in un ribadito servilismo verso la politica USA, nel sostegno del nostro governo ai governi e ai partiti di estrema destra che cercano di riportare l'America Latina sotto il completo dominio statunitense, nella politica autoritaria e fascistoide che il governo Meloni conduce contro ogni forma di opposizione sociale e democratica giovanile e popolare
q.t: Italy's abstention fits into a reiterated servility towards US policy, in our government's support for far-right governments and parties seeking to bring Latin America back under complete US domination, in the authoritarian and fascist-like policy that the Meloni government conducts against every form of social and democratic youth and popular opposition

q.o: LE COMUNISTE E I COMUNISTI ITALIANI SONO DALLA PARTE DEL POPOLO E DEL GOVERNO RIVOLUZIONARIO DI CUBA!
q.t: ITALIAN COMMUNISTS ARE ON THE SIDE OF THE PEOPLE AND THE REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT OF CUBA!

ti: EX ILVA: nazionalizzare per salvare la siderurgia pubblica e difendere il lavoro
s: The Italian Communist Party demands nationalization of ex-ILVA steel plants to prevent closures and job losses, criticizing privatization policies and proposing public management to guarantee employment, environmental remediation, and industrial continuity across all facilities including Taranto and Genoa.

q.o: senza la nazionalizzazione dell'ex ILVA, unica soluzione seria per salvare un asset strategico dell'industria italiana, si va verso la chiusura degli impianti e la dispersione di un patrimonio industriale fondamentale per il Paese
q.t: without the nationalization of ex-ILVA, the only serious solution to save a strategic asset of Italian industry, we are heading toward the closure of the plants and the dispersal of an industrial patrimony fundamental for the country

q.o: È la logica neoliberista del profitto privato e delle perdite pubbliche, alla quale il Governo continua a essere subalterno
q.t: It is the neoliberal logic of private profit and public losses, to which the Government continues to be subordinate

q.o: Nazionalizzare significa garantire investimenti, risanamento ambientale, sicurezza e occupazione, sottraendo la siderurgia alle logiche speculative
q.t: Nationalizing means guaranteeing investments, environmental remediation, safety and employment, removing the steel industry from speculative logics

q.o: Genova non può essere contrapposta a Taranto, né uno stabilimento può salvarsi abbandonando gli altri al proprio destino
q.t: Genoa cannot be opposed to Taranto, nor can one plant save itself by abandoning the others to their fate

q.o: le risorse destinate al riarmo e alla guerra devono essere indirizzate al risanamento e al rilancio dell'industria pubblica
q.t: the resources destined for rearmament and war must be directed to the remediation and relaunch of public industry

ti: Terremoto nelle Marche
s: The Italian Communist Party's Marche federation condemns corruption in post-earthquake reconstruction involving regional officials and calls for anti-capitalist measures and constitutional reforms to combat systemic corruption.

q.o: Al di là dello specifico fatto di cronaca non si può non rilevare che la corruzione non è affatto diminuita dai tempi delle denunce di Berlinguer e dei processi di mani pulite.
q.t: Beyond the specific news event, it must be noted that corruption has not decreased at all since the times of Berlinguer's denunciations and the Clean Hands trials.

q.o: La lotta alla corruzione è lotta anticapitalista e si rafforza contestando il bipolarismo coatto, ripristinando il controllo democratico, con il ritorno alla Costituzione.
q.t: The fight against corruption is an anti-capitalist struggle and is strengthened by challenging forced bipolarism, restoring democratic control, with a return to the Constitution.

ti: Un operaio continuerà a governare il Brasile: ha vinto Lula!
s: The Italian Communist Party celebrates Lula's re-election victory in Brazil, describing it as a crucial counter-trend against US-backed defeats of Latin American socialist governments and emphasizing Brazil's continued role in BRICS and resistance to Trump administration influence.

q.o: Un operaio continuerà a governare il Brasile, con i suoi più di duecento milioni di abitanti.
q.t: A worker will continue to govern Brazil, with its more than two hundred million inhabitants.

q.o: Il Brasile quindi non tornerà a far parte del cortile di casa degli Stati Uniti, ma resterà un tassello fondamentale della lotta in corso fra l'Amministrazione Trump e le forze socialiste, di sinistra e progressiste del sub continente.
q.t: Brazil therefore will not return to being part of the United States' backyard, but will remain a fundamental piece of the ongoing struggle between the Trump Administration and the socialist, left-wing and progressive forces of the subcontinent.

q.o: In un quadro che ha visto la sconfitta (tenacemente perseguita da Trump e dal segretario di Stato Rubio in tutti i modi possibili) di quasi tutti i governi socialisti e progressisti latinoamericani, la rielezione di Lula rappresenta un fatto prezioso in controtendenza.
q.t: In a context that has seen the defeat (tenaciously pursued by Trump and Secretary of State Rubio in every possible way) of almost all Latin American socialist and progressive governments, Lula's re-election represents a precious counter-trend.

ti: Reform UK calls for timetable after £10 million Bury Market funding announcement - Roch Valley Radio
s: Reform UK called for a timetable following the announcement of £10 million in funding for Bury Market.

ti: Reform UK calls for Harrogate relief road review and tighter council spending controls - Harrogate Informer
s: Reform UK has called for a review of the Harrogate relief road project and tighter controls on council spending.

ti: Nigel Farage pledges to rebrand Army force with 'distinctively British' name - Daily Express
s: Nigel Farage pledged to rebrand an Army force with a 'distinctively British' name.

ti: Reform and Farage ‘don’t do defence’ in parliament, new analysis shows - The Independent

q.o: quando la sinistra si organizza, quando smette di parlare a sé stessa e impara a stare tra le persone, quando trasforma l'indignazione in partecipazione e la partecipazione in potere, può vincere
q.t: when the left organizes, when it stops talking to itself and learns to be among the people, when it transforms indignation into participation and participation into power, it can win

q.o: un riferimento perché dimostra che costruire un blocco sociale ampio, radicato nei territori, capace di unire lavoratori, giovani, movimenti femministi e comunità marginalizzate è possibile e vincente; un monito perché la vittoria elettorale è solo l'inizio, e cedere al centro è la strada più rapida verso la perdita di tutto questo capitale politico e sociale

ti: Rosebank lobbying scandal – Green Party responds
s: Green Party leader Zack Polanski condemned revelations that oil and gas firms met UK ministers 200 times between July 2024 and June 2026 regarding Rosebank and Jackdaw projects, calling for rejection of new drilling, a tightened windfall tax, and an end to fossil fuel tax breaks.

q.o: This summer we saw nearly 3000 people die from extreme heat while wildfires raged across the country. This is the crucial decade for climate action – yet Labour ministers are still holding cozy meetings with oil and gas bosses with alarming frequency.
q.t: This summer we saw nearly 3000 people die from extreme heat while wildfires raged across the country. This is the crucial decade for climate action – yet Labour ministers are still holding cozy meetings with oil and gas bosses with alarming frequency.

q.o: Budget documents revealed the government is paving the way to greenlight Rosebank which would be catastrophic for the climate. But it's no wonder this Labour government is making decisions that put the profits of oil and gas giants above the safety of people in this country, when they are constantly rubbing shoulders with them.
q.t: Budget documents revealed the government is paving the way to greenlight Rosebank which would be catastrophic for the climate. But it's no wonder this Labour government is making decisions that put the profits of oil and gas giants above the safety of people in this country, when they are constantly rubbing shoulders with them.

q.o: The people of this country deserve better. We need to say no to new oil and gas drilling, a tightened-up windfall tax on oil and gas and an end to tax breaks for fossil fuel companies so we can stop backing climate-wrecking polluters and take real action for a safe future instead.
q.t: The people of this country deserve better. We need to say no to new oil and gas drilling, a tightened-up windfall tax on oil and gas and an end to tax breaks for fossil fuel companies so we can stop backing climate-wrecking polluters and take real action for a safe future instead.

ti: Lobbyists should not be in the driving seat when it comes to data centres and AI
s: Green Party Deputy Leader Rachel Millward criticized the Labour government for allowing AI industry lobbyists disproportionate access while excluding environmental and community groups from data centre policy decisions, calling for a halt to new data centre approvals due to water and carbon concerns.

q.o: Labour is diving headfirst into AI without a roadmap, charmed by corporate lobbyists while community and green voices are shut out. We need to slam the brakes on new data centres before they drain our water supplies and wreck the UK's carbon budget.

When policy is written by corporations, decisions benefit shareholder profits rather than the public good. It's a dangerous lack of oversight, proven by a recent FOI showing the government doesn't even know what current data centres are being used for.

ti: Green Party reaction to Autumn 2026 Budget
s: Green Party Treasury Spokesperson Ellie Chowns criticized Labour's Autumn 2026 Budget for lacking ambition on climate investment, failing to tax extreme wealth, and supporting the Rosebank oilfield instead of addressing climate crisis and inequality.

q.o: You'd have thought that after going to the trouble of ousting the last PM, taking his job, and installing a brand-new Chancellor, Andy Burnham would be keen to ensure Labour displayed a bit more ambition at today's Budget than it did under his predecessor.
q.t: You'd have thought that after going to the trouble of ousting the last PM, taking his job, and installing a brand-new Chancellor, Andy Burnham would be keen to ensure Labour displayed a bit more ambition at today's Budget than it did under his predecessor.

q.o: There was no discussion of the climate crisis in Healey's speech today, nor any new investment in renewables and climate adaptation, despite the devastating impact of this summer's deadly heatwaves and wildfires on our communities, public services, and economy.
q.t: There was no discussion of the climate crisis in Healey's speech today, nor any new investment in renewables and climate adaptation, despite the devastating impact of this summer's deadly heatwaves and wildfires on our communities, public services, and economy.

q.o: Instead the Chancellor doubled down on fossil fuels, balancing the books on the assumption that climate-wrecking Rosebank oilfield will be approved.
q.t: Instead the Chancellor doubled down on fossil fuels, balancing the books on the assumption that climate-wrecking Rosebank oilfield will be approved.

ti: Greens urge Chancellor not to shy away from taxing extreme wealth and profits as concerns rise over business-as-usual Budget
s: The Green Party proposed measures to raise over £60 billion through taxing extreme wealth and profits, including aligning Capital Gains Tax with income tax, introducing a wealth tax on multimillionaires, and a windfall tax on banks, while calling on Chancellor John Healey to adopt these proposals in the upcoming Budget.

q.o: While millions of households struggle to cope with the cost-of-living crisis, successive governments have permitted a handful of super-rich individuals and corporations to rake in ever-more extreme profits – and to pay proportionally less tax on that wealth. This cannot continue.

Britain needs a genuinely bold Budget – one which taxes extreme wealth and profits fairly, makes life more affordable for struggling households and invests in our long-term climate resilience. Huge inequality and climate breakdown cannot be tackled by tinkering around the edges.

If Labour is serious about addressing the affordability and climate crises, the Chancellor could and should adopt our proposals at the Budget tomorrow. Unfortunately, it seems Healey is set to instead deliver another business-as-usual Budget which fails to take the bold action we need to build a fairer, greener country.

ti: Workers’ rights are universal or they are nothing, says Green Party
s: Green Party deputy leader Mothin Ali criticized Labour's reported budget plan to freeze the minimum wage rate for 18-20 year olds, contrasting it with the Green Party's proposal for a £15 minimum wage for all ages and a Youth Jobs Guarantee.

q.o: Workers' rights are universal or they are nothing.
q.t: Workers' rights are universal or they are nothing.

q.o: Anyone doing a day's work, needs to be paid the same rate for the same job. A young person's rent and food bill is no less because they are young, so they need to receive the same wage.
q.t: Anyone doing a day's work, needs to be paid the same rate for the same job. A young person's rent and food bill is no less because they are young, so they need to receive the same wage.

q.o: The Greens will introduce a £15 minimum wage for all ages and a proper Youth Jobs Guarantee, which pays and trains young people in real jobs, unlike Labour's retro 1980s YTS version.
q.t: The Greens will introduce a £15 minimum wage for all ages and a proper Youth Jobs Guarantee, which pays and trains young people in real jobs, unlike Labour's retro 1980s YTS version.

q.o: Healey and Burnham are now breaking a manifesto pledge to young people that even Starmer managed to keep. Labour have no respect for young people, who appear to just be there for cheap labour for the wealthy and their corporate donors.
q.t: Healey and Burnham are now breaking a manifesto pledge to young people that even Starmer managed to keep. Labour have no respect for young people, who appear to just be there for cheap labour for the wealthy and their corporate donors.

ti: Πάρκαραν τον τόπο στο αδιέξοδο και περιμένουν να τους χειροκροτήσουμε
s: AKEL's General Secretary criticized the ruling DISY party in a Central Committee speech, accusing the Anastasiades and Christodoulides governments of serving big interests, dismantling the welfare state, abandoning small and medium businesses to inflation, and promoting institutional corruption over 13 years of governance.

q.o: ο ΔΗΣΥ κυβερνά τα τελευταία 13 χρόνια. Πριν η Κυβέρνηση Αναστασιάδη και τώρα η Κυβέρνηση Χριστοδουλίδη στρώνουν χαλί στα μεγάλα συμφέροντα, βάζουν τα μεγάλα κέρδη πάνω από το συμφέρον της κοινωνίας, ξηλώνουν το κοινωνικό κράτος και τις εργασιακές σχέσεις, αφήνουν χιλιάδες μικρομεσαίους στο έλεος του πληθωρισμού, απογειώνουν με τα έργα και τις ημέρες τους τη θεσμική διαφθορά και διαπλοκή
q.t: DISY has been governing for the last 13 years. First the Anastasiades Government and now the Christodoulides Government roll out the red carpet for big interests, put big profits above the interest of society, dismantle the welfare state and labor relations, leave thousands of small and medium-sized businesses at the mercy of inflation, and elevate institutional corruption and entanglement with their actions and days

q.o: Πάρκαραν τον τόπο στο αδιέξοδο και περιμένουν να τους χειροκροτήσουμε
q.t: They parked the country in a dead end and expect us to applaud them

q.o: Το ΑΚΕΛ θα συνεχίσει να ασκεί τεκμηριωμένη κριτική και να καταθέτει θέσεις και προτάσεις. Και θ' αγωνιστεί με όλες του τις δυνάμεις για να πετύχει αυτό που τόσο έχει ανάγκη ο τόπος μας: την προοδευτική αλλαγή
q.t: AKEL will continue to exercise documented criticism and submit positions and proposals. And it will fight with all its forces to achieve what our country so badly needs: progressive change

ti: Ανακοίνωση Κ.E ΑΚΕΛ: Αδιαπραγμάτευτος στόχος η προοδευτική αλλαγή στη διακυβέρνηση της χώρας το 2028
s: AKEL's Central Committee convened to establish the political framework and strategy for the 2028 Presidential Elections, reaffirming progressive change in governance as a non-negotiable goal and authorizing leadership to pursue alliances with other political forces based on programmatic convergence.

q.o: Η Κεντρική Επιτροπή επαναβεβαίωσε ότι το ΑΚΕΛ κατέρχεται στις Προεδρικές Εκλογές με αδιαπραγμάτευτο στόχο την προοδευτική αλλαγή στη διακυβέρνηση της χώρας το 2028.
q.t: The Central Committee reaffirmed that AKEL enters the Presidential Elections with the non-negotiable goal of progressive change in the governance of the country in 2028.

q.o: Το ΑΚΕΛ απευθύνει πλατύ κάλεσμα σε όλο τον κόσμο της Αριστεράς και σε όλες τις προοδευτικές και δημοκρατικές δυνάμεις της κυπριακής κοινωνίας να ενώσουν τη φωνή τους με τις δυνάμεις της προοδευτικής αλλαγής
q.t: AKEL issues a broad call to the entire Left and to all progressive and democratic forces of Cypriot society to unite their voice with the forces of progressive change

ti: Ομιλία ΓΓ του ΑΚΕΛ, Στέφανου Στεφάνου, στην Ολομέλεια της ΚΕ για τις Προεδρικές Εκλογές 2028
s: AKEL General Secretary Stefanos Stefanou addressed the Central Committee to approve the political framework for the February 2028 Presidential Elections, calling for a "progressive change" coalition with other political forces to challenge the current government and DISY, criticizing their policies on economic inequality, corruption, and the Cyprus problem.

q.o: Η Κύπρος έχει ανάγκη από αλλαγή. Από προοδευτική αλλαγή που θα υπηρετεί τη μεγάλη πλειοψηφία του λαού μας.
q.t: Cyprus needs change. Progressive change that will serve the great majority of our people.

q.o: Χριστοδουλίδης και ΔΗΣΥ πρέπει να φύγουν από την εξουσία για να αναπνεύσει η κοινωνία.
q.t: Christodoulides and DISY must leave power so that society can breathe.

q.o: Το δύσκολο -και αυτό θα πράξουμε- είναι να αναζητήσουμε συμμαχίες ώστε να διαμορφωθεί ένα πλατύ προοδευτικό μέτωπο με στόχο την αλλαγή.
q.t: The difficult thing—and this is what we will do—is to seek alliances so that a broad progressive front can be formed with the goal of change.

q.o: Οι προοδευτικές δυνάμεις του τόπου έχουν ιστορικό καθήκον να συνεργαστούν για την απομόνωση της ακροδεξιάς.
q.t: The progressive forces of the country have a historic duty to cooperate for the isolation of the far-right.

ti: Συνάντηση ΓΓ ΑΚΕΛ με την Προσωπική Απεσταλμένη του ΓΓ του ΟΗΕ για το Κυπριακό
s: The General Secretary of AKEL met with the UN Secretary-General's Personal Envoy on Cyprus to discuss prospects for progress toward an expanded conference before António Guterres' term ends, reiterating AKEL's position that previously achieved convergences should serve as the basis for resuming substantive negotiations and proposing a roadmap respecting the negotiating acquis including the Guterres Framework.

q.o: Από πλευράς ΑΚΕΛ, επαναλάβαμε τη θέση μας ότι οι συγκλίσεις που έχουν επιτευχθεί μέχρι σήμερα πρέπει να δοθούν στις δύο πλευρές και να αξιοποιηθούν ως βάση για την επανέναρξη ουσιαστικών διαπραγματεύσεων.
q.t: From AKEL's side, we repeated our position that the convergences achieved to date must be given to the two sides and utilized as a basis for the resumption of substantive negotiations.

q.o: Υπογραμμίζοντας, ωστόσο, ότι τα ΜΟΕ, όσο σημαντικά και αν είναι, δεν μπορούν να υποκαταστήσουν τη σημασία της επανέναρξης ουσιαστικών διαπραγματεύσεων για συνολική λύση του Κυπριακού.
q.t: Emphasizing, however, that the Confidence Building Measures, however important they may be, cannot substitute for the importance of resuming substantive negotiations for a comprehensive solution to the Cyprus problem.

ti: Τα ντροπιαστικά φαινόμενα εργασιακής εκμετάλλευσης αναδεικνύουν σοβαρές ανεπάρκειες στους μηχανισμούς ελέγχου και προστασίας των εργαζομένων
s: AKEL condemns revelations of labor trafficking and inhumane working conditions in Cyprus, criticizes the government for weakening employment controls for third-country workers, and demands full investigation, strengthened inspection mechanisms, and comprehensive revision of employment strategy for third-country workers with equal protection for all workers.

q.o: Οι αποκαλύψεις για εργασιακό trafficking και απάνθρωπες συνθήκες εργασίας και διαβίωσης εργαζομένων στην Κύπρο είναι ντροπιαστικές για τον τόπο μας.
q.t: The revelations about labor trafficking and inhumane working and living conditions of workers in Cyprus are shameful for our country.

q.o: Αντί να ενισχύει τους ελέγχους και τις ασφαλιστικές δικλίδες προστασίας, η κυβέρνηση συναίνεσε σε απαιτήσεις των εργοδοτικών οργανώσεων για χαλάρωση των προϋποθέσεων απασχόλησης εργαζομένων από τρίτες χώρες, προς εξυπηρέτηση μεγάλων συμφερόντων αντί του ελέγχου της εργοδοτικής αυθαιρεσίας.
q.t: Instead of strengthening controls and protective safety valves, the government consented to demands from employer organizations to relax the conditions for employing workers from third countries, serving large interests instead of controlling employer arbitrariness.

q.o: Το ΑΚΕΛ απαιτεί την πλήρη διερεύνηση των καταγγελιών και την απόδοση ευθυνών, την ουσιαστική ενίσχυση των ελεγκτικών μηχανισμών και την αυστηρή εφαρμογή της εργατικής νομοθεσίας.
q.t: AKEL demands the full investigation of complaints and accountability, the substantial strengthening of inspection mechanisms and the strict application of labor legislation.

ti: Το ΑΚΕΛ εγγράφει το ζήτημα της παράνομης αδειοδότησης της Μονής στο Κάβο Γκρέκο στην Κοινοβουλευτική Επιτροπή Εσωτερικών
s: AKEL is registering the issue of allegedly illegal licensing of a monastery at Cape Greco for discussion in the Parliamentary Committee on Internal Affairs, seeking to examine both this specific case and the broader framework of urban planning deviations in Cyprus.

q.o: Για τον λόγο αυτό το ΑΚΕΛ θα προχωρήσει στην εγγραφή του θέματος στη Βουλή των Αντιπροσώπων, ώστε να συζητηθεί τόσο η συγκεκριμένη υπόθεση όσο και το ευρύτερο πλαίσιο παραχώρησης πολεοδομικών παρεκκλίσεων στην Κύπρο.
q.t: For this reason, AKEL will proceed to register the issue in the House of Representatives, so that both this specific case and the broader framework of granting urban planning deviations in Cyprus can be discussed.

q.o: Βασική μας αρχή ήταν και παραμένει ότι ο πολεοδομικός σχεδιασμός πρέπει να υπηρετεί την κοινωνία.
q.t: Our basic principle was and remains that urban planning must serve society.
