ti: Widespread Abuse of Workers at Irish-run Data Centre Construction Sites in Europe
s: Paul Murphy TD requested that Tom Parlon, chairman of the Irish Data Centre Supplier Alliance, return to the Oireachtas AI committee to explain his earlier statement that Irish data centre construction companies operate within labour legislation frameworks overseas, following an Investigate Europe report documenting widespread worker abuses at European construction sites involving Irish companies.

q.o: The Investigate Europe report published this morning shows widespread abuse of workers by data construction companies, including Irish companies, at sites across Europe.

I have now written to the Oireachtas AI committee requesting that Tom Parlon be invited back to the committee to address these revelations and to explain why he told the committee meeting that he was absolutely confident that Irish companies involved in building data centres overseas are operating within the framework of labour legislation.

ti: PBP Host Meeting on Daisy Hill
s: People Before Profit organised a public meeting on 2nd November at Ballybot House to discuss community and workplace organising to protect maternity services at Daisy Hill Hospital from suspension, with parliamentary leader Richard Boyd Barrett headlining alongside former Unison organiser Rebekah Corbett and PBP representative Marc Mac Seáin.

q.o: We've seen cut after cut for years at Daisy Hill. Consultants leaving, services removed, beds & wards cut. The only times this have been paused or reversed even temporarily have been in the face of large community mobilisations through the SOS Daisy Hill campaign.
q.t: We've seen cut after cut for years at Daisy Hill. Consultants leaving, services removed, beds & wards cut. The only times this have been paused or reversed even temporarily have been in the face of large community mobilisations through the SOS Daisy Hill campaign.

q.o: Our politicians most particularly those in Stormont have miserably failed to stem this tide. In fact they've given political cover to service collapse through support for centralisation through the Bengoa Report.
q.t: Our politicians most particularly those in Stormont have miserably failed to stem this tide. In fact they've given political cover to service collapse through support for centralisation through the Bengoa Report.

q.o: We saw with Garvaghy Road how a community coming together can stop the state. In the free state 300k+ unionised public sector workers have forced pay negotations through strike, similar to the 150k strong strike here in 2024 to bring Stormont back.
q.t: We saw with Garvaghy Road how a community coming together can stop the state. In the free state 300k+ unionised public sector workers have forced pay negotations through strike, similar to the 150k strong strike here in 2024 to bring Stormont back.

ti: Carroll: DUP Will Pocket the Wage and Wreck the Work
s: People Before Profit MLA Gerry Carroll criticised the DUP for continuing to draw salaries while obstructing Assembly business through the Petition of Concern, citing their blocking of measures including raising the age of criminal responsibility, the Good Jobs Bill, and the ban on conversion practices.

q.o: Strip away the bluster and the DUP's message is simple: they'll keep their wages and ministerial cars, and spend what's left of this mandate obstructing anything that might materially improve people's lives.
If a nurse, care worker or classroom assistant announced they'd spend the next six months deliberately not doing their job, they'd be sacked. Yet the DUP expects a pay packet for it.

They used the Petition of Concern to block raising the age of criminal responsibility, so ten-year-olds can still be arrested and prosecuted - the lowest age in Europe. They've stalled the Good Jobs Bill for months and demanded the trade union rights be ripped out of it.

Working-class people - nationalist, unionist and 'other' - are sick of being held hostage to this carve-up. They deserve representatives who turn up and fight for them - not politicians who take a fat pay packet to block their rights.

ti: Carroll: Court Ruling a Victory for Garvaghy Residents and People Power
s: People Before Profit MLA Gerry Carroll welcomed a High Court ruling dismissing the Orange Order's challenge to the ban on the Drumcree parade past Garvaghy Road, calling it a victory for residents and community organizing.

q.o: Today's ruling is a victory for the people of the Garvaghy Road. For nearly three decades they have said no to a sectarian march being forced past their homes, and today the High Court confirmed that the decision to ban it was lawful.
q.t: Today's ruling is a victory for the people of the Garvaghy Road. For nearly three decades they have said no to a sectarian march being forced past their homes, and today the High Court confirmed that the decision to ban it was lawful.

q.o: Ultimately, this was won by a community that organised, stood its ground and drew support from thousands of people across Ireland. That's the real lesson of Garvaghy: when working class people stand together to oppose the politics of reactionary hate, they win.
q.t: Ultimately, this was won by a community that organised, stood its ground and drew support from thousands of people across Ireland. That's the real lesson of Garvaghy: when working class people stand together to oppose the politics of reactionary hate, they win.

ti: People Before Profit Want to Ban Data Centres - You Do Too!
s: People Before Profit calls for a comprehensive ban on new data centres, citing that they consume over 23% of Ireland's electricity while paying half the residential rate, and proposes a €1.5 billion annual levy to fund household energy credits, building on parliamentary bills introduced in 2021 and 2023.

ti: Plan to Send Irish Soldiers within EU Military Mission in Lebanon Exposes Real Purpose of Ending Triple Lock
s: People Before Profit TD Paul Murphy criticized the government's plan to send Irish soldiers to Lebanon as part of an EU military mission without UN mandate, arguing this exposes the real purpose of ending the Triple Lock mechanism and calling for a referendum on the issue.

q.o: Former President Michael D Higgins' was correct when he said recently that the government is not being honest and he's also correct when he says that the removal of the Triple Lock is a preparatory move towards a military alliance.
q.t: Former President Michael D Higgins' was correct when he said recently that the government is not being honest and he's also correct when he says that the removal of the Triple Lock is a preparatory move towards a military alliance.

q.o: The Government is trying to redefine neutrality to just mean not joining NATO, while at the same time it is preparing to send Irish soldiers to Lebanon as part of an EU military mission. So it's very clear that ending the Triple Lock, as Michael D said, is a preparatory move towards a military alliance.
q.t: The Government is trying to redefine neutrality to just mean not joining NATO, while at the same time it is preparing to send Irish soldiers to Lebanon as part of an EU military mission. So it's very clear that ending the Triple Lock, as Michael D said, is a preparatory move towards a military alliance.

q.o: The Government is preparing the legislative ground to send young people abroad to fight in imperialist wars. If they get away with ending the Triple Lock, sending soldiers to Lebanon on the same side as Israel against Hezbollah will just be the start.
q.t: The Government is preparing the legislative ground to send young people abroad to fight in imperialist wars. If they get away with ending the Triple Lock, sending soldiers to Lebanon on the same side as Israel against Hezbollah will just be the start.

q.o: The Government has no mandate to end the Triple Lock and a majority of the public oppose ending it. The Government must put it to the people in a referendum.
q.t: The Government has no mandate to end the Triple Lock and a majority of the public oppose ending it. The Government must put it to the people in a referendum.

ti: Cllr Conor Reddy Calls for Action on Women’s Safety Following Killing of Woman at Melville Terrace
s: People Before Profit Councillor Conor Reddy responded to the killing of a woman in Dublin 11 by calling for action on gender-based violence, citing increased domestic abuse disclosures and referencing a forthcoming report on domestic violence in Dublin 11 that he helped secure funding for through Dublin City Council.

q.o: I am shocked and deeply saddened by the news from Melville Terrace today. Another woman has lost her life in shocking and tragic circumstances, leaving loved ones and our wider community facing terrible grief.
q.t: I am shocked and deeply saddened by the news from Melville Terrace today. Another woman has lost her life in shocking and tragic circumstances, leaving loved ones and our wider community facing terrible grief.

q.o: We're facing an epidemic of femicide and gender-based violence across this island. Women's Aid recorded a 33% increase in disclosures of domestic abuse in 2025.
q.t: We're facing an epidemic of femicide and gender-based violence across this island. Women's Aid recorded a 33% increase in disclosures of domestic abuse in 2025.

q.o: In the next month or two, a report on domestic and gender-based violence in Dublin 11 will be published. I helped secure funding for this through Dublin City Council's North West Area discretionary budget last year.
q.t: In the next month or two, a report on domestic and gender-based violence in Dublin 11 will be published. I helped secure funding for this through Dublin City Council's North West Area discretionary budget last year.

ti: PBP Support Daisy Hill Maternity March
s: People Before Profit's Newry & Armagh representative Marc Mac Seáin participated in and commended a march of thousands protesting the suspension of maternity services at Daisy Hill Hospital, calling for accountability from the Southern Trust, Department of Health, and Stormont Executive, and demanding cross-border health cooperation.

q.o: It was amazing to see thousands in marching against the suspension of Daisy Hill's maternity service.
q.t: It was amazing to see thousands in marching against the suspension of Daisy Hill's maternity service.

q.o: This cut would put thousands in Newry, South Armagh, South Down & across the border in danger. Families can't be expected to make journeys of 1 & 1/2 hours+ safely up the country roads to Craigavon, especially in dangerous storm conditions like last night.
q.t: This cut would put thousands in Newry, South Armagh, South Down & across the border in danger. Families can't be expected to make journeys of 1 & 1/2 hours+ safely up the country roads to Craigavon, especially in dangerous storm conditions like last night.

q.o: We demand basic healthcare equality and an end to the Bengoa Report and acute service centralisation. We need cross-border health cooperation on a hospital network, along with training of staff from the shared island fund.
q.t: We demand basic healthcare equality and an end to the Bengoa Report and acute service centralisation. We need cross-border health cooperation on a hospital network, along with training of staff from the shared island fund.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: The Portuguese Communist Party requested a leaders' conference to schedule an urgent parliamentary debate on police actions in Lisbon and Porto on November 1, 2026, following what it described as disproportionate and violent police intervention against citizens peacefully demonstrating for housing rights.

q.o: Esta madrugada o País assistiu a uma intervenção desproporcionada e violenta das forças de segurança, depois de um procurador do Ministério Público ter vindo a público afirmar que colocar tendas nas praças não constitui qualquer ilegalidade nem ilícito.
q.t: This morning the country witnessed a disproportionate and violent intervention by security forces, after a public prosecutor came forward to state that placing tents in squares does not constitute any illegality or offense.

q.o: Mais uma vez, o Governo em vez de responder aos problemas da habitação, faz uma interpretação restritiva da lei para limitar o direito de manifestação e dá orientações para a ação repressiva das forças de segurança.
q.t: Once again, the Government instead of responding to housing problems, makes a restrictive interpretation of the law to limit the right to demonstration and gives guidance for repressive action by security forces.

q.o: É intolerável reprimir quem luta pela concretização de um direito consagrado na Constituição.
q.t: It is intolerable to repress those who fight for the realization of a right enshrined in the Constitution.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: The Portuguese Communist Party issued a press office statement condemning government repression of housing protests in Lisbon and Porto, criticizing the PSD/CDS government's policies on housing and cost of living, and calling for mobilization including actions on November 14 for housing rights and a CGTP-IN national demonstration on November 21.

q.o: Os acontecimentos desta noite em Lisboa e no Porto, a exemplo dos que lhes antecederam nestes últimos dias, são inseparáveis da intensificação da ofensiva do Governo PSD/CDS, apoiada por Chega e IL, contra as condições de vida e os direitos dos trabalhadores e do povo.
q.t: The events of tonight in Lisbon and Porto, like those that preceded them in recent days, are inseparable from the intensification of the offensive by the PSD/CDS Government, supported by Chega and IL, against the living conditions and rights of workers and the people.

q.o: Não são a indignação e o protesto que são ilegítimos mas sim o Governo que age à margem da lei, da Constituição e de Abril.
q.t: It is not indignation and protest that are illegitimate but rather the Government that acts outside the law, the Constitution and April.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: The Portuguese Communist Party presented its first set of amendment proposals to the 2027 State Budget, including a 15% salary increase (minimum €150) for public administration workers, a 5% pension increase (minimum €80), price regulation for food and fuel, setting bottled gas at €20, housing investment increase of €900 million, rent regulation, mortgage spread reductions, a 35% tax on real estate funds, and immediate application of maximum IMI rates on vacant properties.

q.o: Avançamos com a proposta de aumento significativo dos salários na AP, instando o Governo à negociação (como a lei determina) com os sindicatos, no sentido de garantir a recuperação do poder de compra perdido
q.t: We are advancing with the proposal for a significant increase in public administration salaries, urging the Government to negotiate (as the law requires) with the unions, in order to guarantee the recovery of lost purchasing power

q.o: O valor de referência que adiantamos envolve a consideração de um aumento de 15% com um mínimo de 150€ nos salários
q.t: The reference value we are putting forward involves consideration of a 15% increase with a minimum of €150 in salaries

q.o: Em relação aos reformados propomos o aumento de 5%, com um mínimo de 80€ para todos os reformados
q.t: Regarding pensioners, we propose an increase of 5%, with a minimum of €80 for all pensioners

q.o: fixando desde já em 20€ o preço do gás de botija, regulando o preço, como acontece aqui ao lado em Espanha
q.t: setting the price of bottled gas at €20 right now, regulating the price, as happens next door in Spain

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: Paulo Raimundo, Secretary-General of the Portuguese Communist Party, issued a statement about a meeting with the President of the Republic on 29 October 2026.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: The Portuguese Communist Party repudiates a US resolution proposal at the UN Security Council regarding Western Sahara, demanding that the Portuguese government defend the Sahrawi people's right to self-determination and oppose Morocco's autonomy plan as the sole negotiation basis.

q.o: O PCP repudia a proposta de resolução apresentada pelos Estados Unidos da América, na ocasião da votação do Conselho de Segurança da ONU sobre o prolongamento do mandato da Missão das Nações Unidas para o Referendo no Sara Ocidental (MINURSO), que se realizará amanhã, 30 de Outubro.
q.t: The PCP repudiates the resolution proposal presented by the United States of America, on the occasion of the UN Security Council vote on extending the mandate of the United Nations Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara (MINURSO), which will take place tomorrow, October 30.

q.o: O PCP considera que o Governo português, nas instâncias internacionais em que está representado, nomeadamente na ONU, deve assumir um inequívoco posicionamento público em defesa de uma resolução do Conselho de Segurança da ONU: que salvaguarde e pugne pelo cumprimento do direito à autodeterminação do povo sarauí
q.t: The PCP considers that the Portuguese Government, in the international bodies where it is represented, namely at the UN, must assume an unequivocal public position in defense of a UN Security Council resolution: that safeguards and advocates for the fulfillment of the right to self-determination of the Sahrawi people

q.o: O PCP reafirma a sua solidariedade com a luta determinada do povo sarauí e da Frente Polisário, sua legítima representante, pelo respeito e cumprimento dos direitos nacionais do povo sarauí e o fim da ocupação ilegal de territórios do Sara Ocidental por Marrocos.
q.t: The PCP reaffirms its solidarity with the determined struggle of the Sahrawi people and the Polisario Front, their legitimate representative, for respect and fulfillment of the national rights of the Sahrawi people and the end of the illegal occupation of Western Sahara territories by Morocco.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: The Portuguese Communist Party issued a statement demanding an end to the US blockade against Cuba, calling on the Portuguese government to support a UN resolution against the blockade and to develop cooperation with Cuba, while condemning the Trump Administration's policies and supporting the "Por Cuba! Fim ao Bloqueio!" solidarity campaign.

q.o: Cuba enfrenta há mais de 60 anos um criminoso bloqueio económico, comercial e financeiro imposto pelos EUA.
q.t: Cuba has faced for more than 60 years a criminal economic, commercial and financial blockade imposed by the USA.

q.o: O PCP exige o fim do bloqueio dos EUA contra Cuba, a retirada de Cuba da ilegítima e arbitrária lista dos EUA de denominados "Estados patrocinadores do terrorismo", o fim da política genocida e das ameaças da Administração Trump contra o povo cubano.
q.t: The PCP demands an end to the US blockade against Cuba, the removal of Cuba from the illegitimate and arbitrary US list of so-called "State sponsors of terrorism", an end to the genocidal policy and threats of the Trump Administration against the Cuban people.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: Paulo Raimundo of the Portuguese Communist Party delivered a parliamentary intervention on 27 October 2026 during the general debate on the State Budget 2027, criticizing the government's policy as undeserving of stability and condemning its alignment with the USA and NATO as a risk to the nation.

q.o: A vossa política não merece estabilidade, merece, e está a ter, indignação, resposta, luta e rejeição
q.t: Your policy does not deserve stability, it deserves, and is receiving, indignation, response, struggle and rejection

q.o: A sujeição do Governo aos EUA e à NATO são um risco para a pátria
q.t: The Government's subjection to the USA and NATO is a risk to the homeland

q.o: O Orçamento do Estado ignora os problemas das MPME's e das regiões afectadas pelas intempéries
q.t: The State Budget ignores the problems of SMEs and regions affected by bad weather

q.o: Falam muito de impostos mas o IRC é mesmo o único imposto que diminui
q.t: They talk a lot about taxes but corporate income tax is really the only tax that decreases

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: The PCP parliamentary group issued a statement warning that proposed legal changes are being used as a pretext to restrict the constitutional right to demonstrate, and called for withdrawal of the PSD/CDS rent and eviction law while demanding government investment of 1% of GDP in public housing.

q.o: O PCP alerta para que a pretexto da alteração da lei se vise uma restrição do direito de manifestação que é inaceitável.
q.t: The PCP warns that under the pretext of changing the law, an unacceptable restriction of the right to demonstrate is being targeted.

q.o: O que tem a maior urgência é a retirada da lei das rendas e dos despejos da responsabilidade do PSD e CDS com o apoio do CH e da IL.
q.t: What has the greatest urgency is the withdrawal of the rent and eviction law that is the responsibility of PSD and CDS with the support of CH and IL.

q.o: A atual situação exige que o Governo assuma a sua a responsabilidade no aumento da oferta de habitação pública, com um sério investimento público no valor de 1% PIB
q.t: The current situation requires that the Government assume its responsibility in increasing the supply of public housing, with a serious public investment worth 1% of GDP

ti: Το ΑΚΕΛ δεν δικαιούται να παραδίδει μαθήματα δημοκρατίας και πατριωτισμού
s: ELAM (National Popular Front) issued a press statement rejecting criticism from AKEL and Stefanos Stefanou, accusing AKEL of hypocrisy regarding democracy and patriotism, defending EOKA's national liberation struggle, and asserting that ELAM will not be silenced by AKEL's threats and labels.

q.o: Το ΑΚΕΛ και ο Στέφανος Στεφάνου, αντί να ασχολούνται με τα υπαρξιακά ζητήματα που αφορούν το μέλλον του Κυπριακού Ελληνισμού, επιλέγουν για ακόμη μία φορά την κινδυνολογία, τη λάσπη και την πολιτική στοχοποίηση του Ε.ΛΑ.Μ.
q.t: AKEL and Stefanos Stefanou, instead of dealing with the existential issues concerning the future of Cypriot Hellenism, once again choose fearmongering, mudslinging and political targeting of ELAM.

q.o: Ας το καταλάβουν επιτέλους στο ΑΚΕΛ: Η δημοκρατία δεν είναι ιδιοκτησία τους και ο κυπριακός λαός δεν χρειάζεται την άδειά τους για να αποφασίσει ποιος θα τον κυβερνήσει.
q.t: Let AKEL finally understand this: Democracy is not their property and the Cypriot people do not need their permission to decide who will govern them.

q.o: Το Ε.ΛΑ.Μ. δεν πρόκειται να φιμωθεί από τις απειλές, τις ταμπέλες και την πολιτική αλαζονεία του ΑΚΕΛ.
q.t: ELAM will not be silenced by the threats, labels and political arrogance of AKEL.

ti: Το Εθνικό Λαϊκό Μέτωπο τίμησε τους ήρωες του Νέου Χωριού
s: The National Popular Front (ELAM) participated in a memorial ceremony for EOKA heroes in Neo Chorio on November 1, 2026, with Deputy President Petros Kountouresis laying a wreath on behalf of President Christos Christou.

q.o: Η διατήρηση της μνήμης των ηρώων και η απόδοση της οφειλόμενης τιμής σε όσους αγωνίστηκαν και θυσιάστηκαν για την πατρίδα αποτελούν χρέος απέναντι στην ιστορία μας.
q.t: Preserving the memory of the heroes and paying due honor to those who fought and sacrificed for the homeland constitute a duty to our history.

q.o: Αιωνία τους η μνήμη. Αθάνατοι!
q.t: Eternal be their memory. Immortal!

ti: Καταφέραμε την αύξηση του επιδόματος για τους φοιτητές εξωτερικού
s: ELAM claims credit for securing an increase in the airline ticket subsidy for students studying abroad from €300 to €500 through its chairmanship of the Parliamentary Committee on Transport, Communications and Works and continuous pressure.

q.o: Μετά από δική μας εισήγηση, στην Κοινοβουλευτική Επιτροπή Μεταφορών, Επικοινωνιών και Έργων, της οποίας προεδρεύει το Ε.ΛΑ.Μ., αλλά και έπειτα από συνεχή άσκηση πιέσεων, επιτεύχθηκε ακόμη ένα σημαντικό βήμα στήριξης των συμπολιτών μας.
q.t: Following our proposal, in the Parliamentary Committee on Transport, Communications and Works, which is chaired by ELAM, and also after continuous pressure, another significant step was achieved in supporting our fellow citizens.

q.o: Η αύξηση του επιδόματος αεροπορικού εισιτηρίου για φοιτητές εξωτερικού, από €300 σε €500, αποτελεί ουσιαστική ενίσχυση προς όφελος των φοιτητών μας και των οικογενειών τους, ιδιαίτερα στην αβέβαιη εποχή που ζούμε.
q.t: The increase in the airline ticket subsidy for students abroad, from €300 to €500, constitutes substantial support for the benefit of our students and their families, especially in the uncertain times we live in.

ti: Η συνταγματική νομιμότητα δεν επιβάλλεται με αστυνομικές δυνάμεις
s: The National Popular Front issued a statement condemning alleged police intervention at Poland's Constitutional Court and calling for the European Union to intervene to restore constitutional order and the rule of law.

q.o: Απαράδεκτες οι πρωτοφανείς εξελίξεις στην Πολωνία, ενώ οι καταγγελλόμενες παρεμβάσεις στο Συνταγματικό Δικαστήριο μάς προκαλούν έντονη ανησυχία.
q.t: The unprecedented developments in Poland are unacceptable, while the alleged interventions in the Constitutional Court cause us intense concern.

q.o: Η Ευρωπαϊκή Ένωση οφείλει να παρέμβει άμεσα και καταλυτικά για να αποκατασταθεί το κράτος δικαίου και η συνταγματική τάξη στην Πολωνία.
q.t: The European Union must intervene immediately and decisively to restore the rule of law and constitutional order in Poland.

q.o: Στηρίζουμε την ανάγκη αποκατάστασης της συνταγματικής ομαλότητας και ζητούμε την άμεση αποχώρηση των δυνάμεων ασφαλείας που αναπτύχθηκαν στον χώρο του Δικαστηρίου.
q.t: We support the need to restore constitutional normality and demand the immediate withdrawal of security forces deployed at the Court premises.

ti: Α. Παπαχαραλάμπους: «Στοχευμένα μέτρα στήριξης των ευάλωτων ομάδων του πληθυσμού»
s: ELAM MP Andreas Papacharalampous called for targeted support measures for vulnerable population groups, a legislative framework for land purchases by third-country nationals, and generous incentives for young families to address low birth rates.

q.o: πρέπει να θεσπιστεί συγκεκριμένο νομοθετικό πλαίσιο
q.t: a specific legislative framework must be established

q.o: πρόκειται για ένα υπαρξιακό ζήτημα, για το οποίο το Ε.ΛΑ.Μ. προειδοποιεί εδώ και χρόνια
q.t: it is an existential issue, about which ELAM has been warning for years

q.o: υπογραμμίζοντας παράλληλα την ανάγκη να ληφθούν περισσότερα μέτρα, με στόχο τη στήριξη των ευάλωτων ομάδων του πληθυσμού
q.t: emphasizing at the same time the need for more measures to be taken, with the aim of supporting vulnerable groups of the population

q.o: τα δημόσια οικονομικά βρίσκονται σε καλή κατάσταση και συνεπώς υπάρχουν περιθώρια να γίνουν περισσότερα
q.t: public finances are in good condition and therefore there is room to do more

ti: Σ. Ιωάννου: «Να χαράξουμε νέα πορεία για την επίλυση του Κυπριακού»
s: ELAM MP Sotiris Ioannou stated on RIK that the party is not optimistic about the Cyprus problem process, criticised UN representatives for equating the Republic of Cyprus with the occupation regime, blamed Turkey and the pseudo-state for preventing a solution, and called for leveraging recent alliances to chart a new course for resolving the Cyprus issue.

q.o: Να χαράξουμε νέα πορεία για την επίλυση του Κυπριακού
q.t: To chart a new course for the resolution of the Cyprus problem

q.o: δεν είμαστε αισιόδοξοι ως προς τον τρόπο με τον οποίο εξελίσσεται η διαδικασία
q.t: we are not optimistic about the way the process is developing

q.o: η Κυπριακή Δημοκρατία δεν ευθύνεται ούτε για τη μη επανέναρξη των συνομιλιών ούτε για τη μη επίλυση του προβλήματος
q.t: the Republic of Cyprus is not responsible either for the non-resumption of talks or for the non-resolution of the problem

ti: Steuergeschenke für reiche Ehepaare? Nein zur Mitte-Initiative!
s: The Swiss Party of Labour opposes the Centre Party's initiative on individual taxation for married couples, calling it a tax gift to wealthy couples that would cost up to three billion francs annually and lead to cuts in public services.

q.o: Die Vorlage ist ein Steuergeschenk für reiche Ehepaare, welche bis zu drei Milliarden Franken kosten und zu Kürzungen im Service public führen wird.
q.t: The proposal is a tax gift for wealthy married couples, which will cost up to three billion francs and lead to cuts in public services.

q.o: Die Vorlage ist damit im Kern ein Steuergeschenk für reiche Ehepaare.
q.t: The proposal is thus fundamentally a tax gift for wealthy married couples.

ti: Ticino al collasso, e Bruxelles vuole che paghiamo anche la disoccupazione dei frontalieri - Ticinonews
s: The Ticino League criticizes a Brussels proposal requiring Switzerland to pay unemployment benefits for cross-border workers while claiming Ticino is in collapse.

ti: Moshe Feiglin to Arutz Sheva: I am aiming to become Defense Minister in next government - Israel National News
s: Moshe Feiglin stated to Arutz Sheva that he aims to become Defense Minister in the next government.

ti: Ben Gvir warns Haredim: 'Don't make historic mistake of joining the left' - Israel National News
s: Itamar Ben Gvir publicly warned Haredi parties against aligning with left-wing political forces, characterizing such a move as a historic mistake.

ti: בן גביר על חנפנות השמאל לחרדים: כמו המשל על השועל שניסה לשכנע דג לצאת מהמים - חרדים10
s: Itamar Ben-Gvir criticized the left's approach to ultra-Orthodox Jews, comparing it to a fable about a fox trying to convince a fish to leave the water.

q.o: כמו המשל על השועל שניסה לשכנע דג לצאת מהמים
q.t: Like the fable about the fox that tried to convince a fish to leave the water

ti: Ben Gvir warns chareidim: Left despises your faith - JFeed
s: Itamar Ben Gvir issued a warning to ultra-Orthodox (chareidi) communities claiming that the political left despises their religious faith.

ti: Religious Zionist Party slams Noam: They cost us a Knesset seat - Israel National News
s: The Religious Zionist Party publicly criticized the Noam party, claiming that Noam's actions resulted in the Religious Zionist Party losing a Knesset seat.

ti: Λευτεριά στον Ακίφ Καν!
s: ANTARSYA calls for mobilization in support of member Akif Khan, a migrant from Kashmir arrested and charged with robbery after a racist incident at a mini-market in Agios Panteleimonas, demanding charges be dropped and his release, with a court gathering scheduled for October 26, 2026.

q.o: Ο σύντροφος Ακίφ Καν, μετανάστης από το Κασμίρ και μέλος της ΑΝΤΑΡΣΥΑ, βρίσκεται αντιμέτωπος με μια ρατσιστική σκευωρία και κατηγορείται ανυπόστατα για κακούργημα.
q.t: Comrade Akif Khan, a migrant from Kashmir and member of ANTARSYA, faces a racist conspiracy and is groundlessly accused of a felony.

q.o: Να καταπέσουν οι ψευδείς κατηγορίες! Αθώωση και αποφυλάκιση του Ακίφ Καν!
q.t: Drop the false charges! Acquittal and release of Akif Khan!

q.o: Όλες/οι στα Δικαστήρια Ευελπίδων την Δευτέρα 26/10 στις 12:00
q.t: Everyone to the Evelpidon Courts on Monday 26/10 at 12:00

ti: Κάλεσμα στήριξης της καμπάνιας για ίσα συνταξιοδοτικά δικαιώματα μεταναστών και μεταναστριών
ac: Anticapitalist Left Cooperation for the Overthrow
s: ANTARSYA announces support for a campaign by Albanian immigrants and solidarity activists demanding equal pension rights for immigrants, criticizing the 2016 Katrougalos Law that links pension amounts to years of legal residence in Greece.

q.o: Ζούμε μαζί παλεύουμε μαζί για αξιοπρεπή ζωή και ίσα δικαιώματα στις κοινωνικές παροχές!!
q.t: We live together, we fight together for a dignified life and equal rights to social benefits!!
q.sp: Anticapitalist Left Cooperation for the Overthrow

q.o: Ο Νόμος 4387/2016 «Κατρούγκαλου» για το ασφαλιστικό, το οποίο ψήφισε η κυβέρνηση ΣΥΡΙΖΑ/ΑΝΕΛ, συνδέει τον υπολογισμό του ποσού της Εθνικής Σύνταξης και του Επιδόματος Κοινωνικής Αλληλεγγύης Ανασφάλιστων Υπερηλίκων, με τη διάρκεια παραμονής στην χώρα.
q.t: Law 4387/2016 'Katrougalos' on insurance, which was voted by the SYRIZA/ANEL government, links the calculation of the National Pension amount and the Social Solidarity Allowance for Uninsured Elderly with the duration of stay in the country.
q.sp: Anticapitalist Left Cooperation for the Overthrow

ti: Αντιφασιστική Εκδήλωση και Συναυλία το Σάββατο 24 Οκτώβρη (18.00), πλατεία ΗΣΑΠ Ν. Ηρακλείου.
ac: Anticapitalist Left Cooperation for the Overthrow
s: ANTARSYA is organizing an antifascist event and concert on Saturday October 24 and a demonstration on Sunday November 1 in Nea Iraklio to counter annual neo-Nazi gatherings, following the recent stabbing of an antifascist in Elefsina and the release of Golden Dawn leaders.

q.o: Κάθε χρόνο την 1η Νοέμβρη φασιστικές γκρούπες προσπαθούν να στήσουν ναζιστική «φιέστα» στο Ηράκλειο, για να διαχύσουν το ρατσιστικό τους δηλητήριο και να προβούν σε επιθέσεις σε κόσμο της γειτονιάς.
q.t: Every year on November 1st fascist groups try to set up a Nazi 'fiesta' in Iraklio, to spread their racist poison and to carry out attacks on people in the neighborhood.
q.sp: Anticapitalist Left Cooperation for the Overthrow

q.o: Εργαζόμενοι και νεολαία του Ηρακλείου δεν θα τους αφήσουμε σπιθαμή γης ούτε φέτος.
q.t: Workers and youth of Iraklio will not leave them an inch of ground this year either.
q.sp: Anticapitalist Left Cooperation for the Overthrow

s: MeRA25 criticizes the government's urban planning policy in the Cyclades islands, alleging it favors large tourism investors with special planning exemptions while residents face housing shortages, and demands immediate completion of local planning schemes with equal building rules for all.

q.o: Για άλλη μια φορά η παρούσα κυβέρνηση ευνοεί τους φίλους της εργολάβους, μεγαλοξενοδόχους και… «επενδυτές». Και πάλι σε βάρος του λαού.
q.t: Once again the current government favors its friends the contractors, large hoteliers and… 'investors'. And again at the expense of the people.

q.o: Στους μεγαλοεπενδυτές παρέχονται ειδικά σχέδια και προνομιακές ρυθμίσεις.
q.t: Large investors are granted special plans and preferential arrangements.

q.o: Ζητάμε αυστηρούς όρους δόμησης και τήρηση της νομοθεσίας από όλους.
q.t: We demand strict building terms and compliance with legislation from everyone.

s: MeRA25's Health Sector denounces the government's promotion of a digital AI cardiology system (AIAS) in Western Macedonia while the region lacks a public haemodynamic laboratory for emergency angioplasty procedures, forcing patients to travel over 120 kilometres to Thessaloniki hospitals.

q.o: Το ΜέΡΑ25 καταγγέλλει την εξαιρετικά προκλητική περίπτωση κυβερνητικής επικοινωνιακής διαχείρισης που εξελίσσεται στη Δυτική Μακεδονία, η οποία αποτυπώνει πλήρως την υποβάθμιση των δημόσιων αγαθών και την τεχνοκρατική απάτη της «ψηφιακής μετάβασης».
q.t: MeRA25 denounces the extremely provocative case of government communication management unfolding in Western Macedonia, which fully reflects the degradation of public goods and the technocratic fraud of 'digital transition'.

q.o: Η προώθηση ψηφιακών άβαταρ που «μιλούν για την καρδιά χωρίς να έχουν καρδιά» αποτελεί καθαρό προπέτασμα καπνού για να κρυφτεί η άρνηση στελέχωσης του ΕΣΥ με μόνιμο ιατρικό προσωπικό και κρίσιμες υποδομές.
q.t: The promotion of digital avatars that 'talk about the heart without having a heart' constitutes a pure smokescreen to hide the refusal to staff the NHS with permanent medical personnel and critical infrastructure.

q.o: Οι αλγόριθμοι δεν κάνουν αγγειοπλαστική και η ψηφιακή βιτρίνα δεν μπορεί να κοστίζει ανθρώπινες ζωές.
q.t: Algorithms do not perform angioplasty and the digital showcase cannot cost human lives.

s: MeRA25 United Left issued a statement condemning pharmaceutical industrialist and media owner Dimitris Giannakopoulos for promoting the views of convicted neo-Nazi Ilias Kasidiaris and accusing him of using an anti-establishment facade while being one of the country's largest industrialists.

q.o: Ο γνωστός φαρμακοβιομήχανος, μπασκετικός παράγοντας και αστέρας του Instagram, Δημήτρης Γιαννακόπουλος μας έχει συνηθίσει ανά τα χρόνια στην αναπαραγωγή ακροδεξιάς ρητορικής.
q.t: The well-known pharmaceutical industrialist, basketball figure and Instagram star, Dimitris Giannakopoulos has accustomed us over the years to reproducing far-right rhetoric.

q.o: Ο Δημήτρης Γιαννακόπουλος μέσω του μιντιακού ομίλου που κατέχει, έχει χτίσει το προφίλ του κυνηγημένου και αντισυστημικού, προσπαθώντας να μας κάνει να ξεχάσουμε ότι είναι ένας από τους μεγαλύτερους βιομήχανους της χώρας.
q.t: Dimitris Giannakopoulos through the media group he owns, has built the profile of the persecuted and anti-establishment figure, trying to make us forget that he is one of the country's largest industrialists.

q.o: Δεν μας ξεγελούν, έχουμε βαθιά μνήμη και ξέρουμε καλά τα ολέθρια αποτελέσματα της συνεργασίας πλουσίων και φασιστών, στην Ελλάδα και σε όλο τον κόσμο.
q.t: They do not deceive us, we have deep memory and we know well the disastrous results of the collaboration of the rich and fascists, in Greece and around the world.

s: MeRA25 issued a statement on the fifth anniversary of Nikos Sabanis's death, demanding justice for his killing by police officers from the DIAS unit and criticizing the delayed trial and the prosecution of two minors who were passengers in the vehicle.

q.o: Δεν ξεχνάμε τον Νίκο Σαμπάνη, τον Κώστα Φραγκούλη, τον Χρήστο Μιχαλόπουλο, τον Θοδωρή Ζαβραδινό-Καραμπαμπά, τον Βασίλη Μάγγο και κάθε θύμα της αστυνομικής βίας.
q.t: We do not forget Nikos Sabanis, Kostas Fragoulis, Christos Michalopoulos, Thodoris Zavradino-Karampampas, Vasilis Mangos and every victim of police violence.

q.o: Οι ζωές των Ρομά μετράνε!
q.t: Roma lives matter!

q.o: Να αποδοθεί δικαιοσύνη για τη δολοφονία του Ν. Σαμπάνη. Να απαλλαγούν οι δύο ανήλικοι επιβαίνοντες.
q.t: Justice must be delivered for the murder of N. Sabanis. The two minor passengers must be acquitted.

s: MeRA25 issued a statement supporting French MEP Rima Hassan, who faces prosecution for alleged apology of terrorism and potential suspension of electoral rights, condemning the case as abuse of power and restriction of democratic freedoms in France.

q.o: Η σκανδαλώδης εισαγγελική πρόταση για ποινή φυλάκισης δέκα μηνών με αναστολή και στέρηση του δικαιώματος του εκλέγεσθαι για δύο έτη σε βάρος της γαλλοπαλαιστίνιας νομικού και ευρωβουλευτρίας της Ανυπότακτης Γαλλίας, Ρίμα Χασάν, αποτελεί χαρακτηριστικό παράδειγμα κατάχρησης εξουσίας και περιστολής των δημοκρατικών ελευθεριών στη Γαλλία.
q.t: The scandalous prosecutorial proposal for a ten-month suspended prison sentence and deprivation of the right to be elected for two years against the Franco-Palestinian lawyer and MEP of La France Insoumise, Rima Hassan, constitutes a characteristic example of abuse of power and restriction of democratic freedoms in France.

q.o: Ως ΜέΡΑ25 Ενωτική Αριστερά στεκόμαστε στο πλευρό της Ρίμα Χασάν και της Ανυπότακτης Γαλλίας που στοχοποιείται από το γαλλικό κατεστημένο.
q.t: As MeRA25 United Left we stand by the side of Rima Hassan and La France Insoumise who are being targeted by the French establishment.

q.o: Αλληλεγγύη στη Ρίμα Χασάν. Λευτεριά στην Παλαιστίνη.
q.t: Solidarity with Rima Hassan. Freedom for Palestine.

ti: ÎŸÎŻĎ„Îˇ: Î— ÂŤĎ€ĎÎŹĎƒÎšÎ˝Îˇ ÎźÎľĎ„ÎŹÎ˛ÎąĎƒÎˇÂť ÎťÎľÎˇÎťÎąĎ„ÎľÎŻ Ď„Îą Î˛ÎżĎ…Î˝ÎŹ
s: MeRA25 demands immediate review of wind-farm permits in Oiti mountain, suspension of installation works, revision of renewable-energy spatial planning with local participation, and public control of energy production, criticising government policy for allowing installations in protected ecosystems despite local opposition.

q.o: Δεν είναι πράσινη μετάβαση να καταστρέφεις το φυσικό περιβάλλον στο όνομα της προστασίας του.
q.t: It is not a green transition to destroy the natural environment in the name of protecting it.

q.o: Η προστασία του περιβάλλοντος δεν μπορεί να θυσιάζεται στον βωμό μιας κατ' όνομα «πράσινης» ανάπτυξης που λεηλατεί το φυσικό τοπίο της χώρας.
q.t: The protection of the environment cannot be sacrificed at the altar of a so-called 'green' development that plunders the country's natural landscape.

ti: ÎŸ Î†Î´Ď‰Î˝ÎšĎ‚ Ď‡ÎżĎÎżĎ€ÎˇÎ´ÎŹÎľÎš – Î¤Îą Î˝ÎżĎƒÎżÎşÎżÎźÎľÎŻÎą Ď„ÎˇĎ‚ Î—Ď€ÎľÎŻĎÎżĎ… ĎƒĎ„ÎľÎ˝ÎŹÎśÎżĎ…Î˝
s: MeRA25 criticizes Health Minister Adonis Georgiadis for conducting ceremonial visits to Epirus hospitals while staff shortages, equipment deficiencies, and funding gaps persist across the region's healthcare facilities.

q.o: Το ΜέΡΑ25 Ενωτική Αριστερά απαιτεί άμεσες μαζικές προσλήψεις μόνιμου προσωπικού, πλήρη κάλυψη των οργανικών κενών, ουσιαστική αύξηση της χρηματοδότησης και ενίσχυση όλων των δημόσιων δομών Υγείας της Ηπείρου
q.t: MeRA25 United Left demands immediate mass recruitment of permanent staff, full coverage of organic vacancies, substantial increase in funding and strengthening of all public health structures in Epirus

q.o: Οι ασθενείς δεν χρειάζονται υπουργούς που χοροπηδούν μπροστά στις κάμερες. Χρειάζονται γιατρούς και νοσηλευτές δίπλα στα κρεβάτια τους.
q.t: Patients do not need ministers dancing in front of cameras. They need doctors and nurses beside their beds.

ti: ÎŒĎ‡Îš ĎƒĎ„ÎˇÎ˝ Ď€ÎżÎťÎšĎ„ÎšÎşÎŽ Î´ÎŻĎ‰ÎžÎˇ Ď„ÎˇĎ‚ Î”Î­ĎƒĎ€ÎżÎšÎ˝ÎąĎ‚ Î–ÎšĎŒÎ˛Îą
s: MeRA25 Western Greece issued a statement condemning the disciplinary proceedings initiated by the Mayor of Thermos against party member and elected municipal councillor Despoina Ziova, characterising it as political persecution and demanding immediate cessation of all disciplinary actions.

q.o: Η ελεύθερη έκφραση δεν τρομοκρατείται! Η πολιτική διαφωνία δεν λύνεται στις δικαστικές αίθουσες!
q.t: Free expression is not intimidated! Political disagreement is not resolved in courtrooms!

q.o: Απαιτούμε την άμεση αναστολή κάθε πειθαρχικής ενέργειας, να πάψει η δημόσια διοίκηση να λειτουργεί με βάση πολιτικές επιταγές!
q.t: We demand the immediate suspension of every disciplinary action, for the public administration to stop operating on the basis of political orders!

ti: Σοβαρές παρενέργειες μετά τα εμβόλια COVID-19 – Η κυβέρνηση οφείλει απαντήσεις στους ασθενείς
s: NIKI MP Aspasia Kouroupaki submitted parliamentary question 5130 on 6 May 2025 regarding government responsibility for serious COVID-19 vaccine adverse events, and proposes creating a nationwide specialized assessment network, scientific registry, and administrative compensation procedure for documented serious injuries.

q.o: Στις 6 Μαΐου 2025 κατέθεσα την Ερώτηση 5130 προς τους Υπουργούς Υγείας και Δικαιοσύνης, με αφορμή δικαστική απόφαση που επιδίκασε χρηματική ικανοποίηση 50.000 ευρώ σε πολίτη ο οποίος υπέστη σοβαρή νευρολογική βλάβη μετά τον εμβολιασμό του.
q.t: On 6 May 2025 I submitted Question 5130 to the Ministers of Health and Justice, prompted by a court decision that awarded monetary compensation of 50,000 euros to a citizen who suffered serious neurological damage after his vaccination.

q.o: Προτείνω τη δημιουργία ενός πανελλαδικού δικτύου εξειδικευμένης αξιολόγησης και παρακολούθησης, με τη συμμετοχή πανεπιστημιακών νοσοκομείων, κατάλληλων κλινικών του ΕΣΥ και επιστημόνων από ειδικότητες όπως η καρδιολογία, η νευρολογία, η ανοσολογία και η αιματολογία.
q.t: I propose the creation of a nationwide network of specialized assessment and monitoring, with the participation of university hospitals, appropriate NHS clinics and scientists from specialties such as cardiology, neurology, immunology and hematology.

q.o: Εμείς στη ΝΙΚΗ θέλουμε αυτοί οι άνθρωποι να γνωρίζουν συγκεκριμένα το ποιος θα εξετάσει την περίπτωσή τους, πώς θα εξασφαλίσουν τη θεραπεία που χρειάζονται και με ποια διαδικασία θα διεκδικήσουν αποζημίωση, εφόσον τεκμηριωθεί η βλάβη τους.
q.t: We in NIKI want these people to know specifically who will examine their case, how they will secure the treatment they need and by what procedure they will claim compensation, provided their injury is documented.

ti: Νέα επίθεση κατά Ελληνορθοδόξων στην Ιορδανία – Η ΝΙΚΗ δεν ξεχνά τους Ρωμηούς της Ανατολής
s: Democratic Patriotic Movement – Victory (NIKI) issued a statement condemning an armed attack on a Greek Orthodox church in Karak, Jordan that killed seven people, criticizing the Greek government's response as lukewarm and calling for support and protection of Orthodox Greeks in the Middle East.

q.o: Μάταια περιμένουμε από την ελληνική κυβέρνηση να μεριμνήσει για τη στήριξη και την προστασία των Ορθόδοξων Ρωμηών της Ανατολής
q.t: We wait in vain for the Greek government to care for the support and protection of the Orthodox Greeks of the East

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ δεν ξεχνά και δεν θα ησυχάσει μέχρι να αναστηθεί η Ελλάδα και η Ρωμηοσύνη και μέχρι να νιώσουν ασφαλείς όλοι οι Ελληνορθόδοξοι αδελφοί μας όπου γης!
q.t: NIKI does not forget and will not rest until Greece and Greekness are resurrected and until all our Greek Orthodox brothers feel safe wherever on earth!

ti: Η Δικαιοσύνη δεν μπορεί να λειτουργεί με δύο μέτρα και δύο σταθμά
s: Victory MP Komninos Delveroudis challenged Prime Minister Mitsotakis on selective justice enforcement, demanding investigations into ministers' responsibilities in OPEKEPE, wiretapping, Tempe tragedy, state advertising, and pandemic contracts, and calling for abolition of Article 86 of the Constitution regarding ministerial criminal liability.

q.o: Μήπως, λοιπόν, ήρθε η ώρα να αφήσετε επιτέλους το κυνήγι της «μαρίδας» και να ρίξετε τα δίχτυα εκεί όπου κολυμπούν οι πραγματικοί «μεγαλοκαρχαρίες» της εξουσίας;
q.t: Perhaps, then, the time has come to finally stop hunting the 'small fry' and cast the nets where the real 'big sharks' of power are swimming?

q.o: Ξεκινήστε με την πλήρη κατάργηση του άρθρου 86 του Συντάγματος, που αφορά την ποινική ευθύνη των υπουργών.
q.t: Start with the complete abolition of Article 86 of the Constitution, which concerns the criminal liability of ministers.

q.o: Ο πολίτης δεν ζητά πολιτικές δηλώσεις. Ζητά δικαιοσύνη, διαφάνεια και λογοδοσία για όλους, χωρίς εξαιρέσεις.
q.t: The citizen does not ask for political statements. They ask for justice, transparency and accountability for all, without exceptions.

ti: Ψηφιακό κράτος με πήλινα πόδια
s: Democratic Patriotic Movement – Victory (NIKH) criticizes the Greek government's digital transformation strategy, arguing it lacks adequate contingency plans for cyberattacks or digital system failures, and calls for independent security audits and guaranteed non-digital service alternatives.

q.o: Ο Τάσος Οικονομόπουλος, κατά τη συζήτηση για την Εθνική Αρχή Κυβερνοασφάλειας, είχε θέσει ζητήματα στελέχωσης και οργάνωσης του μηχανισμού προστασίας των ψηφιακών υποδομών.
q.t: Tassos Oikonomopoulos, during the discussion on the National Cybersecurity Authority, had raised issues of staffing and organization of the mechanism for protecting digital infrastructures.

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ έχει αναδείξει την ανάγκη να διατηρεί ο πολίτης τη δυνατότητα εξυπηρέτησης και χωρίς ψηφιακά μέσα, να ελέγχονται ανεξάρτητα τα κρίσιμα πληροφοριακά συστήματα και να διασφαλίζεται ο ουσιαστικός έλεγχος των κρατικών υποδομών.
q.t: NIKH has highlighted the need for citizens to maintain the ability to be served even without digital means, for critical information systems to be independently audited, and for substantive control of state infrastructures to be ensured.

q.o: Η ελληνική κυβέρνηση, που τόσο υπερηφανεύεται για τα ψηφιακά της επιτεύγματα, οφείλει να εξηγήσει τι έχει προβλέψει για τις ίδιες τρεις ημέρες.
q.t: The Greek government, which is so proud of its digital achievements, must explain what it has planned for the same three days.

ti: Μεγάλο θράσος να μιλά ο πρωθυπουργός για Δικαιοσύνη, νομιμότητα και κυνήγι «μεγάλων ψαριών»
s: Democratic Patriotic Movement – Victory issued a statement criticizing Prime Minister Mitsotakis for hypocrisy regarding justice, legality, and economic policy, accusing him of protecting large economic interests, covering up scandals including Tempe, wiretapping and OPEKEPE, and misrepresenting economic data on trade balance.

q.o: Πόσο μεγάλο θράσος, να μιλά για "μεγάλα ψάρια" ο άνθρωπος που έχει ταχθεί στην υπηρεσία προστασίας των μεγάλων οικονομικών συμφερόντων, από τις αλυσίδες σούπερ μάρκετ και τα διυλιστήρια μέχρι τους μεγαλοεπενδυτές από το εξωτερικό που έρχονται και αγοράζουν μισοτιμής τα ασημικά της χώρας!
q.t: What great audacity, for the man who has committed himself to serving the protection of large economic interests, from supermarket chains and refineries to foreign investors who come and buy the country's silverware at half price, to talk about 'big fish'!

q.o: Πόσο μεγάλο θράσος να μιλά για Δικαιοσύνη και διάβρωση ο ενορχηστρωτής της συγκάλυψης των Τεμπών, των παρακολουθήσεων και του ΟΠΕΚΕΠΕ.
q.t: What great audacity for the orchestrator of the cover-up of Tempe, the wiretapping and OPEKEPE to talk about Justice and corruption.

ti: Δ. Νατσιός: Η επίθεση φανατικών μουσουλμάνων στο Καράκ της Ιορδανίας πληγώνει τον χριστιανισμό και την ρωμιοσύνη
s: Dimitris Natsios of NIKI issued a statement condemning an attack by Muslims on a Greek Orthodox church in Karak, Jordan that killed seven Orthodox Christians and wounded 34, while criticizing the Greek government's protection of Hellenism and Orthodoxy abroad.

q.o: Η αποτρόπαια επίθεση φανατικών μουσουλμάνων κατά της ελληνορθόδοξης εκκλησίας στον Ιερό Ναό του Αγίου Γεωργίου στο Καράκ της Ιορδανίας πληγώνει τον χριστιανισμό και την ρωμιοσύνη.
q.t: The abominable attack by fanatical Muslims against the Greek Orthodox church at the Holy Church of Saint George in Karak, Jordan wounds Christianity and Hellenism.

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ και εγώ προσωπικά εκφράζουμε την οδύνη και τα συλλυπητήρια μας για την τζιχαντιστική δολοφονία 7 ορθόδοξων χριστιανών και τον τραυματισμό 34 ακόμα.
q.t: NIKI and I personally express our pain and condolences for the jihadist murder of 7 Orthodox Christians and the wounding of 34 more.

q.o: εκφράζουμε και την βαθύτατη ανησυχία μας για τον ρόλο της ελληνικής κυβέρνησης σε ο,τι αφορά στην εκτός συνόρων προστασία του ελληνισμού και της ορθοδοξίας.
q.t: we also express our deepest concern about the role of the Greek government regarding the protection of Hellenism and Orthodoxy beyond borders.

ti: Κουρουπάκη για το νομοσχέδιο Υγείας: Κενά στις διατάξεις για ψυχολόγους, ΕΣΥ, φάρμακο και προστασία των ασθενών
s: NIKH MP Aspasia Kouroupaki intervened in the Parliamentary Social Affairs Committee sessions on the Health Ministry bill, proposing specific amendments on psychologists' professional rights, mental health services, ESY staffing, pharmaceutical access, and patient protections, while criticizing temporary appointments and deferred regulatory decisions.

q.o: υποχρεωτική, συστηματική διαβούλευση και τεκμηριωμένη απάντηση στις θέσεις των ασθενών πριν από αποφάσεις που επηρεάζουν την πρόσβασή τους
q.t: mandatory, systematic consultation and documented response to patients' positions before decisions that affect their access

q.o: ιδιαίτερα ευαίσθητες πληροφορίες
q.t: particularly sensitive information

q.o: Στα 84 άρθρα του νομοσχεδίου συναντάμε μια γνώριμη κυβερνητική πρακτική: διορισμένες διοικήσεις με πολιτική θητεία, σημαντικές αποφάσεις που παραπέμπονται σε μελλοντικά διατάγματα, διαδοχικές παρατάσεις συμβάσεων και οικονομικές εκκρεμότητες που τακτοποιούνται εκ των υστέρων
q.t: In the 84 articles of the bill we encounter a familiar governmental practice: appointed administrations with political tenure, important decisions deferred to future decrees, successive contract extensions and financial arrears settled retroactively

q.o: Ένας γονιός που αναζητά βοήθεια για το παιδί του πρέπει να γνωρίζει ποιος αναλαμβάνει τη θεραπεία, ποια επιστημονική κατάρτιση διαθέτει και αν πληροί τις νόμιμες προϋποθέσεις
q.t: A parent seeking help for their child must know who is undertaking the treatment, what scientific training they possess and whether they meet the legal requirements

q.o: Όταν ένα νοσοκομείο χρειάζεται τις υπηρεσίες ενός επαγγελματία επί τέσσερα χρόνια, το Υπουργείο οφείλει να εξετάσει αν καλύπτει μια πάγια ανάγκη και να προγραμματίσει ανάλογα τις προσλήψεις του
q.t: When a hospital needs the services of a professional for four years, the Ministry must examine whether it covers a permanent need and plan its recruitments accordingly

q.o: για έναν ασθενή που αντιμετωπίζει σοβαρή επιδείνωση, ο χρόνος μπορεί να αποδειχθεί καθοριστικός
q.t: for a patient facing serious deterioration, time can prove decisive

q.o: Σας παρουσιάσαμε συγκεκριμένες διορθώσεις που αφορούν τα επαγγελματικά δικαιώματα των ψυχολόγων, τη στελέχωση των νοσοκομείων, την ασφάλεια των εργαζομένων και την πρόσβαση των ασθενών στις θεραπείες τους
q.t: We presented you with specific corrections concerning the professional rights of psychologists, hospital staffing, worker safety and patients' access to their treatments

ti: Στην πολιτική κατάψυξη το καλώδιο – Με την ουρά στα σκέλια η κυβέρνηση
s: NIKH criticizes the Greek government for delaying the Greece-Cyprus undersea cable project after Turkish naval interventions near Kasos, claims the government retreated from its sovereign rights, and states that NIKH had warned on 14 June 2025 about Libya's Haftar shifting position on the Turkey-Libya memorandum and proposed specific policy measures including extending territorial waters to 12 nautical miles and filing complaints against Turkey's EU accession process.

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ είχε προειδοποιήσει ήδη από τις 14 Ιουνίου 2025 για την επικείμενη μεταστροφή της πλευράς Χαφτάρ στο ζήτημα του τουρκολιβυκού μνημονίου.
q.t: NIKH had already warned since 14 June 2025 about the impending shift of the Haftar side on the issue of the Turkey-Libya memorandum.

q.o: Είχε, επίσης, καταθέσει συγκεκριμένες προτάσεις για την επέκταση των χωρικών υδάτων στα 12 ναυτικά μίλια, την οριοθέτηση ΑΟΖ με την Κύπρο, την ενεργοποίηση των περιφερειακών συμμαχιών και την αξιοποίηση των ευρωπαϊκών θεσμών με καταγγελία της ενταξιακής πορείας της Τουρκίας.
q.t: It had also submitted specific proposals for the extension of territorial waters to 12 nautical miles, the delimitation of EEZ with Cyprus, the activation of regional alliances and the utilization of European institutions by denouncing Turkey's accession process.

q.o: Με την ουρά στα σκέλια, λοιπόν, αποχώρησε η ελληνική πλευρά από την Κάσο
q.t: With its tail between its legs, then, the Greek side withdrew from Kasos

ti: Α. Λατινοπούλου : Η ΝΔ είναι σίγουρα κυβέρνηση ημετέρων και διεφθαρμένων.
s: Afroditi Latinopoulou stated that New Democracy is certainly a government of cronies and the corrupt.

q.o: Η ΝΔ είναι σίγουρα κυβέρνηση ημετέρων και διεφθαρμένων.
q.t: ND is certainly a government of cronies and the corrupt.

ti: Α. Λατινοπούλου: “8 νεκροί Χριστιανοί, δεκάδες τραυματίες στην Ιορδανία χτες. Αλήθεια πόσο αίμα αθώων Χριστιανών χρειάζεται ακόμα για να «συγκινηθούν» οι Βρυξέλλες;”
s: Voice of Reason condemns the October 23 attack on a Greek Orthodox church in Karak, Jordan that killed eight Christians, and demands the EU and Greek government end open borders, conduct mass deportations, and reject what it calls Islamization of European societies.

q.o: 8 νεκροί Χριστιανοί, δεκάδες τραυματίες στην Ιορδανία χτες. Αλήθεια πόσο αίμα αθώων Χριστιανών χρειάζεται ακόμα για να «συγκινηθούν» οι Βρυξέλλες;
q.t: 8 dead Christians, dozens injured in Jordan yesterday. Truly how much blood of innocent Christians is still needed for Brussels to be 'moved'?

q.o: Το εξτρεμιστικό Ισλάμ δεν είναι «θρησκευτική έκφραση». Είναι ιδεολογία θανάτου που δολοφονεί, βιάζει και τρομοκρατεί στο όνομα του Αλλάχ.
q.t: Extremist Islam is not 'religious expression'. It is an ideology of death that murders, rapes and terrorizes in the name of Allah.

q.o: Μαζικές απελάσεις όσων δεν σέβονται τους νόμους και τις αξίες μας, και απόρριψη κάθε μορφής ισλαμοποίησης των ευρωπαϊκών κοινωνιών.
q.t: Mass deportations of those who do not respect our laws and values, and rejection of every form of Islamization of European societies.

ti: Α. Λατινοπούλου: “Σπύρος Κουλκουδίνας: Ευρωπαϊκές επιδοτήσεις 200.000 ευρώ για εταιρεία που νοικιάζει τουριστικό σκάφος την ώρα που οι αλιείς εξοντώνονται!”
s: Voice of Reason demands full transparency regarding a €200,000 EU subsidy approved for a company linked to New Democracy MP Spyros Koulkoudinas that rents tourist boats, while Greek fishermen face economic hardship.

q.o: Οι ευρωπαϊκές επιδοτήσεις δεν είναι προσωπικό ταμείο πολιτικών προσώπων ούτε προνόμιο όσων διαθέτουν πρόσβαση στην εξουσία!
q.t: European subsidies are not the personal treasury of political figures nor a privilege of those who have access to power!

q.o: Η ΦΩΝΗ ΛΟΓΙΚΗΣ απαιτεί την άμεση δημοσιοποίηση του φακέλου, των κριτηρίων αξιολόγησης και όλων των σχετικών αποφάσεων.
q.t: Voice of Reason demands the immediate publication of the file, the evaluation criteria and all related decisions.

q.o: Ούτε ένα ευρώ ευρωπαϊκού χρήματος χωρίς λογοδοσία. Ούτε μία σκιά χωρίς απαντήσεις.
q.t: Not one euro of European money without accountability. Not one shadow without answers.

ti: Α. Λατινοπούλου: “Η κα. Αγαπηδάκη κλείνει τα κυλικεία, φέρνει “ημετέρους” στις σχολικές μονάδες και “παίζει” με την υγεία των παιδιών μας!”
s: Voice of Reason criticizes Deputy Health Minister Agapidaki's school canteen regulations (FEK 3060/02.06.2026 & 5578/15.09.2026) for allegedly closing approximately 4,500 canteens and replacing them with vending machines and catering services, claiming over 350 canteens have closed since September and proposing alternative measures including physical education programs and state nutrition programs under dieticians.

q.o: Η κα. Αγαπηδακη (Αν.Υπουργός Υγείας της κυβέρνησης Μητσοτάκη) διατυμπανίζει πως 'φέρνει πλέγμα μέτρων αντιμετώπισης της παιδικής παχυσαρκίας' αλλά την ίδια ώρα δημιουργεί το αντίθετο αποτέλεσμα.
q.t: Ms. Agapidaki (Deputy Health Minister of the Mitsotakis government) proclaims that she 'brings a package of measures to address childhood obesity' but at the same time creates the opposite result.

q.o: Η ΦΩΝΗ ΛΟΓΙΚΗΣ ζητά να ληφθούν εφαρμόσιμα και αποτελεσματικά μέτρα, διότι η Ελλάδα κατέχει τη θλιβερή 3η θέση της παιδικής παχυσαρκίας.
q.t: VOICE OF REASON demands that applicable and effective measures be taken, because Greece holds the sad 3rd place in childhood obesity.

q.o: Όσο πιο γρήγορα απαλλαγούμε τόσο το καλύτερο!
q.t: The sooner we get rid of them, the better!

ti: Η ΦΩΝΗ ΛΟΓΙΚΗΣ στο πλευρό των καθημερινών ηρώων του αθλητικού συλλόγου «Ερμής»
s: Voice of Reason representatives visited the Hermes sports club during Invisible Disability Week, expressing support for people with disabilities and calling for state guarantees of access to sports infrastructure and support services.

q.o: Για τη ΦΩΝΗ ΛΟΓΙΚΗΣ, η στήριξη των ατόμων με αναπηρία και των οικογενειών τους δεν είναι ζήτημα επικοινωνιακής προβολής, αλλά ζήτημα αξιοπρέπειας, ισότητας ευκαιριών και έμπρακτου σεβασμού.
q.t: For Voice of Reason, supporting people with disabilities and their families is not a matter of publicity, but a matter of dignity, equal opportunities and practical respect.

q.o: Η Πολιτεία οφείλει να διασφαλίζει την ουσιαστική πρόσβαση στον αθλητισμό, στις κατάλληλες υποδομές και στις υπηρεσίες υποστήριξης, ώστε κανένα παιδί και καμία οικογένεια να μη νιώθουν μόνοι στον καθημερινό τους αγώνα.
q.t: The State must ensure substantive access to sports, to appropriate infrastructure and to support services, so that no child and no family feels alone in their daily struggle.

q.o: Η συμπερίληψη δεν είναι σύνθημα. Είναι υποχρέωση μιας κοινωνίας που σέβεται κάθε άνθρωπο.
q.t: Inclusion is not a slogan. It is an obligation of a society that respects every person.

ti: Α. Λατινοπούλου: “Για άλλη μια φορά, η «αριστεία» της ΝΔ ψάχνει τα πτυχία της”
s: Voice of Reason MP Afroditi Latinopoulou publicly questioned the appointment of Mr. Bekiris as director of the Prime Minister's parliamentary office, alleging he lacks proper credentials and official appointment documentation, and demanded his removal if irregularities are confirmed.

q.o: Η κυβέρνηση παρέδωσε για άλλη μια φορά μαθήματα αξιοκρατίας, αυτή τη φορά μέσα στο ίδιο το γραφείο του Πρωθυπουργού.
q.t: The government delivered yet another lesson in meritocracy, this time within the Prime Minister's own office.

q.o: Κύριε Μητσοτάκη, η εμπιστοσύνη στο πρόσωο σας έχει χαθεί πλήρως. Το κράτος λειτουργεί με κανόνες, ελέγχους, λογοδοσία και ευθύνη. Αν δεν το έχετε καταλάβει εδώ και 7 χρόνια, θα σας κάνουμε να το μάθετε.
q.t: Mr. Mitsotakis, trust in you has been completely lost. The state functions with rules, controls, accountability and responsibility. If you haven't understood this for 7 years, we will make you learn it.

q.o: Η ΦΩΝΗ ΛΟΓΙΚΗΣ απαιτεί άμεση δημοσιοποίηση των σχετικών εγγράφων και πλήρη έλεγχο της νομιμότητας της άσκησης καθηκόντων. Η απομάκρυνση του κ. Μπεκίρη, σε περίπτωση παρατυπίας, είναι αυτονόητη.
q.t: VOICE OF REASON demands immediate publication of relevant documents and full verification of the legality of the exercise of duties. The removal of Mr. Bekiris, in case of irregularity, is self-evident.

ti: Α. Λατινοπούλου: “Θαυμα! Στην κυβέρνηση Μητσοτάκη οι άριστοι εθελοντές αμοίβονται με σπίτια!” (video)
s: Afroditi Latinopoulou publicly criticized the Mitsotakis government, alleging that excellent volunteers are compensated with houses, referencing someone named Bekiris as an example.

q.o: Θαυμα! Στην κυβέρνηση Μητσοτάκη οι άριστοι εθελοντές αμοίβονται με σπίτια!
q.t: Miracle! In the Mitsotakis government, excellent volunteers are compensated with houses!

q.o: Μη κάθεσαι και σκας, κάντο όπως ο Μπεκίρης!
q.t: Don't just sit there and suffer, do it like Bekiris!

ti: Α. Λατινοπούλου: “Νέο εθνικό Βατερλώ Μητσοτάκη – Γεραπετρίτη! Η Τουρκία επιβάλλει τετελεσμένα και η κυβέρνηση παρακολουθεί ανήμπορη!”
s: Voice of Reason leader Afroditi Latinopoulou condemned the Mitsotakis-Gerapetritis government's foreign policy as a diplomatic failure following Eastern Libya's parliament approval of the Turkish-Libyan memorandum, demanding immediate extension of territorial waters to 12 nautical miles, declaration of Greek EEZ, resumption of Greece-Cyprus undersea cable work, and rejection of any negotiation over Greek sovereignty.

q.o: Η έγκριση του παράνομου τουρκολιβυκού μνημονίου από το Κοινοβούλιο της Ανατολικής Λιβύης, εφόσον επιβεβαιωθεί επισήμως, συνιστά νέο διπλωματικό χαστούκι και εξευτελιστική ήττα της εξωτερικής πολιτικής Μητσοτάκη – Γεραπετρίτη!
q.t: The approval of the illegal Turkish-Libyan memorandum by the Parliament of Eastern Libya, if officially confirmed, constitutes a new diplomatic slap and humiliating defeat of the Mitsotakis-Gerapetritis foreign policy!

q.o: Η Άγκυρα προχωρά, διεκδικεί, απειλεί και δημιουργεί τετελεσμένα, ενώ η Αθήνα παρακολουθεί, διαμαρτύρεται και υποχωρεί!
q.t: Ankara advances, claims, threatens and creates fait accompli, while Athens watches, protests and retreats!

q.o: Επέκταση των χωρικών υδάτων στα 12 ναυτικά μίλια, με άμεση προτεραιότητα νοτίως της Κρήτης και με στόχο την πλήρη άσκηση του αναφαίρετου δικαιώματος της Ελλάδας σε όλες τις θαλάσσιες περιοχές της!
q.t: Extension of territorial waters to 12 nautical miles, with immediate priority south of Crete and with the aim of fully exercising Greece's inalienable right in all its maritime areas!

q.o: Η Ελλάδα δεν είναι προτεκτοράτο της Τουρκίας! Δεν χρειάζεται την άδεια της Άγκυρας για να ασκήσει τα νόμιμα κυριαρχικά της δικαιώματα!
q.t: Greece is not a protectorate of Turkey! It does not need Ankara's permission to exercise its legitimate sovereign rights!

ti: Alice Weidel: Kanzler Merz und Finanzminister Klingbeil dilettieren gegen Deutschland
s: Alice Weidel criticizes the Merz-led coalition government for broken promises on energy tax cuts, chaotic tobacco tax implementation, and excessive regulation instead of deregulation, calling for new elections and a complete policy reversal.

q.o: Mehr denn je sehnt jeder vernünftige Bundesbürger zum Ende dieser Woche Neuwahlen herbei
q.t: More than ever, every reasonable German citizen longs for new elections at the end of this week

q.o: Wir brauchen endlich die 180-Grad-Wende in der Politik: professionelles Arbeiten im Sinne der deutschen Bürger und Steuerzahler – für Wachstum und Wohlstand.
q.t: We finally need a 180-degree turn in politics: professional work in the interest of German citizens and taxpayers – for growth and prosperity.

ti: AfD wird Berichterstattung auf Grundlage illegal erlangter Daten nicht unterstützen
s: The AfD federal party issued a statement on 21 October 2026 declaring it will not cooperate with media reporting based on allegedly stolen party data from a digital attack, calling the data theft a crime and warning that some leaked content appears to be falsified.

q.o: Die AfD ist eine Rechtsstaatspartei. Entsprechend eng werden wir mit den staatlichen Stellen auf Bundes- und Landesebene zusammenarbeiten, um jene zur Rechenschaft zu ziehen, die unsere Partei digital angegriffen und Daten gestohlen haben.
q.t: The AfD is a rule-of-law party. Accordingly, we will work closely with state authorities at federal and state level to hold accountable those who digitally attacked our party and stole data.

q.o: Die AfD-Daten wurden illegal kopiert. Das ist eine Straftat. All jene, die nun diese Daten nutzen, heißen ein Verbrechen gut und missachten oftmals das Persönlichkeitsrecht.
q.t: The AfD data was illegally copied. That is a criminal offense. All those who now use this data are condoning a crime and often disregarding personal rights.

q.o: Deshalb werden unsere Mitarbeiter keine Anfragen beantworten, in denen es um die Frage geht, ob ein vermeintlicher Leak-Inhalt echt oder gefälscht ist.
q.t: Therefore our staff will not answer any inquiries concerning the question of whether alleged leaked content is genuine or falsified.

ti: Sven Tritschler: Linksextremismus darf in Deutschland nicht länger salonfähig sein
s: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Sven Tritschler issued a statement condemning planned protests on October 31, 2026, calling for the federal government to withdraw state funding from left-wing groups and warning against what he characterizes as left-wing extremism, antisemitism, and Islamism.

q.o: Deutschland darf nicht länger auf dem linken Auge blind sein.
q.t: Germany must no longer be blind in its left eye.

q.o: Linksextremismus, Antisemitismus, Islamismus – die Grenzen sind fließend, wie die Enthüllungen rund um die jüngsten Wahlen zum Berliner Abgeordnetenhaus zeigen.
q.t: Left-wing extremism, antisemitism, Islamism – the boundaries are fluid, as the revelations surrounding the recent elections to the Berlin House of Representatives show.

q.o: Linke planen ganz unverhohlen Verfassungsfeindliches, wollen enteignen, den Sicherheitsapparat schwächen, attackieren sicherheitsrelevante Infrastruktur und wollen – wie nun für den 31. Oktober angekündigt – den Klassenkampf auf Deutschlands Straßen zurückbringen.
q.t: The left are quite openly planning anti-constitutional activities, want to expropriate, weaken the security apparatus, attack security-relevant infrastructure and want – as now announced for October 31 – to bring class struggle back to Germany's streets.

ti: AfD zum Daten-Hack: Angriff auf Parteiensystem und Demokratie
s: The AfD issued a statement on October 20, 2026, responding to a September 2026 hacking attack on a hosting provider that resulted in stolen data being published on an activist website, calling it an illegal attack on the party system and democracy and stating they have notified authorities and data protection officials.

q.o: Seit gestern zeigt sich das Ausmaß des digitalen Angriffs: Obwohl nur wenige Mail-Postfächer widerrechtlich kopiert wurden, sind große Datenmengen abgeflossen.
q.t: Since yesterday the extent of the digital attack has become apparent: Although only a few email mailboxes were unlawfully copied, large amounts of data were extracted.

q.o: Solch ein digitaler Angriff ist illegal und strafrechtlich relevant. Zudem ist er ein Angriff auf das deutsche Parteiensystem und damit auf die Demokratie.
q.t: Such a digital attack is illegal and criminally relevant. Moreover, it is an attack on the German party system and thus on democracy.

q.o: Die bislang veröffentlichten, vermeintlichen Skandale halten einer inhaltlichen Überprüfung nicht stand – was zum Glück auch immer mehr Kommentatoren in den Sozialen Medien bestätigen.
q.t: The alleged scandals published so far do not withstand substantive scrutiny – which fortunately more and more commentators on social media are also confirming.

ti: Tino Chrupalla: Weitsichtige Standortpolitik und sozialer Frieden statt Pariser Zustände in Berlin
s: AfD federal spokesman Tino Chrupalla criticized the planned SPD-Left-Green coalition in Berlin, warning against social unrest similar to protests in Paris and other European cities, and called for economic policy and migration control to maintain social peace, citing AfD's approach in Saxony-Anhalt as a model.

q.o: Eine rot-grün-rote Koalition im Roten Rathaus wäre ein Fanal für Pariser Zustände in der deutschen Hauptstadt.
q.t: A red-green-red coalition in the Red City Hall would be a signal for Parisian conditions in the German capital.

q.o: Die Regierungen in Bund und Ländern müssen den Vertrauensverlust verhindern und dem Kontrollverlust vorbeugen. Mit weitsichtiger Standortpolitik müssen sie den Bürgern Perspektiven bieten, mit Augenmaß in der Migrationspolitik den sozialen Frieden sichern.
q.t: The governments at federal and state level must prevent the loss of trust and forestall the loss of control. With far-sighted economic policy they must offer citizens prospects, with moderation in migration policy secure social peace.

q.o: In Sachsen-Anhalt wollen wir mit gutem Beispiel vorangehen.
q.t: In Saxony-Anhalt we want to lead by good example.

ti: Tino Chrupalla: Die Industrie wandert ab, die Bundesregierung schaut zu
s: AfD federal spokesman Tino Chrupalla criticized the federal government's inaction on industrial relocation abroad, calling for lower labor costs, less bureaucracy, lower taxes, education reform, a migration turnaround, reduced development aid, peace policy between Russia and Ukraine, and an end to the current form of energy transition.

q.o: Diese Zahlen sind ein Alarmsignal, doch die Bundesregierung bleibt untätig. Der aktuelle kleine Aufschwung ist mit Milliarden an Sonderschulden teuer erkauft.
q.t: These numbers are an alarm signal, but the federal government remains inactive. The current small upswing has been bought dearly with billions in special debts.

q.o: Produzieren in Deutschland muss sich wieder lohnen: mit niedrigeren Lohnnebenkosten, weniger Bürokratie, niedrigeren Steuern und einem Bildungssystem, das Fachkräfte statt Schulabbrecher hervorbringt.
q.t: Producing in Germany must be worthwhile again: with lower non-wage labor costs, less bureaucracy, lower taxes and an education system that produces skilled workers instead of school dropouts.

q.o: Der Staat muss seine Ausgaben neu ordnen: mit einer echten Migrationswende, weniger Entwicklungshilfe, einer Friedenspolitik zwischen Russland und der Ukraine und einem Ende der Energiewende in ihrer jetzigen Form.
q.t: The state must reorganize its spending: with a real migration turnaround, less development aid, a peace policy between Russia and Ukraine and an end to the energy transition in its current form.

ti: Leaked emails reveal Alice Weidel’s reversal on AfD nationalist Björn Höcke - Mezha.net
s: Leaked emails reportedly show Alice Weidel reversing her position on AfD figure Björn Höcke.
