ti: Trappes et La Verrière : le racisme tue encore une fois
s: The NPA-l'Anticapitaliste expressed solidarity with victims of a shooting in Trappes and La Verrière on October 23, where a far-right individual killed one Black man and seriously injured five others, including a 12-year-old girl, in what the party characterizes as a racist attack targeting people perceived as Arab and/or Muslim.

q.o: Ce vendredi 23 octobre, un individu d'extrême droite a tiré au pistolet mitrailleur à Trappes et à La Verrière, tuant un homme noir de 26 ans, Pengo Bossio Wangi, et en blessant grièvement cinq autres personnes, toutes visées parce que supposées arabes et/ou musulmanEs, dont une enfant de 12 ans, criblée de balles, visée parce que portant un foulard.
q.t: This Friday, October 23, a far-right individual fired a submachine gun in Trappes and La Verrière, killing a 26-year-old Black man, Pengo Bossio Wangi, and seriously injuring five other people, all targeted because they were assumed to be Arab and/or Muslim, including a 12-year-old child, riddled with bullets, targeted because she was wearing a headscarf.

q.o: Le NPA-l'Anticapitaliste exprime toute sa solidarité avec les victimes, leurs proches et les habitantEs.
q.t: The NPA-l'Anticapitaliste expresses its full solidarity with the victims, their loved ones and the residents.

ti: Un couvre-feu autoritaire qui ne fera pas taire nos colères
s: The New Anticapitalist Party condemns curfews imposed in Paris, Marseille, Lyon, Toulouse, Nice, Lille, Bordeaux and other cities following mobilizations on October 17, describing them as a colonial method of order maintenance aimed at preventing mobilization and justifying repression.

q.o: Cette méthode coloniale du maintien de l'ordre a pour unique but d'empêcher toute mobilisation et de justifier une répression encore plus brutale contre celles et ceux qui refuseront de se taire.
q.t: This colonial method of maintaining order has the sole purpose of preventing any mobilization and justifying even more brutal repression against those who refuse to be silenced.

ti: Solidarité face à l’intimidation judiciaire
s: The New Anticapitalist Party issued a statement of solidarity with La France Insoumise deputies Rima Hassan and Raphaël Arnault, who face legal proceedings, describing these as intimidation attempts against activists supporting Palestine and opposing the far right.

q.o: Nous apporterons tout notre soutien à Rima Hassan et à Raphaël Arnault face à ces tentatives d'intimidation visant à faire taire des militantEs engagéEs dans la lutte de solidarité avec le peuple palestinien et contre l'extrême droite et ses idées.
q.t: We will give all our support to Rima Hassan and Raphaël Arnault in the face of these intimidation attempts aimed at silencing activists engaged in the struggle of solidarity with the Palestinian people and against the far right and its ideas.

ti: Non à la répression de la jeunesse
s: The NPA issued a statement supporting the October 17 demonstration of 800,000 people called by yellow vests and unions, which brought together youth and workers against high cost of living, destruction of public services, and for better study conditions.

q.o: Ce samedi 17 octobre, après des semaines de mobilisations lycéennes, 800 000 personnes sont descendues dans la rue à l'appel des gilets jaunes et des syndicats.
q.t: This Saturday, October 17, after weeks of high school mobilizations, 800,000 people took to the streets at the call of the yellow vests and the unions.

q.o: Cet appel a permis une convergence des luttes, entre la jeunesse et les travailleurs et travailleuses, contre la vie chère, la destruction des services publics et pour de meilleures conditions d'études.
q.t: This call enabled a convergence of struggles, between youth and workers, against the high cost of living, the destruction of public services and for better study conditions.

ti: Le 17 octobre, le jour du dépassement pour le gouvernement
s: The NPA reports that over 800,000 demonstrators participated in mobilisations on 17 October 2024, which the party describes as the largest mobilisation in years and an expression of social anger against ten years of Macronism.

q.o: La journée de mobilisation du 17 octobre a été une démonstration de la force collective de celles et ceux qui n'en peuvent plus de ce système.
q.t: The day of mobilisation on 17 October was a demonstration of the collective force of those who can no longer stand this system.

q.o: Avec plus de 800 000 manifestants, c'est la plus grande mobilisation depuis des années. Un raz-de-marée populaire qui est l'expression de la colère sociale contre les 10 ans de macronisme.
q.t: With more than 800,000 demonstrators, this is the largest mobilisation in years. A popular tidal wave that is the expression of social anger against 10 years of Macronism.

ti: Philippe Poutou sur BFM TV : "J'appelle à la lutte et à la mobilisation"
s: Philippe Poutou appeared on BFM TV on 18 October 2026 to discuss the 17 October revolt, questioning the reasons for anger amid calls to condemn and expand repressive measures.

q.o: J'appelle à la lutte et à la mobilisation
q.t: I call for struggle and mobilisation

ti: À Rouen, ni les flics ni les fachos ne nous empêcheront de manifester !
s: The New Anticapitalist Party – Revolutionaries reports on demonstrations in Rouen with over 15,000 participants on October 17 and subsequent general assemblies on university campuses, declaring that neither police nor fascists will prevent them from demonstrating.

ti: France Travail expérimente une IA générative de contrôle
s: The party reports that France Travail is developing a ChatGPT-type generative AI tool to monitor over six million registered jobseekers, with the stated goal of implementing continuous control.

ti: Comparer des homosexuels à des chiens ne choque pas Sarah Knafo
s: NPA-Revolutionaries criticizes Sarah Knafo of Reconquête for her response to homophobic statements by party member Samuel Lafont comparing homosexuals to dogs during a France 2 interview.

ti: Terrorisme : quand Macron a la mémoire courte
s: The NPA-Revolutionaries criticizes President Macron for claiming that a racist attack in Trappes was the first planned terrorist act targeting people based on skin color or religion in France.

q.o: C'est un tournant parce que c'est la première fois qu'il y a un acte terroriste planifié pour tuer nos compatriotes, nos enfants, en raison de leur couleur de peau ou de la religion qu'on leur donne.
q.t: This is a turning point because it is the first time there has been a planned terrorist act to kill our compatriots, our children, because of their skin color or the religion attributed to them.

ti: Le racisme tue et la répression mutile en défense des intérêts du Medef. Le mouvement continue : construisons la grève dans les entreprises
s: The NPA-Revolutionaries condemned a racist attack in Trappes that killed Pengo Bossio Wangi, aged 26, and injured five people including a 12-year-old girl, calling for strikes in workplaces and linking racism and repression to the interests of Medef (French employers' federation).

q.o: L'attentat raciste de Trappes a coûté la vie à un homme de 26 ans, Pengo Bossio Wangi, et blessé cinq personnes dont une fillette de 12 ans qui se bat pour survivre.
q.t: The racist attack in Trappes cost the life of a 26-year-old man, Pengo Bossio Wangi, and injured five people including a 12-year-old girl who is fighting to survive.

q.o: La tristesse est immense, mais aussi la rage et la colère.
q.t: The sadness is immense, but so is the rage and anger.

ti: Samedi 7 novembre, RDV au Parc des Expositions du Bourget, près de Paris, pour un Grand meeting de Jean-Luc Mélenchon !
s: France Unbowed announces a major rally with Jean-Luc Mélenchon on November 7 at Paris Le Bourget exhibition center to launch their presidential election program 'L'Avenir en commun'.

ti: Nous dénonçons la fuite en avant autoritaire du pouvoir
s: France Unbowed calls for nationwide peaceful demonstrations alongside unions and student organizations against government protest bans, curfews, and what it characterizes as authoritarian measures, while supporting legal challenges to these restrictions.

q.o: Les libertés publiques ne peuvent pas être une variable d'ajustement d'un exécutif en perdition.
q.t: Public freedoms cannot be an adjustment variable for an executive in disarray.

q.o: En décidant d'interdire des manifestations, de choisir qui a le droit ou pas d'en organiser, de mettre en place des couvre-feux à l'échelle d'un département ou d'une ville, d'inciter les commerçants à recourir à des sécurités privées, l'exécutif franchit une à une les limites qui séparent une démocratie d'un État autoritaire et policier.
q.t: By deciding to ban demonstrations, to choose who has the right or not to organize them, to implement curfews at the scale of a department or a city, to encourage merchants to use private security, the executive is crossing one by one the limits that separate a democracy from an authoritarian and police state.

q.o: La France insoumise appelle partout en France à manifester pacifiquement, toutes et tous ensemble, aux côtés des organisations syndicales de salariés, étudiantes et lycéennes en participant à la protection de ces cortèges unitaires.
q.t: France Unbowed calls everywhere in France to demonstrate peacefully, all together, alongside workers' unions, student and high school organizations by participating in the protection of these united marches.

ti: La France insoumise à la Paris Games Week : pour une politique publique du jeu vidéo
s: France Unbowed announces a delegation of parliamentarians will attend Paris Games Week 2026 to present their video game policy program, including creation of a national video game center modeled on the national cinema center, funded by a tax on game sales.

q.o: C'est pour ces raisons que nous souhaitons que la puissance publique reprenne la main sur ce secteur.
q.t: It is for these reasons that we want public authorities to take back control of this sector.

q.o: Nous portons la création d'un centre national du jeu vidéo, sur le modèle du Centre national du cinéma, chargé notamment de soutenir la diversité et l'indépendance dans la création vidéoludique.
q.t: We support the creation of a national video game center, modeled on the National Cinema Center, responsible in particular for supporting diversity and independence in video game creation.

q.o: Il sera financé par une taxe affectée sur les ventes de jeux et de services en jeu et permettra de réformer l'ensemble du système d'aides afin que celles-ci ne soient plus accaparées par les grandes entreprises du secteur.
q.t: It will be financed by a dedicated tax on sales of games and in-game services and will allow reform of the entire aid system so that they are no longer monopolized by large companies in the sector.

ti: Avec la jeunesse, contre la vie chère : manifestons partout en France samedi 24 octobre !
s: France Unbowed calls for participation in nationwide demonstrations on October 24, 2026, against the cost of living and in support of youth demands, following a mobilization of nearly one million people on October 17.

q.o: La France insoumise apporte une nouvelle fois son soutien à ces mobilisations et appelle à y participer.
q.t: France Unbowed once again gives its support to these mobilizations and calls for participation.

q.o: Ses élus, parlementaires nationaux et européens, seront sur le terrain aux côtés des personnes mobilisées.
q.t: Its elected officials, national and European parliamentarians, will be on the ground alongside the mobilized people.

ti: Ρένα Δούρου: Ιστορική συμφωνία σε βάρος της Μονής Σινά
s: SYRIZA-PS parliamentary group president Rena Dourou criticized the Greek government's agreement with Egypt regarding Saint Catherine's Monastery in Sinai, demanding full disclosure of the agreement and questioning whether it converts historic property rights into mere usage tolerance.

q.o: Πράγματι η συμφωνία είναι ιστορική αλλά σε βάρος του αρχαιότερου χριστιανικού μοναστηριού σε αδιάκοπη λειτουργία εδώ και 15 αιώνες.
q.t: Indeed the agreement is historic but at the expense of the oldest Christian monastery in continuous operation for 15 centuries.

q.o: Ο Πρωθυπουργός και ο Υπουργός Εξωτερικών οφείλουν να δώσουν άμεσα στη δημοσιότητα το πλήρες κείμενο της συμφωνίας.
q.t: The Prime Minister and the Foreign Minister must immediately make public the full text of the agreement.

q.o: δυστυχώς η Μονή 'πουλήθηκε' από την Ελληνική κυβέρνηση στην Αιγυπτιακή με πρόσχημα ψεύτικη δικαστική διαδικασία
q.t: unfortunately the Monastery was 'sold' by the Greek government to the Egyptian one under the pretext of a fake judicial process

ti: Heimaturlaub statt Absitzen der Haftstrafe
s: FPÖ MP Christian Lausch criticized the coalition's prison reform bill in parliament, arguing it would lead to early releases rather than deportations and noting that Justice Minister Anna Sporrer has not concluded any necessary repatriation agreements in 20 months.

q.o: Was Sie mit dieser Strafvollzugsnovelle vorhaben, bedeutet lediglich früheres Entlassen, späteres Einsperren und die Abschaffung jeder Abschreckung. Das ist nicht unser Verständnis einer Strafvollzugsnovelle. So etwas werden wir nicht mittragen!
q.t: What you intend with this prison reform bill means merely earlier releases, later imprisonment and the abolition of any deterrence. That is not our understanding of a prison reform bill. We will not support such a thing!

q.o: Wir wollen die Rückführung und die Strafverbüßung im Heimatland. Dann brauchen wir auch keine neuen Gefängnisse zu bauen, für die ohnehin kein Geld da ist. Wenn es gelingt, 2.000 ausländische Straftäter zurückzuführen, sparen wir uns bei einem konservativ gerechneten Hafttag von 150 Euro rund 110 Millionen Euro an Steuergeld pro Jahr
q.t: We want repatriation and serving of sentences in the home country. Then we also don't need to build new prisons, for which there is no money anyway. If we succeed in repatriating 2,000 foreign criminals, we save ourselves around 110 million euros in tax money per year at a conservatively calculated detention day of 150 euros

ti: Angebliche ORF-Sparpläne sind reine Augenauswischerei
s: FPÖ media spokesperson Christian Hafenecker criticized the ORF's announced plan to reduce the number of employees earning over 170,000 euros annually from 65 to 60 as cosmetic and called for support of the FPÖ's ORF referendum (ORF-Volksbegehren) to fundamentally reform public broadcasting.

q.o: Dass ausgerechnet jene ORF-Chefetage, die mit über 700 Millionen Euro Einnahmen pro Jahr aus der ORF-Haushaltsabgabe nicht auskommt, die für die explodierenden Kosten und den aufgeblähten Apparat verantwortlich ist, nun den großen Sparmeister spielen will, ist an Zynismus nicht zu überbieten. Da macht sich der Bock zum Gärtner
q.t: That precisely those ORF executives who cannot manage with over 700 million euros in annual revenue from the ORF household levy, who are responsible for the exploding costs and the bloated apparatus, now want to play the great savings master, cannot be surpassed in cynicism. The fox is guarding the henhouse

q.o: Die unverschämten Gehälter einiger weniger werden marginal gekürzt, während der Wasserkopf und die Ineffizienz im System unangetastet bleiben
q.t: The outrageous salaries of a few are being marginally cut, while the top-heavy structure and inefficiency in the system remain untouched

q.o: Der ganze ORF in seiner aktuellen Form muss neu gedacht werden. Ein modernes Medienunternehmen kann sich nämlich weder so viele Gagenkaiser leisten, noch permanent gegen die Interessen der Zuschauer anzusenden
q.t: The entire ORF in its current form must be rethought. A modern media company can neither afford so many salary emperors, nor constantly broadcast against the interests of viewers

ti: Entwurf zur Sozialhilfe-Reform ist ein Pfusch
s: FPÖ social affairs spokesperson Dagmar Belakowitsch criticized the government coalition's draft social welfare reform as inadequate, arguing it fails to achieve nationwide standardization, forces some federal states to increase spending, allows Vienna to continue spending through in-kind benefits, and does not effectively tie social benefits to citizenship.

q.o: Wo soll hier bitte ein Paradigmenwechsel sein? Der eigentliche Grund für dieses monatelange Koalitions-Theater war das Versprechen, endlich eine bundesweite Vereinheitlichung zu schaffen – und genau diese wurde komplett verfehlt!
q.t: Where is there supposed to be a paradigm shift here? The actual reason for this months-long coalition theater was the promise to finally create nationwide standardization – and precisely this has been completely missed!

q.o: Integration ist eine Bringschuld und kein kostenpflichtiges Belohnungsprogramm!
q.t: Integration is an obligation to deliver and not a paid reward program!

q.o: Wer die Einwanderung ins Sozialsystem wirklich stoppen will, muss die rechtlichen Rahmenbedingungen ändern und Sozialleistungen strikt an die Staatsbürgerschaft knüpfen!
q.t: Whoever really wants to stop immigration into the social system must change the legal framework and strictly tie social benefits to citizenship!

ti: Corona-Wahnsinn: Wir werden Unrecht schonungslos aufarbeiten und Opfer entschädigen
s: The Freedom Party of Austria announced it will establish a parliamentary committee of inquiry to investigate COVID-19 policies, demand full repayment of unlawful fines, and seek compensation for victims of lockdowns and vaccine mandates.

q.o: Wir haben ein Defizitverfahren, weil die damalige Regierung nach dem Motto 'Koste es, was es wolle' Milliarden an Steuergeld verbrannt hat.
q.t: We have a deficit procedure because the government at the time burned billions in tax money according to the motto 'cost what it may.'

q.o: Was damals mit den Kindern passiert ist, ist ein Verbrechen an einer ganzen Generation.
q.t: What happened to the children back then is a crime against an entire generation.

q.o: Wir sind bereits in der intensiven Vorbereitung und werden unser Minderheitenrecht nutzen. Wir sind die Stimme derer, die Opfer dieser sinnlosen und willkürlichen Politik geworden sind.
q.t: We are already in intensive preparation and will use our minority rights. We are the voice of those who became victims of this senseless and arbitrary policy.

q.o: Ich fordere schon seit Langem, dass diese mRNA-Covid-19-Impfungen vom Markt genommen werden, weil sie nicht nur massive gesundheitliche Schädigungen, sondern auch Todesfälle verursachen.
q.t: I have long been demanding that these mRNA COVID-19 vaccines be taken off the market because they cause not only massive health damage but also deaths.

q.o: Sie wussten, dass diese mRNA-Impfungen nicht vor der Übertragung des Virus schützen! Und trotzdem haben die Systemparteien die Menschen belogen und ihnen eindringlich empfohlen, ihre Kinder und schwangere Frauen impfen zu lassen.
q.t: They knew that these mRNA vaccines do not protect against transmission of the virus! And yet the system parties lied to people and urgently recommended that they have their children and pregnant women vaccinated.

q.o: Wir fordern die vollständige Rückzahlung aller rechtswidrigen Strafen und eine längst überfällige Entschuldigung bei der eigenen Bevölkerung!
q.t: We demand the complete repayment of all unlawful fines and a long overdue apology to our own population!

ti: News
s: The Freedom Party of Austria announced plans for a parliamentary committee of inquiry into COVID-19 measures including lockdowns and vaccine mandates, promising to compensate victims and repay fines, while simultaneously conducting ongoing investigations into alleged ÖVP political interference in the Pilnacek case.

q.o: Wir werden Unrecht schonungslos aufarbeiten und Opfer entschädigen
q.t: We will ruthlessly investigate injustice and compensate victims

q.o: Lockdowns, Impfzwang und Schikanen müssen aufgeklärt und Strafen zurückgezahlt
q.t: Lockdowns, vaccine mandates and harassment must be clarified and fines repaid

q.o: Das ÖVP-System der Verantwortungslosigkeit setzt sich nahtlos fort
q.t: The ÖVP system of irresponsibility continues seamlessly

q.o: Drückebergertum darf nicht zum Erfolg führen
q.t: Shirking must not lead to success

ti: Työlle ja taistelulle jatkuvuutta – testamenttilahjoitus Spartacus-säätiölle on merkityksellinen
s: The Communist Party of Finland promotes testamentary donations to the Spartacus Foundation, established in 1989, to ensure continuity of communist and workers' movement activities including cooperation with the party and Tiedonantaja newspaper.

q.o: Spartacus-säätiö edistää kommunistisen liikkeen ja työväenliikkeen poliittista, sivistyksellistä, kulttuurista ja kansainvälistä toimintaa.

ti: Antikapitalistinen foorumi kutsuu mukaan Tampereelle 14.11.
s: The Communist Party of Finland's Tampere district organization is co-organizing an Anti-Capitalist Forum in Tampere on 14 November 2026, bringing together multiple left-wing organizations for workshops and discussions on building alternatives to capitalism.

q.o: Tapaaminen on tarkoitettu sinulle, joka vastustat kapitalismia ja haluat rakentaa parempaa maailmaa sen tilalle.
q.t: The meeting is intended for you who oppose capitalism and want to build a better world in its place.

q.o: Foorumin tarkoituksena on saada joukosta voimaa, jakaa kokemuksia, oppia toisiltamme, vahvistaa kollektiivista toimijuutta ja viettää aikaa radikaalissa porukassa.
q.t: The purpose of the forum is to gain strength from the crowd, share experiences, learn from each other, strengthen collective agency and spend time in a radical group.

ti: Cortei: misure governo garantiscono sicurezza e diritto a manifestare
s: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni thanked security forces for managing demonstrations and defended recent Council of Ministers measures designed to give the state more effective tools to prevent violence during protests.

q.o: Voglio ringraziare le donne e gli uomini delle Forze dell'Ordine che anche oggi, nelle piazze italiane, hanno lavorato per garantire la sicurezza dei cittadini e il diritto di manifestare pacificamente, nonostante i tentativi di alcuni violenti di provocare scontri e disordini.
q.t: I want to thank the women and men of the Security Forces who today, in Italian squares, have worked to guarantee the security of citizens and the right to demonstrate peacefully, despite the attempts of some violent individuals to provoke clashes and disorder.

q.o: È in questa direzione che vanno anche le misure approvate nei giorni scorsi dal Consiglio dei Ministri: dare allo Stato strumenti più efficaci per prevenire le violenze e impedire che delinquenti e facinorosi possano mettere a ferro e fuoco intere città.
q.t: It is in this direction that the measures approved in recent days by the Council of Ministers also go: to give the State more effective tools to prevent violence and prevent criminals and troublemakers from putting entire cities to fire and sword.

ti: Olio: 16 milioni per sostenere produzioni Dop e Igp
s: The Ministry of Agriculture launches a tender through Agea to purchase at least 1.8 million liters of DOP and IGP extra virgin olive oil worth 16 million euros from European Social Fund Plus resources for food aid to the needy.

q.o: Con questa misura mettiamo insieme due priorità del governo: sostenere le famiglie che vivono una condizione di difficoltà e valorizzare una delle eccellenze più rappresentative dell'agroalimentare italiano.
q.t: With this measure we bring together two government priorities: supporting families living in difficult conditions and enhancing one of the most representative excellences of Italian agri-food.

q.o: Con questo intervento mettiamo a valore circa 16 milioni di euro di fondi europei destinati al contrasto della povertà, trasformandoli in un aiuto concreto per le persone in difficoltà.
q.t: With this intervention we put to use about 16 million euros of European funds intended to combat poverty, transforming them into concrete help for people in difficulty.

ti: Carburanti: accordo con autotrasporto, risorse a agricoltura e pesca
s: The Italian government announced an agreement with transport associations providing immediate tax credit payments for diesel fuel from March-August 2026, allocated 60 million euros for agricultural diesel subsidies (up to 45 cents per liter discount), 10 million euros for fishing sector, and 106 million euros additional funding for September-October 2026 transport fuel credits, while warning that road blockades will be treated as criminal offenses under the Security Decree.

q.o: Il Governo, tramite il ministro Salvini, ha firmato in queste ultime ore un accordo con le associazioni dell'autotrasporto, con le quali ci siamo tra l'altro sempre confrontati e che ringrazio per la collaborazione, che non è mai mancata in questi mesi difficili.
q.t: The Government, through Minister Salvini, has signed in recent hours an agreement with the road transport associations, with whom we have always consulted and whom I thank for their collaboration, which has never been lacking in these difficult months.

q.o: Stanziamo 60 milioni di euro per un contributo a fondo perduto sul costo del gasolio agricolo, che nei fatti si tradurrà in uno sconto fino a 45 centesimi al litro, per oltre 120 milioni di litri.
q.t: We are allocating 60 million euros for a non-repayable contribution on the cost of agricultural diesel, which will in fact translate into a discount of up to 45 cents per liter, for over 120 million liters.

q.o: Questa non è protesta, è intimidazione, e l'intimidazione non la tolleriamo e non lo dico solamente io.
q.t: This is not protest, it is intimidation, and we do not tolerate intimidation and I am not the only one saying this.

q.o: E useremo tutti gli strumenti che la legge ci offre, comprese le norme del Decreto sicurezza, che hanno reso reato il blocco stradale.
q.t: And we will use all the tools that the law offers us, including the provisions of the Security Decree, which have made road blockades a crime.

ti: Governo: quattro anni di risultati e traguardi per l’Italia
s: Brothers of Italy published a document celebrating the Meloni Government becoming the first in Italian republican history to reach four years in office, claiming achievements including 140 billion euros in tax cuts, a 70% reduction in illegal landings, and 1.4 million new stable jobs.

ti: Protezione civile: riforma va incontro a esigenze territori
s: The Chamber definitively approved a civil protection reform bill introducing criminal liability discipline for volunteers, mayors, and operators, limiting responsibility to intentional crimes or gross negligence while excluding liability when guidelines are followed.

q.o: La Camera oggi ha approvato in via definitiva un provvedimento che mi sta particolarmente a cuore: il disegno di legge sulla Protezione Civile. Una riforma storica, attesa da migliaia di volontari, che prevede l'introduzione della disciplina sulla responsabilità penale inerente i reati colposi accaduti durante le attività di protezione civile.
q.t: The Chamber today definitively approved a measure that is particularly close to my heart: the Civil Protection bill. A historic reform, awaited by thousands of volunteers, which provides for the introduction of discipline on criminal liability concerning negligent crimes that occurred during civil protection activities.

q.o: I volontari, così come i sindaci e gli operatori, risponderanno di reati dolosi o di colpa grave, ma sarà esclusa la responsabilità penale ogni volta che vengano osservate le linee guida o le buone pratiche.
q.t: Volunteers, as well as mayors and operators, will be liable for intentional crimes or gross negligence, but criminal liability will be excluded whenever guidelines or good practices are observed.

q.o: La Protezione Civile è un modello per l'Italia e noi vogliamo valorizzarla e proteggerla come realmente merita
q.t: Civil Protection is a model for Italy and we want to enhance and protect it as it truly deserves

ti: Sicurezza: decreto governo risposta ferma contro violenti
s: Brothers of Italy announces a government security decree introducing criminal penalties for violent participation in demonstrations, parental liability for minor offenders, stricter accountability for 14-18 year-olds, and deployment of 500 military personnel to Milan following recent violent protests that injured nearly 200 police officers.

q.o: Con il nuovo decreto sicurezza illustrato dal presidente Giorgia Meloni, il governo interviene con equilibrio ed efficacia per ristabilire il confine netto tra il legittimo dissenso – come quello espresso civilmente da categorie produttive quali agricoltori, autotrasportatori e lavoratori con cui l'Esecutivo si confronta costantemente – e la pura criminalità.
q.t: With the new security decree presented by President Giorgia Meloni, the government intervenes with balance and effectiveness to re-establish the clear boundary between legitimate dissent – such as that expressed civilly by productive categories like farmers, truck drivers and workers with whom the Executive constantly engages – and pure criminality.

q.o: Con il nuovo decreto sicurezza, tra l'altro, introduciamo il reato di partecipazione violenta a manifestazioni con pene fino a 5 anni di carcere e multe fino a 20mila euro, affermiamo il principio che chi rompe paga – con ingiunzioni dirette del Prefetto per i beni pubblici, decreti immediatamente esecutivi per i privati e responsabilità patrimoniale dei genitori per i minori –, interveniamo sull'imputabilità tra i 14 e i 18 anni estendendo il fermo preventivo ai minorenni e inviamo subito 500 militari in più a Milano fino a fine anno.
q.t: With the new security decree, among other things, we introduce the crime of violent participation in demonstrations with penalties up to 5 years in prison and fines up to 20,000 euros, we affirm the principle that whoever breaks pays – with direct injunctions from the Prefect for public property, immediately executable decrees for private property and parental financial liability for minors –, we intervene on accountability between 14 and 18 years by extending preventive detention to minors and we immediately send 500 more military personnel to Milan until the end of the year.

q.o: Per Fratelli d'Italia la libertà di manifestare è sacrosanta ma nulla può giustificare le devastazioni a cui abbiamo assistito in questi giorni.
q.t: For Brothers of Italy the freedom to demonstrate is sacrosanct but nothing can justify the devastation we have witnessed in recent days.

ti: Antimafia: depistaggi e indagini senza fondamento, Scarpinato si dimetta
s: Brothers of Italy parliamentarians demand the resignation of Senator Roberto Scarpinato from the Anti-Mafia Commission, citing testimony by Caltanissetta Prosecutor Salvatore De Luca that allegedly confirms Scarpinato conducted unfounded investigations in violation of procedural law and coordinated with an indicted colleague to obstruct commission work.

q.o: Definire 'intollerabile' e un 'salto di livello sproporzionato' e di inaudita virulenza l'attacco sferrato dal senatore Roberto Scarpinato contro il Gip del Tribunale di Caltanissetta, Santi Bologna certifica lo spettacolo indegno di chi, dopo aver sbandierato per una vita la difesa dei giudici dal potere politico, oggi usa il proprio scranno parlamentare per aggredire e delegittimare un giudice della Repubblica solo perché ha avuto il coraggio di scrivere la verità.
q.t: Defining as 'intolerable' and a 'disproportionate escalation' of unprecedented virulence the attack launched by Senator Roberto Scarpinato against the investigating judge of the Caltanissetta Court, Santi Bologna, certifies the unworthy spectacle of someone who, after having championed for a lifetime the defense of judges from political power, today uses his parliamentary seat to attack and delegitimize a judge of the Republic only because he had the courage to write the truth.

q.o: Il Procuratore ha chiarito in modo inequivocabile che per la Procura nissena il filone in sé non è chiuso e ha una sua dignità se sorretto da elementi individualizzanti, ma ciò che vale 'zero assoluto, meno 273,31 gradi della scala Kelvin' è proprio la specifica indagine portata avanti dall'allora Procuratore generale di Palermo Roberto Scarpinato
q.t: The Prosecutor clarified unequivocally that for the Caltanissetta Prosecutor's Office the line of investigation itself is not closed and has its dignity if supported by individualizing elements, but what is worth 'absolute zero, minus 273.31 degrees on the Kelvin scale' is precisely the specific investigation carried out by the then General Prosecutor of Palermo Roberto Scarpinato

q.o: Il Procuratore ha certificato che Scarpinato e l'ex collega indagato Gioacchino Natoli 'hanno concordato tutto': hanno concordato a tavolino la strategia da adottare in Commissione Antimafia, hanno concordato quali persone chiedere di audire e hanno pianificato di 'seppellire di carte la presidente Chiara Colosimo'.
q.t: The Prosecutor certified that Scarpinato and his former colleague under investigation Gioacchino Natoli 'agreed on everything': they agreed at the table on the strategy to adopt in the Anti-Mafia Commission, they agreed on which people to request for hearings and they planned to 'bury President Chiara Colosimo with papers'.

ti: Covid: censurarono studio su effetti avversi al vaccino
s: Brothers of Italy parliamentarians Alice Buonguerrieri and Antonella Zedda used testimony in the Covid Commission to criticize alleged censorship of a 2022 study by ISS researcher Loredana Frasca on adverse vaccine effects, particularly myocarditis in young people, and questioned mass vaccination policies during the pandemic.

q.o: Il clima di caccia alle streghe durante la pandemia di Covid fu da regime totalitario. Giornalisti, esponenti politici, esperti di varie materie e persino ricercatori scientifici furono censurati, ridicolizzati o demonizzati per aver espresso opinioni e studi sgraditi al pensiero allora dominante.
q.t: The climate of witch-hunting during the Covid pandemic was like a totalitarian regime. Journalists, political figures, experts in various fields and even scientific researchers were censored, ridiculed or demonized for having expressed opinions and studies unwelcome to the then-dominant thinking.

q.o: A chi giovava questa vaccinazione di massa? Ne deve rispondere chi era al governo.
q.t: Who benefited from this mass vaccination? Those who were in government must answer for it.

q.o: L'audizione di oggi testimonia che in molti, tra rappresentanti politici e sanitari di allora, hanno minimizzato o persino nascosto l'esito di questo studio per timore che alimentasse sfiducia nei confronti del vaccino anti-Covid. Una vergogna, che avvilisce il rigore scientifico in favore dell'interesse politico.
q.t: Today's hearing testifies that many, among the political and health representatives of that time, minimized or even hid the outcome of this study for fear that it would fuel distrust towards the anti-Covid vaccine. A disgrace, which debases scientific rigor in favor of political interest.

ti: Timo Furuholm: Seisovatko Varsinais-Suomen perussuomalaiset kansanedustajat yli 600 miljoonan euron kuntaleikkausten takana?
s: Left Alliance MP Timo Furuholm challenges Finns Party MPs from Southwest Finland to clarify whether they support their party's proposal to cut 600 million euros from municipal index increases and other municipal funding.

q.o: Haluan kysyä Varsinais-Suomen perussuomalaisilta kansanedustajilta Ville Taviolta, Vilhelm Junnilalta, Kike Elomaalta ja Mikko Lundénilta, seisovatko he todella tämän esityksen takana. Ovatko he valmiita leikkaamaan satoja miljoonia euroja kuntien rahoituksesta ja kantamaan vastuun seurauksista omissa kotikunnissaan
q.t: I want to ask the Finns Party MPs from Southwest Finland, Ville Tavio, Vilhelm Junnila, Kike Elomaa and Mikko Lundén, whether they really stand behind this proposal. Are they prepared to cut hundreds of millions of euros from municipal funding and bear responsibility for the consequences in their own home municipalities

q.o: Puhumme lasten päiväkodeista ja kouluista, opetuksen laadusta, kirjastoista, nuorten harrastusmahdollisuuksista sekä liikunta- ja kulttuuripalveluista. Näistäkö perussuomalaiset haluavat seuraavaksi leikata? Mitään satojen miljoonien eurojen hallinnollista säästöpottia ei kunnissa ole odottamassa
q.t: We are talking about children's daycare centers and schools, the quality of education, libraries, young people's hobby opportunities, and sports and cultural services. Is this what the Finns Party wants to cut next? There is no pot of hundreds of millions of euros in administrative savings waiting in the municipalities

q.o: Kunnille ei jää tällaisessa tilanteessa kuin huonoja vaihtoehtoja. Joko leikataan kuntalaisten palveluista tai nostetaan reippaasti kunnallisveroa. Todennäköisesti monessa kunnassa jouduttaisiin tekemään molempia. Perussuomalaiset ovat tottuneet puhumaan verojen keventämisestä, mutta tällä esityksellä velkajarru siirrettäisiin suoraan kuntalaisten maksettavaksi
q.t: In such a situation, municipalities are left with only bad options. Either cut services for residents or raise municipal taxes significantly. Probably in many municipalities both would have to be done. The Finns Party is used to talking about tax cuts, but with this proposal the debt brake would be transferred directly to be paid by municipal residents

ti: Laura Meriluoto: Asuinpaikka ei saa ratkaista oikeutta terveydenhuollon asiakasmaksujen huojennuksiin
s: Left Alliance vice-chair and MP Laura Meriluoto is collecting signatures in parliament for a legislative initiative to expand wellbeing services areas' obligation to reduce or waive social and healthcare client fees, addressing regional disparities where twelve wellbeing services areas and Helsinki do not allow any reductions for flat-rate healthcare fees.

q.o: Orpo-Purran hallitus on monella tavalla romuttanut suomalaisen yhteiskunnan tasa-arvoa. Yksi räikeimmistä esimerkeistä on sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon asiakasmaksujen enimmäismäärien roimat korotukset.
q.t: The Orpo-Purra government has in many ways destroyed the equality of Finnish society. One of the most blatant examples is the massive increases in the maximum amounts of social and healthcare client fees.

q.o: Kahdellatoista hyvinvointialueella ja Helsingissä terveydenhuollon tasasuuruisiin asiakasmaksuihin ei voi hakea lainkaan alennusta tai perimättä jättämistä. Asiakasmaksun huojentaminen ei saa riippua siitä, minkä hyvinvointialueen järjestämiä palveluja henkilö käyttää.
q.t: In twelve wellbeing services areas and Helsinki, one cannot apply for any reduction or waiver of flat-rate healthcare client fees. The reduction of client fees must not depend on which wellbeing services area's services a person uses.

q.o: Suomessa julkisten sosiaali- ja terveyspalvelujen maksuja päätyy myös ulosottoon poikkeuksellisen paljon. Vuonna 2025 ulosottoon tuli noin 507 000 sosiaali- ja terveyspalvelujen sekä varhaiskasvatuksen asiakasmaksua.
q.t: In Finland, public social and healthcare service fees also end up in debt collection exceptionally often. In 2025, approximately 507,000 client fees for social and healthcare services and early childhood education went to debt collection.

ti: Timo Furuholm: Sosiaaliturvan leikkaukset ja terveydenhuollon asiakasmaksujen korotukset vievät suomalaisia todella ahtaalle
s: Opposition parties including Left Alliance submitted an interpellation to the Orpo-Purra government regarding rising living costs, with MP Timo Furuholm criticizing social security cuts and healthcare fee increases and calling for restoration of basic security protections and affordable housing construction.

q.o: Hallitus voisi aloittaa suomalaisten elämän helpottamisen esimerkiksi hautaamalla nyt täällä eduskunnassa käsittelyssä olevat "Rydmanin hinnat" eli terveydenhuollon asiakasmaksujen korotukset ja uudet maksut. Suomessa hyvä terveys ei saa olla kiinni lompakon paksuudesta.
q.t: The government could start making life easier for Finns by, for example, burying the so-called 'Rydman prices' currently being processed in parliament, namely the healthcare fee increases and new charges. In Finland, good health must not depend on the thickness of one's wallet.

q.o: Lisäksi nyt pitäisi saada perusturva kuntoon, palauttaa suojaosat ja lapsikorotukset sekä potkaista täysin pysähtynyt sosiaalinen asuinrakentaminen taas käyntiin, jotta ihmisillä on tulevaisuudessakin kohtuuhintaisia koteja.
q.t: In addition, basic security must now be fixed, protected portions and child supplements restored, and completely stalled social housing construction kicked back into action so that people will have affordable homes in the future as well.

ti: 5 uutta vaalikoordinaattoria aloitti vasemmistoliitossa
s: Left Alliance appointed five new electoral coordinators across Finland to prepare for the spring 2027 parliamentary elections, with coordinators assigned to Uusimaa, Pohjanmaa, Pohjois-Pohjanmaa, and Häme regions.

q.o: Eduskuntavaaleissa tavoittelemme vahvaa tulosta kaikkialla Suomessa. Uudet vaalikoordinaattorimme ovat tärkeässä roolissa siinä, että eri alueiden ehdokkaat, aktiivit ja vapaaehtoiset pääsevät tekemään yhdessä voittavaa kampanjaa
q.t: In the parliamentary elections we are aiming for a strong result everywhere in Finland. Our new electoral coordinators are in an important role in ensuring that candidates, activists and volunteers in different regions can work together on a winning campaign

ti: Aino-Kaisa Pekonen: Perussuomalaisten leikkauslista johtaisi tuhansien hoitajien ja opettajien irtisanomisiin
s: Left Alliance parliamentary group chair Aino-Kaisa Pekonen criticized the Finns Party's proposed cuts list, stating it would lead to thousands of layoffs among nurses and teachers and destroy welfare services.

q.o: Sakset kädessä tavallisille ihmisille virnuilevat perussuomalaiset ovat täällä taas. Tällä leikkauslistalla tuhottaisiin sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluita, leikeltäisiin turvaverkkoja rikki sekä pahennettaisiin työttömyyttä.
q.t: The Finns Party, grinning with scissors in hand at ordinary people, are here again. With this cuts list, social and health services would be destroyed, safety nets would be cut to pieces, and unemployment would be worsened.

q.o: Suomen työttömyys on jo nyt Euroopan korkein ja kasvaa yhä. Päälle perussuomalaisten leikkauslista johtaisi tuhansien hoitajien ja opettajien irtisanomisiin. Suomalaisen työntekijän kohtalo ei perussuomalaisia paljoa paina.
q.t: Finland's unemployment is already the highest in Europe and continues to grow. On top of that, the Finns Party's cuts list would lead to the dismissal of thousands of nurses and teachers. The fate of Finnish workers does not weigh heavily on the Finns Party.

q.o: Perussuomalaiset ovat valinneet puolensa ja se on rahaeliitin puoli, ei tavallisten suomalaisten.
q.t: The Finns Party has chosen its side and it is the side of the financial elite, not ordinary Finns.

ti: Pia Lohikoski: Nuorten uskon tulevaisuuteen voi palauttaa vain vastuullinen politiikka
s: Left Alliance MP Pia Lohikoski delivered a group speech in parliament criticizing the government's report on youth futures for ignoring climate crisis and imposing disproportionate cuts on young people, while proposing to reverse social security cuts, raise student grants, reject tuition fees, and guarantee work or study placements for unemployed youth.

q.o: En ihmettele, että nuoret ovat myös Suomessa pettyneitä politiikkaan. Nuoret ovat olleet tälle hallitukselle vain toistuvien leikkausten kohde. Toivon, että me havahdumme nuorten hätään.
q.t: I'm not surprised that young people in Finland are also disappointed in politics. Young people have been only the target of repeated cuts for this government. I hope that we wake up to the distress of young people.

q.o: Me vasemmistoliitossa haluamme vahvistaa nuorten toimeentuloa perumalla tehdyt sosiaaliturvaleikkaukset ja korottamalla opintorahaa. Sanomme jyrkästi ei koulutuksen maksullisuudelle ja vaadimme työ- tai opiskelupaikkaa jokaiselle kolme kuukautta työttömänä olleelle nuorelle.
q.t: We in the Left Alliance want to strengthen young people's livelihood by reversing the social security cuts that have been made and raising student grants. We say a firm no to tuition fees and demand a work or study placement for every young person who has been unemployed for three months.

q.o: Selonteko ei käsittele käytännössä lainkaan ympäristökriisiä eikä luontokatoa, eikä se mainitse ilmastonmuutosta kuin sivulauseessa.
q.t: The report does not practically address environmental crisis or biodiversity loss at all, and it mentions climate change only in a subordinate clause.

q.o: Nuorten tulevaisuususkon voi palauttaa vain vastuullinen politiikka, joka varmistaa, että vielä vuosikymmentenkin päästä on jäljellä elinkelpoinen planeetta – ja että on yhä mahdollista valita erilaisten tulevaisuuksien välillä.
q.t: Young people's faith in the future can only be restored by responsible politics that ensures that even decades from now there will be a viable planet left – and that it is still possible to choose between different futures.

ti: From seriousness to meme: PP, PSOE, the far-right Vox and Sumar take politics to TikTok while the pre-campaign turns 'trends' into an electoral weapon - El Constitucional
s: Spanish political parties including Vox, PP, PSOE, and Sumar are using TikTok as part of their pre-campaign strategies, turning social media trends into electoral tools.

ti: Abascal presents in Talavera the heads of the list of Vox for the elections of 29N - Demócrata
s: Santiago Abascal presented Vox's electoral list heads in Talavera for the 29 November elections.

ti: Sostegno allo sciopero del 30 ottobre
s: The Italian Communist Party announces support for a general strike called by USB union for October 30, 2026, against rearmament and the cost of living crisis.

q.o: Il Partito Comunista Italiano sostiene lo sciopero generale proclamato dalla Confederazione nazionale Unione Sindacale di Base – USB per il giorno di venerdì 30 ottobre CONTRO IL RIARMO E IL CAROVITA.
q.t: The Italian Communist Party supports the general strike proclaimed by the National Confederation Union Sindacale di Base – USB for Friday, October 30 AGAINST REARMAMENT AND THE COST OF LIVING.

q.o: È intollerabile che gli investimenti necessari al benessere dei cittadini e alla ricerca della Pace siano trasferiti al riarmo e alle guerre.
q.t: It is intolerable that the investments necessary for the well-being of citizens and the pursuit of Peace are transferred to rearmament and wars.

ti: Occupazione e Territorio: quale futuro per la provincia della Spezia?
s: The Italian Communist Party's La Spezia federation is organizing a public meeting on October 24, 2026 at 6pm to discuss employment, infrastructure, environment and services in La Spezia province, focusing on workers' needs and proposing sustainable development alternatives.

q.o: Quale futuro vogliamo per il nostro territorio? Quali prospettive per il lavoro, le infrastrutture, l'ambiente e i servizi?
q.t: What future do we want for our territory? What prospects for work, infrastructure, the environment and services?

q.o: Il lavoro, l'ambiente e i servizi pubblici devono tornare al centro delle scelte politiche. Non servono promesse, ma investimenti, programmazione e una visione di sviluppo che metta al primo posto gli interessi collettivi.
q.t: Work, the environment and public services must return to the center of political choices. We don't need promises, but investments, planning and a vision of development that puts collective interests first.

ti: Noi condanniamo la vostra violenza!
s: The Italian Communist Party issued a statement condemning systemic violence including government repression of protests, EU rearmament plans of 800 billion euros, workplace deaths, child poverty affecting 1.14 million minors, and complicity with Israel, while expressing solidarity with protesting youth and calling for a cooperative socialist system.

q.o: un milione e 140mila minori in Italia secondo dati ufficiali si trovano in famiglie in condizioni di povertà assoluta
q.t: one million and 140 thousand minors in Italy according to official data are in families in conditions of absolute poverty

q.o: i burocrati dell'Unione Europea che a Bruxelles, con il consenso dei partiti di governo in Italia e del PD, hanno varato un colossale Piano di riarmo di 800 miliardi, sottraendoli alla spesa sociale
q.t: the bureaucrats of the European Union who in Brussels, with the consent of the governing parties in Italy and the PD, have approved a colossal rearmament plan of 800 billion, taking them away from social spending

q.o: Il PCI è a fianco dei giovani che lottano per riconquistare il loro futuro, in Italia come in Albania, in Francia come in Spagna, in Palestina
q.t: The PCI stands alongside the young people who are fighting to reclaim their future, in Italy as in Albania, in France as in Spain, in Palestine

q.o: occorre battersi per un sistema nuovo, cooperativo e socialista
q.t: it is necessary to fight for a new system, cooperative and socialist

ti: L’Italia confermi all’ONU il suo sì all’abolizione del “BLOQUEO” USA contro Cuba
s: The Italian Communist Party announces its participation in solidarity demonstrations with Cuba organized in several Italian cities for October 27, 2026, on the eve of the UN General Assembly vote on ending the US embargo against Cuba, and calls on the Italian government to maintain its vote in favor of abolishing the blockade.

q.o: Il PCI aderisce ai presidi di solidarietà con Cuba organizzati in diverse città italiane per il 27 ottobre, vigilia del voto dell'Assemblea Generale ONU.
q.t: The PCI joins the solidarity demonstrations with Cuba organized in various Italian cities for October 27, on the eve of the UN General Assembly vote.

q.o: NO AL BLOCCO E ALL'ASSEDIO ENERGETICO CONTRO CUBA! AUTODETERMINAZIONE DEL POPOLO CUBANO SENZA INGERENZE ESTERNE!
q.t: NO TO THE BLOCKADE AND ENERGY SIEGE AGAINST CUBA! SELF-DETERMINATION OF THE CUBAN PEOPLE WITHOUT EXTERNAL INTERFERENCE!

q.o: Non è esclusa la possibilità che queste pressioni abbiano effetto sull'atteggiamento del governo italiano, prono da sempre a quello statunitense e impegnato in una politica internazionale che, in America Latina, sostiene governi di estrema destra come quello argentino di Milei
q.t: The possibility that these pressures may affect the attitude of the Italian government, always subservient to the American one and engaged in an international policy that, in Latin America, supports far-right governments such as the Argentine one of Milei, cannot be excluded

ti: Con il compagno Raul e la rivoluzione Cubana
s: The Italian Communist Party condemns the arrest warrant issued by Florida's attorney general against Raul Castro, expresses solidarity with Cuba and Venezuela, and calls for mobilization in Italy to defend the Cuban Revolution against what it characterizes as US aggression and economic blockade.

q.o: Il Partito Comunista Italiano condanna il mandato d'arresto contro il compagno Raul Castro per 'cospirazione finalizzata all'omicidio di primo grado', annunciato dal procuratore generale della Florida, James Uthmeier.
q.t: The Italian Communist Party condemns the arrest warrant against comrade Raul Castro for 'conspiracy to commit first-degree murder', announced by Florida's attorney general, James Uthmeier.

q.o: Il Partito Comunista Italiano ribadisce e sottolinea la sua profonda stima e ammirazione al compagno Raul Castro Ruz, colonna portante della lotta contro Batista, della guerriglia che portò al trionfo rivoluzionario del 1° gennaio 1959, della costruzione del socialismo a Cuba e della sua difesa contro l'imperialismo.
q.t: The Italian Communist Party reaffirms and emphasizes its profound esteem and admiration for comrade Raul Castro Ruz, a pillar of the struggle against Batista, of the guerrilla warfare that led to the revolutionary triumph of January 1, 1959, of the construction of socialism in Cuba and its defense against imperialism.

q.o: Esprime la sua disponibilità a promuovere e partecipare alle iniziative che, in Italia, verranno organizzate in difesa della Rivoluzione cubana e contro ogni tentativo di aggressione armata nei suoi confronti.
q.t: It expresses its willingness to promote and participate in initiatives that will be organized in Italy in defense of the Cuban Revolution and against any attempt at armed aggression against it.

ti: Il PCI oggi in piazza a Roma per “La via maestra, insieme per la costituzione”
s: The Italian Communist Party participated in a national demonstration in Rome called 'La Via Maestra – Insieme per la Costituzione' to defend the anti-fascist Constitution and demand full implementation of its principles regarding work, peace, environment, public welfare, and social rights.

q.o: La pace non è riarmo. Il lavoro non è sfruttamento. I diritti non sono privilegi. La Costituzione non si tocca: si attua!
q.t: Peace is not rearmament. Work is not exploitation. Rights are not privileges. The Constitution must not be touched: it must be implemented!

q.o: Siamo scesi in piazza per il lavoro, la pace, la tutela dell'ambiente, il welfare pubblico e i diritti sociali.
q.t: We took to the streets for work, peace, environmental protection, public welfare and social rights.

ti: Reform plan to 'bring back imperial measurements' as party announces list of pledges it says will create jobs - LBC
s: Reform UK announced a list of policy pledges including bringing back imperial measurements, which the party claims will create jobs.

ti: Reform vows to repeal leftover EU laws - The Telegraph
s: Reform UK has pledged to repeal remaining EU laws still in effect in the United Kingdom.

ti: Jackdaw is climate vandalism, say Greens
s: Green Party leader Zack Polanski condemned the Labour government's approval of the Jackdaw gas field as climate vandalism, stating it will not reduce energy bills and will create only 27 jobs.

q.o: This is climate vandalism. Today's decision by Labour is a betrayal of all of our futures, Labour has abandoned all credibility in the fight against climate change.
q.t: This is climate vandalism. Today's decision by Labour is a betrayal of all of our futures, Labour has abandoned all credibility in the fight against climate change.

q.o: The Energy Secretary has herself said it will make no difference to energy bills; the Health Secretary has admitted the summer heatwave added to pressure on the NHS, and the industry's own assessment is that it will create only 27 jobs.
q.t: The Energy Secretary has herself said it will make no difference to energy bills; the Health Secretary has admitted the summer heatwave added to pressure on the NHS, and the industry's own assessment is that it will create only 27 jobs.

q.o: This is a victory for Shell over the people.
q.t: This is a victory for Shell over the people.

ti: Polanski demands Labour ‘comes clean’ on impact from new drilling on NHS
s: Green Party leader Zack Polanski demanded Labour publish NHS impact assessments for North Sea drilling decisions on Jackdaw and Rosebank fields, while MP Carla Denyer submitted a written Parliamentary question on health impacts of drilling emissions.

q.o: Approval of new North Sea drilling wouldn't take a penny off energy bills, according to the Energy Secretary herself, who has also said that, 'to have a shot at staying within 1.5C global warming, we can't have any new oil or gas fields!' I agree with the Energy Secretary and now we have the Health Secretary admitting that the summer heatwaves added to more pressure on an already under pressure NHS.
I am calling today on Labour to come clean and make available any impact assessments for the health service on their expected decision this week to approve new drilling in the North Sea.

ti: New Green Party transport policy aims for 75% cut in carbon emissions within ten years
s: The Green Party of England and Wales approved a revised transport policy at its Autumn Conference proposing a 75% reduction in carbon emissions within ten years through measures including a 50% increase in rail travel, making half of urban journeys active travel within five years, opposing new road building, and targeting private jets and frequent flyers.

q.o: For too long transport policy has focused on moving vehicles rather than enabling people to get where they need to go. Our new policy is about giving everyone genuine choices – reliable and affordable public transport, safe walking, wheeling and cycling, and communities where owning a car isn't a prerequisite for participating fully in society.
q.t: For too long transport policy has focused on moving vehicles rather than enabling people to get where they need to go. Our new policy is about giving everyone genuine choices – reliable and affordable public transport, safe walking, wheeling and cycling, and communities where owning a car isn't a prerequisite for participating fully in society.

q.o: We also need to tackle transport's contribution to the climate crisis in an equitable and fair way. That means providing attractive alternatives to car and air travel, moving more freight onto rail and electrification. Those responsible for the most polluting and unnecessary journeys, including users of private jets and frequent flyers, will make the greatest contribution.
q.t: We also need to tackle transport's contribution to the climate crisis in an equitable and fair way. That means providing attractive alternatives to car and air travel, moving more freight onto rail and electrification. Those responsible for the most polluting and unnecessary journeys, including users of private jets and frequent flyers, will make the greatest contribution.

q.o: We have worked hard with an expert team of professionals and academics to revise our policy. It sets out measures to achieve a 75% reduction in transport carbon emissions within ten years, while making it easier for people and businesses to choose cleaner and healthier alternatives, which will improve not just transport but wider society.
q.t: We have worked hard with an expert team of professionals and academics to revise our policy. It sets out measures to achieve a 75% reduction in transport carbon emissions within ten years, while making it easier for people and businesses to choose cleaner and healthier alternatives, which will improve not just transport but wider society.
