ti: Συνάντηση Γενικού Γραμματέα ΑΚΕΛ, Στέφανου Στεφάνου με στελέχη και φίλους του ΑΚΕΛ που υπηρέτησαν σε δημόσια αξιώματα
s: AKEL General Secretary Stefanos Stefanou met with party members and friends who served in public office to discuss upcoming presidential elections and the goal of achieving progressive change in Cyprus.

q.o: Σε αυτή τη συνάντηση ανοίξαμε έναν διάλογο αναφορικά με τις εξελίξεις στην Κύπρο και πολύ περισσότερο, ανοίξαμε μια συζήτηση αναφορικά με τις επερχόμενες προεδρικές εκλογές και την ανάγκη που υπάρχει και τον στόχο που έχουμε θέσει για να πετύχουμε την προοδευτική αλλαγή στον τόπο.
q.t: In this meeting we opened a dialogue regarding developments in Cyprus and much more, we opened a discussion regarding the upcoming presidential elections and the need that exists and the goal we have set to achieve progressive change in the country.

q.o: Η προοδευτική αλλαγή στον τόπο έχει περιεχόμενο. Και αυτό το περιεχόμενο ξεκινά από τον τερματισμό αυτών των πολιτικών που εφαρμόζονται τα τελευταία χρόνια και έχουν οδηγήσει στην όξυνση των ανισοτήτων, στη μεγέθυνση των κοινωνικών προβλημάτων αλλά και σε μεγάλα ελλείμματα σε ό,τι αφορά την κοινωνική πολιτική.
q.t: Progressive change in the country has content. And this content starts from ending these policies that have been implemented in recent years and have led to the sharpening of inequalities, the magnification of social problems and also to major deficits regarding social policy.

ti: Το ΑΚΕΛ στηρίζει τις διεκδικήσεις των εργαζομένων στις ΥΚΕ
s: AKEL expresses support for striking Social Welfare Services workers and calls on the government to address chronic understaffing, overwork, and the delayed reorganization promised since 2019 by the Anastasiades and Christodoulides governments.

q.o: Το ΑΚΕΛ εκφράζει την στήριξή του στις διεκδικήσεις των εργαζομένων στις ΥΚΕ και καλεί την κυβέρνηση και το Υφυπουργείο να συνειδητοποιήσουν το τέλμα στο οποίο βρίσκονται οι ΥΚΕ και να αναλάβουν τις ευθύνες τους.
q.t: AKEL expresses its support for the demands of the workers in the Social Welfare Services and calls on the government and the Deputy Ministry to realize the impasse in which the Social Welfare Services find themselves and to assume their responsibilities.

q.o: Η γενίκευση της πρακτική της αγοράς υπηρεσιών, όχι μόνο δεν λύνει προβλήματα, αλλά επηρεάζει την ποιότητα και αποτελεσματικότητα των υπηρεσιών ενώ στην ουσία, συνιστά σταδιακή ιδιωτικοποίηση του κοινωνικού κράτους.
q.t: The generalization of the practice of purchasing services not only does not solve problems, but affects the quality and effectiveness of services while in essence, it constitutes a gradual privatization of the welfare state.

ti: Επιδεικτική και εγκληματική η αδράνεια του ΥΠΑΝ
s: AKEL issued a statement supporting striking workers in Ministry of Education support programs who have been without income since May, demanding the government provide comprehensive solutions for summer income restoration and adequate staffing with fixed-term contracts.

q.o: Το ΑΚΕΛ συμπαραστέκεται στον αγώνα των εργαζομένων στα υποστηρικτικά προγράμματα του Υπουργείου Παιδείας, Αθλητισμού και Νεολαίας, οι οποίοι πραγματοποιούν σήμερα παγκύπρια απεργιακή κινητοποίηση, διεκδικώντας τα δίκαια αιτήματά τους.
q.t: AKEL stands in solidarity with the struggle of workers in the support programs of the Ministry of Education, Sports and Youth, who are carrying out a Cyprus-wide strike mobilization today, demanding their just demands.

q.o: Εκατοντάδες εργαζόμενοι και οι οικογένειες τους παραμένουν χωρίς εισόδημα από τον περασμένο Μάιο, ενώ άλλοι έχουν οδηγηθεί στην ανεργία, την ώρα που το Υπουργείο αποφεύγει επιδεικτικά τη λήψη διορθωτικών αποφάσεων.
q.t: Hundreds of workers and their families remain without income since last May, while others have been driven to unemployment, at a time when the Ministry ostentatiously avoids taking corrective decisions.

ti: Νομοθετικές πρωτοβουλίες του ΑΚΕΛ για μείωση του κόστους ηλεκτρισμού
s: AKEL submitted three legislative proposals to the House of Representatives concerning the electricity market, aiming to recover excess profits from electricity producers, introduce competitive tenders for renewable energy projects, and limit the hoarding of renewable energy permits.

q.o: Κατατέθηκαν χθες ενώπιον της Ολομέλειας της Βουλής τρεις νέες προτάσεις νόμου του ΑΚΕΛ που αφορούν την αγορά ηλεκτρισμού, με στόχο την αντιμετώπιση των στρεβλώσεων, τον περιορισμό της αισχροκέρδειας και τη μείωση του κόστους ηλεκτρικής ενέργειας.
q.t: Three new legislative proposals by AKEL concerning the electricity market were submitted yesterday before the House Plenary, aiming to address distortions, limit profiteering, and reduce the cost of electricity.

q.o: Προσβλέπουμε σε μια εποικοδομητική συζήτηση και θετική κατάληξη, ώστε η φθηνότερη παραγωγή ενέργειας από τις ΑΠΕ να μεταφράζεται επιτέλους σε φθηνότερο ηλεκτρισμό για τα νοικοκυριά και τις επιχειρήσεις.
q.t: We look forward to a constructive discussion and positive outcome, so that cheaper energy production from renewable sources finally translates into cheaper electricity for households and businesses.

ti: Ο μέσος μισθός ανεβαίνει, αλλά για χιλιάδες εργαζόμενους ο μήνας δεν βγαίνει
s: AKEL calls for substantial minimum wage increases indexed to inflation, expansion of collective bargaining coverage through pending legislation per EU directive, mandatory application of sectoral agreements, and requirement that state subsidies and public contracts enforce collective agreements, arguing that median wages of €1,953 leave thousands of workers unable to meet basic costs.

q.o: Το ΑΚΕΛ επιμένει στην ουσιαστική αύξηση του κατώτατου μισθού, ώστε να ανταποκρίνεται στο πραγματικό κόστος ζωής, στην ετήσια αναπροσαρμογή του με βάση την ΑΤΑ και στον καθορισμό της ωριαίας απόδοσής του.
q.t: AKEL insists on a substantial increase of the minimum wage, so that it corresponds to the real cost of living, on its annual adjustment based on the CPI and on the determination of its hourly rate.

q.o: Γι' αυτό επιβάλλεται η κυβέρνηση να προχωρήσει χωρίς άλλη καθυστέρηση στην κατάθεση του νομοσχεδίου για την αύξηση του αριθμού των εργαζομένων που καλύπτονται από Συλλογικές Συμβάσεις Εργασίας, όπως προνοεί άλλωστε και η σχετική Ευρωπαϊκή Οδηγία.
q.t: For this reason, the government must proceed without further delay to submit the bill to increase the number of workers covered by Collective Labor Agreements, as provided for by the relevant European Directive.

q.o: Όπου το κράτος παραχωρεί επιδοτήσεις ή αναθέτει δημόσια έργα και συμβάσεις, πρέπει να απαιτεί την εφαρμογή των αντίστοιχων Συλλογικών Συμβάσεων Εργασίας.
q.t: Where the state grants subsidies or awards public works and contracts, it must require the application of the corresponding Collective Labor Agreements.

ti: Αγορά κυπριακής γης από ξένα συμφέροντα: Ώρα για κανόνες και περιορισμούς
s: AKEL MP Aristos Damianou announced that the Parliamentary Interior Committee has restarted discussions on regulating foreign acquisition of Cypriot land, with the party pushing for legislation by year-end that would cover not only individuals but also companies and funds purchasing property.

q.o: Σήμερα στην Επιτροπή Εσωτερικών επανεκκίνησαμε η συζήτηση ενός πολύ σοβαρού ζητήματος, που άπτεται και της κρατικής ασφάλειας και της οικονομίας, αλλά και του μέλλοντος αυτού του τόπου. Αυτό της απόκτησης ακίνητης ιδιοκτησίας, κυπριακής γης, από ξένα συμφέροντα.
q.t: Today in the Interior Committee we restarted the discussion of a very serious issue, which concerns state security and the economy, but also the future of this country. That of the acquisition of immovable property, Cypriot land, by foreign interests.

q.o: Είναι η θέση μας, και είναι κατηγορηματική, ότι αν δεν ρυθμιστούν και τα θέματα των φυσικών προσώπων, των εταιρειών και των ταμείων και όλων εκείνων οι οποίοι με συγκαλυμμένο τρόπο αγοράζουν στην Κύπρο, τότε η ρύθμιση μόνο των φυσικών προσώπων θα είναι ελλειμματική.
q.t: It is our position, and it is categorical, that if the issues of natural persons, companies and funds and all those who buy in Cyprus in a concealed manner are not regulated, then the regulation of only natural persons will be deficient.

q.o: Άρα, πρόθεσή μας είναι, με την αίσθηση του κατεπείγοντος, να προχωρήσουμε, γιατί σε αυτά τα ζητήματα δεν υπάρχει πλέον δυνατότητα για περαιτέρω χρονοτριβή.
q.t: Therefore, our intention is, with a sense of urgency, to proceed, because on these issues there is no longer any possibility for further delay.

ti: Ανακοίνωση ΑΚΕΛ για το παράνομο τουρκολυβικό μνημόνιο
s: AKEL issued a statement condemning the Turkish-Libyan maritime memorandum of understanding as illegal and void, stating it violates international law and the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea, as well as the rights of third states including Greece regarding island maritime zones.

q.o: το εν λόγω μνημόνιο είναι παράνομο, καταδικαστέο και νομικά άκυρο
q.t: the memorandum in question is illegal, condemnable and legally void

q.o: Πρόκειται για ένα μνημόνιο που παραβιάζει κατάφωρα το Διεθνές Δίκαιο και συγκεκριμένα τη Σύμβαση των Ηνωμένων Εθνών για το Δίκαιο της Θάλασσας
q.t: This is a memorandum that blatantly violates International Law and specifically the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea

q.o: Η οριοθέτηση θαλάσσιων ζωνών πρέπει να πραγματοποιείται στη βάση του Διεθνούς Δικαίου, με την εμπλοκή και συνεννόηση όλων των εμπλεκόμενων και επηρεαζόμενων κρατών
q.t: The delimitation of maritime zones must be carried out on the basis of International Law, with the involvement and understanding of all involved and affected states

ti: Vil ha garanti for utbygging
s: Progress Party MP Kristoffer Sivertsen demands a guarantee for development of the disputed Wisting oil field to protect Norwegian shipyard and coastal industry jobs.

q.o: Dersom vi fjerner det store prosjektet som nå ligger i lupen, vil det ha katastrofale konsekvenser for verftsnæringen i Norge
q.t: If we remove the large project that is now under scrutiny, it will have catastrophic consequences for the shipyard industry in Norway

q.o: Det handler om at folk langs kysten skal ha en jobb å gå til. De skal bruke Wisting som en katalysator for å jobbe oss videre nordover med olje- og gassleting
q.t: It is about people along the coast having a job to go to. They should use Wisting as a catalyst to work our way further north with oil and gas exploration

ti: Skuffende og arrogant
s: Progress Party MP Martin Jonsterhaug criticizes Finance Minister Jens Stoltenberg for not implementing Parliament's decision to abolish the norm price council for aquaculture and expects the Centre Party to ensure compliance through budget negotiations.

q.o: Jeg forventer at Sp nå kjenner sin besøkelsestid og gjennom budsjettforhandlingene sørger for at regjeringen følger opp Stortingets vedtak
q.t: I expect that Sp now recognizes its moment of reckoning and through the budget negotiations ensures that the government follows up on Parliament's decision

ti: Grillet samferdselsministeren med 24 spørsmål
s: Progress Party representatives posed 24 questions about various road projects to the transport minister during Wednesday's question time in parliament.

ti: – AUF har lenge ligget i en solidaritetsnarkose
s: Progress Party Youth leader Sebastian Saltrø Ytrevik criticized AUF and the Labour Party for ignoring warnings about clan culture infiltrating public institutions, citing Swedish developments as a warning for Norway.

q.o: AUF har lenge ligget i en solidaritetsnarkose som det ikke ser ut som de kommer ut av
q.t: AUF has long been in a solidarity narcosis that they do not seem to be coming out of

q.o: Det er også et problem som vi advarer mot nå, som vi er nødt til å se på. Dessverre møter vi nok en gang lukkede dører fra venstresiden og Arbeiderpartiet. Det er naivt å tro at det som skjer i Sverige nå ikke kommer til å skje i Norge
q.t: This is also a problem that we are warning against now, which we must look at. Unfortunately, we once again meet closed doors from the left side and the Labour Party. It is naive to believe that what is happening in Sweden now will not happen in Norway

ti: FrP vil stille strengere krav til datasentre: – Det viktigste må få strøm først
s: Progress Party proposes stricter requirements for data centres in Norway, including national control over expansion, changes to electricity queue priority favouring Norwegian jobs, households and critical infrastructure, and requirements for new power production.

q.o: Det viktigste må få strøm først
q.t: The most important must get electricity first

ti: Det viktigste må få strøm først
s: Progress Party proposes greater national control over data centre expansion and requirements for new power, replacement power, or emergency power capacity.

q.o: Vi må ha datasentre. De er en del av vår kritiske infrastruktur, og hvis Norge skal få økonomisk vekst, så vil mye være drevet av AI. Samtidig er vi nødt til å skaffe oss kontroll på utbyggingen
q.t: We must have data centres. They are part of our critical infrastructure, and if Norway is to have economic growth, much will be driven by AI. At the same time, we need to gain control over the expansion

ti: Krever svar om Ringeriksbanen
s: Progress Party MP Morten Wold demands answers from the new transport minister about the Ringerike Railway after the government budget proposal allocated no funds for further planning of the Ringerike Railway/New Bergen Railway and new E16 to Hønefoss.

q.o: Jeg har gang på gang forsøkt å få tidligere samferdselsminister Jon-Ivar Nygård (Ap) til å få fortgang på videre framdrift rundt Ringeriksbanen/FRE16, eller Bergensbanans forkortelse som vi også kaller det, men Nygård og Ap har aldri hatt noe ønske om å realisere prosjektet. Derfor prøver jeg nå å få svar fra den nye samferdselsministeren.
q.t: I have repeatedly tried to get the former transport minister Jon-Ivar Nygård (Labour Party) to make progress on further advancement around the Ringerike Railway/FRE16, or the Bergen Railway shortcut as we also call it, but Nygård and Labour have never had any desire to realize the project. Therefore I am now trying to get answers from the new transport minister.

ti: Vil heller styrke ordningen
s: Progress Party MP Julia Brännström Nordtug opposes the government's proposal to reduce the number of activity aids available to people over 26 with disabilities, proposing instead to strengthen the scheme with a scaling-up plan and a return or deposit system for unused aids.

q.o: Dette handler om voksne mennesker som vil komme seg ut. Det er foreldre som vil følge barna sine på skitur om vinteren, og på sykkeltur om sommeren. Det må de få lov til
q.t: This is about adults who want to get out. There are parents who want to accompany their children on ski trips in winter, and on bike trips in summer. They must be allowed to do that

q.o: Vi kommer ikke til å støtte regjeringens forslag på dette. Vi vil heller se på muligheter for å innføre en returordning eller en panteordning, som kan sørge for at vi får tak i de hjelpemidlene som ligger og støver bort, men som kan være til nytte for andre
q.t: We will not support the government's proposal on this. We would rather look at opportunities to introduce a return scheme or a deposit scheme, which can ensure that we get hold of the aids that are gathering dust, but which can be useful for others

ti: Cllr Conor Reddy Condemns Dubliner Ian Hutcheson’s Arrest and Detention by Israelis in the West Bank
s: People Before Profit councillor Conor Reddy condemned the arrest and detention of Dublin resident Ian Hutcheson by Israeli authorities in the West Bank, while TD Paul Murphy called for comprehensive sanctions against Israel and criticized the government for weakening the Occupied Territories Bill.

q.o: Each year, international volunteers travel to Palestine to provide international solidarity and act as observers as Palestinian farmers face harassment and attack by Israeli settlers and the Israeli authorities during the harvest season. Israeli settlers have carried out over 600 attacks in the West Bank since late September, including stealing olives and crops and cutting down and burning trees.

It is outrageous that Ian went to the West Bank to offer support and protection to Palestinians as they harvested their crops, and for this he was arrested and detained and appears set to be deported.

The Government gutted the Occupied Territories Bill of meaningful impact, and in May it defeated our Sanctions Against the State of Israel Bill. That has meant Israel remains confident that it can get away with genocide in Gaza and escalating violence in the West Bank.
The Government must finally do the only thing that will stop Israel, impose comprehensive sanctions to force an end to its violence and crimes of genocide and apartheid.

ti: Harkin: Home Care Workers Can No Longer be Ignored
s: People Before Profit Councillor Shaun Harkin spoke at a Unison meeting supporting home care workers, criticizing Stormont for allowing corporate exploitation in the private home care industry and calling on workers to join trade unions rather than wait for government action.

q.o: Low wages, wage theft, and a complete lack of basic rights and fair treatment are rife across the private home care industry.
q.t: Low wages, wage theft, and a complete lack of basic rights and fair treatment are rife across the private home care industry.

q.o: It is no lie to say Stormont MLAs have turned over home care to corporate profiteers who pay bare minimum wages and mileage rates, and who then use loopholes to get out of paying workers what they're even legally entitled to.
q.t: It is no lie to say Stormont MLAs have turned over home care to corporate profiteers who pay bare minimum wages and mileage rates, and who then use loopholes to get out of paying workers what they're even legally entitled to.

q.o: Workers should not wait on Stormont because that could be forever; it's a government for corporate sweaters, bankers, landlords, polluters, and warmongers, not for workers and the working-class.
q.t: Workers should not wait on Stormont because that could be forever; it's a government for corporate sweaters, bankers, landlords, polluters, and warmongers, not for workers and the working-class.

ti: Richard Boyd Barrett Seeks Dáil Debate on Withdrawal of Sally Rooney’s Books From Sale In Britain
s: Richard Boyd Barrett TD requested Dáil debate time on the withdrawal of Sally Rooney's books from sale in Britain, expressing concern about restrictions on free speech regarding Palestine, and announced he is drafting a cross-party motion of support for Rooney.

q.o: The withdrawal of Sally Rooney's books from sale in Britain is an alarming development. It means the definition of terrorism has now been extended to encompass the expression of support for Palestine.
q.t: The withdrawal of Sally Rooney's books from sale in Britain is an alarming development. It means the definition of terrorism has now been extended to encompass the expression of support for Palestine.

q.o: We are in dangerous territory when books are being removed from shelves because the author has expressed support for the people of Palestine and opposition to the genocide in Gaza. This has very serious implications for freedom of artistic expression and freedom of speech.
q.t: We are in dangerous territory when books are being removed from shelves because the author has expressed support for the people of Palestine and opposition to the genocide in Gaza. This has very serious implications for freedom of artistic expression and freedom of speech.

q.o: We are currently drafting a motion of support for Sally that I will circulate to all TDs, and I hope that the motion will get the support of all parties, including government parties.
q.t: We are currently drafting a motion of support for Sally that I will circulate to all TDs, and I hope that the motion will get the support of all parties, including government parties.

ti: Harkin: Council Motion Stands with Sally Rooney Against Hypocritical British Government Repression
s: People Before Profit Councillor Shaun Harkin submitted a motion to Derry City and Strabane District Council expressing solidarity with writer Sally Rooney against British government repression related to her support for Palestine Action, calling for an end to criminalisation of Palestine solidarity campaigners.

q.o: We salute Sally Rooney for taking a resolute stand against Israel's genocidal war on Palestine. Rooney's stand in solidarity with Palestine Action has exposed the pro-Israel hypocrisy of the British government and its continued attempt to criminalise opposition to genocide.
q.t: We salute Sally Rooney for taking a resolute stand against Israel's genocidal war on Palestine. Rooney's stand in solidarity with Palestine Action has exposed the pro-Israel hypocrisy of the British government and its continued attempt to criminalise opposition to genocide.

q.o: We need to take a stand against what's happening to Rooney. Our motion calls on the Council to stand in solidarity with Sally Rooney against the British government and oppose her criminalisation.
q.t: We need to take a stand against what's happening to Rooney. Our motion calls on the Council to stand in solidarity with Sally Rooney against the British government and oppose her criminalisation.

q.o: It's time for the British state to end its support for Israel and for charges against Palestine solidarity campaigners to be dropped. No one is free while Palestinians are denied freedom.
q.t: It's time for the British state to end its support for Israel and for charges against Palestine solidarity campaigners to be dropped. No one is free while Palestinians are denied freedom.

ti: Harkin: DUP Incitement of Sectarian Tensions Must be Challenged
s: People Before Profit Councillor Shaun Harkin condemned sectarian attacks and accused the DUP of inciting sectarian and racist tensions while deflecting from Stormont austerity policies, calling for working-class unity around demands for healthcare funding, opposition to cuts, and anti-poverty measures.

q.o: Disgraceful sectarian attacks on young people in any part of the city are deplorable and should be condemned, discouraged and acted on. What's happening on our streets and in our communities can't be separated from Stormont toxicity and austerity.
q.t: Disgraceful sectarian attacks on young people in any part of the city are deplorable and should be condemned, discouraged and acted on. What's happening on our streets and in our communities can't be separated from Stormont toxicity and austerity.

q.o: The DUP can call on everyone who is 'peace loving' to get along but it has been in overdrive to whip-up sectarian and racist tensions. This hypocrisy needs to be challenged.
q.t: The DUP can call on everyone who is 'peace loving' to get along but it has been in overdrive to whip-up sectarian and racist tensions. This hypocrisy needs to be challenged.

q.o: It's urgent to push back against sectarian and racist incitement by backing demands on Stormont for healthcare workers pay justice, stopping atrocious health service cuts, stopping public transport cuts and fare hikes, ending child hunger at school, opposing the Ulster University jobs cull and challenging handouts for powerful and profitable corporations when working-class households are told there's no cost-of-living support available.
q.t: It's urgent to push back against sectarian and racist incitement by backing demands on Stormont for healthcare workers pay justice, stopping atrocious health service cuts, stopping public transport cuts and fare hikes, ending child hunger at school, opposing the Ulster University jobs cull and challenging handouts for powerful and profitable corporations when working-class households are told there's no cost-of-living support available.

ti: Carroll: “Garvaghy Shows What Working Class People can win together”
s: People Before Profit MLA Gerry Carroll hosted a public meeting on 21 October 2026 examining the Garvaghy Road dispute, where a community blocked an Orange march despite official approval, with Carroll framing it as working-class solidarity against sectarian division.

q.o: A month ago, the Parades Commission, the courts and the British state all lined up behind an Orange march down the Garvaghy Road. It never happened because a working class community said no and held its ground. Thousands came from across Ireland to stand with them.
q.t: A month ago, the Parades Commission, the courts and the British state all lined up behind an Orange march down the Garvaghy Road. It never happened because a working class community said no and held its ground. Thousands came from across Ireland to stand with them.

q.o: Unionist elites have nothing to offer working class communities but division. Garvaghy showed the alternative: when people organise together, they win. That's the foundation of the new Ireland we need, built by and for working people - not one carved up between orange and green elites.
q.t: Unionist elites have nothing to offer working class communities but division. Garvaghy showed the alternative: when people organise together, they win. That's the foundation of the new Ireland we need, built by and for working people - not one carved up between orange and green elites.

ti: Zohran Mamdani Mayoral Campaign Organiser to address Derry Public Meeting
s: People Before Profit is hosting a public meeting in Derry on 21 October featuring Emma Bally, a coordinator from Zohran Mamdani's New York mayoral campaign, to discuss lessons from the socialist candidate's election victory.

q.o: We're looking forward to hearing from Emma and the work of Democratic Socialist of American members in the Zohran Mamdani campaign. Mamdani's mayoral victory has created hope across the United States and internationally that change is possible. In a highly contested election, New Yorkers choose the pro-Palestine, pro-migrant, pro-right to choose, socialist candidate championing working-class demands, opposition to fascism and war. There are lessons for socialists, trade union activists and progressives in Ireland from the Mamdani campaign and the explosive growth of the socialist movement in the US. Mamdani is Mayor of the city that hosts Wall Street and many of the wealthiest people and corporations in the world. They will not want Mamdani to succeed or for a socialist progressive challenge to the Republican and Democratic Party to emerge.
q.t: We're looking forward to hearing from Emma and the work of Democratic Socialist of American members in the Zohran Mamdani campaign. Mamdani is Mayor of the city that hosts Wall Street and many of the wealthiest people and corporations in the world. They will not want Mamdani to succeed or for a socialist progressive challenge to the Republican and Democratic Party to emerge.

ti: Government Denying Proper "End Triple Lock" Dáil Debate
s: People Before Profit TDs condemned the government's decision to limit debate on the Defence (Amendment) Bill 2026 ending the Triple Lock to 3.5 hours on Wednesday, opposed the time guillotine at an Oireachtas Business Committee meeting, and called for a referendum on neutrality and the triple lock.

q.o: News that the Government will limit the debate on their legislation to end the Triple Lock confirms that Fianna Fáil and Fine Gael remain determined to dismantle our neutrality and align us ever more closely to the project of European militarisation and to NATO.
q.t: News that the Government will limit the debate on their legislation to end the Triple Lock confirms that Fianna Fáil and Fine Gael remain determined to dismantle our neutrality and align us ever more closely to the project of European militarisation and to NATO.

q.o: At an Oireachtas Business Committee meeting this morning I opposed the 'guillotine' to limit Wednesday's debate, but the Government would not agree to give additional time for an adequate debate on this defining issue.
q.t: At an Oireachtas Business Committee meeting this morning I opposed the 'guillotine' to limit Wednesday's debate, but the Government would not agree to give additional time for an adequate debate on this defining issue.

q.o: The Government has no mandate to end the triple lock. On the contrary, Catherine Connolly made opposition to militarisation and defence of the triple lock central to her presidential election campaign, a position that was key to her emphatic win.
q.t: The Government has no mandate to end the triple lock. On the contrary, Catherine Connolly made opposition to militarisation and defence of the triple lock central to her presidential election campaign, a position that was key to her emphatic win.

q.o: The Government should stop lying to people about what they are doing and why they are doing it. Let the people decide, through a referendum, on the future of our neutrality and the triple lock.
q.t: The Government should stop lying to people about what they are doing and why they are doing it. Let the people decide, through a referendum, on the future of our neutrality and the triple lock.

ti: Καταδικάζουμε τη σφαγή σε Ελληνορθόδοξη εκκλησία στην Ιορδανία
s: The National Popular Front condemned an armed attack on a Greek Orthodox church in Jordan that killed at least seven people and wounded over thirty, demanding the Cypriot Republic take necessary actions to condemn the massacre and calling for zero tolerance toward terrorism against Orthodox Christians and other minorities.

q.o: Καταδικάζουμε την αισχρή ένοπλη επίθεση σε Ελληνορθόδοξη εκκλησία στην Ιορδανία, από την οποία τουλάχιστον επτά άνθρωποι σκοτώθηκαν και περισσότεροι από τριάντα τραυματίστηκαν.
q.t: We condemn the shameful armed attack on a Greek Orthodox church in Jordan, from which at least seven people were killed and more than thirty were injured.

q.o: Απαιτούμε από την Κυπριακή Δημοκρατία να προβεί στις απαραίτητες ενέργειες για την καταδίκη της απάνθρωπης σφαγής.
q.t: We demand that the Cypriot Republic take the necessary actions to condemn the inhuman massacre.

q.o: Καμία ανοχή στην τρομοκρατία. Καμία ανοχή στις θηριωδίες εις βάρος Ορθόδοξων χριστιανών και άλλων μειονοτήτων.
q.t: No tolerance for terrorism. No tolerance for atrocities against Orthodox Christians and other minorities.

ti: Α. Παπαχαραλάμπους: «Να θεσπιστεί πλαίσιο για την αγορά γης από υπηκόους τρίτων χωρών»
s: ELAM MP Andreas Papacharalampous called for a regulatory framework to govern land purchases by third-country nationals, proposing restrictions in sensitive areas such as military bases and agricultural land while not seeking to ban foreign investment entirely.

q.o: το θέμα που προκύπτει με την αγορά γης από υπηκόους τρίτων χωρών μας ανησυχεί ιδιαίτερα και πρέπει να τεθεί σε ένα συγκεκριμένο πλαίσιο
q.t: the issue arising with land purchases by third-country nationals concerns us particularly and must be placed within a specific framework

q.o: δεν επιδιώκουμε την απαγόρευση των ξένων επενδύσεων
q.t: we are not seeking to ban foreign investments

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: PCP Secretary-General Paulo Raimundo condemned government housing policies and announced the party will propose measures in the state budget to regulate and lower rents, guarantee 10-year rental contracts, invest 1% of GDP annually in public construction, lower banking spreads and commissions, strengthen housing cooperatives, and reform land laws.

q.o: É justa a indignação, o protesto e a rejeição expressa na manifestação da CGTP do passado sábado e nas acções que, em particular em Lisboa e no Porto. se desenvolveram nos últimos dias, de uma política que medida após medida de forma evidente nega o direito à habitação.
q.t: The indignation, protest and rejection expressed in the CGTP demonstration last Saturday and in the actions that have taken place in recent days, particularly in Lisbon and Porto, against a policy that measure after measure clearly denies the right to housing, is justified.

q.o: PSD, CDS, Chega e IL, porta-vozes dos fundos imobiliários e testas de ferro da especulação e dos especuladores querem agora dar ainda mais poder à grande propriedade, querem acelerar ainda mais os despejos, querem aumentar ainda mais as rendas
q.t: PSD, CDS, Chega and IL, spokespersons for real estate funds and front men for speculation and speculators, now want to give even more power to large property owners, want to accelerate evictions even more, want to increase rents even more

q.o: O PCP não desperdiçará nenhuma possibilidade – desde já no quadro do OE e de outros instrumentos legislativos – de voltar a propor medidas que: regulem e façam baixar as rendas, garantam a estabilidade dos contratos (10 anos), promovam a construção pública (1%do PIB em média por ano)
q.t: The PCP will not waste any opportunity – starting with the state budget framework and other legislative instruments – to propose again measures that: regulate and lower rents, guarantee contract stability (10 years), promote public construction (1% of GDP on average per year)

s: The Portuguese Communist Party issued a press office statement condemning the privatization of TAP airline to Lufthansa, alleging that the sale constitutes an economic crime and demanding urgent government clarifications on contract details, maintenance operations transfer, and potential EU restrictions.

q.o: A cada dia que passa somam-se preocupações com o crime económico que constitui a entrega da maior empresa nacional aos alemães da Lufthansa.
q.t: With each passing day, concerns grow about the economic crime that constitutes handing over the largest national company to the Germans of Lufthansa.

q.t: the money that the private parties will pay for it is already there

q.o: foi a primeira vez que comprámos uma companhia a dar lucro
q.t: it was the first time we bought a company making a profit

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: PCP Secretary-General Paulo Raimundo announced at a press conference following the Central Committee meeting of October 18-19, 2026, that the party will launch a national campaign in early November under the slogan "Children and Parents with rights. Portugal with future" and outlined policy proposals including ten-year rental contracts, 1% GDP investment in public housing, raising minimum wage to 1100 euros, and increasing all pensions by 80 euros.

q.o: É urgente travar a política injusta e promotora das desigualdades que condena a maioria às dificuldades ao mesmo tempo que é o garante da concentração da riqueza nas mãos dos que se acham donos disto tudo.
q.t: It is urgent to stop the unjust policy that promotes inequalities, which condemns the majority to difficulties while guaranteeing the concentration of wealth in the hands of those who think they own everything.

q.o: O Comité Central do PCP decidiu, no seguimento de uma linha de trabalho da maior importância, levar por diante a partir de inicio de Novembro uma acção com expressão nacional sob o lema "Crianças e Pais com direitos. Portugal com futuro", uma prioridade de intervenção que o PCP assume.
q.t: The PCP Central Committee decided, following a line of work of the greatest importance, to carry forward from the beginning of November a national action under the slogan "Children and Parents with rights. Portugal with future", a priority intervention that the PCP assumes.

ti: Tannhelsereformen: Får nye rødgrønne ben å gå på!
s: The Socialist Left Party (SV) announces that a comprehensive dental health reform proposal is being put out for consultation, building on five years of budget negotiations with Labour and Centre parties that have already given over 550,000 Norwegians cheaper dental care, with the proposal including free necessary orthodontics for children and phased expansion of dental rights starting with younger age groups.

q.o: For SV har det lenge vært klart at tennene er en del av kroppen, da skal ikke ommeboka avgjøre om du får den helsehjelpa du trenger.
q.t: For SV it has long been clear that teeth are part of the body, so the wallet should not determine whether you get the healthcare you need.

q.o: Dette har vi kjempa for siden 2004, og endelig sier flertallet at det ikke lenger skal koste mer å gå til tannlegen enn til legen
q.t: We have fought for this since 2004, and finally the majority says it should no longer cost more to go to the dentist than to the doctor

q.o: Jeg er veldig glad for at vi har fått det inn i forslaget og vi legger pengene for å få det til på forhandlingsbordet i høst
q.t: I am very happy that we have got it into the proposal and we are putting the money on the negotiating table this autumn to make it happen

q.o: For oss er det veldig viktig at en ny reform ikke svekker eksisterende rettigheter, og at vi må sørge for at folk som har rett til refusjon fra HELFO i dag ikke mister den og ender med en større regning.
q.t: For us it is very important that a new reform does not weaken existing rights, and that we must ensure that people who are entitled to reimbursement from HELFO today do not lose it and end up with a larger bill.

ti: Un artiste nous a accusés d’avoir « plagié » son affiche politique … Voici ce que le MCG lui a répondu !
s: The Geneva Citizens' Movement (MCG) defended its use of a modified political poster during a campaign against a 39.5 million franc credit to France, responding to plagiarism accusations from the original artist by arguing that political posters are public arguments subject to satire and reinterpretation.

q.o: Une affiche politique n'est pas un tableau de salon. C'est un argument public, et un argument public appelle une réplique.
q.t: A political poster is not a salon painting. It is a public argument, and a public argument calls for a response.

q.o: Un comité réunissant à peu près tous les partis du canton a commandé une affiche pour convaincre les Genevois de faire un cadeau de 39,5 millions à la France.
q.t: A committee bringing together almost all the canton's parties commissioned a poster to convince Genevans to give a gift of 39.5 million to France.

q.o: Les 39,5 millions donnés à la France, eux, sont toujours au programme. Spoiler : ce sont les contribuables genevois qui paieront l'addition.
q.t: The 39.5 million given to France are still on the agenda. Spoiler: it's the Genevan taxpayers who will foot the bill.

ti: Am 29. November: Nein zur Erhöhung der Mehrwertsteuer
s: The Swiss Party of Labour calls for a No vote on the November 29 referendum to finance the 13th AHV pension through a VAT increase, arguing the regressive tax burdens lower-income households and that AHV reserves of 60.4 billion francs make the increase unnecessary.

q.o: Die Lohnabhängigen in der Schweiz, die bereits unter den steigenden Treibstoffpreisen leiden, welche die Kriegspolitik der USA und ihrer Verbündeten verursachen, und eine weitere Erhöhung der Krankenkassenprämien für das Jahr 2027 schlucken müssen, sehen sich einem starken und unnötigen zusätzlichen Druck ausgesetzt.
q.t: Wage earners in Switzerland, who are already suffering from rising fuel prices caused by the war policy of the USA and its allies, and must swallow a further increase in health insurance premiums for 2027, are facing strong and unnecessary additional pressure.

q.o: NEIN zur Finanzierung der AHV durch eine Erhöhung der Mehrwertsteuer am 29. November!
q.t: NO to financing the AHV through an increase in VAT on November 29!

q.o: Nicht die AHV ist am Ende ihrer Kräfte, sondern das Dreisäulensystem!
q.t: It is not the AHV that is at the end of its strength, but the three-pillar system!

ti: Nein zur Lockerung von Waffenexporten, Ja zur internationalen Solidarität!
s: The Swiss Party of Labour opposes the relaxation of war material export laws that would allow exports to 36 NATO states and allies even during armed conflicts and permit re-export, calling for a 'No' vote in the November 29 referendum.

q.o: Die bürgerlichen Parteien möchten die militärische Zusammenarbeit mit dem westlichen, imperialistischen Block weiter ausbauen. Das müssen wir verhindern!
q.t: The bourgeois parties want to further expand military cooperation with the western, imperialist bloc. We must prevent this!

q.o: Diese Lockerung fördert nicht nur den Militarismus und die Kriegsgefahr für die Schweizer Bevölkerung, sondern widerspricht auch dem Prinzip der internationalen Solidarität der Arbeiter:innenklasse.
q.t: This relaxation not only promotes militarism and the danger of war for the Swiss population, but also contradicts the principle of international solidarity of the working class.

s: MeRA25 issued a statement condemning a workplace accident at Motor Oil facilities in Agioi Theodoroi, demanding full investigation, accountability, and stronger labour protections including increased inspections, reduced working hours, and union freedoms.

q.o: Ως ΜέΡΑ25 Ενωτική Αριστερά θεωρούμε ότι τα δυστυχήματα αυτά αποτελούν κατ' ουσίαν δολοφονικά εγκλήματα, στον βαθμό που είναι αποτέλεσμα της συνειδητής απουσίας μέτρων προστασίας από τους εργοδότες με την ανοχή αν όχι την ενθάρρυνση της κυβέρνησης.
q.t: As MeRA25 United Left we consider these accidents to be essentially homicidal crimes, insofar as they result from the deliberate absence of protective measures by employers with the tolerance if not the encouragement of the government.

q.o: Η ζωή μας αξίζει πολύ περισσότερο από τις περικοπές που κάνουν οι εργοδότες για να γεμίσουν κι άλλο τους λογαριασμούς τους και να ικανοποιήσουν τα λόρσα τους.
q.t: Our lives are worth much more than the cuts employers make to fill their accounts even more and satisfy their greed.

q.o: Κανένας άνθρωπος δεν πρέπει να πεθαίνει στη δουλειά. Δεν θα συνηθίσουμε να μετράμε νεκρούς και τραυματίες στους χώρους εργασίας.
q.t: No person should die at work. We will not get used to counting dead and injured in workplaces.

s: MeRA25 endorsed and publicized a call by the Antifascist Coordination of Athens-Piraeus for a demonstration on 10 October 2026 in Elefsina against fascist activity, following a knife attack by two Propatria members on an antifascist.

q.o: Ως ΜέΡΑ25 Ενωτική Αριστερά στηρίζουμε και αναδημοσιεύουμε το κάλεσμα του Αντιφασιστικού Συντονισμού Αθήνας – Πειραιά
q.t: As MeRA25 United Left we support and republish the call of the Antifascist Coordination of Athens – Piraeus

q.o: ΟΥΤΕ ΣΤΗΝ ΕΛΕΥΣΙΝΑ ΟΥΤΕ ΠΟΥΘΕΝΑ! ΣΥΓΚΕΝΤΡΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΠΟΡΕΙΑ ΣΑΒΒΑΤΟ 10 ΟΚΤΩΒΡΗ ΩΡΑ 17:00 ΣΤΗΝ ΠΛΑΤΕΙΑ ΗΡΩΩΝ ΣΤΗΝ ΕΛΕΥΣΙΝΑ
q.t: NOT IN ELEFSINA, NOT ANYWHERE! GATHERING AND MARCH SATURDAY 10 OCTOBER AT 17:00 IN HEROES SQUARE IN ELEFSINA

q.o: 2 φασίστες της οργάνωσης Propatria έστησαν καρτέρι στην οδό Κωνσταντινουπόλεως στην Ελευσίνα και επιτέθηκαν με μαχαίρι σε αντιφασίστα
q.t: 2 fascists of the Propatria organization set up an ambush on Konstantinoupoleos Street in Elefsina and attacked an antifascist with a knife

s: MeRA25 Youth issued a statement supporting students and teachers at the 3rd High School of Lamia after plaster fell on students' heads, sending four to hospital, and demanding immediate structural safety inspections of all school buildings while denouncing systematic degradation of public education.

q.o: Το περιστατικό με την πτώση σοβάδων στα κεφάλια μαθητ(ρι)ών στο 3ο ΓΕΛ της Λαμίας (αυτήν τη φορά), πέραν της σοβαρής επικινδυνότητας, που οδήγησε τέσσερις μαθητές στο νοσοκομείο, είναι απλά η κορυφή του παγόβουνου.
q.t: The incident with plaster falling on the heads of students at the 3rd High School of Lamia (this time), beyond the serious danger that sent four students to the hospital, is simply the tip of the iceberg.

q.o: Απαιτούμε άμεσα ελέγχους στατικής επάρκειας σε όλα τα σχολικά κτήρια και άμεσες παρεμβάσεις αντιμετώπισης κινδύνων επείγοντος χαρακτήρα.
q.t: We demand immediate structural adequacy inspections in all school buildings and immediate interventions to address dangers of an urgent nature.

q.o: Καταγγέλλουμε τη συνεχή και συστηματική υποβάθμιση του δημόσιου χαρακτήρα της εκπαίδευσης, που στοχεύει στην απαξίωση των δημόσιων φορέων και ιδρυμάτων, προς όφελος ιδιωτικών συμφερόντων και ενεργειών.
q.t: We denounce the continuous and systematic degradation of the public character of education, which aims at the devaluation of public bodies and institutions, for the benefit of private interests and actions.

s: MeRA25 announced support for a two-day Palestine Solidarity Festival on 10–11 October 2026 at the Lycabettus Theatre in Athens, criticizing the Mitsotakis government for military and political cooperation with Israel and calling for an end to all collaboration with the Israeli state.

q.o: Η κυβέρνηση Μητσοτάκη έχει στην πράξη καταστήσει τη χώρα συνένοχο της γενοκτονίας.
q.t: The Mitsotakis government has in practice made the country complicit in the genocide.

q.o: Ως ΜέΡΑ25 Ενωτική Αριστερά στηρίζουμε και καλούμε όλες και όλους να βρεθούν στο Φεστιβάλ Αλληλεγγύης, στο Θέατρο Λυκαβηττού.
q.t: As MeRA25 United Left we support and call on everyone to attend the Solidarity Festival at the Lycabettus Theatre.

q.o: Για να απαιτήσουμε να σταματήσει κάθε πολιτική, στρατιωτική ή εμπορική και οικονομική συνεργασία με το κράτος του Ισραήλ.
q.t: To demand that every political, military or commercial and economic cooperation with the state of Israel be stopped.

s: MeRA25 condemned a knife attack by alleged Propatria members against an antifascist activist in Elefsina on 8 October 2026, calling for mass antifascist mobilisation and immediate investigation.

q.o: Ως ΜέΡΑ25 Ενωτική Αριστερά καταγγέλλουμε τη σοβαρή επίθεση και καλούμε όλη την κοινωνία σε αντιφασιστική επιφυλακή.
q.t: As MeRA25 United Left we denounce the serious attack and call on all of society to antifascist vigilance.

q.o: Ο φόβος δεν θα περάσει στους αγωνιστές. Θα επιστρέψει σε αυτούς που τον σπέρνουν.
q.t: Fear will not pass to the activists. It will return to those who sow it.

q.o: Ο φασισμός δεν θα περάσει!
q.t: Fascism will not pass!

ti: ÎŸÎš ÎťÎľĎƒÎ˛ÎŻÎľĎ‚ ÎśÎˇĎ„ÎŹÎźÎľ Ď„Îˇ Î´ÎšÎľĎĎĎ…Î˝ĎƒÎˇ Ď„Ď‰Î˝ ĎƒĎ…ÎźÎźÎąĎ‡ÎšĎŽÎ˝ ÎźÎąĎ‚!
s: MeRA25's Gender Equality and LGBTQI+ Section issued a statement on International Lesbian Day calling for equal opportunities for lesbians and expansion of allies to fight patriarchal and neoliberal oppression.

q.o: Οι λεσβίες απλώς ζητάμε ίσες ευκαιρίες με όλους τους υπόλοιπους ανθρώπους ανεξάρτητα από τις όποιες ταυτότητες μπορεί να κουβαλάει κάθε άτομο.
q.t: We lesbians simply demand equal opportunities with all other people regardless of whatever identities each person may carry.
q.sp: MeRA25 Gender Equality and LGBTQI+ Section

q.o: Οι λεσβίες δεν ζητάμε περαιτέρω διακρίσεις, ζητάμε τη διεύρυνση των συμμαχιών μας.
q.t: We lesbians do not demand further distinctions, we demand the expansion of our alliances.
q.sp: MeRA25 Gender Equality and LGBTQI+ Section

q.o: Διαγιατί μόνο έτσι θα μπορέσουμε να αντισταθούμε πατριαρχική – νεοφιλελεύθερη – εξορυκτική μάστιγα, και γιατί μόνο ένας καλύτερος κόσμος για όλους μας συνεπάγεται έναν καλύτερο κόσμο για τις λεσβίες!
q.t: Because only in this way can we resist the patriarchal – neoliberal – extractive scourge, and because only a better world for all of us entails a better world for lesbians!
q.sp: MeRA25 Gender Equality and LGBTQI+ Section

s: MeRA25 issued a statement supporting residents of the Peloponnese and the "Save Parnonas" initiative against the installation of industrial wind parks on Mount Zavitsa, welcoming a court order from Tripoli that temporarily halts work until November 20, 2026.

q.o: Ως ΜέΡΑ25 Ενωτική Αριστερά λέμε όχι στην καταστροφή των βουνών.
q.t: As MeRA25 United Left we say no to the destruction of the mountains.

q.o: Η μετατροπή των παρθένων δασικών εκτάσεων και των βιότοπων της περιοχής σε εργοτάξια με τόνους μπετόν και γιγαντιαίες ανεμογεννήτριες δεν αποτελεί «πράσινη ανάπτυξη», αλλά περιβαλλοντικό έγκλημα εις βάρος της ελληνικής υπαίθρου και των όμορφων χωριών της για τα κέρδη των λίγων.
q.t: The conversion of virgin forest areas and the region's habitats into construction sites with tons of concrete and giant wind turbines does not constitute 'green development', but an environmental crime against the Greek countryside and its beautiful villages for the profits of the few.

q.o: Η φωνή των τοπικών κοινοτήτων, που αντιτίθενται μαζικά στα σχέδια υποβάθμισης του Πάρνωνα, είναι η μόνη που πρέπει να εισακουστεί, μακριά από κυβερνητικούς αντιπεριβαλλοντικούς νόμους που εξυπηρετούν μονάχα τα συμφέροντα των ολιγαρχών της ενέργειας.
q.t: The voice of the local communities, who massively oppose the plans to degrade Parnonas, is the only one that should be heard, far from governmental anti-environmental laws that serve only the interests of the energy oligarchs.

ti: Δύο νεκροί για τα υπερκέρδη της Motor Oil
ac: Anticapitalist Left Cooperation for the Overthrow
s: ANTARSYA issued a statement condemning a fatal explosion at Motor Oil refineries in Agioi Theodoroi, Corinthia on 9 October 2026 that killed two workers and injured four, calling it an employer crime driven by profit maximization and demanding comprehensive labor reforms including reduced working hours, collective bargaining rights, higher minimum wage, and improved workplace safety inspections.

q.o: Αυτό δείχνει ότι οι εργασίες συντήρησης δεν πραγματοποιούνται με όρους προστασίας της ζωής και της ασφάλειας των εργαζομένων, αλλά το μόνο που ενδιαφέρει την εργοδοσία είναι να προστατεύσει τα υπερκέρδη της.
q.t: This shows that maintenance work is not carried out under terms that protect the life and safety of workers, but the only thing that interests the employer is to protect its super-profits.
q.sp: Anticapitalist Left Cooperation for the Overthrow

q.o: Δεν πάει άλλο! Η εργατική τάξη δουλεύει πιο πολύ, πιο εντατικά, πιο ελαστικά και πιο κακοπληρωμένα, χαράζεται το κορμί και η ψυχή της από τη σκληρή δουλειά.
q.t: Enough is enough! The working class works more, more intensively, more flexibly and more poorly paid, its body and soul are carved up by hard work.
q.sp: Anticapitalist Left Cooperation for the Overthrow

ti: Η ΑΝΤΑΡΣΥΑ καταγγέλλει τη φασιστική δολοφονική επίθεση στην Ελευσίνα σε βάρος αγωνιστή με αντιφασιστική δράση
s: ANTARSYA condemned a fascist knife attack in Elefsina on 8 October 2026 against an antifascist activist and called for an antifascist rally on 10 October at 5pm in Heroes' Square, demanding prosecution of perpetrators and exposure of parastate mechanisms.

q.o: Η ΑΝΤΑΡΣΥΑ καταγγέλλει τη βάρβαρη δολοφονική επίθεση με μαχαίρια 3 φασιστών στην Ελευσίνα την Πέμπτη 8/10/2026 σε βάρος αγωνιστή με αντιφασιστική δράση, που παραλίγο να του στοιχίσει τη ζωή.
q.t: ANTARSYA condemns the barbaric murderous attack with knives by 3 fascists in Elefsina on Thursday 8/10/2026 against an activist with antifascist action, which almost cost him his life.

q.o: Η αποφυλάκιση του καταδικασμένου για την εγκληματική δράση της Χρυσής Αυγής Κασιδιάρη λειτούργησε σαν πυροκροτητής για την ένταση της φασιστικής βίας ενάντια στην κοινωνία και τις δημοκρατικές ελευθερίες.
q.t: The release from prison of Kasidiaris, convicted for the criminal activity of Golden Dawn, functioned as a trigger for the intensification of fascist violence against society and democratic freedoms.

q.o: Να σημάνει αντιφασιστικός συναγερμός! Ενωτικές αντιφασιστικές πρωτοβουλίες δράσης και μαζικής διαφώτισης παντού!
q.t: Sound the antifascist alarm! Unifying antifascist action initiatives and mass enlightenment everywhere!

ti: Σχόλιο για Γκράβα και μαθητικές καταλήψεις
ac: Anticapitalist Left Cooperation for the Overthrow
s: ANTARSYA issued a statement condemning the government's underfunding of public education after a school building in Grava was evacuated due to gas leaks, supporting student mobilizations and occupations against educational policy.

q.o: Απέναντι σε αυτή την πολιτική θα βάλουμε φρενο! Δεν θα επιτρέψουμε οι ζωές των μαθητών και των μαθητριών στα σχολεία να μπαίνουν σε κίνδυνο λόγω της υποχρηματοδότησης και της έλλειψης ενδιαφέροντος για τις υποδομές και τους κανόνες ασφαλείας.
q.t: We will put a stop to this policy! We will not allow the lives of students in schools to be put at risk due to underfunding and lack of interest in infrastructure and safety regulations.
q.sp: Anticapitalist Left Cooperation for the Overthrow

q.o: Χαιρετίζουμε τις μαθητικές κινητοποιήσεις! Στηρίζουμε και συμμετέχουμε σε αυτόν τον αγώνα και το κύμα καταλήψεων που έχει ξεσπάσει
q.t: We salute the student mobilizations! We support and participate in this struggle and the wave of occupations that has erupted
q.sp: Anticapitalist Left Cooperation for the Overthrow

ti: Εκδήλωση ΤΕ ΑΝΤΑΡΣΥΑ, Καισαριανή, Σάββατο 10/10
s: ANTARSYA's Kaisariani local branch is organizing a public event on October 10, 2026, addressing touristification of cities and the housing crisis, with speakers including a central committee member and the head of the local electoral list.

ti: Η ΑΝΤΑΡΣΥΑ για την απαγόρευση συναθροίσεων εξαιτίας της επίσκεψης Ρούμπιο
s: ANTARSYA condemns the police ban on assemblies in central Athens during US Secretary of State Rubio's visit on 7 October and calls for participation in anti-war demonstrations on 6, 7, and 10 October.

q.o: Η ΑΝΤΑΡΣΥΑ καταγγέλλει την απαγόρευση συναθροίσεων που εξήγγειλε η Γενική Αστυνομική Διεύθυνση Αττικής για σημαντικό τμήμα του κέντρου της Αθήνας κατά την 7η Οκτώβρη εξαιτίας της επίσκεψης Ρούμπιο.
q.t: ANTARSYA condemns the ban on assemblies announced by the General Police Directorate of Attica for a significant part of central Athens on 7 October due to Rubio's visit.

q.o: Οι πολιτικές οργανώσεις, τα εργατικά σωματεία, οι φοιτητικοί σύλλογοι και οι αντιπολεμικοί φορείς που διαδηλώνουν δεν είναι τρομοκράτες!
q.t: The political organizations, trade unions, student associations and anti-war bodies that demonstrate are not terrorists!

q.o: Ο λαός δεν κινδυνεύει από τις αντιπολεμικές διαδηλώσεις αλλά από την κυβερνητική, φιλοπόλεμη πολιτική και την ιμπεριαλιστική πολιτική των ΗΠΑ.
q.t: The people are not endangered by anti-war demonstrations but by the governmental, pro-war policy and the imperialist policy of the USA.

ti: Δ. Μελίδης: «Ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ-ΠΣ θα εκπλήξει πολλούς την ημέρα των εκλογών – Οι πολίτες επί ΣΥΡΙΖΑ δεν φοβούνταν να μπουν στο σούπερ μάρκετ ή να δουν τον λογαριασμό της ΔΕΗ»
s: SYRIZA-PS press spokesperson Dimitris Melidis stated in television interviews that the party will surprise many on election day and claimed that under SYRIZA governance citizens were not afraid to shop at supermarkets or check their electricity bills.

q.o: Ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ-ΠΣ θα εκπλήξει πολλούς την ημέρα των εκλογών
q.t: SYRIZA-PS will surprise many on election day

q.o: Ο ελληνικός λαός επί ΣΥΡΙΖΑ δεν φοβόταν να μπει στο σούπερ μάρκετ για να ψωνίσει. Δεν φοβόταν να δει τον λογαριασμό της ΔΕΗ. Δεν φοβόταν να πάει να βάλει βενζίνη
q.t: The Greek people under SYRIZA were not afraid to enter the supermarket to shop. They were not afraid to see the electricity bill. They were not afraid to go fill up with petrol

ti: «Όχι άλλες ανασκοπήσεις αυτοθαυμασμού κύριε Μητσοτάκη, οι Έλληνες πολίτες ζουν σε μια άλλη Ελλάδα από αυτή που περιγράφετε»
s: SYRIZA-PS Press Office issued a statement criticizing Prime Minister Mitsotakis's weekly message, accusing him of presenting a false picture of Greece prospering while the social majority experiences a different reality.

q.o: Ο κ. Μητσοτάκης επιμένει να παρουσιάζει μια Ελλάδα που ευημερεί, πρωταγωνιστεί διεθνώς και προχωρά με σταθερά βήματα προς το μέλλον. Μόνο που αυτή η Ελλάδα υπάρχει κυρίως στις εβδομαδιαίες αναρτήσεις του πρωθυπουργού και όχι στην καθημερινότητα της κοινωνικής πλειοψηφίας.
q.t: Mr. Mitsotakis insists on presenting a Greece that is prospering, playing a leading role internationally and moving forward with steady steps towards the future. Except that this Greece exists mainly in the Prime Minister's weekly posts and not in the daily life of the social majority.

ti: Φ. Καρυστινάκη: Κομματικοί «Γκρούεζες», αυταρχισμός και εξευτελιστικοί μισθοί διώχνουν τους υγειονομικούς από το ΕΣΥ
s: Fotini Karystinaki, member of SYRIZA's Political Secretariat and head of the Health Sector, criticized the government's health policy in a radio interview, stating that party patronage, authoritarianism, and humiliating wages are driving healthcare workers away from the National Health System (ESY).

q.o: Ο κ. Μητσοτάκης είχε απόλυτο δίκιο όταν χαρακτήρισε τον Υπ. Υγείας "επιτυχημένο". Είναι πράγματι «επιτυχημένος» με βάση τα κριτήρια και τις προτεραιότητες της δεξιάς πολιτικής.
q.t: Mr. Mitsotakis was absolutely right when he characterized the Health Minister as 'successful'. He is indeed 'successful' based on the criteria and priorities of right-wing politics.

ti: Χρ. Γιαννούλης: «Χίλιοι μαθητές στη Θεσσαλονίκη χωρίς σχολική μεταφορά»
s: SYRIZA-PS Parliamentary Representative Christos Giannoulis stated that approximately 1,000 students in Thessaloniki still lack school transportation one month after the school year began.

q.o: Έναν μήνα μετά την έναρξη της σχολικής χρονιάς, περίπου 1.000 μαθητές στη Θεσσαλονίκη εξακολουθούν να μην έχουν εξασφαλισμένη σχολική μεταφορά.
q.t: One month after the start of the school year, approximately 1,000 students in Thessaloniki still do not have secured school transportation.

q.o: Γονείς σε απόγνωση, οικογένειες που επιβαρύνονται οικονομικά, παιδιά που ταλαιπωρούνται καθημερινά και εκτίθενται σε κινδύνους.
q.t: Parents in despair, families burdened financially, children suffering daily and exposed to dangers.

ti: Δ. Μελίδης: «Να επιστρέψουν οι έδρες στον ΣΥΡΙΖΑ ΠΣ – να δυναμώσει η Αριστερά στη Βουλή»
s: SYRIZA-PS press spokesperson Dimitris Melidis called for parliamentary seats to be returned to SYRIZA-PS and for the Left to be strengthened in Parliament, while discussing the practical implementation of an escape clause.

q.o: Πρέπει να δούμε πώς θα εφαρμοστεί στην πράξη η ρήτρα διαφυγής
q.t: We must see how the escape clause will be implemented in practice

q.o: Να επιστρέψουν οι έδρες στον ΣΥΡΙΖΑ ΠΣ – να δυναμώσει η Αριστερά στη Βουλή
q.t: The seats should return to SYRIZA-PS – the Left should be strengthened in Parliament

ti: Γ. Μπουλέκος: Συμπεριφορές που τραυματίζουν το ηθικό πλεονέκτημα της Αριστεράς στα μάτια της κοινωνίας δεν θα γίνονται πλέον ανεκτές
s: SYRIZA-PS Organizational Secretary Giannis Boulekos stated that behaviors damaging the Left's moral advantage in society's eyes will no longer be tolerated, while discussing party initiatives on private debt and a proposal for an investigative committee on funds and servicers.

q.o: Συμπεριφορές που τραυματίζουν το ηθικό πλεονέκτημα της Αριστεράς στα μάτια της κοινωνίας δεν θα γίνονται πλέον ανεκτές
q.t: Behaviors that wound the moral advantage of the Left in the eyes of society will no longer be tolerated

ti: Ρ. Δούρου: Ούτε ένα δευτερόλεπτο δεν βρέθηκε για το Κυπριακό στην επίσκεψη Ρούμπιο στην Αθήνα
s: SYRIZA-PS parliamentary group president Rena Dourou criticized the absence of any discussion of the Cyprus issue during US Secretary of State Rubio's visit to Athens, noting 52 years since the Turkish invasion and occupation of Cyprus.

q.o: Κλείνουμε 52 χρόνια από τη βάρβαρη τουρκική εισβολή και κατοχή στην Κύπρο. Και επειδή έπαιζε πριν από λίγο η επίσκεψη του Ρούμπιο στην Αθήνα, με λυπεί ιδιαίτερα ότι δεν βρέθηκε ούτε ένα δευτερόλεπτο σε αυτές να μιλήσουν για το Κυπριακό
q.t: We are closing 52 years since the barbaric Turkish invasion and occupation of Cyprus. And because Rubio's visit to Athens was just playing, I am particularly saddened that not even one second was found in it to talk about the Cyprus issue

ti: Η ΝΙΚΗ τίμησε τη μνήμη του Νικηταρά στο Χιλιομόδι Κορινθίας
s: NIKI party vice-president and MP Georgios Rountas attended a memorial ceremony for 1821 Greek Revolution hero Nikitaras in Chiliomodi, Corinthia, on 11 October 2026, laying a wreath and declaring that Greece must be liberated again in this critical era for the Greek nation.

q.o: Σήμερα τιμούμε τη μνήμη του τεράστιου αυτού ήρωα της θεόπνευστης Επανάστασης του 1821, του Νικήτα Σταματελόπουλου, του Νικηταρά. Σήμερα, σε αυτή την τόσο κρίσιμη εποχή για το έθνος των Ελλήνων, ευχόμαστε ολόψυχα ο καλός Θεός να γεμίσει τις καρδιές των Ελλήνων με το πύρωμα της ψυχής του μεγάλου αυτού ήρωα, του Νικηταρά, και να βοηθήσει να ελευθερωθεί και πάλι η Ελλάδα.
q.t: Today we honor the memory of this tremendous hero of the divinely inspired Revolution of 1821, Nikitas Stamatelopoulos, Nikitaras. Today, in this very critical era for the Greek nation, we wholeheartedly pray that the good God fills the hearts of Greeks with the fire of the soul of this great hero, Nikitaras, and helps Greece to be liberated once again.

q.o: να παραδώσουμε στα παιδιά μας μια πατρίδα ελεύθερη, περήφανη και πιστή στις ιερές της παραδόσεις
q.t: to hand over to our children a homeland free, proud and faithful to its sacred traditions

ti: Στον Άγιο Ελευθέριο Χαλανδρίου η Ασπασία Κουρουπάκη – Συνάντηση με τον Γέροντα Εφραίμ τον Βατοπαιδινό
s: NIKH MP Aspasia Kouroupaki attended a Divine Liturgy at Agios Eleftherios Church in Chalandri on 11 October 2026, met with Elder Efraim of Vatopedi Monastery, and discussed the need to preserve Greek Orthodox values and spiritual heritage amid contemporary social challenges.

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ παραμένει σταθερά προσηλωμένη στην ενίσχυση των δεσμών της κοινωνίας με την Εκκλησία και στη διαφύλαξη της ορθόδοξης παράδοσης.
q.t: NIKH remains firmly committed to strengthening the bonds of society with the Church and to safeguarding the Orthodox tradition.

ti: Μια επιδότηση δεν αρκεί για την Αναγέννηση της Περιφέρειας
s: NIKH criticizes the government's relocation subsidy program as fragmentary and presents its comprehensive Regional Renaissance Plan 'Greece 2040' linking rural return with productive investments, employment, housing, infrastructure and family support.

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ επισημαίνει ότι η επιδότηση της μετακίνησης αποτελεί αποσπασματικό μέτρο-κοροϊδία , το οποίο από μόνο του δεν μπορεί να ανατρέψει την ερήμωση της ελληνικής περιφέρειας.
q.t: NIKH points out that the relocation subsidy constitutes a fragmentary measure-mockery, which by itself cannot reverse the desertification of the Greek periphery.

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ έχει εκπονήσει το ολοκληρωμένο Σχέδιο Περιφερειακής Αναγέννησης «Ελλάδα 2040» , το οποίο αντιμετωπίζει συνδυαστικά αυτές τις ανάγκες.
q.t: NIKH has developed the comprehensive Regional Renaissance Plan 'Greece 2040', which addresses these needs in combination.

q.o: Καλούμε την κυβέρνηση να αντιμετωπίσει την περιφερειακή ερήμωση με συνολική και μακροπρόθεσμη πολιτική .
q.t: We call on the government to address regional desertification with comprehensive and long-term policy.

ti: Δ. Νατσιός από Κοζάνη: «Καρφί στα πλευρά της Μακεδονίας και ολόκληρου του ελληνικού έθνους η προδοσία των Πρεσπών»
s: Dimitris Natsios, president of NIKI party, attended the 114th anniversary of Kozani's liberation, laid a wreath, and criticized the Prespa Agreement as a betrayal of Macedonia and Greece, while also condemning Prime Minister Mitsotakis for declaring war on Russia and noting that NIKI submitted a bill in 2025 to abolish the Prespa Agreement.

q.o: Η μνήμη είναι το πιο ισχυρό αμυντήριο ενός έθνους. Ταυτόχρονα όμως είναι και διδασκαλείο. Μας διδάσκει η μνήμη, ότι η λευτεριά είναι κάστρο και το παίρνεις με το σπαθί σου και το δέντρο της ελευθερίας ποτίζεται με ποταμούς αίματος.
q.t: Memory is the most powerful defense of a nation. At the same time, however, it is also a school. Memory teaches us that freedom is a castle and you take it with your sword and the tree of freedom is watered with rivers of blood.

q.o: Αυτή η κηλίδα, αυτός ο λεκές πρέπει να φύγει από την ιστορία μας. Δυστυχώς, βρέθηκαν πριν από μερικά χρόνια οι Ιούδες, οι προδότες της Μακεδονίας, ο Τσίπρας και ο Κοτζιάς και η Νέα Δημοκρατία συνεχίζει να υποστηρίζει εμμέσως πλην σαφώς αυτή την προδοτική συμφωνία
q.t: This stain, this blemish must be removed from our history. Unfortunately, a few years ago the Judases were found, the traitors of Macedonia, Tsipras and Kotzias, and New Democracy continues to support indirectly but clearly this treasonous agreement

q.o: Όλοι θα τα φτιάξουν με τη Ρωσία, πλην της Ελλάδος, διότι έχουμε κυβερνήτες οι οποίοι δεν έχουν όραμα, πνίγουν το όνειρο και την ευημερία της Ελλάδος και τα οράματα και τις ελπίδες του λαού μας στην ανυπαρξία και στην ανικανότητά τους.
q.t: Everyone will fix things with Russia, except Greece, because we have rulers who have no vision, they drown the dream and prosperity of Greece and the visions and hopes of our people in their non-existence and incompetence.

ti: Κουρουπάκη: Σχέδια εγκατάστασης μπαταριών λιθίου κοντά σε οικισμούς της Αρκαδίας – «Κάτοικοι φοβούνται πυρκαγιές και έκλυση τοξικών αερίων»
s: NIKH MP Aspasia Kouroupaki submitted a parliamentary question to the Ministers of Environment and Energy and Climate Crisis and Civil Protection demanding full disclosure on licensing, fire risks, and operational readiness regarding planned lithium battery storage facilities near residential areas in Arcadia.

q.o: Κάτοικοι φοβούνται πυρκαγιές και έκλυση τοξικών αερίων
q.t: Residents fear fires and release of toxic gases

q.o: Οι κάτοικοι της Αρκαδίας έχουν δικαίωμα να γνωρίζουν τι σχεδιάζεται κοντά στα σπίτια και στις περιουσίες τους, ποιοι κίνδυνοι έχουν αξιολογηθεί και ποια ακριβώς μέτρα έχει προβλέψει η Πολιτεία για την προστασία της ζωής, της υγείας και του τόπου τους.
q.t: The residents of Arcadia have the right to know what is being planned near their homes and properties, what risks have been assessed and what exactly measures the State has foreseen for the protection of their lives, health and place.

ti: Αναδιώτης: Το «Σπίτι μου ΙΙ» αφήνει χωρίς χρηματοδότηση τους νέους που θέλουν να χτίσουν πρώτη κατοικία στα μικρά νησιά
s: MEP Nikolaos Anadiotis of NIKH submitted a written question to the European Commission requesting special provisions for small Greek islands where the "My Home II" housing program excludes funding for self-construction of first homes on privately owned plots, particularly affecting Kastellorizo, Symi, Halki, Tilos, and Kasos.

q.o: Το στεγαστικό πρόγραμμα «Σπίτι μου ΙΙ» αφήνει ένα σοβαρό κενό στα μικρά ελληνικά νησιά, όπου οι νέοι που διαθέτουν δικό τους οικόπεδο αδυνατούν να αξιοποιήσουν τη χρηματοδότηση για να χτίσουν την πρώτη τους κατοικία.
q.t: The housing program 'My Home II' leaves a serious gap in small Greek islands, where young people who own their own plot are unable to utilize the funding to build their first home.

ti: Κουρουπάκη: Απλήρωτοι εργαζόμενοι στο «Μαργαρίτα» της Νέας Πεντέλης – Σε κίνδυνο η φροντίδα περισσότερων από 100 ΑμεΑ
s: NIKH MP Aspasia Kouroupaki submitted a parliamentary question to two ministers demanding immediate solutions for unpaid workers at the "Margarita" Special Education Workshop in Nea Penteli, where over 100 people with intellectual disabilities and autism receive care, with debts estimated to reach 250,000 euros by December 2026.

ti: Αναδιώτης: «Εκρηκτική αύξηση των λοιμώξεων από ανθεκτικά μικρόβια στην Ελλάδα – Σοβαρές ελλείψεις στην πρόληψη»
s: NIKH MEP Nikolaos Anadiotis submitted a written question to the European Commission regarding Greece's deteriorating antimicrobial resistance indicators, citing a 109% increase in third-generation cephalosporin-resistant E. coli bloodstream infections since 2019 and demanding accountability for EU-funded prevention programs.

q.o: Εκρηκτική αύξηση των λοιμώξεων από ανθεκτικά μικρόβια στην Ελλάδα – Σοβαρές ελλείψεις στην πρόληψη
q.t: Explosive increase in infections from antibiotic-resistant microbes in Greece – Serious deficiencies in prevention

ti: 12 Οκτωβρίου 1944 – Η απελευθέρωση της Αθήνας και η αρχή του τέλους για την Κατοχή της Ελλάδας από τους Ναζί
s: Voice of Reason and MEP Afroditi Latinopoulou issued a statement commemorating the 82nd anniversary of Athens' liberation from Nazi occupation on 12 October 1944, criticizing leftist claims that the communist EAM liberated Athens and emphasizing five milestones of the 1940s including the suppression of communist insurgency in December 1944 and August 1949.

q.o: Δεν είναι λίγοι όμως, εκείνοι που αυτοαποκαλούμενοι ως "φιλειρηνιστές", προερχόμενοι ασφαλώς από τον χώρο της Αριστεράς, τους υπερτονίζουν τα τελευταία χρόνια την σημασία της 12ης Οκτωβρίου 1944, προπαγανδίζοντας αναληθώς ότι το κομμουνιστικό Ε.Α.Μ. απελευθέρωσε την Αθήνα.
q.t: However, there are not few of those who call themselves 'pacifists', certainly coming from the Left, who in recent years overemphasize the significance of 12 October 1944, falsely propagandizing that the communist EAM liberated Athens.

q.o: Η ΦΩΝΗ ΛΟΓΙΚΗΣ και η Πρόεδρός της, Ευρωβουλευτής Αφροδίτη Λατινοπούλου, τιμούν, όπως και κάθε Έλληνας Πατριώτης τα 5 ορόσημα της Επικής Δεκαετίας του 1940
q.t: VOICE OF REASON and its President, MEP Afroditi Latinopoulou, honor, like every Greek Patriot, the 5 milestones of the Epic Decade of the 1940s

ti: Α. Λατινοπούλου: “Ελλάδα 2025: Πρωταθλήτρια ευρωπαϊκής φτώχειας και οικονομικής απελπισίας – Η κυβέρνηση Μητσοτάκη πανηγυρίζει πάνω στα ερείπια των νοικοκυριών!”
s: Voice of Reason leader Afroditi Latinopoulou criticizes the Mitsotakis government over Eurostat data showing 50.5% of Greeks cannot cover unexpected expenses, demanding tax cuts and support for families and businesses.

q.o: Η ΦΩΝΗ ΛΟΓΙΚΗΣ απαιτεί άμεση μείωση της φορολογίας στην εργασία, ουσιαστική ελάφρυνση των έμμεσων φόρων, περιορισμό της κρατικής σπατάλης και πραγματική στήριξη της παραγωγής, των επιχειρήσεων και της ελληνικής οικογένειας.
q.t: VOICE OF REASON demands immediate reduction of taxation on labor, substantial relief from indirect taxes, limitation of state waste and real support for production, businesses and the Greek family.

q.o: Κύριε Μητσοτάκη, σταματήστε να προσβάλλετε τη νοημοσύνη των Ελλήνων με τα παραμύθια της ανάπτυξης.
q.t: Mr. Mitsotakis, stop insulting the intelligence of Greeks with fairy tales of growth.

q.o: Η δική σας ανάπτυξη υπάρχει στις κυβερνητικές παρουσιάσεις. Η φτώχεια και η ανασφάλεια υπάρχουν στα ελληνικά σπίτια.
q.t: Your growth exists in government presentations. Poverty and insecurity exist in Greek homes.

ti: Α. Λατινοπούλου: “Επίσκεψη Ρούμπιο: Μη τολμήσουν να χαραμίσουν άλλη μια εθνική ευκαιρία!”
s: Voice of Reason leader Afroditi Latinopoulou issued a statement criticizing the Greek government's handling of US Secretary of State Rubio's Athens visit, demanding exploitation of Greece's geopolitical position, restoration of national identity in education, strict border enforcement with immediate deportations of irregular migrants, and transparent defense procurement while deepening strategic cooperation with the United States.

q.o: Η επίσκεψη Ρούμπιο στην Αθήνα δεν μπορεί να καταλήξει σε ακόμη ένα διπλωματικό σόου με φωτογραφίες, δηλώσεις και επικοινωνιακές φιέστες.
q.t: Rubio's visit to Athens cannot end up as yet another diplomatic show with photographs, statements and communication festivities.

q.o: Η ΦΩΝΗ ΛΟΓΙΚΗΣ τονίζει ότι η Ελλάδα οφείλει να επιστρέψει στις αξίες που γέννησαν τον ελληνικό πολιτισμό. Αυτή είναι η απάντηση στην παρακμή της woke ατζέντας, στον ανεξέλεγκτο δικαιωματισμό, στην αποδόμηση της εθνικής ταυτότητας και στην ανοχή απέναντι στη λαθρομετανάστευση.
q.t: VOICE OF REASON emphasizes that Greece must return to the values that gave birth to Greek civilization. This is the answer to the decline of the woke agenda, to uncontrolled rights-ism, to the deconstruction of national identity and to tolerance towards illegal immigration.

q.o: να επιβάλει αυστηρή φύλαξη των συνόρων, άμεσες επιστροφές λαθρομεταναστών και τερματισμό της πολιτικής που μετατρέπει την Ελλάδα σε αποθήκη ψυχών
q.t: to impose strict guarding of borders, immediate returns of illegal immigrants and termination of the policy that turns Greece into a warehouse of souls

q.o: Πρώτα η Ελλάδα – Πρώτα οι Έλληνες!
q.t: Greece First – Greeks First!

ti: Α. Λατινοπούλου: Η απαγόρευση μετρητών είναι οικονομικός φασισμός!
s: Afroditi Latinopoulou issued a public statement characterizing the prohibition of cash transactions as economic fascism.

q.o: Η απαγόρευση μετρητών είναι οικονομικός φασισμός!
q.t: The prohibition of cash is economic fascism!

ti: Α.Λατινοπούλου: “Ο πληθωρισμός στον Θεό, ο Μητσοτάκης στον κόσμο του!”
s: Voice of Reason leader Afroditi Latinopoulou criticized Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis following his interview on a day when 5% inflation was announced, demanding real tax cuts on fuel and basic goods instead of promises while citing increases of 15% in electricity, 53.2% in heating oil, 22.5% in gasoline, and 5.9% in rents.

q.o: Η ΦΩΝΗ ΛΟΓΙΚΗΣ απαιτεί πραγματικές μειώσεις φόρων στα καύσιμα και στα βασικά αγαθά, ουσιαστική αντιμετώπιση της ακρίβειας και μέτρα που θα αφήνουν επιτέλους χρήματα στην τσέπη του Έλληνα.
q.t: VOICE OF REASON demands real tax cuts on fuel and basic goods, substantial addressing of high prices and measures that will finally leave money in the pocket of the Greek.

q.o: Ο πληθωρισμός στον Θεό, ο Μητσοτάκης «περί άλλων τυρβάζει» και ο ελληνικός λαός όπως πάντα, να πληρώνει τον λογαριασμό!
q.t: Inflation to God, Mitsotakis 'busies himself with other things' and the Greek people as always, paying the bill!

ti: Α. Λατινοπούλου: “Αυτό είναι ο ορισμός του οικονομικού φασισμού κ. Μητσοτάκη.” (+video)
s: Afroditi Latinopoulou accused Prime Minister Mitsotakis of economic fascism for proposing to ban cash payments in cash-on-delivery transactions, claiming the policy benefits banks and follows EU directives while harming small businesses.

q.o: Πείτε την αλήθεια: ότι θέλετε να καταργήσετε τα μετρητά και ξεκινάτε με την απαγόρευση μετρητών στην αντικαταβολή.
q.t: Tell the truth: that you want to abolish cash and you are starting with the ban on cash in cash-on-delivery.

q.o: Αυτό είναι ο ορισμός του οικονομικού φασισμού κ. Μητσοτάκη.
q.t: This is the definition of economic fascism Mr. Mitsotakis.

ti: Α. Λατινοπούλου: “Ισλαμισμός στην Ευρώπη: τέλος στην υποκρισία και την πολιτική δειλία – η Ευρώπη ξυπνά και δεν θα παραδοθεί στον θρησκευτικό φανατισμό”
s: Voice of Reason MEP Afroditi Latinopoulou issued a statement welcoming a European Parliament resolution on Islamism in Europe (381 votes in favor, 167 against, 15 abstentions) and demanding zero tolerance for Islamist extremism, immediate deportation of convicted migrants, closure of organizations promoting violence, rejection of parallel religious justice systems, and stricter immigration control.

q.o: Η εποχή της φίμωσης τελειώνει. Η Ευρώπη δεν είναι ξέφραγο αμπέλι και οι νόμοι της δεν μπαίνουν σε διαπραγμάτευση με θρησκευτικούς φανατικούς.
q.t: The era of silencing is ending. Europe is not an unguarded vineyard and its laws are not up for negotiation with religious fanatics.

q.o: Η θρησκευτική ελευθερία είναι αδιαπραγμάτευτη, αλλά ο ισλαμιστικός ολοκληρωτισμός δεν έχει καμία θέση στην Ευρώπη.
q.t: Religious freedom is non-negotiable, but Islamist totalitarianism has no place in Europe.

ti: Alice Weidel: Angehobene Herbstprojektion basiert auf hoher Staatsquote
s: AfD federal spokesperson Alice Weidel criticized the German government's raised economic growth forecast of 1.3 percent, arguing it is based on an increasing state quota financed by debt, and called for tax cuts, reduced bureaucracy, subsidy elimination, and opposition to higher contribution assessment limits planned for 2027.

q.o: Die angehobene Herbstprojektion von Wirtschaftsministerin Reiche basiert auf einer immer weiter steigenden Staatsquote. Und der Staatskonsum erfolgt auf Pump. Die Schulden belasten nachfolgende Generationen.
q.t: The raised autumn projection by Economics Minister Reiche is based on an ever-increasing state quota. And state consumption is financed by debt. The debts burden future generations.

q.o: Merz' und Klingbeils Staat auf Pump ist jedenfalls brandgefährlich, aktuell vermeintlich positive Konjunkturdaten kaschieren lediglich den desolaten Zustand von Wirtschaft und Infrastruktur.
q.t: Merz's and Klingbeil's debt-financed state is in any case extremely dangerous; currently supposedly positive economic data merely conceal the desolate state of the economy and infrastructure.

q.o: Deshalb fordern wir als AfD, die Steuern zu senken, den Sozialstaat zu fokussieren, Subventionen zu streichen, die Bürokratie zu reduzieren, technologieoffen zu agieren – gerade in der Energiepolitik, keine neuen Steuern einführen (ob nun für Zucker, Kunststoff oder andere Absurditäten) und in der Außenpolitik auf Frieden zu setzen.
q.t: Therefore we as AfD demand to lower taxes, focus the welfare state, eliminate subsidies, reduce bureaucracy, act in a technology-open manner – especially in energy policy, introduce no new taxes (whether for sugar, plastic or other absurdities) and to pursue peace in foreign policy.

ti: Tino Chrupalla/Alice Weidel: Ein Sieg für den Wählerwillen – Tobias Rausch ist erster AfD-Landtagspräsident Deutschlands
s: Tobias Rausch was elected as the first AfD state parliament president in German history in Saxony-Anhalt, receiving votes from AfD, BSW, and some CDU members, with AfD federal co-leaders Chrupalla and Weidel calling it a historic breakthrough and demanding similar recognition in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

q.o: Zum ersten Mal stellt die AfD mit Tobias Rausch den Landtagspräsidenten in Sachsen-Anhalt – ein historischer Schritt und eine Premiere für ganz Deutschland.
q.t: For the first time, the AfD is providing the state parliament president in Saxony-Anhalt with Tobias Rausch – a historic step and a premiere for all of Germany.

q.o: Damit ist die Brandmauer in Magdeburg endgültig gefallen.
q.t: With this, the firewall in Magdeburg has definitively fallen.

q.o: Die jahrelange Ausgrenzung unserer Partei hat heute endlich ein Ende gefunden.
q.t: The years-long exclusion of our party has finally come to an end today.

q.o: Wir wünschen Ulrich Siegmund ein ebenso erfolgreiches Ergebnis bei der anstehenden Wahl zum Ministerpräsidenten.
q.t: We wish Ulrich Siegmund an equally successful result in the upcoming election for minister-president.

ti: Yemen meets Uganda
s: The MLPD announces support for the International Environmental Strategy Conference and foreign guests, organizing a fundraising event to finance their travel.

ti: gemeinsamen Online-Teilnahme an der Internationalen Umweltstrategiekonferenz
s: The MLPD Munich branch is organizing collective online participation in an International Environmental Strategy Conference on October 24, 2026, at a location in Munich-Giesing with a participation fee of 15 euros plus voluntary donation.

ti: Stadtzeitung erschienen: Ausgabe Oktober 2026
s: The MLPD Munich branch published its October 2026 city newspaper addressing how to stop what it characterizes as an exploitation offensive by monopolies and the state.

q.o: Wie können wir die Ausbeutungsoffensive von Monopolen und Staat stoppen?
q.t: How can we stop the exploitation offensive by monopolies and the state?

ti: REBELL-AG „Kampfsport International – Solidarität mit Gaza!“
s: REBELL, the MLPD youth organization, announces a biweekly working group combining martial arts training with participation in Palestine vigils and organizing resistance against what they term genocide in Gaza.

ti: Toustes ensemble ! Le 13 octobre, un pas vers la grève
s: The NPA calls for participation in a strike on October 13, 2026, supporting high school student mobilizations against inequality and linking them to broader demands for wage increases, pensions, and social benefits.

ti: Autocollant JA : « Non à "bienvenue en France", logiciel de tri raciste »
