s: The Jeunes Anticapitalistes (youth wing of NPA) produced a sticker opposing the "Bienvenue en France" software, which they characterize as a racist sorting tool.

q.o: Non à "bienvenue en France", logiciel de tri raciste
q.t: No to 'Welcome to France', racist sorting software

ti: Olivier Besancenot : "Mobilisations lycéennes : une revitalité démocratique"
s: Olivier Besancenot appeared on BFM TV on 9 October 2026 to discuss high school and student mobilisations occurring at the start of the presidential campaign.

ti: Olivier Besancenot : "Les colères vont se cristalliser"
s: Olivier Besancenot appeared on C ce Soir on 6 October 2026 to discuss a major day of high school and student mobilization and the future of this youth revolt movement.

q.o: Les colères vont se cristalliser
q.t: The anger will crystallize

ti: Brésil : l’extrême droite progresse, la bataille continue
s: The New Anticapitalist Party issued a statement on the first round of the Brazilian presidential election held on October 4, noting the concerning progress of the far right.

q.o: Le premier tour de l'élection présidentielle brésilienne, le 4 octobre, a été marqué par une progression inquiétante de l'extrême droite.
q.t: The first round of the Brazilian presidential election, on October 4, was marked by a concerning progress of the far right.

ti: À l’EPSM de Caen, les suppressions de lit mettent le personnel debout
s: The New Anticapitalist Party reports on staff mobilization at the Caen public mental health facility against bed closures, where 125 beds have been eliminated between 2013 and 2026 and ten more are scheduled for closure in October with staff reductions.

ti: Colère lycéenne et étudiante : comment développer la mobilisation ?
s: The NPA-Revolutionaries reports on ongoing high school and student mobilizations following massive demonstrations on October 6, with tens of thousands continuing street protests and attempts to structure the movement.

q.o: À peine deux jours après les manifestations massives du 6 octobre, des dizaines de milliers de lycéens et étudiants sont à nouveau descendus dans la rue, et poursuivent leurs tentatives de structuration du mouvement.
q.t: Barely two days after the massive demonstrations of October 6, tens of thousands of high school and university students took to the streets again, and continue their attempts to structure the movement.

q.o: Le gouvernement a peur de l'enracinement de la colère
q.t: The government is afraid of the entrenchment of anger

ti: La jeunesse ouvre la voie, rejoignons-la !
s: The New Anticapitalist Party – Revolutionaries issued a statement supporting youth and student demonstrations that mobilized over 400,000 people on October 6 and grew larger two days later, calling on others to join the movement.

q.o: À deux jours d'affilée, les lycéens, rejoints par une partie de la jeunesse étudiante, ont fait une démonstration de force.
q.t: For two days in a row, high school students, joined by part of the student youth, made a show of force.

q.o: Mardi 6 octobre, c'était plus de 400 000 personnes qui ont manifesté dans le pays : lycéens, mais aussi à leurs côtés des salariés, profs, parents…
q.t: On Tuesday, October 6, more than 400,000 people demonstrated in the country: high school students, but also alongside them workers, teachers, parents...

ti: Lycéens, étudiants, 17 octobre… Pour vivre et non survivre, généralisons la révolte ! — Réunion publique à Paris
s: The New Anticapitalist Party – Revolutionaries is organizing a public meeting in Paris regarding high school and university student revolts that have spread from working-class suburbs and professional schools to over 90% of universities.

q.o: La révolte des lycéens percute toute la société. La réponse de l'État ? Envoyer sa police les réprimer et fermer les établissements, sans succès.
q.t: The high school students' revolt is shaking all of society. The State's response? Send its police to repress them and close the establishments, without success.

q.o: Parti des banlieues populaires, des lycées professionnels et des colonies, le mouvement a gagné les autres lycées et plus de 90% des universités.
q.t: Starting from working-class suburbs, professional high schools and the colonies, the movement has spread to other high schools and more than 90% of universities.

ti: Sur France 24 — « On ne cherche pas un accord politique » : sur les routes, le NPA en quête de parrainages
s: Selma Labib, designated candidate for the New Anticapitalist Party – Revolutionaries, is traveling on her days off to collect the 500 mayoral endorsements required for the party to participate in an election.

q.o: On ne cherche pas un accord politique
q.t: We are not seeking a political agreement

ti: 10 octobre : manifestation contre le génocide à Gaza et en solidarité avec le peuple palestinien !
s: France Unbowed calls for participation in a demonstration on 10 October 2026 in Paris against what it terms genocide in Gaza and in solidarity with the Palestinian people, demanding sanctions against Israel and cessation of arms trade.

q.o: Samedi 10 octobre, la France insoumise appelle à participer à la manifestation contre le génocide à Gaza et en soutien avec le peuple palestinien.
q.t: Saturday 10 October, France Unbowed calls for participation in the demonstration against the genocide in Gaza and in support of the Palestinian people.

q.o: Nous exigeons des actions fortes et immédiates de la France : Des sanctions contre Israël, dont la suspension immédiate de l'accord d'association entre l'Union européenne et Israël.
q.t: We demand strong and immediate actions from France: Sanctions against Israel, including the immediate suspension of the association agreement between the European Union and Israel.

q.o: L'arrêt du commerce d'armes avec Israël, l'interdiction de toute livraison d'armes ou de composants militaires à Israël, l'arrêt du transit des armes vers Israël par les ports français
q.t: The cessation of arms trade with Israel, the prohibition of any delivery of arms or military components to Israel, the cessation of arms transit to Israel through French ports

ti: Retrait de l’Allemagne du MGCS
s: France Unbowed issued a statement criticizing Emmanuel Macron after Germany withdrew from the MGCS future tank project, claiming the party had predicted this outcome years ago and calling for a sovereign, non-aligned defense policy under Jean-Luc Mélenchon's potential presidency.

q.o: C'est l'épilogue d'un mauvais feuilleton dont la France insoumise avait annoncé le dénouement il y a déjà plusieurs années.
q.t: This is the epilogue of a bad soap opera whose outcome France Unbowed had announced several years ago.

q.o: Aveugle volontaire et obstiné, Emmanuel Macron aura été dupé par des dirigeants allemands froids et déloyaux.
q.t: Willfully and stubbornly blind, Emmanuel Macron will have been duped by cold and disloyal German leaders.

q.o: Il faut en tirer toute les conséquences pour l'avenir et admettre que notre partenaire d'outre-Rhin est travaillé par des aspirations hégémoniques que les récents succès des néo-nazis rendent particulièrement préoccupantes.
q.t: We must draw all the consequences for the future and admit that our partner across the Rhine is driven by hegemonic aspirations that the recent successes of neo-Nazis make particularly worrying.

q.o: Avec Jean-Luc Mélenchon pour président, la France s'emploiera à consolider une défense souveraine, crédible non-alignée au service de la paix.
q.t: With Jean-Luc Mélenchon as president, France will work to consolidate a sovereign, credible, non-aligned defense in the service of peace.

ti: Ce 8 octobre, grande mobilisation en soutien aux lycéen·nes et étudiant·es !
s: France Unbowed announces continued support and participation in youth mobilisations on 8 October and 13 October, demanding improved study conditions, staff recruitment, abolition of Parcoursup, and one-euro meals for all students.

q.o: Son accueil si chaleureux dans les cortèges par les plus jeunes témoigne de l'osmose entre la jeunesse du pays et le mouvement insoumis.
q.t: His warm welcome in the marches by the youngest testifies to the osmosis between the country's youth and the insoumis movement.

q.o: La France insoumise soutient pleinement cet appel et annonce être présente à leurs côtés, autant pour les soutenir dans leurs revendications que pour les protéger face à la lourde répression du gouvernement.
q.t: France Unbowed fully supports this call and announces it will be present at their side, both to support them in their demands and to protect them against the heavy repression of the government.

ti: Niche 2026 - En finir avec les amendes abusives
s: France Unbowed proposes to abolish fixed-penalty fines for criminal offenses, arguing they enable police arbitrariness and disproportionately affect precarious and racialized young men, creating debt spirals.

q.o: Le développement des amendes forfaitaires délictuelles ces dernières années accompagne la politique pénale répressive et autoritaire de la macronie.
q.t: The development of fixed-penalty fines for criminal offenses in recent years accompanies the repressive and authoritarian penal policy of Macronism.

q.o: Nous proposons donc de supprimer les amendes forfaitaires délictuelles.
q.t: We therefore propose to abolish fixed-penalty fines for criminal offenses.

ti: Niche 2026 - Défiscaliser les pensions alimentaires perçues
s: France Unbowed presents a bill to exempt child support payments received by custodial parents from taxation, index pensions to inflation, and strengthen family support allowances, addressing precarity of single-parent families.

q.o: Aujourd'hui, en plus d'être trop faible (200 euros en moyenne quand un enfant coûte 750 euros) la pension est déduite des revenus du parent qui la verse, mais imposée chez le parent qui la reçoit, dans l'écrasante majorité des cas, la mère.
q.t: Today, in addition to being too low (200 euros on average when a child costs 750 euros), the pension is deducted from the income of the parent who pays it, but taxed for the parent who receives it, in the overwhelming majority of cases, the mother.

q.o: Lors de notre précédente niche, l'obstruction de l'extrême droite nous avait retardé l'examen du texte.
q.t: During our previous niche session, the obstruction of the far right had delayed our examination of the text.

q.o: Portée par la mobilisation des collectifs de mamans solo, cette proposition de loi fait de la pension alimentaire ce qu'elle doit être, un droit de l'enfant.
q.t: Supported by the mobilization of single mother collectives, this bill makes child support what it should be, a right of the child.

ti: Niche 2026 - Moratoire sur le mégacanal Seine-nord
s: France Unbowed proposes a bill establishing a 10-year moratorium on the Seine-Nord Europe mega-canal project, citing ecological concerns including threats to agricultural land, wetlands, biodiversity, and water resources.

q.o: Notre proposition de loi instaure un moratoire de 10 ans sur le méga-canal Seine-Nord Europe, projet vieux de plus de 40 ans, en contradiction avec l'urgence écologique.
q.t: Our bill establishes a 10-year moratorium on the Seine-Nord Europe mega-canal, a project over 40 years old, in contradiction with the ecological emergency.

q.o: Sur 107 kilomètres, ce chantier menace terres agricoles, zones humides, biodiversité et ressource en eau, avec 35 millions de m³ d'eau mobilisés, pour un coût pouvant dépasser 10 milliards d'euros.
q.t: Over 107 kilometers, this project threatens agricultural land, wetlands, biodiversity and water resources, with 35 million m³ of water mobilized, for a cost that could exceed 10 billion euros.

q.o: Pour notre niche parlementaire, nous proposons donc de mettre ce chantier à l'arrêt en suspendant travaux, études, opérations foncières et autorisations.
q.t: For our parliamentary niche, we therefore propose to halt this project by suspending works, studies, land operations and authorizations.

ti: Niche 2026 - Rétablir le droit commun de la propriété en Outre-mer
s: France Unbowed proposes to repeal 2024 legislation that reduced the acquisitive prescription period to 10 years in overseas territories, arguing it exposes modest families to land dispossession by speculators and demanding a return to common law.

q.o: En 2024, sans concertation, la prescription acquisitive a été ramenée à 10 ans en outre-mer (contre 30 ans ailleurs).
q.t: In 2024, without consultation, the acquisitive prescription was reduced to 10 years in overseas territories (compared to 30 years elsewhere).

q.o: Faciliter les sorties d'indivision est nécessaire, mais pas au prix de la dépossession des plus fragiles. Nous demandons donc l'abrogation de ces deux mesures et le retour au droit commun.
q.t: Facilitating exits from joint ownership is necessary, but not at the cost of dispossessing the most vulnerable. We therefore demand the repeal of these two measures and a return to common law.

ti: Niche parlementaire LFI 2026
s: France Unbowed announces twelve legislative proposals for their parliamentary niche day on October 29, 2026, including raising minimum wage to 1700 euros net, creating civil servant positions for disabled student accompaniment, and opposing government budget cuts of 43 billion euros.

q.o: Ce jeudi 29 octobre 2026 aura lieu la dernière niche du groupe parlementaire La France insoumise avant l'entrée de l'insoumission à l'Elysée.
q.t: This Thursday, October 29, 2026 will be the last niche of the France Unbowed parliamentary group before the entry of insoumission into the Élysée.

q.o: Nous proposerons ainsi un texte pour augmenter le salaire minimum à 1700 euros net, augmenter les pensions et indexer les salaires sur l'inflation.
q.t: We will thus propose a text to increase the minimum wage to 1700 euros net, increase pensions and index wages to inflation.

q.o: Désormais, alors que tous les services publics s'effondrent, alors que les fonctionnaires, les pompiers, les lycéens, les étudiants et les professeurs crient leur colère, la Macronie annonce un nouveau budget cruel de 43 milliards de coupes
q.t: Now, while all public services are collapsing, while civil servants, firefighters, high school students, university students and teachers cry out their anger, the Macronie announces a new cruel budget of 43 billion in cuts

ti: DENK |
s: DENK's website presents the party's core platform advocating for equal opportunities, fighting racism and discrimination, tackling poverty, and fairer wealth distribution in the Netherlands, while listing its three current Members of Parliament.

q.o: Wij strijden voor een Nederland waarin iedereen meetelt. Een land waar racisme en discriminatie worden bestreden, armoede actief wordt aangepakt en welvaart eerlijker wordt verdeeld.
q.t: We fight for a Netherlands in which everyone counts. A country where racism and discrimination are combated, poverty is actively tackled and prosperity is distributed more fairly.

q.o: Je afkomst, geloof, huidskleur, achternaam, inkomen of de wijk waarin je opgroeit mogen nooit bepalen welke kansen je krijgt.
q.t: Your origin, faith, skin color, surname, income or the neighborhood in which you grow up should never determine what opportunities you get.

ti: Elezioni: con approvazione legge popolo torna sovrano
s: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announces the definitive approval of a new electoral law that reintroduces preference voting after over thirty years, introduces out-of-residence voting for students and workers, and aims to ensure governmental stability.

q.o: Con l'approvazione definitiva della nuova legge elettorale, quando gli italiani torneranno a votare potranno scegliere tutto: il partito, la coalizione, il programma, il candidato premier e – di nuovo – il proprio parlamentare.
q.t: With the definitive approval of the new electoral law, when Italians return to vote they will be able to choose everything: the party, the coalition, the program, the prime ministerial candidate and – again – their own parliamentarian.

q.o: Il centrodestra reintroduce il voto di preferenza, che mancava da oltre trent'anni, restituendo ai cittadini il potere di scegliere direttamente chi li rappresenta.
q.t: The center-right reintroduces preference voting, which had been missing for over thirty years, returning to citizens the power to directly choose who represents them.

q.o: E a chi sperava di vedere il centrodestra diviso, oggi rispondiamo con i fatti: siamo uniti, compatti e determinati a portare avanti gli impegni presi con i cittadini.
q.t: And to those who hoped to see the center-right divided, today we respond with facts: we are united, compact and determined to carry forward the commitments made to citizens.

ti: Sanità: aumenti fino a 560 euro per personale medico
s: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announced contract renewal for healthcare workers bringing average monthly increases of 393 euros for over 137,000 medical personnel, with potential total increases up to 560 euros.

q.o: Un altro passo concreto per valorizzare chi ogni giorno si prende cura della salute degli italiani. Con il rinnovo del contratto 2025-2027 dell'Area Sanità, che riguarda oltre 137 mila medici e dirigenti sanitari, arrivano aumenti medi di 393 euro al mese per 13 mensilità, ai quali possono aggiungersi ulteriori risorse previste dalla legge, fino a un incremento complessivo di circa 560 euro.
q.t: Another concrete step to value those who every day take care of the health of Italians. With the renewal of the 2025-2027 contract for the Health Area, which concerns over 137 thousand doctors and health managers, average increases of 393 euros per month for 13 months are coming, to which additional resources provided by law can be added, up to a total increase of about 560 euros.

q.o: Continuiamo a investire sulle professionalità del nostro Servizio sanitario nazionale, riconoscendo il lavoro, le competenze e le responsabilità di chi ogni giorno garantisce assistenza e cure ai cittadini.
q.t: We continue to invest in the professionalism of our National Health Service, recognizing the work, skills and responsibilities of those who every day guarantee assistance and care to citizens.

ti: Elezioni: voto fuorisede anche per caregiver. Incomprensibile astensione sinistra
s: Brothers of Italy deputies criticized the opposition's abstention on Article 8 of the electoral law, which passed with center-right support and allows Italians to vote outside their residence for reasons including study, work, and caregiving for sick or disabled family members.

q.o: L'astensione dell'articolo 8 della legge elettorale da parte dell'opposizione è un gesto incomprensibile e non curante delle esigenze di moltissimi nostri concittadini.
q.t: The opposition's abstention on Article 8 of the electoral law is an incomprehensible gesture that is uncaring toward the needs of very many of our fellow citizens.

q.o: Sono fiero che grazie a Fratelli d'Italia ora finalmente anche gli studenti fuorisede potranno finalmente votare ed esprimere le proprie posizioni politiche.
q.t: I am proud that thanks to Brothers of Italy, now finally students living away from home will finally be able to vote and express their political positions.

q.o: Scegliere la via dell'astensione su temi che toccano direttamente le famiglie, la fragilità e il diritto costituzionale al voto significa voltare le spalle a chi ogni giorno affronta prove durissime.
q.t: Choosing the path of abstention on issues that directly affect families, fragility, and the constitutional right to vote means turning one's back on those who face the harshest trials every day.

ti: 7 ottobre: ricordiamo vittime barbarie Hamas
s: On the third anniversary of the 7 October 2023 Hamas attacks, the Italian government issued a statement commemorating victims, condemning antisemitism, expressing concern for Palestinian civilian suffering in Gaza and the West Bank, and reaffirming commitment to a two-state solution.

q.o: Tre anni fa, il 7 ottobre 2023, gli attacchi terroristici di Hamas massacravano uomini, donne e bambini, aggredivano giovani riuniti per ascoltare musica, strappavano persone innocenti alle loro famiglie per trascinarle nella prigionia.
q.t: Three years ago, on 7 October 2023, Hamas terrorist attacks massacred men, women and children, attacked young people gathered to listen to music, tore innocent people from their families to drag them into captivity.

q.o: Nessuna causa può giustificare il massacro deliberato di innocenti.
q.t: No cause can justify the deliberate massacre of innocents.

q.o: Proprio in nome della tutela di tutta la popolazione civile coinvolta, non possiamo restare indifferenti davanti alle drammatiche e inaccettabili sofferenze degli abitanti di Gaza o alla violenza crescente di cui sono vittime i civili palestinesi in Cisgiordania.
q.t: Precisely in the name of protecting all the civilian population involved, we cannot remain indifferent to the dramatic and unacceptable suffering of the inhabitants of Gaza or to the growing violence of which Palestinian civilians in the West Bank are victims.

q.o: L'Italia continuerà a lavorare per una pace che garantisca agli israeliani sicurezza e ai palestinesi un futuro di libertà e dignità, nella prospettiva di due Stati che vivano l'uno accanto all'altro all'interno di confini riconosciuti.
q.t: Italy will continue to work for a peace that guarantees Israelis security and Palestinians a future of freedom and dignity, with the prospect of two States living side by side within recognized borders.

ti: Covid: commissario smaltimento materiale riparerà danni sinistra
s: Brothers of Italy senator Antonella Zedda criticizes the previous Conte-Arcuri government's COVID-19 procurement as wasteful, citing 3.5 billion unused masks and expired materials, and states the Meloni government is appointing a commissioner to dispose of stockpiled materials.

q.o: Il tentativo della sinistra di ribaltare la verità non conosce pudore né vergogna. I fatti sono incontestabili: la fallimentare gestione del Covid da parte del duo Arcuri-Conte è costata e continua a costare miliardi di euro di soldi pubblici.
q.t: The left's attempt to overturn the truth knows no shame or embarrassment. The facts are incontestable: the failed management of Covid by the Arcuri-Conte duo has cost and continues to cost billions of euros of public money.

q.o: Solo a titolo d'esempio, i recenti lavori della commissione Covid hanno accertato che 3,5 miliardi di mascherine sono state acquistate e poi inutilizzate, senza dimenticare una mole immensa di materiale sdoganato già scaduto.
q.t: Just as an example, the recent work of the Covid commission has established that 3.5 billion masks were purchased and then unused, not to mention an immense amount of material cleared through customs already expired.

q.o: Il governo Meloni sta tentando ora di riparare i danni attraverso un commissario ad hoc che dovrà smaltire tutto questo materiale presente nei magazzini.
q.t: The Meloni government is now attempting to repair the damage through an ad hoc commissioner who will have to dispose of all this material present in the warehouses.

ti: Economia: Italia recupera potere d’acquisto, strada è quella giusta
s: Brothers of Italy representatives claim ECB economist Philip Lane's projections validate the government's economic policies, stating Italian wages will outpace inflation in 2027-2028 due to fiscal wedge cuts and reduced income tax.

q.o: Le parole del capo economista della Bce, Philip Lane, sono una fotografia chiara: l'economia italiana ha una solidità di fondo che consentirà ai salari di crescere più dell'inflazione nel 2027 e nel 2028, con un miglioramento concreto del tenore di vita per le famiglie. Non lo dice il governo, lo dice Francoforte.
q.t: The words of the ECB's chief economist, Philip Lane, are a clear picture: the Italian economy has a fundamental solidity that will allow wages to grow more than inflation in 2027 and 2028, with a concrete improvement in the standard of living for families. The government doesn't say it, Frankfurt says it.

q.o: La sinistra continua a raccontare un'Italia peggiore di quella reale per puro calcolo elettorale, ma i successi del governo l'hanno già smentita e continueranno a farlo
q.t: The left continues to portray an Italy worse than the real one for pure electoral calculation, but the government's successes have already disproved them and will continue to do so

q.o: Quando l'economia regge, i salari possono tornare a crescere più dei prezzi. Le proiezioni della Bce indicano infatti per l'Italia un recupero del potere d'acquisto nel 2027 e nel 2028.
q.t: When the economy holds up, wages can grow more than prices again. The ECB's projections indeed indicate a recovery of purchasing power for Italy in 2027 and 2028.

ti: Lavoro: intervento governo evita licenziamenti Ericsonn ed Elettrolux
s: Brothers of Italy representatives praised Prime Minister Meloni's direct intervention with Ericsson that halted collective dismissal procedures affecting 131 workers, and Minister Urso's mediation with Electrolux that led to withdrawal of unilateral layoffs and a new 90-million-euro investment plan.

q.o: Apprendiamo con sollievo dell'intervento diretto del presidente Meloni con Ericsson. Una telefonata che reso possibile il blocco della procedura di licenziamento collettivo salvando il posto di lavoro di 131 persone e delle loro famiglie.
q.t: We learn with relief of President Meloni's direct intervention with Ericsson. A phone call that made possible the blocking of the collective dismissal procedure, saving the jobs of 131 people and their families.
q.sp: Matteo Rosso, Maria Grazia Frijia, Gianni Berrino

q.o: Tutti coloro che in queste settimane hanno gridato all'immobilismo del governo oggi devono chiedere scusa tanto per Ericsson quanto per Electrolux due aziende su cui l'impegno dell'esecutivo è stato determinante.
q.t: All those who in recent weeks have cried out about the government's immobility today must apologize both for Ericsson and for Electrolux, two companies where the executive's commitment has been decisive.
q.sp: Matteo Rosso, Maria Grazia Frijia, Gianni Berrino

q.o: Grazie al ministro Adolfo Urso per il lavoro svolto e per aver mantenuto aperto un confronto concreto tra azienda, Governo, Regioni e parti sociali.
q.t: Thanks to Minister Adolfo Urso for the work done and for having kept open a concrete dialogue between the company, Government, Regions and social partners.

ti: Pesca: con ‘cambiale azzurra’ 10 milioni per liquidità imprese
s: Minister Francesco Lollobrigida announced the 'Cambiale Azzurra' program providing 10 million euros in zero-interest financing to fishing and aquaculture businesses, with loans up to 20,000-60,000 euros per enterprise, applications open October 13-30 via Ismea portal.

q.o: Grazie a la Cambiale Azzurra, un intervento che abbiamo previsto in queste ore, garantiremo liquidità alle imprese di pesca e acquacoltura. Con un investimento di 10 milioni di euro chi verrà ammesso potrà accedere a finanziamenti fino a 20.000 euro, per un massimo di 60.000 euro per imprese o cooperative armatoriali con più imbarcazioni.
q.t: Thanks to the Cambiale Azzurra, an intervention we have planned in these hours, we will guarantee liquidity to fishing and aquaculture businesses. With an investment of 10 million euros, those admitted will be able to access financing up to 20,000 euros, for a maximum of 60,000 euros for businesses or shipowner cooperatives with multiple vessels.

q.o: Questo provvedimento rappresenta un altro tassello del lavoro che stiamo portando avanti per sostenere la pesca italiana: più liquidità, più strumenti, più sostegno alle imprese.
q.t: This measure represents another piece of the work we are carrying forward to support Italian fishing: more liquidity, more tools, more support for businesses.

ti: Ex ILVA, il PCI: “Nazionalizzare per tutelare lavoro, salute e ambiente”
s: The Italian Communist Party proposes full nationalization of the ex-ILVA steel plant in Taranto, demanding the government abandon privatization plans and implement a comprehensive industrial transformation including pollution controls, job protection, and economic diversification.

q.o: Nazionalizzare per tutelare lavoro, salute e ambiente
q.t: Nationalize to protect work, health and environment

q.o: La contrapposizione tra occupazione e tutela della salute non è inevitabile: è il risultato di scelte politiche che possono e devono essere superate.
q.t: The opposition between employment and health protection is not inevitable: it is the result of political choices that can and must be overcome.

q.o: Taranto non ha bisogno di un nuovo proprietario, di un altro rinvio o dell'ennesima promessa: ha bisogno di uno Stato che torni a decidere, pianificare e investire.
q.t: Taranto does not need a new owner, another postponement or yet another promise: it needs a State that returns to deciding, planning and investing.

ti: PCI: Melonellum, le ombre della legge Acerbo e i rischi per la democrazia. DIFENDIAMO LA COSTITUZIONE!
s: The Italian Communist Party condemns the proposed electoral law (dubbed 'Melonellum') as unconstitutional, drawing parallels to the 1923 Acerbo law that facilitated fascism, and pledges to defend the Constitution through political and legal challenges.

q.o: Le similitudini con la legge Acerbo del 1923 non possono essere liquidate come un semplice richiamo storico. Quella legge assegnava i due terzi dei seggi alla lista più votata che avesse superato il 25% dei voti validi, contribuendo a consegnare al fascismo una maggioranza parlamentare schiacciante dopo le elezioni del 1924.
q.t: The similarities with the Acerbo law of 1923 cannot be dismissed as a simple historical reference. That law assigned two-thirds of the seats to the most-voted list that exceeded 25% of valid votes, contributing to delivering to fascism an overwhelming parliamentary majority after the 1924 elections.

q.o: Il PCI non accetterà che il pluralismo venga sacrificato sull'altare della governabilità o che la sovranità popolare venga svuotata da regole costruite a vantaggio di chi detiene già il potere.
q.t: The PCI will not accept that pluralism be sacrificed on the altar of governability or that popular sovereignty be emptied by rules constructed to advantage those who already hold power.

q.o: La Costituzione non è un ostacolo da aggirare, il Parlamento non è un notaio del Governo e il voto dei cittadini non è una cambiale in bianco per chi vince le elezioni.
q.t: The Constitution is not an obstacle to be circumvented, Parliament is not a notary of the Government, and the vote of citizens is not a blank check for whoever wins the elections.

ti: La Settimana Leghista #40
s: League newsletter reports multiple party activities including activation of housing support for separated parents, European Parliament resolution against Islamist networks, opposition to Islamic arbitration chamber in Padua, support for Silvia Sardone as Milan mayoral candidate with proposed primaries, and proposal for 5 billion euro contribution from banks and insurance companies.

q.o: La nostra battaglia contro chiunque voglia imporre la Sharia in Italia sarà senza quartiere: nel nostro Paese esiste una sola legge, quella italiana.
q.t: Our battle against anyone who wants to impose Sharia in Italy will be without quarter: in our country there exists only one law, the Italian one.

q.o: Per anni Bruxelles ha aperto le porte alle reti islamiste, concedendo spazio, legittimità e finanziamenti. Ora, con la risoluzione approvata dal Parlamento europeo, chiediamo di chiuderle una volta per tutte
q.t: For years Brussels has opened the doors to Islamist networks, granting space, legitimacy and funding. Now, with the resolution approved by the European Parliament, we ask to close them once and for all

q.o: Potremmo anche essere più ambiziosi e aspettarci almeno 5 miliardi
q.t: We could also be more ambitious and expect at least 5 billion

q.o: Lasciamo che siano i Milanesi a decidere chi sarà il miglior Sindaco per rilanciare la città. Se non ci riescono i partiti, saranno i cittadini di tutti i quartieri, con le primarie, a fare la scelta migliore.
q.t: Let the Milanese decide who will be the best Mayor to relaunch the city. If the parties cannot do it, the citizens of all neighborhoods, with primaries, will make the best choice.

q.o: La SHARIA anche in Italia? Assolutamente NO. In Italia non possono esistere 'tribunali islamici' né leggi parallele: esistono, e tutti devono rispettare, solo le leggi italiane.
q.t: SHARIA also in Italy? Absolutely NO. In Italy there cannot exist 'Islamic tribunals' nor parallel laws: there exist, and everyone must respect, only Italian laws.

ti: “Our second best ever by-election result” – Zack Polanski reacts to Holborn and St Pancras by-election
s: Green Party Leader Zack Polanski achieved the party's second-best parliamentary by-election result ever in Holborn and St Pancras, receiving 33% of the vote and more than tripling the 2024 vote share, while Labour's Sagal Abdi-Wali won the seat vacated by former PM Keir Starmer.

q.o: What will really stick with me from this campaign is all the amazing people I've met.
q.t: What will really stick with me from this campaign is all the amazing people I've met.

q.o: I knew we had a good chance of taking a run at the seat, and in fact what we got was the second best ever by-election result in Green Party history.
q.t: I knew we had a good chance of taking a run at the seat, and in fact what we got was the second best ever by-election result in Green Party history.

q.o: People voted Green and then we moved Labour.
q.t: People voted Green and then we moved Labour.

q.o: I always said that part of my mission was to make the Labour government more worried about the Green Party than Reform. Mission achieved.
q.t: I always said that part of my mission was to make the Labour government more worried about the Green Party than Reform. Mission achieved.

q.o: The real question now – and no-one know the answer to this – is: Does Andy Burnham really want to end neoliberalism?
q.t: The real question now – and no-one know the answer to this – is: Does Andy Burnham really want to end neoliberalism?

q.o: What we're seeing is rhetoric. What we're not yet seeing is action.
q.t: What we're seeing is rhetoric. What we're not yet seeing is action.

ti: Greens respond to Holborn and St Pancras by-election result
s: The Green Party achieved a 22% vote share increase in the Holborn and St Pancras by-election compared to the General Election, finishing second in a Labour safe seat, and stated this demonstrates voter demand for rent controls, water renationalisation, Palestinian justice, and opposition to North Sea drilling.

q.o: Achieving a huge swing in one of Labour's safest seats – an increase of 22% in vote share since the General Election – is an incredible result for the Green Party, and during a honeymoon period for the new PM.
q.t: Achieving a huge swing in one of Labour's safest seats – an increase of 22% in vote share since the General Election – is an incredible result for the Green Party, and during a honeymoon period for the new PM.

q.o: We are disappointed to miss out tonight but any ideas of a return to the cosy two party system is just wishful thinking on the part of the establishment.
q.t: We are disappointed to miss out tonight but any ideas of a return to the cosy two party system is just wishful thinking on the part of the establishment.

q.o: They want real change, they want rent controls, they want to see an end to the privatised water rip off and they want to see justice for Palestinians.
q.t: They want real change, they want rent controls, they want to see an end to the privatised water rip off and they want to see justice for Palestinians.

q.o: On the climate crisis, Labour will not have an easy political ride if they bring in new North Sea drilling.
q.t: On the climate crisis, Labour will not have an easy political ride if they bring in new North Sea drilling.

ti: Green Party close of polls statement
s: Green Party spokesperson issued a statement as polls closed in the Holborn and St Pancras by-election, thanking volunteers and stating the party would pressure the Labour government on rent controls, water nationalisation and climate issues regardless of the result.

q.o: Zack would like to thank the thousands of volunteers who helped him in this campaign and the warm reception he received throughout the campaign from the people of Holborn and St Pancras.
q.t: Zack would like to thank the thousands of volunteers who helped him in this campaign and the warm reception he received throughout the campaign from the people of Holborn and St Pancras.

q.o: He would also like to pay tribute to Sagal, for a respectful campaign and for rising above the appalling racism she has had to endure. Despite our political differences, we stand in solidarity with you.
q.t: He would also like to pay tribute to Sagal, for a respectful campaign and for rising above the appalling racism she has had to endure. Despite our political differences, we stand in solidarity with you.

q.o: We know that many want to give the new Prime Minister a chance and for the Greens to keep them on a progressive track, on issues like rent controls, water nationalisation and the climate crisis.
q.t: We know that many want to give the new Prime Minister a chance and for the Greens to keep them on a progressive track, on issues like rent controls, water nationalisation and the climate crisis.

ti: Greens slam Conservatives as “pro-billionaires, pro-inequality and pro-damaging the environment”
s: Green MP Carla Denyer criticized Kemi Badenoch's Conservative Party conference speech, accusing the Conservatives of favoring billionaires and inequality while the Green Party promotes wealth taxes, rent controls, higher minimum wage, home insulation, and renewable energy.

q.o: Today Kemi Badenoch once again defined the Conservative Party as pro-billionaires, pro-inequality and pro-damaging the environment.
q.t: Today Kemi Badenoch once again defined the Conservative Party as pro-billionaires, pro-inequality and pro-damaging the environment.

q.o: However much money you throw at it, you cannot have national security without action on the climate crisis. You cannot make this country fairer while you continue to favour the super-wealthy over ordinary working people, and you will not help young people into work by removing worker protections and support.
q.t: However much money you throw at it, you cannot have national security without action on the climate crisis. You cannot make this country fairer while you continue to favour the super-wealthy over ordinary working people, and you will not help young people into work by removing worker protections and support.

q.o: Only the Green Party has the policies to address inequality, through taxes on wealth; tackle the cost of living crisis with rent controls and raising the minimum wage; and fight climate breakdown through a nationwide home insulation programme and turbocharging renewable energy generation.
q.t: Only the Green Party has the policies to address inequality, through taxes on wealth; tackle the cost of living crisis with rent controls and raising the minimum wage; and fight climate breakdown through a nationwide home insulation programme and turbocharging renewable energy generation.

ti: “Small tweaks won’t cut it” on energy bills, say Greens
s: Green Party Westminster Leader Ellie Chowns responded to reports of Chancellor's budget measures on energy bills by calling for scaling up renewable energy, ending energy company profiteering, public ownership of energy, home insulation, decoupling gas and electricity prices, and scrapping North Sea oil and gas drilling plans.

q.o: It should not take 'forecasts' to tell the government that families cannot cope with spiralling energy costs; speak to anyone and they will tell you we're all being ripped off.
q.t: It should not take 'forecasts' to tell the government that families cannot cope with spiralling energy costs; speak to anyone and they will tell you we're all being ripped off.

q.o: Small tweaks won't cut it. To bring down bills for good, we need to scale up renewable energy, end rampant profiteering by energy giants and bring energy back into public hands, insulate homes properly, and fully decouple the price of gas from electricity.
q.t: Small tweaks won't cut it. To bring down bills for good, we need to scale up renewable energy, end rampant profiteering by energy giants and bring energy back into public hands, insulate homes properly, and fully decouple the price of gas from electricity.

q.o: And the government must commit to scrapping any plans it has for new oil and gas drilling in the North Sea, which will do nothing to bring down bills and will only add fuel to the fire of the climate emergency.
q.t: And the government must commit to scrapping any plans it has for new oil and gas drilling in the North Sea, which will do nothing to bring down bills and will only add fuel to the fire of the climate emergency.

ti: Green Party reaction to ‘Britannia Shield’ defence system proposal
s: Green Party defence spokesperson Ellie Chowns MP criticised Conservative plans for a £10bn 'Britannia Shield' defence system, calling it political posturing with inadequate scrutiny, funded by cuts to benefits and disability support, and argued genuine security requires focus on cyber-attacks, pandemics, and climate breakdown instead.

q.o: The Conservatives' announcement of £10bn over 10 years on a 'Britannia Shield' is political posturing and picking round numbers out of a hat to make conference headlines.
q.t: The Conservatives' announcement of £10bn over 10 years on a 'Britannia Shield' is political posturing and picking round numbers out of a hat to make conference headlines.

q.o: And once again, the Tories would go after the most vulnerable in society to fund their militarism, cutting billions in benefits, reimposing the two-child benefit cap, and steering funds away from a scheme funding cars for disabled people.
q.t: And once again, the Tories would go after the most vulnerable in society to fund their militarism, cutting billions in benefits, reimposing the two-child benefit cap, and steering funds away from a scheme funding cars for disabled people.

q.o: Genuine security is about far more than weapons systems. We need to look at countering cyber-attacks and being prepared for pandemics, which as we know can kill millions of people. Above all we need to address the security risks posed by climate breakdown, loss of nature and ecosystem collapse.
q.t: Genuine security is about far more than weapons systems. We need to look at countering cyber-attacks and being prepared for pandemics, which as we know can kill millions of people. Above all we need to address the security risks posed by climate breakdown, loss of nature and ecosystem collapse.

ti: Zack Polanski reaction to Zionism is racism motion
s: Green Party leader Zack Polanski issued a statement responding to a motion on Zionism and racism, emphasizing the distinction between antisemitism and criticism of Israel, defending the party's position on Palestinian rights, and affirming his commitment to inclusivity while noting recent government policy shifts on Israeli settlements.

q.o: Antisemitism and criticism of the Israeli state are, and must always be, completely distinct – blurring the line between the two is not only wrong but antisemitic, and makes Jewish people less safe.
q.t: Antisemitism and criticism of the Israeli state are, and must always be, completely distinct – blurring the line between the two is not only wrong but antisemitic, and makes Jewish people less safe.

q.o: As leader I will not accept any exclusion, or refusal to engage with anyone, because of the religious or communal body they are part of.
q.t: As leader I will not accept any exclusion, or refusal to engage with anyone, because of the religious or communal body they are part of.

q.o: Through the Green Party's unified stance and dedicated pressure, we have begun to shift this government away from its complicity with the Israeli government's atrocities in Gaza, with the Foreign Secretary now taking the long overdue step of ending trade with illegal settlements.
q.t: Through the Green Party's unified stance and dedicated pressure, we have begun to shift this government away from its complicity with the Israeli government's atrocities in Gaza, with the Foreign Secretary now taking the long overdue step of ending trade with illegal settlements.

ti: Green reaction to Conservatives “bonfire of environmental standards”
s: Green Party parliamentary leader Ellie Chowns criticised Conservative proposals to scrap environmental regulations, arguing they weaken climate protection following summer wildfires and falsely blame nature protection for blocking housing development.

q.o: Following the devastating wildfires of the summer, that were a direct result of climate breakdown, the Tories have chosen this moment to make a bonfire of environmental standards, weaken climate protection, and abolish organisations charged with protecting nature.
q.t: Following the devastating wildfires of the summer, that were a direct result of climate breakdown, the Tories have chosen this moment to make a bonfire of environmental standards, weaken climate protection, and abolish organisations charged with protecting nature.

q.o: The Conservatives are also once again pretending that protecting nature is a blocker to building the homes and infrastructure this country desperately needs. It isn't. The real barriers are decades of underinvestment in vital community infrastructure and cruel austerity – the very conditions the Tories seem set to reignite.
q.t: The Conservatives are also once again pretending that protecting nature is a blocker to building the homes and infrastructure this country desperately needs. It isn't. The real barriers are decades of underinvestment in vital community infrastructure and cruel austerity – the very conditions the Tories seem set to reignite.

q.o: The Green Party knows that environmental protection and economic prosperity are not opposing goals. The homes and communities we build today must be fit for the future; that means investing in clean energy, a resilient climate, and genuinely affordable, energy-efficient homes.
q.t: The Green Party knows that environmental protection and economic prosperity are not opposing goals. The homes and communities we build today must be fit for the future; that means investing in clean energy, a resilient climate, and genuinely affordable, energy-efficient homes.

ti: – Nå er det på tide med avgiftskutt
s: Progress Party calls for tax cuts in response to record fuel price increases between August and September.

q.o: Nå er det på tide med avgiftskutt
q.t: Now it is time for tax cuts

ti: – Som å tro på julenissen
s: Progress Party leader Sylvi Listhaug criticizes the Labour Party government's budget, claiming tax cuts are offset by increased electricity price surcharges, and proposes FrP's alternative of tax cuts, halving food VAT, and reducing fuel taxes.

q.o: Å tro at Arbeiderpartiet kutter skatter og avgifter er som å tro på julenissen
q.t: To believe that the Labour Party cuts taxes and fees is like believing in Santa Claus

q.o: Regjeringen har forsøkt å skape et inntrykk av at de gir folk skattelette, men øker avgifter og Norgespris på strøm som gjør at svært mange sitter igjen med mindre i lommeboka. Frp vil kutte skattene, halvere matmomsen og redusere drivstoffavgiftene for å gi folk mer økonomisk handlefrihet
q.t: The government has tried to create an impression that they are giving people tax relief, but increases fees and the Norway price on electricity which means that very many are left with less in their wallet. FrP will cut taxes, halve the food VAT and reduce fuel taxes to give people more economic freedom

ti: Ingen penger til nye politihelikoptre
s: Progress Party justice committee leader Jon Engen-Helgheim criticizes the government's decision not to exercise the option for three new police helicopters intended for Bergen, Tromsø and Trøndelag, calling it a dramatic decision that weakens emergency preparedness particularly in Western and Northern Norway.

q.o: Dette er en dramatisk og overraskende beslutning. Politihelikopter er et helt nødvendig og svært effektivt verktøy som bidrar til langt bedre beredskap
q.t: This is a dramatic and surprising decision. Police helicopters are a completely necessary and very effective tool that contributes to far better emergency preparedness

ti: – En mørk dag for bilistene
s: Progress Party transport spokesperson Bård Hoksrud criticized the government's transport budget for planning to increase toll road revenue collection.

ti: Ingen satsing på eldre og syke i regjeringens budsjett
s: Progress Party health spokesperson Kristian Eilertsen criticizes the government's proposed state budget for failing elderly people, patients, and their relatives.

ti: Arbeidslinja er taperen i statsbudsjettet
s: Progress Party's work policy spokesperson Julia Brännström Nordtug criticizes the state budget, stating that Labour Party fails to get more people into work and that large amounts go to people outside the workforce with fewer people to finance it.

q.o: Ap får ikke flere i jobb med dette budsjettet. Dette er et budsjett hvor de store pengene går til mennesker utenfor arbeidslivet, og med stadig færre folk til å finansiere det
q.t: Labour Party does not get more people into work with this budget. This is a budget where the big money goes to people outside the workforce, and with ever fewer people to finance it

ti: Ap trosser Stortinget og svikter oljearbeiderne
s: Progress Party criticizes the Labour-led government for not allocating funds in the 2027 state budget for oil pioneers or victims and survivors of the Alexander Kielland accident, despite repeated parliamentary decisions.

ti: Kjønnslemlestelse og tvangsekteskap hører ikke hjemme i Norge
s: Fremskrittspartiet proposes eight measures to protect children and youth against forced marriage, female genital mutilation, and involuntary stays abroad, including stricter penalties and revocation of residence permits for those involved in such abuses.

ti: People Power Forced Drumcree U-Turn
s: People Before Profit claims community mobilisation forced the Secretary of State to cancel a contested Orange Order march on Garvaghy Road, criticises the DUP and unionist elites for sectarian division, and calls for a socialist Ireland built by working-class unity across communities.

q.o: This didn't come from the Parades Commission, which folded the moment the DUP and the TUV turned up the pressure. It didn't come from the courts, which made a series of harried decisions through the night. Nor did it come from a Secretary of State who spent nearly a fortnight disingenuously insisting his hands were tied. It came from the community of the Garvaghy Road, as well as thousands of ordinary people standing with them over the past two weeks.
q.t: This didn't come from the Parades Commission, which folded the moment the DUP and the TUV turned up the pressure. It didn't come from the courts, which made a series of harried decisions through the night. Nor did it come from a Secretary of State who spent nearly a fortnight disingenuously insisting his hands were tied. It came from the community of the Garvaghy Road, as well as thousands of ordinary people standing with them over the past two weeks.

q.o: The DUP can't build houses. It can't get people a hospital appointment. It can't deliver a single thing for the communities it claims to speak for. It reaches for sectarian division instead, because division is the only thing it has ever reliably produced.
q.t: The DUP can't build houses. It can't get people a hospital appointment. It can't deliver a single thing for the communities it claims to speak for. It reaches for sectarian division instead, because division is the only thing it has ever reliably produced.

q.o: Not a united Ireland run by the same landlords and developers who run things now, but a socialist Ireland built by working class people - of all backgrounds and from all communities - organised together.
q.t: Not a united Ireland run by the same landlords and developers who run things now, but a socialist Ireland built by working class people - of all backgrounds and from all communities - organised together.

ti: Solidarity with Public Sector Workers
s: People Before Profit issued a statement supporting public sector workers who voted for strike action on pay, calling for 10% pay increases and escalated disruptive action while presenting their 2027 Alternative Budget proposals including pay increases, USC abolition under €100,000, and price caps.

q.o: People Before Profit stands fully behind public sector workers and encourages all workers to get behind their struggle.
q.t: People Before Profit stands fully behind public sector workers and encourages all workers to get behind their struggle.

q.o: Workers need at least 10% just to catch up and stay ahead.
q.t: Workers need at least 10% just to catch up and stay ahead.

q.o: The prospect of an all-out strike that would close down the country would force the government to take the demands of the unions seriously.
q.t: The prospect of an all-out strike that would close down the country would force the government to take the demands of the unions seriously.

ti: Richard Boyd Barrett and Paul Murphy Sign Letter to British Prime Minister - Stop Orange Order’s Sectarian Provocation on Garvaghy Road
s: People Before Profit TDs Richard Boyd Barrett and Paul Murphy signed a letter from Oireachtas members to British Prime Minister Andy Burnham calling on him to use statutory powers to prevent an Orange Order march through the Garvaghy Road community.

q.o: Paul Murphy and I have added my name to a letter to British Prime Minister Andy Burnham calling on him to ensure that the Orange Order is not permitted to march through the Garvaghy Road community.
q.t: Paul Murphy and I have added my name to a letter to British Prime Minister Andy Burnham calling on him to ensure that the Orange Order is not permitted to march through the Garvaghy Road community.

q.o: The attempt by the Orange Order to march on Garvaghy Road has nothing to do with an expression of cultural identity. It is an expression of supremacism undertaken to whip up sectarianism.
q.t: The attempt by the Orange Order to march on Garvaghy Road has nothing to do with an expression of cultural identity. It is an expression of supremacism undertaken to whip up sectarianism.

q.o: The British Government must now finally do what it has failed to do so many times throughout our history - they must stop the Orange Order's sectarian provocation and allow a return of peace to Garvaghy Road.
q.t: The British Government must now finally do what it has failed to do so many times throughout our history - they must stop the Orange Order's sectarian provocation and allow a return of peace to Garvaghy Road.

ti: Paul Murphy Condemns Government Using EU Presidency to Promote Big Tech Profits
s: Paul Murphy TD condemned the Irish Government for using its EU Council Presidency to host an International AI Summit promoting big tech interests, criticised proposed GDPR changes for AI training data, and announced he will join anti-data centre protesters at the RDS event on 14 October.

q.o: Next week's International AI Summit at the RDS demonstrates that the Government continues to use its Presidency of the European Council to represent the interests of big tech.
q.t: Next week's International AI Summit at the RDS demonstrates that the Government continues to use its Presidency of the European Council to represent the interests of big tech.

q.o: We already know that during the EU Presidency the Irish Government is pushing for very disturbing changes to privacy regulations which would mean that current GDPR rules to protect privacy wouldn't apply to personal data as it relates to the training of AI models. This is a grotesque betrayal of ordinary people to feed the insatiable demand of big tech for ever larger profits.
q.t: We already know that during the EU Presidency the Irish Government is pushing for very disturbing changes to privacy regulations which would mean that current GDPR rules to protect privacy wouldn't apply to personal data as it relates to the training of AI models. This is a grotesque betrayal of ordinary people to feed the insatiable demand of big tech for ever larger profits.

q.o: The reality is that AI data centres are the toxic waste of the 21st century, but the government carries on putting itself at the service of big tech regardless of the consequences for the rest of society.
q.t: The reality is that AI data centres are the toxic waste of the 21st century, but the government carries on putting itself at the service of big tech regardless of the consequences for the rest of society.

q.o: Anti-data centre campaigners will protest at the AI event at the RDS at 11am next Wednesday. They say 'Energy Vampires and Job Robbers Not Welcome' and I will stand with them at the protest.
q.t: Anti-data centre campaigners will protest at the AI event at the RDS at 11am next Wednesday. They say 'Energy Vampires and Job Robbers Not Welcome' and I will stand with them at the protest.

ti: Carroll Receives Invite to PSNI Interview: “Standing Up for What’s Right is Never Wrong”
s: Gerry Carroll received an invitation from the PSNI for a voluntary interview under caution regarding peaceful protests on the Garvaghy Road, and defended his participation in the protests against a sectarian march.

q.o: I make no apology for standing with the residents of the Garvaghy Road. For almost three decades, this community has said no to a sectarian march being forced past their homes.
q.t: I make no apology for standing with the residents of the Garvaghy Road. For almost three decades, this community has said no to a sectarian march being forced past their homes.

q.o: The PSNI's operation around Drumcree had already cost more than £3 million by last week. Now the state is pouring yet more resources into pursuing peaceful protesters. While patients wait years for treatment and families sit on housing waiting lists, it says everything about the priorities of those in power.
q.t: The PSNI's operation around Drumcree had already cost more than £3 million by last week. Now the state is pouring yet more resources into pursuing peaceful protesters. While patients wait years for treatment and families sit on housing waiting lists, it says everything about the priorities of those in power.

q.o: Standing up for what's right is never wrong.
q.t: Standing up for what's right is never wrong.

ti: Carroll: Orange Order Should Read the Room and Walk Away
s: Gerry Carroll of People Before Profit called on the Orange Order's Portadown District to withdraw its application to march on Garvaghy Road, citing 28 years of community opposition and recent protests involving tens of thousands, while criticizing unionist leaders and Jamie Bryson for promoting division.

q.o: The Court of Appeal has reserved judgement with no date given, which only prolongs the sense of anxiety felt by the Garvaghy Road community, with no end in sight.
q.t: The Court of Appeal has reserved judgement with no date given, which only prolongs the sense of anxiety felt by the Garvaghy Road community, with no end in sight.

q.o: They have had their answer from that community for 28 years, and they got it again last week when tens of thousands of people from every corner of this island stood on the Garvaghy Road and said no to this unwanted hate march.
q.t: They have had their answer from that community for 28 years, and they got it again last week when tens of thousands of people from every corner of this island stood on the Garvaghy Road and said no to this unwanted hate march.

q.o: 35 men walking a road where nobody wants them will not build a house, shorten a hospital waiting list or put a pound in anyone's pocket - in Portadown or anywhere else. The only thing it delivers is division, and division is the one commodity unionist leaders have never been short of.
q.t: 35 men walking a road where nobody wants them will not build a house, shorten a hospital waiting list or put a pound in anyone's pocket - in Portadown or anywhere else. The only thing it delivers is division, and division is the one commodity unionist leaders have never been short of.

q.o: The Order should withdraw this application and let the people of Portadown get on with their lives in peace.
q.t: The Order should withdraw this application and let the people of Portadown get on with their lives in peace.

ti: We Need An All-Island Health Configuration
s: People Before Profit representative Marc Mac Seáin calls for an all-island health configuration, revocation of the 2016 Bengoa Report, and potential industrial action to prevent cuts to Daisy Hill Hospital's maternity and emergency services.

q.o: We are well down the path of 'Managed Decline', of 'Reform', Centralisation. We need to practically change course, or else Daisy Hill's Emergency Department will be next.
q.t: We are well down the path of 'Managed Decline', of 'Reform', Centralisation. We need to practically change course, or else Daisy Hill's Emergency Department will be next.

q.o: Frankly in People Before Profit we do not think Stormont is fit for purpose. Society in the North of Ireland is crumbling after decades of austerity, underinvestment.
q.t: Frankly in People Before Profit we do not think Stormont is fit for purpose. Society in the North of Ireland is crumbling after decades of austerity, underinvestment.

q.o: 150k workers went on strike in January 2024 to bring Stormont back, and it was returned within weeks. It's done nothing to fix our health service yet our unions should be exploring the possibility of emergency industrial action to force change.
q.t: 150k workers went on strike in January 2024 to bring Stormont back, and it was returned within weeks. It's done nothing to fix our health service yet our unions should be exploring the possibility of emergency industrial action to force change.

q.o: If direct action is required to save Maternity at Daisy Hill, so be it.
q.t: If direct action is required to save Maternity at Daisy Hill, so be it.
