q.t: We urgently need a radical policy change if we do not want to completely destroy our industrial foundations. It would be sensible if responsible politicians would listen to industry representatives instead of chasing ideological fantasies

ti: Sri Lanka nousee vasemmistopolitiikalla – SKP tapasi JVP:n delegaation
s: The Communist Party of Finland met with a delegation from Sri Lanka's ruling communist party JVP, led by Transport Minister Bimal Rathnayake, to discuss JVP's electoral success and Finland's upcoming parliamentary elections.

q.o: Ministeri Rathnayaken mukaan JVP:n ja NPP:n kahden vuoden työn tuloksena Sri Lanka on onnistuttu nostamaan kriisistä.
q.t: According to Minister Rathnayake, as a result of two years of work by JVP and NPP, Sri Lanka has succeeded in rising from the crisis.

q.o: Ministerin mukaan korruptio on kitketty hallituksesta, ja sen vastainen työ muualla hallinnossa ja yhteiskunnassa on tuottanut nopeasti tuloksia.
q.t: According to the minister, corruption has been eradicated from the government, and anti-corruption work elsewhere in the administration and society has quickly produced results.

ti: Koti on ihmisen perusoikeus
s: The Communist Party of Finland's Social and Health Group issued a statement on 14 October 2026 condemning the Orpo government's policies for causing a 20% increase in homelessness and calling for expanded state-funded affordable housing, rent regulation, and raising basic social security to 1,500 euros per month.

q.o: Asunnottomuus on kääntynyt selvään kasvuun Petteri Orpon oikeistohallituksen kaudella.
q.t: Homelessness has turned to clear growth during Petteri Orpo's right-wing government's term.

q.o: Suomessa on työssäkäyviä ihmisiä, jotka joutuvat tinkimään ruuasta selvitäkseen vuokrasta.
q.t: In Finland there are working people who have to cut back on food to manage their rent.

q.o: SKP on esittänyt perusturvan nostamista 1 500 euroon kuukaudessa.
q.t: SKP has proposed raising basic security to 1,500 euros per month.

q.o: Orpon hallituksen politiikka on luokkapolitiikkaa.
q.t: The Orpo government's policy is class politics.

ti: Polisario arvostelee YK:n Länsi-Saharan erityislähettilään puolueellisuutta
s: The Communist Party of Finland published a statement supporting the Polisario Front's criticism of UN Special Envoy Staffan de Mistura for allegedly compromising his neutrality by supporting Morocco's autonomy model for Western Sahara.

q.o: SKP tukee Länsi-Saharan vapaustaistelua.
q.t: SKP supports the liberation struggle of Western Sahara.

ti: Xylella: 30 milioni per rigenerazione olivicola
s: The Italian government allocates 30 million euros for olive cultivation regeneration in Puglia areas affected by Xylella bacteria, with Minister Lollobrigida and Brothers of Italy deputy Cerreto announcing support for farmers and agricultural recovery.

q.o: Il Ministero dell'Agricoltura, della Sovranità alimentare e delle Foreste mette in campo risorse concrete e risposte immediate per sostenere i territori colpiti dalla Xylella e rilanciare l'olivicoltura pugliese.
q.t: The Ministry of Agriculture, Food Sovereignty and Forests is deploying concrete resources and immediate responses to support the territories affected by Xylella and relaunch Puglia's olive cultivation.

q.o: Con lo stanziamento di 30 milioni di euro per la rigenerazione olivicola nelle aree della Puglia colpite dalla Xylella, il governo Meloni dà una risposta concreta agli agricoltori e a un territorio duramente segnato dall'emergenza.
q.t: With the allocation of 30 million euros for olive regeneration in the areas of Puglia affected by Xylella, the Meloni government gives a concrete response to farmers and to a territory severely marked by the emergency.

ti: Istat: povertà in calo, politiche governo efficaci
s: Brothers of Italy senators Guido Liris and Guerino Testa claim that ISTAT data showing poverty declining to 8% in 2025 and risk of poverty or social exclusion falling to 22.6% demonstrate the effectiveness of the Meloni government's policies including employment measures, tax cuts, and family support.

q.o: I dati diffusi oggi dall'Istat confermano che con il governo Meloni la povertà in Italia è in calo. La povertà assoluta è scesa all'8% nel 2025, rispetto all'8,4% del 2024 e all'8,3% del 2022.
q.t: The data released today by ISTAT confirm that under the Meloni government poverty in Italy is declining. Absolute poverty fell to 8% in 2025, compared to 8.4% in 2024 and 8.3% in 2022.

q.o: Sono numeri che smentiscono ancora una volta la narrazione delle opposizioni e dimostrano che le politiche del governo stanno producendo risultati concreti: più occupazione stabile e a tempo pieno, sostegno ai redditi, riduzione dell'Irpef e del cuneo fiscale e misure a favore delle famiglie con figli.
q.t: These are numbers that once again refute the opposition's narrative and demonstrate that the government's policies are producing concrete results: more stable and full-time employment, income support, reduction of IRPEF and the tax wedge, and measures in favor of families with children.

q.o: I dati Istat smentiscono nuovamente le opposizioni: il rischio di povertà ed esclusione sociale scende al 22,6%, minimo storico per le serie Eurostat, registrando un calo sei volte superiore a quello della Spagna e in controtendenza rispetto ai peggioramenti di Francia e Germania.
q.t: The ISTAT data once again refute the opposition: the risk of poverty and social exclusion falls to 22.6%, a historic low for the Eurostat series, recording a decline six times greater than that of Spain and contrary to the worsening trends in France and Germany.

ti: Sanità: legge su assistenti familiari riconosce e sostiene categoria
s: Brothers of Italy announces approval of legislation recognizing family caregivers with tax-exempt contributions up to 400 euros monthly, 257 million euros allocated for 2027 and 260 million annually from 2028, with ISEE threshold raised from 15,000 to 25,000 euros.

q.o: L'approvazione della legge sui caregiver familiari rappresenta una svolta storica per l'Italia e un importante traguardo di civiltà.
q.t: The approval of the law on family caregivers represents a historic turning point for Italy and an important milestone of civilization.

q.o: Grazie al governo Meloni compiamo un passo concreto per dare sostegno alle famiglie, prevedendo misure differenziate in base al carico assistenziale e rafforzando l'attenzione verso chi affronta le situazioni più difficili.
q.t: Thanks to the Meloni government we are taking a concrete step to support families, providing differentiated measures based on care burden and strengthening attention to those facing the most difficult situations.

q.o: Il Governo Meloni ha scelto di accompagnare questo riconoscimento con risorse strutturali: 257 milioni di euro per il 2027 e 260 milioni annui a decorrere dal 2028.
q.t: The Meloni Government has chosen to accompany this recognition with structural resources: 257 million euros for 2027 and 260 million annually starting from 2028.

q.o: Il provvedimento prevede, a partire dal 2027, un contributo esentasse fino a 400 euro mensili per i caregiver familiari prevalenti in possesso dei requisiti previsti, con una soglia Isee che, grazie al lavoro svolto in commissione Affari Sociali, è stata innalzata da 15mila a 25mila euro.
q.t: The measure provides, starting from 2027, a tax-exempt contribution of up to 400 euros monthly for primary family caregivers meeting the required criteria, with an ISEE threshold that, thanks to work done in the Social Affairs committee, has been raised from 15,000 to 25,000 euros.

ti: Energia: Ue sospenda Ets, basta speculazioni su famiglie e imprese
s: Brothers of Italy MP Riccardo Zucconi supports the Meloni government's proposal, alongside the Czech Republic, to suspend the EU ETS system and postpone ETS2 introduction, arguing that CO2 permit speculation harms Italian families and industries without environmental benefit.

q.o: Registriamo con soddisfazione l'azione del governo italiano e del presidente del Consiglio Giorgia Meloni che con chiarezza determinazione ha sollevato in Europa la fondamentale questione del sistema Ets.
q.t: We note with satisfaction the action of the Italian government and Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni who with clarity and determination has raised in Europe the fundamental question of the ETS system.

q.o: I permessi di emissione di CO2, pensati teoricamente per la tutela dell'ambiente, si acquistano sui mercati finanziari e il loro prezzo viene dominato da spregiudicate dinamiche speculative che nulla hanno a che vedere con la transizione ecologica.
q.t: CO2 emission permits, theoretically designed for environmental protection, are purchased on financial markets and their price is dominated by unscrupulous speculative dynamics that have nothing to do with ecological transition.

q.o: È indispensabile dunque sospendere l'attuale sistema Ets, per rivedere il prezzo della CO2 ancorandolo all'economia reale, sia rinviare l'introduzione dell'ETS2 per evitare nuove stangate a danno di famiglie e imprese.
q.t: It is therefore essential to suspend the current ETS system, to revise the price of CO2 by anchoring it to the real economy, and to postpone the introduction of ETS2 to avoid new blows to families and businesses.

ti: Polizia Locale: approvata riforma attesa da decenni
s: The Senate approved a local police reform law that had been awaited for decades, with Brothers of Italy representatives highlighting enhanced protections, access to databases, separate collective bargaining, and uniform training, to be implemented by government decree within 12 months.

q.o: La riforma della polizia locale è legge. Il Senato ha approvato il testo già vagliato dalla Camera.
q.t: The local police reform is law. The Senate has approved the text already examined by the Chamber.

q.o: Il governo Meloni e il ministro Piantedosi portano a termine l'ennesima riforma che nessuno, prima d'ora, aveva avuto il coraggio di approvare.
q.t: The Meloni government and Minister Piantedosi complete yet another reform that no one, until now, had the courage to approve.

q.o: Oggi siamo di fronte a un passaggio parlamentare molto importante: l'approvazione di una riforma attesa da 40 anni.
q.t: Today we are facing a very important parliamentary passage: the approval of a reform awaited for 40 years.

q.o: Il nostro obiettivo è definire la polizia di prossimità, il primo presidio di sicurezza.
q.t: Our objective is to define proximity policing, the first security outpost.

ti: Sanità: da governo risorse record al sistema nazionale
s: Brothers of Italy Senator Franco Zaffini announces government funding for the National Health Fund will increase from 141.5 billion euros in 2025 to 160 billion euros in 2029, emphasizing investment in general practitioners and community health centers.

q.o: Questo documento prevede un ulteriore finanziamento al fondo sanitario nazionale, che passa così dai 141,5 miliardi del 2025 ai 160 miliardi del 2029, confermando il primato delle risorse stanziate da qualunque governo al Fondo Sanitario Nazionale.
q.t: This document provides for additional funding to the national health fund, which thus goes from 141.5 billion in 2025 to 160 billion in 2029, confirming the record of resources allocated by any government to the National Health Fund.

q.o: Il comparto della medicina generale, infatti, è quello che tiene in piedi gran parte del nostro sistema sanitario, ma, paradossalmente, negli anni, è stato definanziato, nonostante sia l'unica sanità con la porta sempre aperta e non chiede di passare di Cup.
q.t: The general medicine sector, in fact, is what holds up most of our health system, but, paradoxically, over the years, it has been defunded, despite being the only healthcare with the door always open and not requiring passage through Cup.

ti: Famiglia: Italia promuove campagna europea per natalità
s: Brothers of Italy senators Lavinia Mennuni and Paola Mancini propose a European campaign called 'ReBirth EU' to combat demographic decline through cultural and economic measures supporting young couples and birth rates, arguing that family spending should be treated differently in EU budget rules.

q.o: ReBirth Eu potrebbe essere il nuovo piano europeo per combattere l'inverno demografico del nostro continente.
q.t: ReBirth EU could be the new European plan to combat the demographic winter of our continent.

q.o: L'Italia è tra le nazioni che l'Europa l'hanno fondata e ha il diritto e il dovere di dire quando qualcosa non va, non per indebolirla, ma esattamente per il contrario, per renderla più forte
q.t: Italy is among the nations that founded Europe and has the right and duty to say when something is wrong, not to weaken it, but exactly for the opposite, to make it stronger

q.o: Una parte di mondo che non fa figli, e che quindi non crea nuova forza lavoro, non è destinata a crescere. Noi, invece, vogliamo crescere.
q.t: A part of the world that does not have children, and therefore does not create new workforce, is not destined to grow. We, instead, want to grow.

q.o: Serve che l'Europa riconosca la natalità come investimento e non come spesa: le risorse destinate alle famiglie andrebbero trattate in modo diverso nelle regole di bilancio comuni.
q.t: Europe needs to recognize birth rates as investment and not as expenditure: resources allocated to families should be treated differently in common budget rules.

ti: Turismo: Italia prima in Ue per presenze, politiche governo lungimiranti
s: Brothers of Italy claims credit for Italy becoming first in the EU for tourist presences in 2025 with 535.5 million visits, attributing the success to the Meloni government's tourism policies focused on promoting small towns and diversifying tourism offerings.

q.o: I dati Istat pubblicati oggi confermano il successo storico del turismo italiano: nel 2025 l'Italia conquista il primo posto nell'Unione Europea per numero di presenze (535,5 milioni), superando Spagna e Francia.
q.t: The Istat data published today confirm the historic success of Italian tourism: in 2025 Italy conquers first place in the European Union for number of presences (535.5 million), surpassing Spain and France.

q.o: Fratelli d'Italia rivendica con orgoglio questo risultato, frutto delle politiche lungimiranti del governo Meloni e del Ministero del Turismo, che hanno saputo valorizzare il brand Italia nel mondo, partendo dai borghi e dai piccoli comuni, che rappresentano un motore strategico per generare ricchezza e occupazione, diversificando l'offerta turistica
q.t: Brothers of Italy proudly claims this result, the fruit of the far-sighted policies of the Meloni government and the Ministry of Tourism, which have been able to enhance the Italy brand in the world, starting from villages and small municipalities, which represent a strategic engine for generating wealth and employment, diversifying the tourism offer

q.o: Ricordo che soltanto sette anni fa, nel 2019, l'Italia era quarta alle spalle di Spagna, Francia e Germania. Avanti così per una nazione che sa valorizzare il suo patrimonio attrattivo rendendo il turismo un settore chiavo del rilancio occupazione ed economico
q.t: I recall that only seven years ago, in 2019, Italy was fourth behind Spain, France and Germany. Forward like this for a nation that knows how to enhance its attractive heritage making tourism a key sector for employment and economic revival

ti: La Settimana Leghista #41
s: La Settimana Leghista #41. 18 ottobre 2026 «CHI ROMPE PAGA»: SALVINI ANNUNCIA IL RITORNO IN PARLAMENTO DELLA PROPOSTA DELLA LEGA Dopo gli episodi di violenza e danneggiamento registrati durante le manifestazioni degli ultimi giorni, la Lega rilancia la proposta «Chi rompe paga». Matteo

ti: HGV protest: road haulage talks to be held on Tuesday. Salvini ready to release the funds - Il Sole 24 ORE
s: Matteo Salvini announced readiness to release funds in response to HGV protests, with road haulage talks scheduled for Tuesday.

ti: Budget Bill, Salvini: ‘Banks? A 5 billion contribution is the bare minimum.’ The ABI: the measure was not agreed upon - Il Sole 24 ORE
s: Matteo Salvini stated that a 5 billion euro contribution from banks in the budget bill is the bare minimum, while the Italian Banking Association (ABI) responded that the measure was not agreed upon.

q.o: Banche? Un contributo di 5 miliardi è il minimo sindacale
q.t: Banks? A 5 billion contribution is the bare minimum

ti: Salvini: "Banks beaten? Patuelli is surprising, the €5 billion contribution is the bare minimum." - Agenzia Nova
s: Matteo Salvini responded to banking sector criticism by stating that a €5 billion contribution from banks is the bare minimum and expressed surprise at comments from Patuelli.

ti: The most noble of men, Garavaglia: a blank ballot is also standing against Salvini - Il Foglio
s: Garavaglia stated that casting a blank ballot in an internal League vote constitutes a position against Salvini's leadership.

ti: Who is Matteo Salvini’s challenger: a profile of Massimo Garavaglia, a ‘Draghi-aligned’ member of the Lega - Il Foglio
s: Massimo Garavaglia, described as a 'Draghi-aligned' member of the League, is challenging Matteo Salvini within the party.

ti: Salvini: Garaviglia a candidate for the League congress? Good, the more people who contribute ideas, the better. - Agenzia Nova
s: Salvini welcomes Garavaglia as a candidate for the League party congress, stating that more contributors of ideas is beneficial.

q.o: Garaviglia a candidate for the League congress? Good, the more people who contribute ideas, the better.
q.t: Garavaglia a candidate for the League congress? Good, the more people who contribute ideas, the better.

ti: Salvini and Tajani want primary elections in the cities. Meloni puts a stop to them - Il Foglio
s: Salvini and Tajani proposed holding primary elections for candidate selection in cities, but Meloni rejected the proposal.

ti: Otto Bruun: Kohti eduskuntavaalien ilmastokäännettä
s: Otto Bruun, speaking at the Left Alliance party council on 17 October 2026, criticized the Orpo government for failing to make any significant positive climate decisions, announced that the Left Alliance will regulate data centers in the next term, and declared the party's intention to make the spring parliamentary elections a turning point for strong climate policy.

q.o: Hallitus ei ole tehnyt kaudellaan yhtäkään merkittävää positiivista ilmastopäätöstä.
q.t: The government has not made a single significant positive climate decision during its term.

q.o: Linjan pitää olla kirkas: fossiilisten polttoaineiden eläkeikää ei voi enää nostaa.
q.t: The line must be clear: the retirement age of fossil fuels can no longer be raised.

q.o: Tämän virheen vasemmistoliitto tulee korjaamaan ensi kaudella.
q.t: The Left Alliance will correct this mistake in the next term.

q.o: Vasemmistoliitto aikoo tehdä kevään eduskuntavaaleista myös vahvan ilmastopolitiikan käänteen.
q.t: The Left Alliance intends to make the spring parliamentary elections also a turning point for strong climate policy.

ti: Laura Meriluoto: Edes vaikeimmassa asemassa olevat lapset eivät säästy hallituksen leikkauksilta
s: Left Alliance MP Laura Meriluoto criticized the government's 100 million euro cuts to social welfare, particularly affecting over 5,000 child protection clients, in a speech at the party council on 17 October 2026.

q.o: Liian vähälle huomiolle julkisessa keskustelussa on mielestäni jäänyt uusi 100 miljoonan euron leikkaus sosiaalihuoltoon. Tämä leikkauslaki osuu erityisesti lastensuojelun asiakkaisiin. Arviolta yli 5000 lastensuojelun asiakkaan asemaa ja oikeuksia heikennetään.
q.t: In my opinion, the new 100 million euro cut to social welfare has received too little attention in public debate. This cut law particularly affects child protection clients. An estimated over 5,000 child protection clients' positions and rights will be weakened.

q.o: Minusta tässä murennetaan koko sitä eettistä pohjaa, jolle suomalaista yhteiskuntaa on rakennettu, kun edes vaikeimmassa asemassa olevat lapset eivät säästy leikkauksilta.
q.t: I think this is eroding the entire ethical foundation on which Finnish society has been built, when even children in the most difficult positions are not spared from cuts.

q.o: Vasemmistoliitto kykenee ainoana puolueena tarjoamaan suomalaisille uskottavan punavihreän vaihtoehdon.
q.t: The Left Alliance is the only party capable of offering Finns a credible red-green alternative.

ti: Miikka Kortelainen esittää reilun kotimaisen ruoan ohjelmaa: Ruoan pitää olla halvempaa ostaa ja kannattavampaa tuottaa
s: Left Alliance vice-chair Miikka Kortelainen proposed at the party council in Helsinki on 17 October 2026 the preparation of a fair domestic food programme aimed at lowering food costs for consumers, improving farmers' incomes, and strengthening domestic food production.

q.o: Miten ihmeessä on mahdollista, että suomalainen ruoka on kuluttajalle liian kallista, mutta sen tuottaminen on viljelijälle liian huonosti kannattavaa? Jossakin tässä yhtälössä on pahasti vikaa
q.t: How on earth is it possible that Finnish food is too expensive for the consumer, but producing it is too poorly profitable for the farmer? Something is seriously wrong with this equation

q.o: Ei voi olla niin, että viljelijä kantaa riskit, kuluttaja maksaa laskun ja ruokaketjun vahvimmat sanelevat ehdot. Jos markkinat eivät pysty turvaamaan kohtuuhintaista ruokaa suomalaisille ja kunnollista toimeentuloa ruoantuottajille, päättäjien tehtävä on korjata markkinoiden toimintaa.
q.t: It cannot be that the farmer bears the risks, the consumer pays the bill, and the strongest in the food chain dictate the terms. If the markets cannot ensure reasonably priced food for Finns and decent livelihoods for food producers, it is the task of decision-makers to correct the functioning of the markets.

q.o: Suomalainen maanviljelijä on työtä tekevä ihminen ja yrittäjä, jonka pitää saada työstään kunnollinen korvaus. Kun yhteiskunta vaatii ruoantuotannolta enemmän kestävyyttä, sen pitää olla valmis myös investoimaan siihen.
q.t: A Finnish farmer is a working person and entrepreneur who must receive proper compensation for their work. When society demands more sustainability from food production, it must also be ready to invest in it.

q.o: Suomalaisen ruoan pitää olla halvempaa ostaa, kannattavampaa tuottaa ja kestävämpää kasvattaa. Reilu hinta kuluttajalle, reilu korvaus tuottajalle ja kotimaista ruokaa myös tuleville sukupolville.
q.t: Finnish food must be cheaper to buy, more profitable to produce, and more sustainable to grow. A fair price for the consumer, fair compensation for the producer, and domestic food for future generations as well.

ti: Minja Koskela: ammattiliittojen jäsenmaksun verovähennysoikeus täytyy tuplata
s: Left Alliance chair Minja Koskela proposed doubling the tax deduction for trade union membership fees to increase unionisation rates and restore balance in labour relations after government reforms weakened worker power.

q.o: Ay-jäsenmaksun verovähennysoikeus pitäisi palauttaa, ja se pitäisi palauttaa tuplana. Tämä lisäisi kannusteita liittyä ammattiliittoihin ja sitä kautta vahvistaisi neuvottelukulttuuria, yhteiskunnan vakautta sekä demokratian toteutumista.
q.t: The tax deduction for trade union membership fees should be restored, and it should be restored doubled. This would increase incentives to join trade unions and thereby strengthen negotiation culture, societal stability, and the realisation of democracy.

q.o: Ensi kaudella täytyy aloittaa valtatasapainon palauttaminen. Se edellyttää, että järjestäytymisastetta nostetaan eli että yhä useampi työntekijä kuuluu ammattiliittoon.
q.t: In the next term, we must begin restoring the balance of power. This requires increasing the rate of unionisation, meaning that more and more workers belong to a trade union.

q.o: Vasemmistoliitto kannattaa maltillisempaa sopeutussummaa, joka jaetaan useammalle vaalikaudelle, ja joka sisältää myös taloutta elvyttäviä investointeja.
q.t: The Left Alliance supports a more moderate adjustment sum, which is divided over several electoral terms, and which also includes economy-stimulating investments.

ti: Johannes Yrttiaho: Käännytyslaki vaarantaa demokraattisen oikeusvaltion
s: Left Alliance MP Johannes Yrttiaho and Green MP Krista Mikkonen submitted a dissenting opinion in the Constitutional Law Committee opposing the extension of the so-called pushback law, arguing it violates Finland's constitutional order and binding international human rights obligations.

q.o: Käännytyslaki eli laki väliaikaisista toimenpiteistä välineellistetyn maahantulon torjumiseksi on Suomen perusoikeusjärjestelmän ja valtiosäännön vastainen. Se loukkaa räikeästi useita Suomea sitovia kansainvälisiä ihmisoikeussopimuksia
q.t: The pushback law, i.e. the law on temporary measures to counter instrumentalized immigration, is contrary to Finland's fundamental rights system and constitution. It blatantly violates several international human rights treaties binding on Finland

q.o: Kansainvälisistä ihmisoikeusvelvoitteista ei voi tehdä poikkeuksia. Valtiosopimusoikeutta koskevan Wienin sopimuksen 27 artiklan mukaan valtio ei voi vedota sisäisen oikeutensa määräyksiin perusteena valtiosopimuksen täyttämättä jättämiselle. Poikkeuslailla ei voida ratkaista ristiriitaa kansainvälisen oikeuden kanssa
q.t: No exceptions can be made to international human rights obligations. According to Article 27 of the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties, a state cannot invoke the provisions of its internal law as justification for its failure to perform a treaty. An exception law cannot resolve a conflict with international law

ti: Johannes Yrttiaho: Hallitus on pettämässä asumisoikeusasukkaiden kanssa tehdyt elinikäiset sopimukset
s: Left Alliance MP Johannes Yrttiaho submitted a dissenting opinion in the Constitutional Law Committee opposing a government bill that would allow termination of lifelong housing-right agreements, arguing it violates constitutional property protections and breaks contracts with residents.

q.o: Hallituksen esitys on asukkaiden perusoikeuksien vastainen. Se rapauttaa luottamusta asumisoikeuksien pysyvyyteen. Siksi lakiesitys pitäisi hylätä.
q.t: The government's proposal is contrary to residents' fundamental rights. It undermines trust in the permanence of housing rights. Therefore, the bill should be rejected.

q.o: Tässä petetään asukkaiden kanssa tehdyt sopimukset elinikäisestä, jopa perinnöksi jätettävästä asumisoikeudesta ja asumisturvasta.
q.t: This betrays the contracts made with residents regarding lifelong housing rights, even inheritable, and housing security.

q.o: Muuten valiokunnan enemmistö ja puheenjohtaja kyllä asettuvat kaikessa omaisuuden suojan kannalle, kuten kokoomus aina on tehnyt. On kysyttävä, eikö sama omaisuuden suoja koskekaan pieni- ja keskituloisia ihmisiä?
q.t: Otherwise, the committee majority and chairman do support property protection in everything, as the National Coalition Party has always done. One must ask, does the same property protection not apply to low- and middle-income people?

ti: Minja Koskela: Asiakasmaksujen korotukset pakottavat pienituloiset valitsemaan ruoan ja hoidon välillä
s: Left Alliance MP Minja Koskela criticized the Orpo government's healthcare fee increases, stating that low-income people are being forced to choose between food and medical care, with surgical procedures being cancelled because patients cannot afford the fees.

q.o: Helsingin Sanomien mukaan HUSin sairaaloissa perutaan nyt leikkaushoitoja, koska niitä tarvitsevilla ei ole varaa asiakasmaksuihin. Tämä on pöyristyttävä tilanne hyvinvointivaltiossa ja suora seuraus Orpon hallituksen politiikasta ja Rydmanin hinnoista.
q.t: According to Helsingin Sanomat, surgical procedures are now being cancelled in HUS hospitals because those who need them cannot afford the patient fees. This is an outrageous situation in a welfare state and a direct consequence of the Orpo government's policy and Rydman's prices.

q.o: Orpon hallitus on luonut sote-Suomen, jossa kaikkein pienituloisimmat ihmiset eivät uskalla hakeutua hoitoon maksujen pelossa. Tämän kylmempää politiikkaa on vaikea keksiä.
q.t: The Orpo government has created a healthcare Finland where the very poorest people do not dare to seek treatment for fear of fees. It is hard to think of colder politics than this.

q.o: Hallituksen on kuulemma 'pakko' leikata terveyspalveluista ja korottaa asiakasmaksuja, vaikka suuryrityksille suunnattuun miljardiluokan veroaleen kyllä riittää rahaa. Köyhät ja sairaat laitetaan siis kirjaimellisesti maksamaan rikkaiden veroalet.
q.t: The government supposedly 'has to' cut health services and raise patient fees, even though there is enough money for billion-class tax cuts aimed at large corporations. So the poor and sick are literally being made to pay for the tax cuts of the rich.

ti: Abascal warns: I am very worried about the elections, Sánchez will use his militias and they will not be clean. - Demócrata

ti: Gli studenti da tutte le piazze d’Italia: soldi per le aule, non per le armi
s: The Italian Communist Party expressed active support for student demonstrations on October 16, 2026, across Italy demanding increased education funding instead of military spending, opposing the Valditara decree, criticizing government and EU military expenditures, and announcing participation in upcoming strikes on October 30 and November 20.

q.o: Più aule e meno bombe
q.t: More classrooms and fewer bombs

q.o: Al movimento delle studentesse e degli studenti vanno la simpatia e il sostegno attivo e convinto del Partito Comunista Italiano, comuni sono i nostri obiettivi.
q.t: To the movement of female and male students go the sympathy and active and convinced support of the Italian Communist Party, our objectives are common.

ti: “Una cittadinanza senza confini”: lavoro, diritti, istruzione e pace
s: The Italian Communist Party organized two public assemblies in Iglesias and Sassari on October 16-17 titled "A citizenship without borders" to discuss migration, citizenship, labor rights, and social services, advocating for extending rights to all workers regardless of origin and criticizing detention centers in Sardinia.

q.o: L'iniziativa vuole mettere al centro una prospettiva che rifiuta la contrapposizione tra lavoratrici e lavoratori italiani e migranti.
q.t: The initiative aims to center a perspective that rejects the opposition between Italian and migrant workers.

q.o: Accettare che una parte della popolazione possa vivere e lavorare con meno diritti significa rendere più fragili i diritti di tutti.
q.t: Accepting that a part of the population can live and work with fewer rights means making everyone's rights more fragile.

q.o: Per il PCI Sardegna si tratta di un sistema fallimentare e umiliante che va radicalmente cambiato, rimettendo al centro la dignità e diritti, incrementando i livelli qualitativi e quantitativi dell'assistenza e dei servizi di accoglienza.
q.t: For the PCI Sardinia this is a failed and humiliating system that must be radically changed, putting dignity and rights back at the center, increasing the qualitative and quantitative levels of assistance and reception services.

ti: Siderurgia, il rischio di chiusura non è una fatalità. A Genova come a Taranto, serve una politica industriale pubblica, non il riarmo
s: The Italian Communist Party expresses full support for steelworkers occupying the Prefecture in Genoa-Cornigliano and calls for nationalization of strategic steel assets and public industrial policy instead of military spending, criticizing decades of privatization and neoliberal policies.

q.o: Il Partito Comunista Italiano esprime pieno sostegno e solidarietà alle lavoratrici e ai lavoratori di Cornigliano che hanno occupato la Prefettura per difendere il proprio futuro e quello della siderurgia genovese.
q.t: The Italian Communist Party expresses full support and solidarity with the workers of Cornigliano who have occupied the Prefecture to defend their future and that of Genoese steelmaking.

q.o: Per il nostro Partito, l'unica strada seria è il ritorno a una presenza pubblica forte e diretta nella siderurgia, attraverso la nazionalizzazione degli asset strategici e il finanziamento degli investimenti necessari a rilanciare la produzione di acciaio.
q.t: For our Party, the only serious path is the return to a strong and direct public presence in steelmaking, through the nationalization of strategic assets and financing of the necessary investments to relaunch steel production.

q.o: Ed è ancora più inaccettabile che, mentre si dice che non ci sono risorse sufficienti per salvaguardare la siderurgia, l'industria e il lavoro, si continuino a destinare ingenti risorse al riarmo e agli armamenti.
q.t: And it is even more unacceptable that, while it is said there are not sufficient resources to safeguard steelmaking, industry and work, huge resources continue to be allocated to rearmament and armaments.

ti: Il PCI di Empoli in piazza per Iyad Taha e per il popolo palestinese
s: The Italian Communist Party section in Empoli organized a protest on 12 October 2026 in solidarity with the Palestinian people and mourning the killing of Iyad Taha by Israeli forces, demanding severance of ties with Israel, BDS measures, and opposition to an anti-semitism bill they characterize as targeting anti-Zionism.

q.o: Interruzione di ogni rapporto economico, militare e politico con Israele; Boicottaggio, Disinvestimento, Sanzioni contro i prodotti israeliani venduti in Italia; NO ALL'APPROVAZIONE DEL DDL 'ANTISEMITISMO', CHE PUNISCE NON L'ANTISEMITISMO MA L'ANTISIONISMO E OGNI CRITICA AL GOVERNO DI ISRAELE.
q.t: Interruption of all economic, military and political relations with Israel; Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions against Israeli products sold in Italy; NO TO THE APPROVAL OF THE 'ANTI-SEMITISM' BILL, WHICH PUNISHES NOT ANTI-SEMITISM BUT ANTI-ZIONISM AND ANY CRITICISM OF THE GOVERNMENT OF ISRAEL.

ti: Polanski calls for bold and immediate action on the cost of living in October Budget
s: Green Party leader Zack Polanski called for bold action on the cost of living in the October Budget, including moving costs off energy bills, funding home insulation, clamping down on energy company profiteering, and scaling up renewable energy.

q.o: Economists are telling the Chancellor today that a steady-as-she-goes budget 'is not an option'. With three in five families already cutting back on spending, and many about to see a £300 increase in their bills in January, we're challenging the government to take bold and immediate action on the cost of living. For a start, this means moving more costs off energy bills, properly funding a national home insulation scheme, clamping down on profiteering by energy companies, and rapidly scaling up cheaper, cleaner energy.

s: The Communist Party of Britain issued a solidarity statement condemning state repression against Indian Communists protesting electoral roll deletions and demanding the dismissal of India's Chief Election Commissioner.

q.t: The Communist Party of Britain sends solidarity to the Communists, left progressive forces and students in India facing brutal state repression in their struggle to defend the democratic rights of all India's citizens and uphold the integrity of the electoral system.

q.t: The Communist Party of Britain stands in firm solidarity with our comrades in India and upholds their fight in defence of people's democracy.
