ti: Κινδυνεύουμε να μείνουμε χωρίς ρεύμα, αλλά με πανάκριβους λογαριασμούς
s: AKEL criticizes the government for energy infrastructure delays including the incomplete Vasiliko project and lack of energy sufficiency planning until 2030, demanding concrete measures to reduce electricity costs and targeted support for households including transport subsidies, heating assistance, and reduced circulation fees.

q.o: Το Βασιλικό παραμένει μισοτέλειωτο, η αναβάθμιση των μονάδων παραγωγής και η αποθήκευση καθυστερούν, ενώ ούτε η ηλεκτρική διασύνδεση θα δώσει λύση στην ενεργειακή επάρκεια μέχρι το 2030.
q.t: Vasiliko remains half-finished, the upgrading of production units and storage are delayed, while the electrical interconnection will not provide a solution to energy sufficiency until 2030.

q.o: Οι ευθύνες του παρελθόντος δεν αποτελούν άλλοθι για τη σημερινή αδράνεια, που απειλεί να βυθίσει την Κύπρο στο σκοτάδι.
q.t: The responsibilities of the past do not constitute an alibi for today's inaction, which threatens to plunge Cyprus into darkness.

q.o: Καλούμε την κυβέρνηση να προχωρήσει σε νέα, στοχευμένα μέτρα στήριξης που να καλύπτουν περισσότερα νοικοκυριά, όπως επιδότηση μετακινήσεων, ενίσχυση για θέρμανση και μείωση των τελών κυκλοφορίας.
q.t: We call on the government to proceed with new, targeted support measures covering more households, such as transport subsidies, heating assistance, and reduction of circulation fees.

ti: Οι χορηγίες για ενεργειακή αναβάθμιση να φτάνουν σε όσους τις έχουν περισσότερο ανάγκη – Οι προτάσεις του ΑΚΕΛ
s: AKEL General Secretary Stefanos Stefanou submitted a letter to the Minister of Energy, Commerce and Industry proposing improvements to the 2026 Housing Energy Upgrade Grant Scheme, including advance payment mechanisms, a separate scheme for energy-poor households with up to 100% subsidies, full coverage of energy audits for vulnerable households, and replacement of first-come-first-served allocation with social and energy-based scoring.

q.o: Η βασική μας θέση είναι ότι η ενεργειακή αναβάθμιση των κατοικιών πρέπει να αποτελέσει μέρος μιας ολοκληρωμένης πολιτικής αντιμετώπισης της ενεργειακής φτώχειας και όχι να περιορίζεται σε ένα σχέδιο επιδότησης επενδύσεων για όσους έχουν ήδη την οικονομική δυνατότητα να τις πραγματοποιήσουν.
q.t: Our basic position is that the energy upgrading of homes must be part of a comprehensive policy to address energy poverty and not be limited to a subsidy scheme for investments for those who already have the financial capacity to carry them out.

q.o: Θεωρούμε ότι η επιτυχία ενός σχεδίου ενεργειακής αναβάθμισης δεν πρέπει να αξιολογείται μόνο με βάση το ύψος του διαθέσιμου προϋπολογισμού ή τον αριθμό των κατοικιών που θα αναβαθμιστούν. Πρέπει πρωτίστως να αξιολογείται με βάση το κατά πόσο η κρατική στήριξη φτάνει σε εκείνους που τη χρειάζονται περισσότερο.
q.t: We believe that the success of an energy upgrade scheme should not be evaluated only on the basis of the amount of available budget or the number of homes to be upgraded. It must primarily be evaluated on the basis of whether state support reaches those who need it most.

ti: Πόσο δύσκολο τους είναι να ψελλίσουν έστω ότι στηρίζουν το διεθνές δίκαιο;
s: AKEL criticizes the Democratic Rally party and pro-Israel lobby forces for failing to support international law while condemning Israel's policy in Palestine, arguing this undermines Cyprus's own reliance on international law against Turkish expansionism.

q.o: Όταν η Κύπρος αγωνίζεται να πείσει ότι η μεγαλύτερη προστασία της χώρας είναι ο σεβασμός του διεθνούς δίκαιου, με ποιο έρεισμα αλήθεια θα απευθυνθεί ο Συναγερμός και οι υπόλοιπες δυνάμεις του ισραηλινού λόμπι στο διεθνή παράγοντα απέναντι στις επεκτατικές επιδιώξεις την Τουρκίας;
q.t: When Cyprus struggles to convince that the country's greatest protection is respect for international law, on what basis will the Rally and the other forces of the Israeli lobby address the international factor against Turkey's expansionist ambitions?

q.o: Τελικά, όταν πρόκειται για τα συμφέροντα του Ισραήλ, πόσο δύσκολο τους είναι να ψελλίσουν έστω ότι στηρίζουν το διεθνές δίκαιο;
q.t: Ultimately, when it comes to Israel's interests, how difficult is it for them to even mumble that they support international law?

ti: Δημόσιες συγκοινωνίες που δεν εξυπηρετούν τις ανάγκες της κοινωνίας
s: AKEL MP Valentinos Fakontis issued a written statement criticizing government public transport policies in Nicosia following an Audit Service report, demanding immediate comprehensive upgrades including more frequent routes, modern infrastructure, affordable tickets, universal accessibility, and strict oversight.

q.o: Είναι αποκαλυπτικό ότι το 63% των συμμετεχόντων στην έρευνα δήλωσε πως δεν θα επέλεγε ξανά το λεωφορείο!
q.t: It is revealing that 63% of survey participants stated they would not choose the bus again!

q.o: Ως ΑΚΕΛ, απαιτούμε άμεσα ολοκληρωμένο σχέδιο αναβάθμισης των δημόσιων συγκοινωνιών, με συχνότερα δρομολόγια, σύγχρονες υποδομές, προσιτά εισιτήρια, καθολική προσβασιμότητα και αυστηρή εποπτεία.
q.t: As AKEL, we demand an immediate comprehensive plan to upgrade public transport, with more frequent routes, modern infrastructure, affordable tickets, universal accessibility and strict oversight.

q.o: Το λεωφορείο θα έπρεπε να συμβάλλει ουσιαστικά στην μείωση του κυκλοφοριακού. Αντί γι' αυτό, με τους χειρισμούς της κυβέρνησης έχει καταστεί μια μη ελκυστική και μη ανταγωνιστική επιλογή.
q.t: The bus should contribute substantially to reducing traffic. Instead, with the government's handling it has become an unattractive and uncompetitive option.

ti: Συνάντηση ΑΚΕΛ με το Κλαδικό Συμβούλιο Λειτουργών Κοινωνικών Υπηρεσιών της Παγκύπριας Συντεχνίας ΙΣΟΤΗΤΑ
s: AKEL delegation led by Health Sector Head Dr. Chrysanthos Georgiou met with the Sectoral Council of Social Services Officers of the Pan-Cyprian Union ISOTITA to discuss chronic problems in Social Welfare Services, demanding immediate staffing increases, workload limits per officer, removal of administrative burdens, and rejecting the government's practice of outsourcing services to private programs.

q.o: Το ΑΚΕΛ τονίζει ότι η πολιτεία οφείλει να δώσει άμεσες και ουσιαστικές λύσεις, αφού τα προβλήματα που καταγράφονται απαιτούν άμεση και αποφασιστική παρέμβαση.
q.t: AKEL emphasizes that the state must provide immediate and substantial solutions, since the problems recorded require immediate and decisive intervention.

q.o: Η πρακτική της κυβέρνησης να καταφεύγει στην «εύκολη λύση» της αγοράς υπηρεσιών μέσω προγραμμάτων δεν αποτελεί πολιτική κοινωνικής προστασίας των ευάλωτων ομάδων, αλλά μετακύλιση ευθύνης και σταδιακή ιδιωτικοποίηση κρίσιμων υπηρεσιών που αφορούν ευάλωτες ομάδες.
q.t: The government's practice of resorting to the 'easy solution' of purchasing services through programs does not constitute a social protection policy for vulnerable groups, but a shifting of responsibility and gradual privatization of critical services concerning vulnerable groups.

q.o: Το ΑΚΕΛ θα συνεχίσει με συνέπεια και αποφασιστικότητα να υπερασπίζεται το δικαίωμα των πολιτών σε ποιοτικές, δημόσιες και καθολικές υπηρεσίες κοινωνικής πρόνοιας.
q.t: AKEL will continue with consistency and determination to defend the right of citizens to quality, public and universal social welfare services.

ti: Η κυπριακή Βουλή δεν μπορεί να μετατρέπεται σε λόμπι προώθησης των συμφερόντων του Ισραήλ
s: AKEL condemns the formation of a parliamentary group by DISY, DIKO and ELAM in cooperation with the Israel Allies Foundation and the creation of a Cypriot branch of Transatlantic Friends of Israel, calling it an unprecedented lobby for a foreign country's interests within parliament and criticizing government support for Israel while Cyprus seeks international pressure on Turkey regarding occupation.

q.o: Η συγκρότηση κοινοβουλευτικής ομάδας από ΔΗΣΥ, ΔΗΚΟ και ΕΛΑΜ σε συνεργασία με το Israel Allies Foundation και η δημιουργία κυπριακού παραρτήματος του Transatlantic Friends of Israel (TFI) αποτελούν εξαιρετικά προκλητικές ενέργειες.
q.t: The formation of a parliamentary group by DISY, DIKO and ELAM in cooperation with the Israel Allies Foundation and the creation of a Cypriot branch of Transatlantic Friends of Israel (TFI) constitute extremely provocative actions.

q.o: Πώς συμβιβάζεται η συμμετοχή Κύπριων βουλευτών σε τέτοιες πρωτοβουλίες με τον αγώνα μας για τερματισμό της τουρκικής κατοχής και του εποικισμού, ο οποίος στηρίζεται στο διεθνές δίκαιο και στα ψηφίσματα του ΟΗΕ;
q.t: How is the participation of Cypriot MPs in such initiatives compatible with our struggle to end the Turkish occupation and colonization, which is based on international law and UN resolutions?

q.o: Η Κύπρος δεν μπορεί να διεκδικεί δικαιοσύνη για τον λαό της και να γίνεται πολιτικά συνένοχη στην αδικία σε βάρος ενός άλλου λαού.
q.t: Cyprus cannot claim justice for its people and become politically complicit in injustice against another people.

ti: Συνάντηση ΑΚΕΛ με οργανώσεις και φορείς για τα δικαιώματα των γυναικών και την ισότητα
s: AKEL's Gender Equality and Parity Office held a meeting with organizations working on gender equality, women's rights, and human rights to discuss policy gaps and legislative initiatives including protection of gender-based violence victims, sexual and reproductive health access, LGBTQI+ strategy, and gender-responsive budgeting.

q.o: Μέσα από τις τοποθετήσεις των οργανώσεων αναδείχθηκαν σοβαρά κενά, καθυστερήσεις και προβλήματα εφαρμογής πολιτικών και νομοθεσιών.
q.t: Through the organizations' presentations, serious gaps, delays and problems in the implementation of policies and legislation were highlighted.

q.o: Το Γραφείο Ισότητας και Ισοτιμίας των Φύλων της Κ.Ε. ΑΚΕΛ θα κωδικοποιήσει τα ζητήματα που τέθηκαν, με στόχο την προώθησή τους μέσα από πολιτικές, κοινοβουλευτικές και όπου απαιτείται νομοθετικές πρωτοβουλίες.
q.t: The Gender Equality and Parity Office of AKEL's Central Committee will codify the issues raised, with the aim of promoting them through political, parliamentary and where necessary legislative initiatives.

ti: Συνάντηση Γενικού Γραμματέα ΑΚΕΛ Στέφανου Στεφάνου με την Ένωση Αντιδημάρχων Κύπρου
s: AKEL General Secretary Stefanos Stefanou met with the Union of Deputy Mayors of Cyprus to discuss proposals for institutionalizing the powers and responsibilities of deputy mayors within local government reform.

q.o: το ΑΚΕΛ πιστεύει στη Μεταρρύθμιση της Τοπικής Αυτοδιοίκησης, παρόλες τις αδυναμίες, που πιθανόν να παρατηρούνται και δήλωσε έτοιμος να συζητήσει τις όποιες προτάσεις κατατεθούν από την Εκτελεστική Εξουσία για τον ρόλο των Αντιδημάρχων
q.t: AKEL believes in the Reform of Local Government, despite the weaknesses that may be observed, and declared ready to discuss any proposals submitted by the Executive Authority regarding the role of Deputy Mayors

ti: – Norge står ved et veiskille
s: Progress Party contrasts its approach to taxation with the left, stating that while the left asks how much more the state can take, FrP asks how much more people can keep.

q.o: Forskjellen på FrP og venstresiden er at de spør: «Hvor mye mer kan staten ta?», mens FrP spør «Hvor mye mer kan folk få beholde?».
q.t: The difference between FrP and the left is that they ask: 'How much more can the state take?', while FrP asks 'How much more can people keep?'.

ti: – Mange tør ikke snakke om dette
s: Progress Party leader Sylvi Listhaug referenced the book 'Innvandringens skyggesider' by former NRK journalist Anders Magnus in her speech to the party's national board.

ti: – Norge står ved et veiskille
s: Progress Party leader Sylvi Listhaug criticized the Labour Party's budget proposal, claiming it will worsen the economy for families and businesses in 2027, and promised her party will do the opposite.

q.o: Fremskrittspartiet og folk er ikke lettlurte. Arbeiderpartiets budsjett vil gi mange familier og bedrifter i Norge dårligere økonomi i 2027. Nok en gang beskytter Støre statskassen, heller enn å hjelpe vanlige folk. Jeg kan love at Fremskrittspartiet skal gjøre det motsatte
q.t: The Progress Party and the people are not easily fooled. The Labour Party's budget will give many families and businesses in Norway a worse economy in 2027. Once again, Støre protects the state treasury, rather than helping ordinary people. I can promise that the Progress Party will do the opposite

ti: Vil stenge kriminelle ute av barnevernet
s: Progress Party demands stricter control over who gets responsibility for vulnerable children in child welfare services.

q.o: Barn under offentlig omsorg skal være trygge
q.t: Children under public care shall be safe

ti: FrP er positiv til Gjedrem-utvalget
s: Progress Party supports the Gjedrem committee's recommendations that Norges Bank should decide on divestments with a high threshold and that the fund should be allowed to invest in defense companies in NATO countries that produce nuclear weapons.

q.o: Fremskrittspartiet støtter at Norges Bank skal bestemme om fondet skal ut av selskaper og at terskelen skal være høy.
q.t: Progress Party supports that Norges Bank should decide whether the fund should divest from companies and that the threshold should be high.

q.o: Det er positivt at utvalget vil åpne for å investere i forsvarsbedrifter i NATO- land som produserer atomvåpen.
q.t: It is positive that the committee will open up for investing in defense companies in NATO countries that produce nuclear weapons.

ti: FrP er positiv til Gjedrem-utvalget
s: Progress Party supports the Gjedrem committee's recommendations that Norges Bank should decide on divestments with a high threshold and that the committee proposes opening for investments in defense companies in NATO countries that produce nuclear weapons.

q.o: Fremskrittspartiet støtter at Norges Bank skal bestemme om fondet skal ut av selskaper og at terskelen skal være høy.
q.t: Progress Party supports that Norges Bank should decide whether the fund should divest from companies and that the threshold should be high.

q.o: Det er positivt at utvalget vil åpne for å investere i forsvarsbedrifter i NATO- land som produserer atomvåpen.
q.t: It is positive that the committee will open for investing in defense companies in NATO countries that produce nuclear weapons.

ti: FrP krever innstramminger i sosialhjelpen til innvandrere
s: Progress Party immigration spokesperson Erlend Wiborg demands a halt to asylum immigration and stricter self-sufficiency requirements in response to figures from Vadsø showing 92.5 percent of social assistance goes to immigrants.

ti: Red-Green Alliance demands guaranteed transport for students in rural areas - The Copenhagen Post
s: The Red-Green Alliance is demanding guaranteed transport provision for students living in rural areas of Denmark.

ti: Ανάγκη για άμεση στήριξη και πληθυσμιακή ενίσχυση των κοινοτήτων της Τηλλυρίας – Περιοδεία ΕΛΑΜ
s: ELAM delegation toured Tillyria region and proposed special-status designation with incentives including reduced energy costs, housing support, and business aid to increase population and combat rural depopulation in communities of national importance.

q.o: Ως Ε.ΛΑ.Μ., στηρίζουμε την άμεση θεσμοθέτηση και επίσημη ανακήρυξη της περιοχής σε περιοχή με ειδικό καθεστώς, ώστε να εφαρμόζονται πολιτικές που όχι μόνο θα καταπολεμούν την αστυφιλία, αλλά θα συμβάλλουν ταυτόχρονα στην αύξηση του πληθυσμού των κοινοτήτων της Τηλλυρίας.
q.t: As ELAM, we support the immediate institutionalization and official declaration of the area as a region with special status, so that policies are implemented that will not only combat rural depopulation, but will simultaneously contribute to increasing the population of the Tillyria communities.

q.o: Από πλευράς μας, θα μεταφέρουμε τις εισηγήσεις μας στην εκτελεστική εξουσία και θα συνεχίσουμε να ασκούμε πιέσεις, ώστε να διαμορφωθούν όσο το δυνατόν καλύτερες συνθήκες για τις τοπικές κοινωνίες, εις όφελος και των εθνικών μας συμφερόντων.
q.t: For our part, we will convey our proposals to the executive authority and will continue to exert pressure, so that the best possible conditions are formed for the local communities, for the benefit of our national interests as well.

ti: Βουλή Στο Μικροσκόπιο | Επ. 3: Σωτήρης Ιωάννου και Πόλυς Ανωγυριάτης
s: ELAM MPs Sotiris Ioannou and Polys Anogyriatis discussed parliamentary work in their video series, covering education committee debates on disability support in schools, PISA results, nursing staff imports, Cyprus-Israel relations, their legislative proposal on child benefits, and school operating hours.

ti: Άρθρο Γ. Γεάδη: Μπορεί η Κύπρος να προσφέρει στους νέους της ένα μέλλον με πραγματική προοπτική;
s: National Popular Front MEP Geadis Geadi questioned European Commission Executive Vice-President Roxana Mînzatu in the EMPL Committee on 12 October 2026 about quality employment and the inability of young qualified workers in Cyprus and small island states to afford housing or start families despite working, calling for decent wages and real career prospects beyond job creation.

q.o: πώς μπορούμε να μιλάμε για ποιοτικές θέσεις εργασίας, όταν ένας νέος άνθρωπος, ακόμη και με μεταπτυχιακό τίτλο, εργάζεται καθημερινά αλλά δεν μπορεί να αγοράσει κατοικία;
q.t: how can we talk about quality jobs when a young person, even with a postgraduate degree, works every day but cannot buy a home?

q.o: Η δημιουργία νέων θέσεων εργασίας είναι αναγκαία, αλλά δεν αρκεί από μόνη της. Χρειαζόμαστε αξιοπρεπείς μισθούς, πραγματικές δυνατότητες επαγγελματικής εξέλιξης και θέσεις που ανταποκρίνονται στις γνώσεις και στις δεξιότητες των εργαζομένων.
q.t: The creation of new jobs is necessary, but it is not enough by itself. We need decent wages, real opportunities for professional development and positions that correspond to the knowledge and skills of workers.

ti: Μ. Πελεκάνος: «Προτεραιότητα στις ευάλωτες ομάδες μέσω κριτηρίων για προώθηση της ηλεκτροκίνησης»
s: ELAM MP Marios Pelekanos proposed criteria to prioritize vulnerable population groups in the distribution of a 20 million euro budget for promoting electric mobility during the examination of the Ministry of Transport budget, and the Minister responded positively to the proposal.

q.o: Αναφορικά με το κονδύλι ύψους 20 εκατομμυρίων ευρώ, το οποίο περιλαμβάνεται στον προϋπολογισμό για την προώθηση της ηλεκτροκίνησης, επισήμανε την εισήγηση που καταθέσαμε για τον καθορισμό συγκεκριμένων κριτηρίων, ώστε να δίνεται προτεραιότητα στις ευάλωτες ομάδες του πληθυσμού.
q.t: Regarding the fund of 20 million euros, which is included in the budget for the promotion of electric mobility, he highlighted the proposal we submitted for the establishment of specific criteria, so that priority is given to vulnerable groups of the population.

q.o: Τόνισε ότι η Υπουργός Μεταφορών ανταποκρίθηκε θετικά στην εισήγησή μας, σημειώνοντας ότι θα αναμένουμε να ακούσουμε περισσότερα μετά την ψήφιση των προϋπολογισμών.
q.t: He stressed that the Minister of Transport responded positively to our proposal, noting that we will wait to hear more after the voting on the budgets.

ti: Σ. Ιωάννου: «Μαθήματα ιστορίας, πολιτικής και γεωπολιτικής δεν αποδεχόμαστε από το ΑΚΕΛ»
s: ELAM parliamentary spokesperson Sotiris Ioannou defended inter-parliamentary cooperation to strengthen Cyprus-Israel relations, citing common geostrategic interests in defense, energy and security, while criticizing AKEL for ideological rigidity and accusing the party of historical ties to Soviet intelligence.

q.o: Μαθήματα ιστορίας, πολιτικής και γεωπολιτικής δεν αποδεχόμαστε από το ΑΚΕΛ
q.t: We do not accept lessons in history, politics and geopolitics from AKEL

q.o: το ΑΚΕΛ, λόγω των ιδεολογικών του αγκυλώσεων, θέλει να αφήσει την Κύπρο ανοχύρωτη, απροστάτευτη και απομονωμένη
q.t: AKEL, due to its ideological rigidity, wants to leave Cyprus unfortified, unprotected and isolated

q.o: δεν αποδεχόμαστε μαθήματα γενοκτονίας από το ΑΚΕΛ, το οποίο, πριν από λίγες ημέρες, υπερασπιζόταν τη διατήρηση του ονόματος του γενοκτόνου του Ελληνισμού, Κεμάλ Ατατούρκ, σε οδό στην Πάφο
q.t: we do not accept lessons on genocide from AKEL, which, a few days ago, was defending the retention of the name of the genocider of Hellenism, Kemal Atatürk, on a street in Paphos

q.o: όποιος είναι εχθρός της Τουρκίας και της Μουσουλμανικής Αδελφότητας αποτελεί σύμμαχο στον αγώνα του Κυπριακού Ελληνισμού για την απελευθέρωση της Πατρίδας μας
q.t: whoever is an enemy of Turkey and the Muslim Brotherhood is an ally in the struggle of Cypriot Hellenism for the liberation of our Homeland

ti: Σ. Ιωάννου: «Θέσαμε σειρά ζητημάτων για τον προϋπολογισμό του Υπουργείου Μεταφορών»
s: ELAM parliamentary spokesperson and chair of the Transport Committee raised multiple issues during the Ministry of Transport budget examination, including taxi legislation modernization, scooter regulations, public transport staffing shortages, Larnaca port and marina matters, airport compensation measures for municipalities, and subsidies for large families to purchase vehicles.

q.o: Ως Ε.ΛΑ.Μ., θέσαμε σειρά ερωτημάτων και ζητημάτων που μας απασχολούν έντονα και για τα οποία είτε καταθέσαμε προτάσεις νόμου είτε έχουν εγγραφεί αυτεπάγγελτα στην αρμόδια επιτροπή.
q.t: As ELAM, we raised a series of questions and issues that concern us intensely and for which we have either submitted legislative proposals or they have been registered ex officio in the competent committee.

q.o: Μετά τις απαντήσεις που έχουμε λάβει, θα εξετάσουμε τον προϋπολογισμό ξεχωριστά και θα κάνουμε τις αναγκαίες παρεμβάσεις κατά τη διαδικασία ψήφισής του.
q.t: After the answers we have received, we will examine the budget separately and will make the necessary interventions during the voting process.

ti: 16 Οκτωβρίου 1958: Ο Σπύρος Χατζηγιακουμής πεθαίνει από βασανιστήρια των Άγγλων
s: ELAM commemorates Spyros Chatzigiakoumis, who died on 16 October 1958 from torture by British colonial forces during the Cyprus independence struggle, describing his arrest, torture, and death with injuries including perforated legs and a shattered skull.

ti: Οφειλόμενη απάντηση στο Κομμουνιστικό Κόμμα Κύπρου
s: ELAM issued a statement criticizing AKEL (the Communist Party of Cyprus) for opposing Cyprus's Western alliances, accusing AKEL of serving Turkish interests and receiving Soviet funding, while defending cooperation with countries AKEL considers problematic.

q.o: Με άλλη μια σοβιετικού τύπου ανακοίνωση, το ΑΚΕΛ αποδεικνύει ότι θέλει την Κύπρο απομακρυσμένη και απομονωμένη από τον δυτικό κόσμο, σε μια περίοδο πλήρους γεωπολιτικής αβεβαιότητας.
q.t: With yet another Soviet-style announcement, AKEL proves that it wants Cyprus distanced and isolated from the Western world, in a period of complete geopolitical uncertainty.

q.o: Όποιος είναι εχθρός της Τουρκίας και της Μουσουλμανικής Αδελφότητας είναι σύμμαχος στον αγώνα της Κύπρου και του Ελληνισμού.
q.t: Whoever is an enemy of Turkey and the Muslim Brotherhood is an ally in the struggle of Cyprus and Hellenism.

q.o: Το ΑΚΕΛ πρέπει κάποια στιγμή να σταματήσει να εξυπηρετεί τα συμφέροντα της Τουρκίας και να βάλει έστω και τώρα πάνω από τις ιδεολογικές του εμμονές το καλό της Πατρίδας μας.
q.t: AKEL must at some point stop serving the interests of Turkey and put, even now, the good of our Homeland above its ideological obsessions.

ti: Pay The Workers: The Money is There
s: People Before Profit calls for a minimum 10% pay increase for public sector workers, arguing the government has budget surpluses and could raise additional revenue through wealth taxes and increased employer PRSI contributions to fund inflation-busting wage increases.

q.o: At a bare minimum workers need 10% now. The money is there to pay for this.
q.t: At a bare minimum workers need 10% now. The money is there to pay for this.

q.o: Between 2021 & 2025 public sector wages fell behind inflation by 5.5%.
q.t: Between 2021 & 2025 public sector wages fell behind inflation by 5.5%.

q.o: The government will run a budget surplus of €6.7b in 2026 and another €9.6b in 2027.
q.t: The government will run a budget surplus of €6.7b in 2026 and another €9.6b in 2027.

q.o: Workers need to send a clear message to their union leaders that any deal that does not deliver will not be accepted.
q.t: Workers need to send a clear message to their union leaders that any deal that does not deliver will not be accepted.

ti: Disparity for Derry. No New A&E at Altnagelvin.
s: People Before Profit Councillor Shaun Harkin criticized the Health Minister's decision not to build a new Emergency Department at Altnagelvin Hospital, calling it discrimination against Derry and the North West, and announced a special council meeting on October 26th with trade union representatives to address health service cuts and pressures.

q.o: The Health Minister's announcement that there won't be a new Altnagelvin Hospital Emergency Department continues Stormont discrimination against Derry and the North West.
q.t: The Health Minister's announcement that there won't be a new Altnagelvin Hospital Emergency Department continues Stormont discrimination against Derry and the North West.

q.o: The existing Altnagelvin A&E is the oldest 24-hour emergency facility in the North, dealing with more than double the number of patients it was originally designed to support.
q.t: The existing Altnagelvin A&E is the oldest 24-hour emergency facility in the North, dealing with more than double the number of patients it was originally designed to support.

q.o: The new Health Minister and his Stormont Executive colleagues claim there is no money to build the new Altnagelvin Emergency Department but hundreds of millions are drained out of the Health Service every year to corporations.
q.t: The new Health Minister and his Stormont Executive colleagues claim there is no money to build the new Altnagelvin Emergency Department but hundreds of millions are drained out of the Health Service every year to corporations.

ti: Workers Need At Least 10% and They Need It Now
s: People Before Profit calls on public sector workers to maintain strike pressure and hold workplace meetings on Monday to demand at least 10% pay increases, arguing that the government's €1.2 billion offer is insufficient and that further escalated action is needed.

q.o: Workers need at least 10% for the next year just to catch up and stay ahead.
q.t: Workers need at least 10% for the next year just to catch up and stay ahead.

q.o: Activists should call meetings across the public sector next week to demand the action continue until real pay increases are delivered.
q.t: Activists should call meetings across the public sector next week to demand the action continue until real pay increases are delivered.

q.o: If one day of action can soften the government's cough and make them accept that pay must be top of the agenda think of what an all-out strike could achieve.
q.t: If one day of action can soften the government's cough and make them accept that pay must be top of the agenda think of what an all-out strike could achieve.

ti: Kilmeadan Stops Data Centre - Permission Denied - Victory for People Power
s: People Before Profit celebrated the refusal of planning permission for a data centre in Kilmeadan, County Waterford, praising local campaigners and calling for international opposition to data centres which they describe as environmentally damaging and harmful to communities.

q.o: This is a blow against the tech billionaires who profit off of data centres which are a huge net harm on the communities where they are placed.
q.t: This is a blow against the tech billionaires who profit off of data centres which are a huge net harm on the communities where they are placed.

q.o: People Before Profit salute the campaigners who organised their slow-drive last week.
q.t: People Before Profit salute the campaigners who organised their slow-drive last week.

q.o: No more Data Centres. People Power works.
q.t: No more Data Centres. People Power works.

ti: “Justice Has Been Done” Won’t Wash, Says Carroll After Donaldson Sentence
s: People Before Profit's Carroll criticised the DUP's response to Jeffrey Donaldson's sentencing for child abuse, calling for proper funding of Women's Aid and rape crisis services and a grassroots movement to end gender-based violence.

q.o: My thoughts today are first and foremost with the women who suffered at the hands of Jeffrey Donaldson. They were children when he abused them, carried that pain and suffering for decades and then went through a gruelling trial, both in the courtroom and by the media.
q.t: My thoughts today are first and foremost with the women who suffered at the hands of Jeffrey Donaldson. They were children when he abused them, carried that pain and suffering for decades and then went through a gruelling trial, both in the courtroom and by the media.

q.o: The DUP's line today that 'justice has been done' simply won't wash. Abuse that went unpunished for up to four decades is not proof that the system works.
q.t: The DUP's line today that 'justice has been done' simply won't wash. Abuse that went unpunished for up to four decades is not proof that the system works.

q.o: Meaningful justice will take far more than one high-profile sentence. It means properly funding Women's Aid and rape crisis services so women aren't turned away from essential services.
q.t: Meaningful justice will take far more than one high-profile sentence. It means properly funding Women's Aid and rape crisis services so women aren't turned away from essential services.

ti: We need to keep the pressure up: “This government needs their balls squeezed”
s: People Before Profit reports on public sector workers' strike action demanding pay increases above the government's proposed 3.5%, with union membership in one workplace tripling to 80% and workers linking cost of living pressures to the Middle East war and climate impacts.

q.o: This government needs their balls squeezed
q.t: This government needs their balls squeezed

q.o: The response was overwhelmingly positive. Only one person in our office had been on strike before in 2009 so this was the first time for most of us.
q.t: The response was overwhelmingly positive. Only one person in our office had been on strike before in 2009 so this was the first time for most of us.

q.o: In the budget they mentioned €1.2 billion which would be a 3.5% increase. In the weeks before the budget a figure of €2billion had been mentioned. Even this would only be 5.8% which still isn't enough.
q.t: In the budget they mentioned €1.2 billion which would be a 3.5% increase. In the weeks before the budget a figure of €2billion had been mentioned. Even this would only be 5.8% which still isn't enough.

ti: Save Edmonstown Sorting Office - PROTEST Saturday at Noon, Edmonstown Roundabout, Rathfarnham
s: People Before Profit TD Paul Murphy urged people to attend a protest on Saturday 17th October at noon at Edmonstown Roundabout to oppose the proposed relocation of Edmonstown sorting office from Rathfarnham to Lucan, citing concerns about service quality and worker disruption.

q.o: This proposal to move the sorting office from Edmonstown to Lucan makes no sense for the people of Rathfarnham, Knocklyon and Whitechurch. Travelling to Edmondstown is already a challenge for many residents - the idea that they would now have to make their way to Lucan just to collect a parcel is absurd.
q.t: This proposal to move the sorting office from Edmonstown to Lucan makes no sense for the people of Rathfarnham, Knocklyon and Whitechurch. Travelling to Edmondstown is already a challenge for many residents - the idea that they would now have to make their way to Lucan just to collect a parcel is absurd.

q.o: The workers at the Edmondstown sorting office have dedicated years, even decades of service to this community. Their jobs, their commutes, and their work-life balance would all be severely disrupted by this decision. They deserve better.
q.t: The workers at the Edmondstown sorting office have dedicated years, even decades of service to this community. Their jobs, their commutes, and their work-life balance would all be severely disrupted by this decision. They deserve better.

ti: Brilliant Display of Worker Power and Solidarity
s: People Before Profit members participated in public sector strike pickets across Ireland, with the party calling for escalation to all-out strike action and demanding at least 10% pay increases in 2027 plus back payment for 2026 to address inflation.

q.o: Between 2021 & 2025 public sector wages fell behind inflation by 5.5%. In 2026 workers got 2% for the first half of the year: inflation is now 4.1%
q.t: Between 2021 & 2025 public sector wages fell behind inflation by 5.5%. In 2026 workers got 2% for the first half of the year: inflation is now 4.1%

q.o: Workers need at least 10% just to catch up and stay ahead.
q.t: Workers need at least 10% just to catch up and stay ahead.

q.o: To really win the action should be continued until the government give a clear commitment to meet the pay demand of the workers. That means calling an all-out strike and major rallies to really disrupt the country
q.t: To really win the action should be continued until the government give a clear commitment to meet the pay demand of the workers. That means calling an all-out strike and major rallies to really disrupt the country

q.o: We have a great opportunity to strike a blow against an anti-worker right wing government and to energise and rebuild our movement.
q.t: We have a great opportunity to strike a blow against an anti-worker right wing government and to energise and rebuild our movement.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: The Portuguese Communist Party proposes an 80-euro increase in all pensions and the Solidarity Supplement for the Elderly starting January 1st, a 5% minimum increase, raising minimum pension values, creating two new tiers for longer contributory careers, and calculating the Solidarity Supplement individually rather than penalizing couples.

q.o: O PCP defende que a partir de 1 de Janeiro todas as reformas e pensões tenham um aumento de 5% com um mínimo de 80 euros.
q.t: The PCP defends that from January 1st all pensions have an increase of 5% with a minimum of 80 euros.

q.o: É preciso denunciar a falsidade dos argumentos do Governo segundo os quais não é possível avançar com aumentos substanciais das reformas pensões, porque é preciso preservar o equilíbrio financeiro da Segurança Social.
q.t: It is necessary to denounce the falsity of the Government's arguments according to which it is not possible to advance with substantial increases in pensions, because it is necessary to preserve the financial balance of Social Security.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: Paulo Raimundo delivered a parliamentary interpellation on 16 October 2026 criticizing government policy on housing, wages, healthcare, education, and privatization, and calling for participation in a CGTP demonstration the following day.

q.o: O PCP avança hoje com esta interpelação com o objectivo de debater a realidade da vida, na falta de respostas às dificuldades e aos problemas crescentes, uma interpelação de confronto com uma política errada que precisa de ser travada.
q.t: The PCP advances today with this interpellation with the objective of debating the reality of life, in the absence of responses to growing difficulties and problems, an interpellation confronting a wrong policy that needs to be stopped.

q.o: Como estaria o País se em vez de uma política egoísta, violenta e ao serviço da especulação imobiliária e dos especuladores, onde rendas de 2300 euros são consideradas moderadas, houvesse uma verdadeira política de habitação?
q.t: How would the country be if instead of a selfish, violent policy serving real estate speculation and speculators, where rents of 2300 euros are considered moderate, there was a true housing policy?

q.o: Qual seria a realidade da imensa maioria dos reformados se as suas reformas fossem aumentadas em 5% no mínimo em 80 euros já no próximo ano, tal como vai propor o PCP e que não só é possível como é urgente.
q.t: What would be the reality of the vast majority of retirees if their pensions were increased by 5%, at least 80 euros, already next year, as the PCP will propose and which is not only possible but urgent.

q.o: É verdade que o problema são as opções de um Governo do PSD e CDS que compromete o presente e o futuro do País e daqueles como o Chega e a IL que o apoiam e do PS que viabiliza a política do Governo.
q.t: It is true that the problem is the choices of a PSD and CDS Government that compromises the present and future of the country and those like Chega and IL who support it and the PS that enables the Government's policy.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: PCP Secretary-General Paulo Raimundo delivered a speech on 15 October 2026 in Amadora condemning the 2027 State Budget as an assault on workers' lives, calling for mobilisation including demonstrations on 17 October in Porto, Coimbra and Lisbon, and opposing the privatisation of TAP to Lufthansa.

q.o: estamos perante um assalto. Cada um que reflicta, cada um que olhe para trás e veja se há ou não uns poucos que, independentemente de pandemias, guerras, frio ou calor, chuva ou nevoeiro, concentram sempre mais riqueza à custa dos muitos que pagam sempre a factura.
q.t: we are facing an assault. Let each one reflect, let each one look back and see whether or not there are a few who, regardless of pandemics, wars, cold or heat, rain or fog, always concentrate more wealth at the expense of the many who always pay the bill.

q.o: o Orçamento do Estado é um instrumento deste assalto em curso, é um frete ao capital e um desastre para o País.
q.t: the State Budget is an instrument of this ongoing assault, it is a gift to capital and a disaster for the Country.

q.o: privatizar a TAP é uma decisão antipatriótica e um crime económico de que PSD, CDS, Chega, IL e PS são responsáveis.
q.t: privatising TAP is an unpatriotic decision and an economic crime for which PSD, CDS, Chega, IL and PS are responsible.

q.o: o aumento geral dos salários, de todos os salários e do Salário Mínimo Nacional para 1100 euros em 1 de Janeiro de 2027, 150 euros para todos os trabalhadores, é esta a estabilidade nos salários que se exige.
q.t: the general increase in wages, all wages and the National Minimum Wage to 1100 euros on 1 January 2027, 150 euros for all workers, this is the wage stability that is demanded.

q.o: é preciso um aumento de 5% para todos os reformados sem excepção, garantindo sempre um valor mínimo de 80 euros
q.t: a 5% increase is needed for all pensioners without exception, always guaranteeing a minimum value of 80 euros

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: Paula Santos of the Portuguese Communist Party delivered a parliamentary intervention criticizing the government's Single Social Benefit (Prestação Social Única) proposal, arguing it perpetuates rather than combats poverty.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
ac: Direcção da Organização Regional do Porto do PCP
s: The Portuguese Communist Party's Porto Regional Directorate condemned police intervention against housing rights protesters in Praça D. João I and called for participation in a CGTP demonstration on Saturday, criticizing the PSD/CDS government's housing policy as serving speculators.

q.o: A crescente dificuldade de acesso à Habitação é uma das mais vincadas expressões de políticas antisociais e antipatrióticas deste Governo PSD/CDS, apoiada por CH e IL.
q.t: The growing difficulty of access to Housing is one of the most marked expressions of antisocial and antipatriotic policies of this PSD/CDS Government, supported by CH and IL.
q.sp: Direcção da Organização Regional do Porto do PCP

q.o: O Governo está a actuar como especulador imobiliário destruindo a vida de milhares de famílias e não como o garante do direito à Habitação como determina a Constituição.
q.t: The Government is acting as a real estate speculator destroying the lives of thousands of families and not as the guarantor of the right to Housing as determined by the Constitution.
q.sp: Direcção da Organização Regional do Porto do PCP

q.o: A forma como as forças policiais intervieram é desproporcional e incompreensível, a exigir um cabal apuramento, incluindo responsabilidades políticas.
q.t: The way in which police forces intervened is disproportionate and incomprehensible, requiring a thorough investigation, including political responsibilities.
q.sp: Direcção da Organização Regional do Porto do PCP

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: Paula Santos of the Portuguese Communist Party delivered a parliamentary speech on 14 October 2026 criticizing the government's housing policies, accusing it of facilitating evictions and rent increases while the PCP presented legislative initiatives to protect tenants and increase public housing.

q.o: Para este Governo é expulsando os inquilinos de casa e aumentando as rendas que se defende a Habitação!
q.t: For this Government, it is by evicting tenants from their homes and increasing rents that Housing is defended!

q.o: O Governo está a atuar como especulador imobiliário e não como o garante do direito à habitação como determina a Constituição.
q.t: The Government is acting as a real estate speculator and not as the guarantor of the right to housing as determined by the Constitution.

q.o: Contarão com a ação e luta dos trabalhadores, dos reformados, da juventude, das populações contra estas opções do Governo que negam o direito à habitação.
q.t: They will count on the action and struggle of workers, retirees, youth, and populations against these Government options that deny the right to housing.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: The Portuguese Communist Party condemned the government's decision to sell 49.9% of TAP airline to Lufthansa for 1.201 billion euros, calling it an economic crime and antipatriotic decision, and pledged to take parliamentary initiatives to reverse the privatization.

q.o: O Governo anunciou hoje que foi a Lufthansa quem ganhou o processo de privatização da TAP, preparando-se agora esta para tomar o controlo da TAP e de 49,9% do seu capital. Esta decisão, na sequência de outras tentativas de privatização da TAP realizadas ao longo dos anos, é um crime contra a economia nacional que pode e deve ser travado.
q.t: The Government announced today that Lufthansa won the TAP privatization process, now preparing to take control of TAP and 49.9% of its capital. This decision, following other attempts to privatize TAP over the years, is a crime against the national economy that can and must be stopped.

q.o: O Governo decidiu vender a maior empresa do País, por uma verba inferior – 1201 milhões de euros - àquilo que todos os anos oferece em benefícios fiscais ao grande capital.
q.t: The Government decided to sell the country's largest company for an amount – 1,201 million euros – lower than what it offers annually in tax benefits to big capital.

q.o: A privatização da TAP é uma decisão antipatriótica, é um ataque aos direitos dos trabalhadores, à soberania nacional, é uma ameaça ao desenvolvimento do País.
q.t: The privatization of TAP is an antipatriotic decision, it is an attack on workers' rights, on national sovereignty, it is a threat to the country's development.

q.o: O PCP apela à luta dos trabalhadores e de todos os patriotas para travarem a privatização da TAP. Ao mesmo tempo o PCP tomará todas as iniciativas que estiverem ao seu alcance, designadamente na Assembleia da República, para reverter, assim que seja possível, esta inaceitável decisão.
q.t: The PCP calls on workers and all patriots to fight to stop the privatization of TAP. At the same time, the PCP will take all initiatives within its reach, particularly in the Assembly of the Republic, to reverse this unacceptable decision as soon as possible.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: Paula Santos, President of the PCP Parliamentary Group, announced the party will vote against the 2027 State Budget proposal, criticizing it as favoring capital over workers through low wages, public service cuts, and tax benefits for corporations, while the Socialist Party's support enables the government's anti-social agenda.

q.o: A proposta de Orçamento do Estado para 2027 é um frete ao capital e um desastre para o País.
q.t: The 2027 State Budget proposal is a gift to capital and a disaster for the Country.

q.o: Esta proposta de orçamento merece a rejeição, a denúncia e o combate do PCP.
q.t: This budget proposal deserves the rejection, denunciation and opposition of the PCP.

q.o: Para o PCP, esta proposta só pode ter um voto, o voto contra.
q.t: For the PCP, this proposal can only have one vote, the vote against.

q.o: O Governo quer limitar o SMN aos 970€ em 2027, quando em Espanha esse valor ultrapassou os 1220€ em 2026.
q.t: The Government wants to limit the minimum wage to 970€ in 2027, when in Spain that value exceeded 1220€ in 2026.

ti: Conseil fédéral: Céline Amaudruz vise le siège de Guy Parmelin - rts.ch
s: Céline Amaudruz is targeting Guy Parmelin's seat on the Federal Council.

ti: Alors qu’Annemasse est sous les balles, Genève inaugure le tram 17
s: The Geneva Citizens' Movement deposited a motion demanding increased police presence at border crossings and tram 17 stops, citing drug-related violence in neighboring French towns including shootings in Annemasse and Gaillard, and criticizing the canton's celebration of the tram extension without security measures.

q.o: A deux semaines seulement de la votation, les faits divers transfrontaliers continuent de se succéder et les gros titres font froid dans le dos.
q.t: Just two weeks before the vote, cross-border incidents continue to occur one after another and the headlines are chilling.

q.o: Le MCG était le seul parti à alerter la population contre le risque de créer un lien direct, rapide et permanent entre des quartiers à haut risque et Genève.
q.t: The MCG was the only party to alert the population to the risk of creating a direct, rapid and permanent link between high-risk neighborhoods and Geneva.

q.o: La sécurité des Genevois ne peut pas attendre le prochain fait divers. Il faut agir maintenant, pas après.
q.t: The security of Genevans cannot wait for the next incident. We must act now, not after.

ti: FAQ – Initiative pour la priorité au logement à Genève
s: The Geneva Citizens' Movement is collecting signatures for a cantonal legislative initiative requiring subsidized housing applicants to have resided in Geneva for 5 consecutive years out of the last 10 (instead of 4 out of 8), with a deadline of December 8, 2026 to gather 4,272 valid signatures.

q.o: En 2022, les Genevois ont soutenu une loi du MCG pour renforcer la priorité aux personnes qui habitent à Genève. Pourtant, le Conseil d'État a ensuite introduit des exceptions et des dérogations qui permettent de contourner cette règle, sans nouvelle décision du peuple ni accord du Parlement.
q.t: In 2022, Geneva residents supported an MCG law to strengthen priority for people who live in Geneva. However, the State Council then introduced exceptions and derogations that allow this rule to be circumvented, without a new decision by the people or agreement from Parliament.

q.o: Nous voulons modifier la loi pour que les personnes qui demandent un logement subventionné aient résidé à Genève pendant 5 années consécutives au cours des 10 dernières années, au lieu de 4 années sur les 8 dernières.
q.t: We want to modify the law so that people applying for subsidized housing have resided in Geneva for 5 consecutive years out of the last 10 years, instead of 4 years out of the last 8.

s: Fascist groups targeted the offices of Jewish-Arab leftists in Tel Aviv, according to a report by In Defense of Communism.

q.t: Not a Zionist, or religious

ti: «Il y a des millions de Français qui sont en colère, mais qui ne cassent rien, ne pillent rien» : Marine Le Pen réagit aux violences du 17 octobre - CNews
s: Marine Le Pen issued a public statement responding to violence that occurred on October 17th, contrasting millions of angry French citizens who do not engage in destruction or looting.

q.o: Il y a des millions de Français qui sont en colère, mais qui ne cassent rien, ne pillent rien
q.t: There are millions of French people who are angry, but who break nothing, loot nothing

s: A figure described as France's hard-Right mastermind stated that France needs 'shock therapy', according to The Telegraph.

s: Dutch lawmakers are pressing the Cabinet to provide financial rescue for a nearly bankrupt seal center in Lauwersoog.

ti: ÖVP-„Herbst der Ergebnisse“ wird zum eiskalten sozialen Winter
s: FPÖ General Secretaries Schnedlitz and Hafenecker criticized the ÖVP-SPÖ-NEOS coalition's announced policy measures as inadequate PR stunts, attacking a proposed one-time 500 euro bonus, social welfare reform, and media funding package, while calling for new elections and a government led by Herbert Kickl.

q.o: reine PR-Show und durchschaubares Ablenkungsmanöver vom eigenen Chaos und Totalversagen
q.t: pure PR show and transparent diversionary maneuver from their own chaos and total failure

q.o: politische Brosamen, die die massiven Probleme in unserem Land nicht einmal ansatzweise lösen können
q.t: political crumbs that cannot even begin to solve the massive problems in our country

q.o: Seit Jahren warnen wir Freiheitliche vor dem Missbrauch unseres Sozialsystems durch die Massenzuwanderung. Was es braucht, ist eine Unterscheidung zwischen Steuerzahlern und jenen, die nie einen Cent in unser System eingezahlt haben.
q.t: For years we Freedom Party members have been warning about the abuse of our social system through mass immigration. What is needed is a distinction between taxpayers and those who have never paid a cent into our system.

q.o: Mit 50 Millionen Euro für den Medienstandort wird nichts anderes gemacht, als die regierungsfreundlichen Systemmedien mit Steuergeld zu füttern, damit sie weiterhin unkritisch über das Totalversagen dieser Koalition berichten.
q.t: With 50 million euros for the media sector, nothing else is being done than feeding the government-friendly system media with tax money so that they continue to report uncritically about the total failure of this coalition.

q.o: Österreich braucht keine Almosen, sondern eine Festung Österreich und eine Politik, die wieder für die eigene Bevölkerung da ist. Das wird es nur mit einem Volkskanzler Herbert Kickl geben!
q.t: Austria does not need alms, but a Fortress Austria and a policy that is there again for its own population. That will only happen with a People's Chancellor Herbert Kickl!

ti: Regierung bestätigt Handlungsunfähigkeit mit „Schuss-in-den-Ofen-Gipfel“
s: FPÖ party leader Herbert Kickl criticized the government's press conference following the FPÖ's motion of no confidence, calling it a "shot-in-the-foot summit" that offers empty future promises instead of immediate relief for families struggling with the cost of living.

q.o: Das war heute nichts anderes als ein ‚Schuss-in-den-Ofen-Gipfel' dieser Regierung. Wer im ,Hier und Jetzt' keine Lösungen hat, verlegt die angebliche Handlungskompetenz weit in die Zukunft, verspricht Dinge, die noch dazu für keinen lebenden Österreicher, auch nicht für die Kleinsten, gelten und die dann aus irgendwelchen Gründen in achtzehn Jahren dann wahrscheinlich erst recht wieder nicht kommen – auch nicht für all jene, die erst geboren werden. Dabei bräuchte es Lösungen im ‚Hier und Jetzt' und zwar sofort
q.t: That was nothing other than a 'shot-in-the-foot summit' by this government today. Those who have no solutions in the 'here and now' shift their supposed competence to act far into the future, promising things that don't even apply to any living Austrian, not even the youngest, and which for some reason probably won't come in eighteen years either – not even for all those who are yet to be born. What we need are solutions in the 'here and now' and immediately

q.o: Vielleicht hat man bei ÖVP, SPÖ und NEOS noch nicht bemerkt, dass viele Menschen gar kein Geld mehr zum Sparen haben, sondern vielmehr ums Überleben kämpfen.
q.t: Perhaps the ÖVP, SPÖ and NEOS have not yet noticed that many people no longer have any money to save, but are rather fighting for survival.

q.o: Die Verlierer-Ampel ist aber in allen Bereichen auch heute wieder Antworten schuldig geblieben.
q.t: But the loser traffic-light coalition has once again failed to provide answers in all areas today.

q.o: In Wahrheit ist diese Regierung mit dieser Nicht-Performance und absolut fehlenden Handlungsfähigkeit rücktrittsreifer denn je. ‚Die Frucht des Rücktritts' ist nicht reif, sondern fault schon regelrecht!
q.t: In truth, this government with this non-performance and absolutely lacking ability to act is more ready for resignation than ever. 'The fruit of resignation' is not ripe, but is already literally rotting!

ti: Tiroler ÖVP lässt Stocker fallen
s: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz criticized the Tyrolean ÖVP's plan to introduce a separate regional membership independent of the federal ÖVP, calling it a sign of the party's disintegration under Chancellor Stocker and demanding immediate new elections with Herbert Kickl as candidate for chancellor.

q.o: Wenn Landesorganisationen wie jene in Tirol beginnen, sich auch schon organisatorisch von der Bundespartei abzukoppeln, dann weiß jeder, dass das Schiff der ÖVP am Sinken ist. Kanzler Stocker ist nur mehr ein Kapitän auf Abruf, dem die eigene Mannschaft die Gefolgschaft verweigert und der sich beharrlich an die Macht klammert
q.t: When regional organizations like the one in Tyrol begin to organizationally decouple themselves from the federal party, then everyone knows that the ÖVP ship is sinking. Chancellor Stocker is merely a captain on probation, whose own crew refuses to follow him and who stubbornly clings to power

q.o: Der einzige Weg dahin führt über die Wahlurne, wo die Österreicher mit einem klaren Votum für die FPÖ und einen Volkskanzler Herbert Kickl den Systemwechsel einleiten können!
q.t: The only way there is through the ballot box, where Austrians can initiate a system change with a clear vote for the FPÖ and a people's chancellor Herbert Kickl!

s: A far-right politician was involved in an altercation with Belgian-Moroccan wedding guests in Belgium.
